contributorNote: Somali (Af-Soomaali) vocabulary compiled from R. N. Cust (1883), Rev. Fr. Evangelist de Larajasse (1897 "Somali-English and English-Somali Dictionary", Kegan Paul, Trench, Trübner & Co., London — audited 100% line-by-line across Front Matter, Preface pp. v–xiii, Abbreviations p. xiv, 20-row Kenya Reference Table [Swahili sawaheli/sawahili, Ogaden & Darod dialect wa debai, Galla daba galla, East African antelopes si‘g, garanug/lig, adéryo/adéryo ‘ari/godir, b‘e‘id/bi‘‘id, sagaro/sakaro, and rubiad/rubod/rubi currency], and Full Two-Column Page Transcriptions of pp. 26, 123, 127, 242, 266 & 293), Sir Harry H. Johnston (1902), Lt. J. W. C. Kirk (1903 "Notes on the Somali Language", 1905 "A Grammar of the Somali Language"), BFBS (1921), Morgan Nilsson (2016), Wendell Kimper et al. (2019), and Anna M. DiGarbo & Rose Stamp (2019). Expanded and cross-verified with Commercially Permissive Datasets (The Thiomi Dataset Somali (CC-BY-4.0), Google SMOL/GATITOS (en_som, CC-BY-4.0), African Next Voices Maxatire Somali (CC-BY-4.0), DDD Kenyan Somali (CC-BY-4.0), Language Science Press Somali & Marka Corpora (2016/2019, CC-BY-4.0), CLDF Tsammalex & ASJP v20 (CC-BY-4.0), Kaikki.org Somali (CC-BY-SA-4.0)). Further enriched with attested Somali customary-law, clan, pastoral, and maritime terms from Major H. Rayne (1921) 'Sun, Sand and Somals' (Project Gutenberg #48598, US Public Domain).

entries.english: Ram looked at me in surprise "What do you mean?" he asked "My sculptures are a celebration of life."

entries.english: "No," I said "They are a denial of it. They are a way of keeping people from experiencing the real world.

entries.english: Your skin is your largest organ, and it's important to take care of it both inside and out. Here are some tips for healthy skin:

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Drink plenty of water: Water is essential for healthy skin, as it helps to keep your skin hydrated and soft. Aim to drink eight glasses of water per day.
entries.translation: * Cab biyo badan: Biyaha muhiim ayeey u yihiin caafimadka maqaarka, waayo waxa ay kaa cawinayaan inuu qoynaado oo jilicsanaado maqaarkaaga. Hadaf ka dhigo inaad cabtid sideed galaas oo biya ah malinkii.

entries.english: * Eat a healthy diet: Eating a healthy diet rich in fruits, vegetables, and whole grains can help to improve your skin's appearance.

entries.english: * Protect your skin from the sun: The sun's UV rays can damage your skin and lead to premature aging, wrinkles, and skin cancer.

entries.english: “I don’t know,” Mum says. “But it’s big and it’s coming this way.”
entries.translation: "Ma garanaayo" Ayeey Hooyo tiri. "Laakiin way weyn tahay dhankaan ayayna usoo socotaa".
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dad gets up from the couch.
entries.translation: Aabe fadhiga ayuu kasoo kacay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: “We need to get out of here,” he says.
entries.translation: "Waxaan u baahannahay inaan meshaan ka tagno," ayuu yiri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We all run for the front door.
entries.translation: Kuligeen waxaan u cararnay albaabka hore
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mum unlocks it and we rush outside.
entries.translation: Hooyo ayaa furtay waxaana u cararnay banankan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The creature is right behind us.
entries.translation: Abuurka ayaa naga dambeeya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It’s so close I can feel its hot breath on the back of my neck.
entries.translation: Aad ayuu noogu dhawaa waan daremayay neeftisa kulul ee luqunta gadasheeda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We run to the car and get in.
entries.translation: Waxaan u cararnay gaariga oona galnay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dad starts the engine and we peel out of the driveway.
entries.translation: Aabe ayaa kiciyay gaariga waxaana ku cararnay dhinacaas iyo wadad.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The creature chases after us, but we’re too fast.
entries.translation: Abuurka ayaa nasoo daba bursaday, laakin aad ayaan u dheeraynaynay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Movies have long been a powerful force in shaping our culture and our values.
entries.translation: Filimaanta waxay muddo dheer ahaayeen kuwa awood xoogan taasoo qaabaysa dhaqankeena, iyo qiyamkeena.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can influence our beliefs about everything from love and romance to war and violence.
entries.translation: Waxay nagu dhiiri galin karaan waxaan aaminsanahay laga bilabo jacayl, muxubo ilaa dagal iyo gacan ka hadal.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And they have a particularly strong influence on our ideas about gender roles.
entries.translation: Waxayna si gaar ah saamayn xoogan ugu leeyihin fikradaheena ku saabsan doorka jinsiga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For decades, Hollywood has perpetuated the stereotype of the ideal wife as a beautiful, submissive, and domestic woman who puts her husband and children first.
entries.translation: Muddo qarniyo ah, Hollywood waxay sii waday fikradda xaaska ku habboon inay tahay haweeney qurux badan, hogaansan, iyo naag guri taasoo hormarisa ninkeeda iyo caruurteeda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This image is often reinforced by the way that female characters are portrayed in movies.
entries.translation: Sawirkaan waxaa inta badan lagu xoojiyaa sida jilayaasha dumarka ah loogu muujiyo filimaanta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The majority of female characters were portrayed as either romantic interests or mothers.
entries.translation: Inta badan jilayaasha dumarka waxaa lagu muujiyay kuwa yinxiisaynaya muxibo ama hooyoo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This narrow representation of women in film sends a powerful message to viewers about what it means to be a woman.
entries.translation: Matalaadaan ciriiriga ah ee dumarka ku jira filimka waxa ay fariin xoogan u diraysaa daawadayaasha oo ku saabsan waxa ay ka macno tahay inaad dumar tahay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It suggests that women's primary role is to be attractive and nurturing, and that their success is measured by their relationships with men and children.
entries.translation: Waxay soo jeedinaysaa in doorka koowaad ee haweenku yahay soo jiidashada iyo barbaarinta, iyo in gushoda lagu cabbiro xirirka ay la leeyihiin ragga iyo carruurta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This idealized image of the wife can be harmful to women in several ways.
entries.translation: Sawirkaan ku habboon ee xaaska wuxuu waxyeelo ugu gaysan karaa haweenka dhowr siyaabood.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Doctor, I've been having this terrible stomach pain for the past few days.
entries.translation: Bukaanka: Dhakhtar, waxaan dareemayay calool xanuunkaan daran dhowrkii maalmood ee lasoo dhaafay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's so bad that I can't eat or sleep.
entries.translation: Aad ayay u xun tahay inaan waxba cuni karin ama seexan karin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's a sharp, stabbing pain that comes and goes.
entries.translation: Waa xanuun oodin ah, oo imudaayo oo marna i qabanaayo marna idaynaayo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Can you tell me more about the pain? Where is it located?
entries.translation: Dhakhtar: Ma isheegi kartaa wax badan oo sabsan xanuunka? xagee ka dareemee?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: It's mostly in my lower abdomen, right around my belly button, but it sometimes radiates to my back.
entries.translation: Bukaanka: Waxay u badan tahay qaybta hoose ee caloosha, wareegga xundhurtayda, laakin mar mar wuxu u wareegaa dhabarka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Does anything make the pain worse?
entries.translation: ?Dhakhtar: Wax xanuunka kasi darsinaayo miyaa jiro
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Eating seems to make it worse, especially fatty or greasy foods.
entries.translation: Bukaanka: Cunista ayaa kaga sii darayso, gaar ahaan cuntada dufanka leh.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: And does anything make it better.?
entries.translation: Dhakhtarka: Wax aad kaga roonaanayso miyaa jirta.?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Lying down seems to help a little.
entries.translation: Bukaanka: Markaan seexdo ayaa xoogaa iyara cawiso
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Does the pain come and go, or is it constant?
entries.translation: Dhakhtarka: Xanunka ma mid marna ku qabto marna ku daayaa ah, ama waa mid joogto ah?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: It's constant. It's just a dull ache, but it's really uncomfortable.
entries.translation: Bukaanka: Waa joogto. Wa xanuun dansan, laakiin runtii aan raaxa hayn.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Have you had any other symptoms? Nausea, vomiting, diarrhea?
entries.translation: Dhakhtarka: Wax kaloo calamada ah ma leedahay? Lalabo, matag, shuba?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: No, just the pain.
entries.translation: Bukaanka: Maya, kaliya xanuun.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: I see. Well, it sounds like you're having a case of gastritis.
entries.translation: Dhakhtarka: Waan arkaa. Hagaag, waxay u muuqataa inaad qabto gaas.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Gastritis is inflammation of the stomach lining.
entries.translation: Gaaska waa hur caloosha dhabarkeeda ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It can be caused by a number of things, including eating spicy or fatty foods, drinking alcohol, or taking certain medications.
entries.translation: Waxaa sababi kara dhowr waxyaabood, ay ku jiraan cunista cuntooyinka basbaaska ama saliida leh, cabida khamriga, ama qaadashada dawooyinka qaarkood.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Is it serious?
entries.translation: Bukaanka: Ma dhab baa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: It can be, but in most cases it's not.
entries.translation: Dhakhtarka: Way noqon kartaa, laakiin inta badan ma aha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm going to prescribe you some medication to help relieve the pain and inflammation.
entries.translation: Waxaan kuu qorayaa daawoyin kaa caawinaya inay kaa yareeyaan xanuunka iyo hurka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You should also avoid eating spicy or fatty foods, and drink plenty of fluids.
entries.translation: Waa inaad sidoo kale iska ilaalisaa cunista cuntooyinka basbaaska iyo dufanka leh, oodna cabtaa sharaab badan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ingredients:
entries.translation: Waxa ay ka kooban tahay:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * 1 cup all-purpose flour
entries.translation: *1 koob oo burka siyabaha kala duwan loo isticmaalo ah
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * 1 cup almond flour
entries.translation: *1 koob oo burka almoonka ah
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * 1/2 cup granulated sugar
entries.translation: koob oo sokor budo ah 1/2 *
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * 1/4 cup packed light brown sugar
entries.translation: *1/4 koob sokorta bunniga qafiifka ah ee sijilaysan
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * 1/2 teaspoon baking powder
entries.translation: * 1/2 qaando fixiso ah
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * 1/4 teaspoon baking soda
entries.translation: qamiir 1/4 qaado ah *
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * 1/4 teaspoon salt
entries.translation: cusbo 1/4 qaado ah*
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, at room temperature
entries.translation: 1/2 koob (1 ul) subag aan cusbayn, heerkulka qolka*
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * 1 large egg
entries.translation: 1 ukun oo weyn*
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * 1 large egg yolk
entries.translation: 1 xabo ukunta jalaha ah*
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * 1 teaspoon almond extract
entries.translation: * 1 qaado salida almoonka lag soo saaray
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * 1/2 cup milk
entries.translation: * koob 1/2 oo caano ah
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Instructions:
entries.translation: Tilmaamo:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease and flour an 8-inch round cake pan.
entries.translation: 1. Ku kululee foornada ilaa 350 darajo F (175 darajo C). Dufan iyo bur mari digsiga keega wareeg ah oo 8-inch ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 2. In a medium bowl, whisk together the flours, granulated sugar, brown sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
entries.translation: 2. Baaquli dhexe, iskula qas bur, sokor shiidan, sokorta bunniga ah, qamiir iyo fixiso, iyo cusbo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 3. In a large bowl, cream together the butter and egg until light and fluffy. Beat in the egg yolk and almond extract.
entries.translation: 3. Baaquli weyn, iskula qas dhammaan subagga iyo ukunta ilaa kululato oo dhalasho. Garaac ukunta jaalaha iyo almoonka lasoo habeeyay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 4. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, alternating with the milk. Mix until just combined.
entries.translation: 4. Si tartiib ah ugu dar maadooyinka qalallan maadooyinka qoyan, ku gadi caano. Isku qas ilaa ay isku darsamaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 5. Fold in the almond flour until evenly distributed.
entries.translation: 5. Isku lab burka almoonka ilaa ay isku dhex milmaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a hot summer day in July when I finally turned 16 years old.
entries.translation: Waxay ahayd maalin kulul oo xagaag ah ee Luulyo markii ugu damabeyntii aan noqday 16 sano jir.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I had been eagerly anticipating this day for as long as I could remember, and now that it was finally here, I couldn't wait to get started on my road to freedom.
entries.translation: Waxaan si aad ah u sugayay maalintaan ilaa inta aan xasuusan karo, haddana hadda oo ay ugu dambeyntii timid,waan sugi kari waayey inaan bilowdo wadadayda xorriyadda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The first step was to take the written test.
entries.translation: Tallaabada ugu horeysay waxay ahayd inaan sameeyo imtixaanka qoraalka ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I studied hard for weeks, and I was confident that I would pass.
entries.translation: Aad ayaan u akhriyay todobaadyo, waxaana ku kalsoonaa in aa baasi doono.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: On the day of the test, I arrived at the DMV early and took my seat in the waiting room.
entries.translation: Maalintii imtixaanka, waxaan imid DMV goor hore oo aan kursigayga ku fadhiistay qolka sugitaanka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After a few hours, my name was called, and I was ushered into a small room with a computer.
entries.translation: Saacado yar ka dib, magacayga ayaa la wacay, waxaana la i geeyay qol yar oo kombuyuutar leh.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The test was surprisingly easy, and I finished it in no time.
entries.translation: Imtixaanka si la yaab leh ayuu u fududaa, waxaana ku dhammeeyey wakhti yar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A few days later, I received a letter in the mail informing me that I had passed the written test.
entries.translation: Dhowr maalmood ka dib, waxaa la iigu soo diray warqad boostada oo igu wargelinaysay in aan imtixaanka qoraalka ahaa ka soo gudbay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The next step was to schedule a driving test.
entries.translation: Tallaabada xigtay waxay ahayd in la qorsheeyo imtixaanka wadista.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I called the DMV and made an appointment for the following week.
entries.translation: Waxaan wacay DMV waxaana ballan ka qabsadey usbuuca soo socda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The day of my driving test arrived, and I was more nervous than I had ever been in my life.
entries.translation: Maalintii imtixaan wadista ayaa timid, waxaana ka walwalsanaa in ka badan sidii aan waligay nolashayda ahaan jiray.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I drove to the DMV with my mom, who would be accompanying me on the test.
entries.translation: Waxaan aadnay DMV aniga iyo hooyaday taas oo ii raaci kartay imtixaanka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Heartbreak," sighed the poet, "is the cruelest of afflictions.
entries.translation: "Qalbi jab," ayuu taahay gabaygii, "waa kan ugu naxariis daran ee dhibaatooyinka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a pain that pierces the soul and leaves us feeling empty and alone.
entries.translation: Waa xanuun waxa nafta dalooliya oo nooga taga inaan dareenno marnaan iyo kali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a fire that burns from within, consuming us with its flames.
entries.translation: Waa dab ka gubanaya gudaha, oo nagu baabi'inayo ololkiisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a storm that tears us apart, leaving us broken and scarred.
entries.translation: Waa duufaan na kala jeexjeexaysa, oo nooga tagaysa jajab iyo nabarro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But even in the midst of our heartbreak, there is hope.
entries.translation: Laakiin xitaa qalbi jabka dhexdiisa, rajo ayaa jirta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For even as our hearts are broken, they are also made new.

entries.english: Albert Einstein was a German-born theoretical physicist who developed the theory of relativity, one of the two pillars of modern physics (alongside quantum mechanics).
entries.translation: Albert Einstein wuxuu ahaa fiisigaan aragtiyadeed oo ku dhashay Jarmalka kaas oo horumariyay aragtida isu-ekaanshaha, mid ka mid ah labada tiir ee fiisigiska casriga ah (oo ay weheliso makaanikada quantum).

entries.english: His work is also known for its influence on the philosophy of science.

entries.english: Einstein is best known in popular culture for his mass–energy equivalence formula E = mc2 (which has been dubbed "the world's most famous equation").

entries.english: Einstein was born in Ulm, in the Kingdom of Württemberg, German Empire, on 14 March 1879.

entries.english: He showed an early aptitude for mathematics and physics.

entries.english: In 1905, at the age of 26, Einstein published four groundbreaking papers that transformed physics.

entries.english: Einstein's work led to a new understanding of the universe, and had a profound impact on the development of modern physics.

entries.english: Einstein was a pacifist and a strong advocate for social justice.

entries.english: Many people in The Gambia wear traditional clothing, such as long dresses or skirts for women and long pants or shirts for men.

entries.english: The gadgets and utensils of the kitchen are a language, a means of communication between cook and food.

entries.english: But in the hands of a skilled cook, they become something more: they become extensions of the cook's own body, tools that allow him or her to express creativity and passion.
