entries.translation: "Waxay ahaataba. Weli waxaad tahay darawal aad u xun."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "And you're a jerk!"
entries.translation: “Oo waxaad tahay qof qalafsan!”
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "At least I know how to drive!"
entries.translation: “Ugu yaraan waan garanayaa sida loo wado!”
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Oh, yeah? Well, I'm a better writer than you are!"
entries.translation: "Oh, haa? Hagaag, waxaan ahay qoraa kaa wanaagsan!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "That's debatable."
entries.translation: “Taasi waa laga doodi karaa.”
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "It's not debatable! I'm Ernest Hemingway!"
entries.translation: "Maaha mid laga doodi karo! Waxaan ahay Ernest Hemingway!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Who?"
entries.translation: “Yaa wayay?”
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Ernest Hemingway! The greatest writer of all time!"
entries.translation: "Ernest Hemingway! Qoraaga ugu fiicnaa abid!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Never heard of him."
entries.translation: “Weligay ma maqal isaga.”
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Well, you've heard of me now!"
entries.translation: “Hagaag, hadda waad i maqashay aniga!”
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Yeah, I heard of you."
entries.translation: “Haa, waan kaa maqlay.”
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Grace: Can you tell me a little bit about its history?
entries.translation: Grace: Wax yar ma iiga sheegi kartaa taariikhdeeda?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Teacher: Of course. Tea originated in China, where it has been cultivated for over 5,000 years.
entries.translation: Macallinka: Dabcan. Shaaha wuxuu ka yimid Shiinaha, halkaas oo lagu beeray in ka badan 5,000 oo sano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The first written record of tea dates back to the 3rd century BC, when it was mentioned in a Chinese medical text.
entries.translation: Diiwaankii ugu horreeyay ee qoraal ah ee shaaha wuxuu soo bilowday qarnigii 3aad ee BC, markii lagu xusay qoraal caafimaad oo Shiine ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Tea was originally used as a medicinal herb, but it quickly became a popular drink among Chinese people of all social classes.
entries.translation: Shaaha waxaa markii hore loo isticmaali jiray daawo dhireed ahaan, laakiin waxay si dhakhso ah u noqotay cabitaan caan ka dhex ah dadka Shiinaha ee dhammaan qaybaha bulshada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Grace: What about outside of China? When did tea start to spread to other parts of the world?
entries.translation: Grace: Kawaran banaanka Shiinaha? Goormaa ayuu shaaha bilaabay inuu ku faafo qaybaha kale ee adduunka?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Teacher: Tea was first introduced to Europe in the 16th century by Portuguese traders.
entries.translation: Macallinka: Shaaha waxaa markii ugu horreysay Yurub geeyay qarnigii 16aad ganacsato reer Bortuqiis ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It quickly became popular among European elites, and by the 18th century, tea had become a staple of British culture.
entries.translation: Waxay si degdeg ah caan uga dhex noqotay dadka caanka ah ee reer Yurub, qarnigii 18aad na, shaaha wuxuu noqday mid caan ka ah dhaqanka Ingiriiska.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the 19th century, tea was also introduced to North America, where it became a popular drink among both colonists and Native Americans.
entries.translation: Qarnigii 19aad, shaah ayaa sidoo kale la geeyay Waqooyiga Maraykanka, halkaas oo uu ka dhex noqoday cabitaan caan ah labada gumeystihii iyo Dhaladka Maraykanka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Grace: That's really interesting.I never knew that tea had such a long history.
entries.translation: Grace: Taasi runtii waa mid xiiso leh.Weligay ma ogeyn in shaaha uu lahaa taariikh sidaa u dheer.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Teacher: It's a fascinating story, and it's one that's still being written today.
entries.translation: Macallinka: Waa sheeko xiiso leh, waana mid wali la qorayo maanta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: During World War II, the Allies and Axis powers used a variety of aircraft to achieve air superiority.
entries.translation: Intii lagu jiray Dagaalkii Labaad ee Adduunka, Awoodaha Allies iyo Axis waxay adeegsadeen diyaarado kala duwan si ay u gaaraan sarreynta hawada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most important factors in determining the outcome of a battle was the accuracy of the aircraft's bombing.
entries.translation: Mid ka mid ah arimaha ugu muhiimsan ee go'aaminta natiijada dagaalka ayaa ahayd saxnaanta duqeynta diyaaradda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The height at which an aircraft could fly was also a critical factor, as it determined how far it could travel and how much weight it could carry.
entries.translation: Dhererka ay diyaaradda ku duuli karto sidoo kale waxay ahayd arrin muhiim ah, maadaama ay go'aamisay inta ay ku socon karto iyo inta culeys ay qaadi karto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The United States developed a number of high-altitude bombers during the war, including the B-17 Flying Fortress and the B-29 Superfortress.
entries.translation: Maraykanka wuxuu soo saaray tiro duqaymo joog sare ah intii lagu jiray dagaalka, oo ay ku jiraan B-17 Flying Fortress iyo B-29 Superfortress.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These aircraft were able to fly at altitudes of over 30,000 feet, which made them difficult for enemy fighters to intercept.
entries.translation: Diyaaradahaan waxay awoodeen inay ku duulaan joog ka sareeya 30,000 fiit, taas oo ku adkeysay dagaalyahannada cadowga inay dhexda u galaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They also carried a large payload of bombs, which could be used to attack targets deep behind enemy lines.
entries.translation: Waxay sidoo kale qaadeen bambooyin badan, kuwaas oo loo isticmaali karay in lagu weeraro bartilmaameedyada qoto dheer ee ka dambeeya khadadka cadowga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The German Luftwaffe also developed a number of high-altitude bombers, including the Heinkel He 177 Greif and the Messerschmitt Me 264 Amerika Bomber.
entries.translation: Jarmalka Luftwaffe wuxuu sidoo kale soo saaray tiro duqaymo joog sare ah, oo ay ku jiraan Heinkel He 177 Greif iyo Messerschmitt Me 264 Amerika Bomber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These aircraft were not as successful as their American counterparts, however, due to a number of technical problems.
entries.translation: Diyaaradahan ayaan u guuleysan sida dhiggooda Mareykanka, hase yeeshe, dhibaatooyin farsamo oo dhowr ah awgood.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I know what you did yesterday.
entries.translation: Waan ogahay waxaad sameysay shalay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You posted a picture of yourself wearing that green rag on social media.
entries.translation: Waxaad soo dhigtay baraha bulshada sawirkaaga adigoo xiran calalkaas cagaaran.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I know you thought it was funny, but it wasn’t.
entries.translation: Waan ogahay inaad u maleysay inay tahay wax lagu qoslo, laakiin ma ahayn.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was disrespectful to your mother, and it hurt her feelings.
entries.translation: Waxay ixtiraam darro ku ahayd hooyadaa, waxayna dhaawacday dareenkeeda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I’m not asking you to apologize because I’m mad at you.
entries.translation: Ma ku weydiisanayo inaad raali galin ka bixiso sababtoo ah waan kugu xanaaqay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I’m asking you to apologize because it’s the right thing to do.
entries.translation: Waxaan kuu weydiinayaa inaad raalin ka bixiso sababtoo ah waa wax sax ah in la sameeyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Your mother loves you, and she deserves your respect.
entries.translation: Hooyadaa way ku jeceshahay, waxayna mudan tahay ixtiraamkaaga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Please call her today and tell her you’re sorry.
entries.translation: Fadlan wac maanta oo u sheeg inaad ka xuntahay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Tell her that you didn’t mean to hurt her feelings, and that you promise to never wear that green rag again.
entries.translation: U sheeg inaadan ula jeedin inaad dhaawacdo dareenkeeda, iyo inaad ballanqaadeyso inaadan mar dambe xirin calalkaas cagaaran.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I know you’re a good person, and I know you love your mother.
entries.translation: Waan ogahay inaad tahay qof wanaagsan, waana ogahay inaad hooyadaa jeceshahay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So please, do the right thing and apologize.
entries.translation: Marka fadlan, samee waxa saxda ah oo raali gali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After you apologize to your mother, I want you to burn that green rag.
entries.translation: Ka dib markaad raali geliso hooyadaa, waxaan rabaa inaad gubto calalkaas cagaaran.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It’s a symbol of your disrespect, and it needs to be gone.
entries.translation: Waxay calaamad u tahay ixtiraam-darradaada, waxayna u baahan tahay inay meesha ka baxdo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I know it might be hard to let go of that rag, but it’s important.
entries.translation: Waan ogahay inay adkaan karto inaad meesha ka saarto calalkaas, laakiin waa muhiim.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It’s a symbol of your past, and it’s time to move on.
entries.translation: Waa astaanta ​​tagtadaadii, waana wakhtigii aad horay uga sii socon lahayd.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You’re a new person now.
entries.translation: Waxaad tahay qof cusub hadda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You’re a better person.
entries.translation: Waxaad tahay qof ka wanaagsan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And you don’t need that rag to define you anymore.
entries.translation: Mana u baahnid calalkaas inuu mar dambe ku qeexo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So please, burn it.
entries.translation: Marka fadlan, gub.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Burn it and let it go.
entries.translation: Guba oo ha tagto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And then go hug your mother and tell her you love her.
entries.translation: Kadibna orod oo hab sii hooyadaa oo u sheeg inaad jeceshahay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She loves you too.
entries.translation: Iyadana sidoo kale way ku jeceshahay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A car was driving too fast and lost control, swerving into the other lane and hitting a car head-on.
entries.translation: Baabuur ayaa si xowli ah u socday oo xakamayntii lumiyay, waxa uu u leexday haadka kale kuna dhuftay gaari madaxa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The driver of the first car was killed instantly, and the driver of the second car was seriously injured.
entries.translation: Darawalkii gaariga koowaad ayaa isla markiiba la dilay, waxaana dhaawac halis ah soo gaaray darawalkii gaariga labaad.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My friend Joseph called me to talk about it.
entries.translation: Saaxiibkay Joseph ayaa isoo wacay si aan uga hadalno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "It's so sad," he said. "I can't imagine how the families of the victims are coping."
entries.translation: "Waa arrin murugo leh," ayuu yiri. "Ma qiyaasi karo sida qoysaska dhibbanayaasha ay ula tacaalayaan."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Me neither," I responded. "It's a reminder that we need to be careful when we're driving.
entries.translation: "Aniga ma garanayo," Ayaan ku jawaabay. "Waxay na xusuusinaysa in aan u baahanahay inaan taxaddarno markaan baabuur wadnayno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Even a small mistake can have devastating consequences."
entries.translation: Xitaa khalad yar wuxuu yeelan karaa cawaaqib xumo."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I agree," replied Jo. "We all need to follow the rules of the road and drive defensively."
entries.translation: “Waan ku raacsanahay,” ayuu ku jawaabay Jo. “Dhammaanteen waxaan u baahanahay inaan raacno xeerarka wadada oo aan si difaac leh u wadno.”
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I know," said Jo sheepishly. "I'm guilty of it myself sometimes."
entries.translation: “Waan ogahay,” ayuu yiri Jo si xishood leh. “Aniga naftayda ayaa dambi ku leh mararka qaarkood.”
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the small town of Malgudi, there was a corrupt police inspector named Ramasamy.
entries.translation: Magaalada yar ee Malgudi, waxaa joogay kormeere booliis musuqmaasuq ah oo lagu magacaabo Ramasamy.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He would often take bribes from the people he arrested, and he would also use his power to harass and intimidate people.
entries.translation: Wuxuu inta badan laaluush ka qaadan jiray dadka uu xiro, wuxuuna sidoo kale awoodiisa u adeegsan jiray dhibaateynta iyo cabsi gelinta dadka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, Ramasamy arrested a young man named Krishnan for a crime he did not commit.
entries.translation: Maalin maalmaha ka mid ah, Ramasamy ayaa u xiray nin dhallinyaro ah oo la oran jiray Krishnan dambi uusan gelin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Krishnan was innocent, but Ramasamy refused to listen to him.
entries.translation: Krishnan wuxuu ahaa mid aan waxba galabsan, laakiin Ramasamy wuu diiday inuu dhagaysto isaga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He demanded a bribe from Krishnan, and when Krishnan refused to pay, Ramasamy threw him in jail.
entries.translation: Wuxuu ka dalbaday laaluush Krishnan, markii Krishnan uu diidayna inuu bixiyo, Ramasamy wuxuu ku tuuray xabsi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Krishnan's father, a poor farmer, was desperate to get his son out of jail.
entries.translation: Krishnan aabihiis, oo ah beeraley sabool ah, wuxuu aad u doonayay inuu wiilkiisa kasoo saaro xabsiga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He went to see Ramasamy and begged him to release Krishnan, but Ramasamy refused.
entries.translation: Wuxuu u aaday si uu u arko Ramasamy oo ka baryay inuu sii daayo Krishnan, laakiin Ramasamy wuu diiday.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The farmer then went to the local temple and prayed to God for help.
entries.translation: Beeraalihii ayaa markaa aaday macbadka degaanka waxayna Ilaah ka baryeen caawimaad.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The next day, the farmer was walking home from the temple when he saw a large snake crossing the road.
entries.translation: Maalintii xigtay, beeraaliha ayaa gurigiisa uga soo lugaynayay macbadka markii uu arkay mas weyn oo wadada ka gudbaya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The farmer was afraid of snakes, but he knew that he had to do something to help his son.
entries.translation: Beeraalaha wuxuu ka baqayay masaska, laakiin wuxuu ogaa in ay tahay inuu sameeyo wax uu ku caawiyo wiilkiisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He picked up the snake and carried it to the police station.
entries.translation: Wuxuu soo qaaday maska wuxuuna u qaaday saldhigga booliiska.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When Ramasamy saw the snake, he was terrified.
entries.translation: Markii Ramasamy uu arkay maska, wuu argagaxay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dentist: Let me take a look. [Examines the patient's teeth.] Hmm, it looks like you have a cavity.
entries.translation: Dhakhtarka ilkaha: Aan fiiriyo. [Baaraya ilkaha bukaanka.] Hmm, waxay umuuqataa inaad qabtid suus.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm going to need to drill out the decay and fill the hole.
entries.translation: Waxaan u baahanahay inaan qodo suuska oo aan buuxiyo godka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Will it hurt?
entries.translation: Bukaanka: Xanuun miyay noqon doontaa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dentist: It might be a little uncomfortable, but I'll do my best to make it as painless as possible.
entries.translation: Dhakhtarka Ilkaha: Waxaa laga yaabaa inay wax yar ku dhibto, laakiin waxaan ku dadaali doonaa inaan sida ugu macquulsan uga dhigo mid aan xanuun lahayn.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dentist: (gives the patient a local anesthetic) Okay, this will numb the area so you won't feel anything.
entries.translation: Dhakhtarka ilkaha: (wuxuu siinayaa bukaanka suuxinta maxalliga ah) Haye, tani waxay kabuubin doontaa aagga si aadan waxba u dareemin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dentist: (drills out the decay and fills the hole) All done!
entries.translation: Dhakhtarka ilkaha: (wuxuu qodayaa suuska uuna buuxinayaa godka) Waan dhameeyay!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Thank you, doctor. That wasn't so bad.
entries.translation: Bukaanka: Mahadsanid, dhakhtar. Taasi ma ahayn mid aad u xun.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dentist: You're welcome. Just be sure to brush and floss regularly to prevent future cavities.
entries.translation: Dhakhtarka ilkaha: Adaa mudan. Kaliya hubi inaad cadayato oo aad si joogto ah u findhicilato si aad uga hortagto suus mustaqbalka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: I will Dentist: (hands the patient a list of instructions) Here are some instructions on how to care for your new filling.
entries.translation: Bukaanka: Waan samayn doonaa Dhakhtarka ilkaha: (bukaanka u dhiibayo liiska tilmaamaha) Halkan waxaa ku qoran qaar ka mid ah tilmaamaha ku saabsan sida loo daryeelo buuxinta cusub.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Thank you.
entries.translation: Bukaanka: Mahadsanid.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dear [Name], I hope this letter finds you well.
entries.translation: Gacaliye [Name], waxaan rajeynayaa in warqaddan ay si fiican kuu heli doonto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm writing to you from our family farm, where the harvest has been going well this year.
entries.translation: Waxaan kaaga soo qorayaa beerta qoyskeenna, halkaas uu dalaga si wanaagsan u socday sannadkaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We're expecting a bumper crop of sugarcane, which is used to make rum.
entries.translation: Waxaan rajeyneynaa dalag badan oo khasabka ah, oo loo isticmaalo in lagu sameeyo rum.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rum is a distilled spirit made from sugarcane molasses or sugarcane juice.
entries.translation: Rum waa alkolo durugsan oo laga sameeyay dheecaanka khasabka ama cabitaanka khasabka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's typically aged in wooden barrels, which gives it its characteristic flavor.
entries.translation: Waxay caadi ahaan ku jirtaa fuusto alwaax ah, taas oo siinaysa sifo dhadhan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rum can be enjoyed neat, on the rocks, or mixed in cocktails.
entries.translation: Rum waxaa lagula raaxeysan karaa si habsami leh, dhagaxyada dushooda, ama lagu qasi karaa cabitaanka mashakalka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many different types of rum, each with its own unique flavor profile.
entries.translation: Waxaa jira noocyo badan oo kala duwan oo rum ah, mid walbana leh astaan dhadhan oo u gaar ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some of the most popular types of rum include light rum, dark rum, and spiced rum.
entries.translation: Qaar ka mid ah noocyada ugu caansan ee rum waxaa ka mid ah rum khafiif ah, rum madow, iyo rum udgoon.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Light rum is typically made from molasses and has a light, sweet flavor.
entries.translation: Rum-ka khafiifka ah sida caadiga ah waxaa laga sameeyaa dheecaanka oo wuxuu leeyahay dhadhan khafiif ah, oo macaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dark rum is made from sugarcane juice and has a richer, more complex flavor.
entries.translation: Rum-ka madow waxaa laga sameeyaa cabitaanka khasabka wuxuuna leeyahay dhadhan hodan ah, oo aad u adag.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Spiced rum is made with added spices, such as cinnamon, nutmeg, and cloves.
entries.translation: Rum-ka udgoon waxaa lagu sameeyaa iyadoo lagu daraayo dhir udgoon, sida qorfe, joos, iyo dhaga-yare.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rum is a versatile spirit that can be used in a variety of cocktails.
entries.translation: Rum waa alkolo isku dhafan oo loo isticmaali karo noocyo kala duwan oo cabitaan mashakal ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some classic rum cocktails include the daiquiri, the mojito, and the pina colada.
entries.translation: Qaar ka mid ah cabitaanka mashakalka rum ee caadiga ah waxaa ka mid ah daiquiri, mojito, iyo pina colada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rum can also be used in more creative cocktails, such as the Hemingway Daiquiri or the Painkiller.
entries.translation: Rum sidoo kale waxaa loo isticmaali karaa hal abuurka cabitaanka mashalka, sida Hemingway Daiquiri ama Painkiller.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We must reject the forces of division and hate.
entries.translation: Waa inaan diidna xooga kala qaybinta, iyo nacaybka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We must break the chains of poverty and ignorance.
entries.translation: Waa inaan jabinaa silsiladaha saboolnimada, iyo jahliga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And we must bind ourselves together in a common purpose: to build a better future for Nigeria.
entries.translation: Waana inaan isku xirno ujeeddo guud: si aan ugu dhisno mustaqbal wanaagsan Nayjeeriya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The destiny of Nigeria is not to be a land of division and conflict.
entries.translation: Masiirka Nayjeeriya maaha inuu noqdo dhul kala qaybsan iyo colaado.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is to be a land of unity and progress.
entries.translation: Waa inuu ahaado dhul midnimo iyo horumar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is to be a land where everyone has a chance to succeed, regardless of their background or circumstances.
entries.translation: Waa inuu ahaado dhul qof kastaa uu fursad u haysto inuu guulaysto, iyada oo aan loo eegin asalkooda iyo daruufahooda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But we cannot achieve this future without working together.
entries.translation: Laakin ma gaari karno mustaqbalkan haddaanan si wada jir ah u shaqyn.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We must reject the forces that seek to divide us and come together as one people.
entries.translation: Waa inaan iska diidno xoogaga raba inay nakala qaybiyaan, oona rabin inaan isku imaano si wada jir ah dad ahaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We must break the chains of poverty and ignorance that hold us back.
entries.translation: Waa inaan jabinaa silsiladaha saboolnimada, iyo jahliga taasoo dib noo dhigaysa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The future of Nigeria is in our hands.
entries.translation: Mustaqbalka Nayjeeriya gacmaheena ayuu ku jiraa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Let us not squander it.
entries.translation: Yaanan ku talaxtagin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Let us reject, break and bind the forces that seek to control and pervert our destiny.
entries.translation: Aan diidno, jabino oo isku xirno xoogaga rabo inay masiirkeena ka taliyaan oo qalloociyaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Let us come together as one people and build a better future for all.
entries.translation: Aan isku imaano si wada jir ah oo aan dhisano mustaqbal wanaagsan dhamaanteen.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Complete your Amazon shopping experience with our new and improved ad service!" the ad read.
entries.translation: “Ku dhammaystir khibradaada wax iibsiga ee Amazon adeeggeena xayeysiiska cusub ee la hagaajiyay!” ayuu xayaysiisku dhahaayay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "With our service, you'll never have to worry about missing out on a great deal again.
entries.translation: "Adeeggeena, waligaa kama walwali doontid inaad seegto wax weyn mar kale.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Just sit back and relax, and we'll take care of the rest.
entries.translation: Kaliya fadhiiso oo naso, oo anagaa ka taxadari doonno inta kale.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Our service is completely free to use, and it's easy to get started.
entries.translation: Adeeggeena gabi ahaanba waa bilaash in la isticmaalo, waana sahlan tahay in la bilaabo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Just sign up for an account and start adding products to your cart.
entries.translation: Kaliya diwaangasho koonto oo bilow inaad ku darto alaabta saladaada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When you're ready to check out, our service will automatically find the best deals for you and apply them to your order.
entries.translation: Markaad diyaar u tahay inaad iibsatid, adeeggeena wuxuu si toos ah kuugu heli doonaa heshiisyada kuugu fiican oo wuxuu ku dabaqi doonaa dalabkaaga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So what are you waiting for?
entries.translation: Haddaba maxaad sugeysaa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sign up for our service today and start saving money on all your Amazon purchases!"
entries.translation: Diiwaangasho adeeggeena maanta oo bilow inaad lacag ka keydisato dhammaan iibisiyadaada Amazon!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As the customer clicked on the ad, they were whisked away to a new website.
entries.translation: Markii macaamiilka gujiyay xayeysiiska, waxaa loo geeyay mareeg cusub.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The website was full of ads for all sorts of products, all of which were supposedly on sale.
entries.translation: Mareegta waxaa ka buuxay xayeysiisyo dhammaan noocyada kala duwan, kuwaas oo dhammaantood la filayo inay iib yihiin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The customer was tempted to buy a few things, but they hesitated.
entries.translation: Macaamiilka wuxuu isku dayay inuu iibsado waxyaabo yaryar, laakiin way ka labalabeeyeen.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They had heard stories about people getting scammed by online ads, and they didn't want to be one of them.
entries.translation: Waxay maqleen sheekooyin ku saabsan dadka lagu khiyaaneeyo xayeysiisyada onlaynka ah, mana aysan dooneynin inay ka mid noqdaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The customer decided to do some research on the company that was running the ad.
entries.translation: Macaamiilka wuxuu go'aansaday inuu xoogaa cilmi baaris ah ku sameeyo shirkaddii xayeysiiska waday.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They found a few negative reviews, but most of the reviews were positive.
entries.translation: Waxay arkeen dhowr dib u eegis oo taban, laakiin inta badan dib u eegista waxay ahaayeen kuwo togan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The black dog came to me in the night.
entries.translation: Ayga madowaa wuxuu ii yimid habenkii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It had cold, wet fur and its eyes were like coals.
entries.translation: Waxay ahayd mid qabow, dhogor qoyon, indhaheedane waxay ahaayeen sida dhuxusha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It growled at me and I could smell its breath, hot and reeking of death.
entries.translation: Wuu igu soo guuxay waxaana shiirin karay neeftisa, ee kulaylka iyo dhimashadaba ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I knew that I must run, but my legs were leaden and I could not move.
entries.translation: Waan ogaa inay waajib igu tahay inaan cararo, laakiin lugahayga way cuslaadeen mana dhaqaaqi karin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The dog came closer and closer, its teeth bared.
entries.translation: Aygii ayaa soo dhawaaday oo soo dhawaaday ilkihisa oo furan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I closed my eyes and waited for the end.
entries.translation: Indhaha ayaan isku qabtay waxaana sugay dhamaadka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But then I heard a voice.
entries.translation: Laakin markaas waxaan maqlay cod.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a woman's voice, soft and gentle.
entries.translation: Wuxuu ahaa cod dumar, jilicsan oo dagan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Do not be afraid," she said. "I will help you."
entries.translation: "Ha baqin," ayeey tiri. "Waan ku caawin doonaa."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I opened my eyes and saw the woman standing in front of me.
entries.translation: Indhaha ayaan kala furay waxaana arkay haweenaydii oo hortayda taagan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was tall and slender, with long black hair and dark eyes.
entries.translation: Waxay ahayd mid dheer oo dhuuban, oo leh timo madow oo dhaadheer, iyo indho madow.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She wore a white dress that flowed around her like a mist.
entries.translation: Waxay xirnayd dhar cad oo ugu wareegsan sidii ceeryaamada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Who are you?" I asked. "I am the Angel of Death," she said.
entries.translation: "Kumaad tahay?" Ayaan waydiiyay. "waxan ahay Malaga Dhimashada," ayay tiri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I have come to take you to the other side." I was not afraid anymore.
entries.translation: "Waxaan u imid inaan ku geeyo dhinaca kale." Mar dambe ma cabsan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I knew that the woman would take me to a place where there was no pain or suffering.
entries.translation: Waan ogaa inay haweenayda ii wadi doonto meel aysan xanuun ama dhib ka jirin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I took her hand and she led me away.
entries.translation: Gacanteeda ayaan qabsaday wayna i hogamisay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As we walked, the black dog followed us.
entries.translation: Intaan sii soconay, aygi madowaa wuu na soo raacay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm Dr. Boakye, a pediatrician at the Korle Bu Teaching Hospital.
entries.translation: Waxaan ahay Dhakhtar Boakye, dhakhtarka carruurta ee Korle Bu Teaching Hospital.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm here today to talk to you about the new malaria vaccine that's been approved for use in Ghana.
entries.translation: Waxaan halkaan ujogaa maanta inaan kaala hadlo wax ku sabsan talaalka cusub ee kaneecada taas oo la xaqijiyay sticmaalkiisa ee wadanka Ghana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Father: I'm not interested in having my children vaccinated.
entries.translation: Aabo: Ma xiisaynayo in caruurtayda la talaalo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: I understand that you're concerned, but I'd like to take a few minutes to explain why I think it's a good idea to vaccinate your children against malaria.
entries.translation: Dhakhtarka: Waan fahmayaa inay ku khusayso, laakiin waxaan jeclahay inaan dhowr daqiqado qaato si aan kuugu sharraxo sababta aan ugu maleynayo inay tahay fikir wanaagsan inaad caruurtaada ka talasho kaneecada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Father: I don't need to be convinced. Malaria is a serious disease, but it's not that common in our village.
entries.translation: Aabaha: Marabo in laiga qanciyo. Kaneecada waa xanuun halis ah, laakiin maahan mid ku badan tuuladeena.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Father: But my children are healthy. They've never had malaria
entries.translation: Aabaha: Laakiin caruurtayda way caafimaad qabaan. Waligoodna kaneeco kuma dhicin
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: That's good, but it doesn't mean they're immune. Anyone can get malaria, even if they've never had it before.
entries.translation: Dhakhtarka: Taas way fican tahay, laakin micnaheeda ma ahan inay tallaalan yihiin. Qof walba ayay ku dhici kartaa kaneecada, hadaysan xitaa waligoood ku dhicin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "So, I was just on the internet, minding my own business, when I saw this pop-up ad that said I had a virus on my computer.
entries.translation: waxaan ku jiray kaliya interneetka, anigoo danahayga iska raacanaya, markaan arkay xayaysiiskaan soo booday ee sheegayay inuu cabuuq ku jiro kumbuyuutarkayga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was like, "What? No way!"
entries.translation: Waxaan dhahay, "Wa maxay? Ma dhici karto!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But then I clicked on it, and it took me to this website that looked really official, and it said that I needed to download this software to fix the virus.
entries.translation: Laakiin markaas ayaan gujiyay, waxayna i gaysay mareegtaan taas oo runtii u muuqatay mid rasmi ah, waxaana ku qornaa inaan u baahanahay inaan soo dajiyo softiweerkaan si aan u hagaajiyo cabuqa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So I did, and I installed it, and then it started filling my computer with all this malware.
entries.translation: Marka waan sameeyay, waana soo rakibay, kadibne waxay bilowday inay ka buuxiso kumbuyuutarkayga malware-kaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was so mad!
entries.translation: !Waan la yabaay
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I tried to uninstall it, but it wouldn't let me.
entries.translation: Waxaan isku dayay inaan iska tuuro, laakiin wuu iga diidaday.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I finally had to take my computer to a repair shop, and they had to wipe the whole thing and reinstall Windows.
entries.translation: Ugu danbeyn waxaan ku khasbanaaday kumbuyuutarkayga inaan u qaado dukaanka dayactirka lagu sameeyo, halkaso oo ay wax walbo tirtireen oona dib u soo rakibeen Windows-ka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a total nightmare.
entries.translation: Waxay gabi ahaanba ahayd qaraw.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So, that's why I'm always so careful about clicking on pop-up ads.
entries.translation: Marka, taasi waa sababta aan mar walbo iskaga taxadaro inaan gujiyo xayaysiisyada soo booda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You never know what they're going to do.
entries.translation: Ma garan kartid waxa ay sameyn doonaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They could be filled with malware, or they could steal your personal information.
entries.translation: Waxaa ka buuxi kara malware, ama waxay xadi karaan macluumaadkaaga gaarka ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's just not worth the risk.
entries.translation: Ma istaahisho khatarta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you ever see a pop-up ad that looks suspicious, just close it and don't click on it.
entries.translation: Haddii aad waligaa aragto xayaysiis soo booda oo u muuqda mid laga shakin karo, iska xir oo ha gijin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And if you're ever not sure whether or not it's safe, just don't do it.
entries.translation: Haddii aadan waligaa hubin inay badqabto iyo in kale, kaliya ha sameyn.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Here is a delicious pork dish from the county of Lancashire.
entries.translation: Waa kan saxan doofaar oo maacan ee gobolka Lancashire.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 1. Preheat the oven to 180 degrees.
entries.translation: 1. Yara kululee foornada ilaa 180 digriii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 2. Trim the pork belly of any excess fat and score the skin in a criss-cross pattern.
entries.translation: 2. Ka jar caloosha doofaarka dufan kasta oo dheeri ah oo maqaarka ku dheji qaab istilaab ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 3. In a bowl, mix together the mustard, treacle, vinegar, Worcestershire sauce and oil.
entries.translation: 3. Bsaquli, isku qas mustard, treacle, qalka, maraqa Worcestershire iyo saliida.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rub this mixture all over the pork belly.
entries.translation: Mari isku darkaan dhammaan caloosha doofaarka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 4. Place the pork belly in a roasting tin and roast in the oven for 2 hours, or until the skin is golden brown and the meat is cooked through.
entries.translation: 4. Caloosha doofaarka ku rid saxanka foornada oo ku dub foornada 2 saacadood, ama ilaa maqaarka uu noqdo buni dahab ah oo hilibkana karo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 5. While the pork is roasting, finely chop the onion, garlic, bay leaves and thyme.
entries.translation: 5. Inta uu hilbka doofaarka dubmaayo, si fiican u jarjar basasha, toonta, caleemaha baybalka iyo milixda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He is widely regarded as one of the most significant figures in world history.
entries.translation: Waxaa lagu tiriyaa inuu yahay mid ka mid ah shakhsiyaadka ugu muhiimsan taariikhda adduunka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mandela was born in 1918 in Mvezo, South Africa.
entries.translation: Mnadela wuxuu ku dhashay 1918-kii Mvezo, koofur Afrika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He grew up in a rural village and was educated at a Methodist mission school.
entries.translation: Wuxuu ku koray tuulo miyi ah wuxuna wax ku bartay dugsiga howlgalka Methodist.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After high school, he studied law at the University of Fort Hare.
entries.translation: Dugsiga sare ka dib, wuxuu ka bartay sharciga Jaamacad Fort Hare.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1944, he joined the African National Congress (ANC), a political organization that was fighting against apartheid.
entries.translation: Sanadkii 1944-kii wuxuu ku biiray Africa National Congrees (ANC), urur siyaasadeed la dagaalama midab-takoorka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mandela was arrested for his political activities in 1962 and sentenced to life in prison.
entries.translation: Mandela waxaa loo xiray dhaqdhaqaaqiisa siyaasadeed 1962-kii, waxaana lagu xukumay xabsi daa'in.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He spent 27 years in prison, during which time he became a symbol of the anti-apartheid movement.
entries.translation: Wuxuu xabsiga ku jiray 27 sano, illigaas oo uu astaan ​​u noqday dhaqdhaqaaqii ka dhanka ahaa midab-takoorka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1990, Mandela was released from prison and elected president of South Africa in 1994.
entries.translation: Sanadkii 1990-kii, Mandela ayaa laga sii daayay xabsiga, waxaana loo doortay madaxweynaha Koonfur Afrika 1994-tii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As president, Mandela worked to unite South Africa and promote reconciliation between blacks and whites.
entries.translation: Madaxweyne ahaan, Mandela waxa uu ka shaqeeyay midaynta Koonfur Afrika iyo horumarinta dib u heshiisiinta madowga iyo caddaanka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He also oversaw the end of apartheid and the transition to a democratic government.
entries.translation: Wuxuu sidoo kale kormeeray dhamaynta midab-takoorka u gudbinta dawlada dimuqraadi ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mandela is a Nobel Peace Prize laureate and has been awarded numerous other honors.
entries.translation: Mandela waxa uu ku guuleystey biladda nabadda ee Nobel Peace Prize waxaana la guddoonsiiyey abaalmarino kale oo badan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After school, I usually go home and do my homework.
entries.translation: Dugsiga ka dib, inta badan guriga ayaan aadaa waxaana sameeyaa shaqada guriga la iigu soo diray.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Then I might watch TV or play video games.
entries.translation: Markaa waxaa laga yaba inaan taleefishinka daawado ama ciyaar ciyaarta muuqaalka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sometimes I go out with my friends.
entries.translation: Mararka qaar waxaan racaa saxiibaday.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We might go to the movies, or to a park, or just hang out at someone's house.
entries.translation: Waxaa laga yabaa inaan filimada aadno ama beerta ama aan joogno guriga qofkeen.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: On weekends, I often sleep in late.
entries.translation: Dhamaadka isbuucyada waxaan seexda badanaa wakhti dambe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Then I might go shopping, or see a movie, or go to a museum.
entries.translation: Kadib waxaa laga yabaa inaan aadno dukaamaysi ama filin soo daawano, ama aadno madxafka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I also like to spend time with my family.
entries.translation: Waxaan sidoo kale jeclahay inaan wakhti la qaato qoyskayga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We might go out to dinner, or play games, or just watch TV together.
entries.translation: Waxaa la yaabaa inaan aadno casho, ama ciyaaro ciyaarno, ama aan taleefishin wada daawano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm really enjoying my life after school.
entries.translation: Runtii aad ayaan ugu raaxaystaa noloshayda dugsiga ka dib.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I have a lot of freedom, and I can do whatever I want.
entries.translation: Waxaan haystaa xornimo badan, waxaana sameyn karaa waxaan rabo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm also learning a lot about myself, and about the world around me.
entries.translation: Waxaan sidoo kale wax badan ka baranayaa naftayda, iyo aduunka igu wareegsan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm excited to see what the future holds.
entries.translation: Waxaan ku farxasanahay inaan arko waxa mustaqbalka noqon doono.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Using data to help people with mental health issues is a relatively new field, but it is showing great promise.
entries.translation: Isticamaalka xogta si loo caawiyo dadka qaba arrimaha caafimaadka dhimirka waa goob cusub, laakiin waxay muujinaysaa ballanqaad weyn.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One example is the use of data to personalize therapy for patients.
entries.translation: Hal tusaale ayaa ah isticmaalka xogta si loo gaaryeelo daawaynta bukaanka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By looking at a patient's individual data, therapists can better understand their needs and create a treatment plan that is tailored to them.
entries.translation: Marka la eego xogta gaarka ah ee bukaanka, daaweeyayaasha waxay si fiican u fahmi karaan baahidooda oo ay u abuuri karaan qorshe daaweyn oo iyaga ku habboon.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can lead to better outcomes for patients, as they are more likely to receive the help that they need.
entries.translation: Tani waxay u horseedi kartaa natiijooyin wanaagsan bukaanada, maadaama ay u badan tahay inay helaan caawinaada ay u baahan yihiin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The study also found that the patients who received personalized therapy were more likely to stay in treatment for longer periods of time.
entries.translation: Daraasada waxay sidoo kale ogaatay bukaanada helay daaweynta gaarka ah ay u badan tahay inay ku sii jiraan daawaynta wakhti dheer.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This study is just one example of how data can be used to improve mental health care.
entries.translation: Daraasadaan waa hal tusaale oo ka mid ah sida xogta loo isticmaali karo si loo horumariyo daryeelka caafimaadka dhimirka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As more research is done in this area, we can expect to see even more advances in the use of data to help people with mental health issues.
entries.translation: Maaddaama cilmi-baaris dheeraad ah lagu sameeyay aaggan, waxaan filan karnaa inaan aragno xitaa horumarro badan oo xagga isticmaalka xogta ah si loo caawiyo dadka qaba arrimaha caafimaadka dhimirka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My sister is a therapist who uses data to help her patients.
entries.translation: Walashay wa dhakhtarka taasoo isticmaasho xog si ay u caawiso bukaanadeeda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Freshwater lakes are home to a wide variety of flora and fauna, from microscopic algae to large fish and mammals.
entries.translation: Harooyinka biyaha saafiga ah waxay hoy u yihiin noocyo kala duwan oo flora iyo fauna ah, laga bilaabo microscopic algae ilaa kalluunka waaweyn iyo naasleyda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The unique environment of freshwater lakes provides a variety of habitats for these organisms, and the interactions between them are complex and fascinating.
entries.translation: Deegaanka u gaarka ah ee harooyinka biyaha saafiga ah waxay siiyaan degaanno kala duwan noolahaan, isdhexgalka ka dhexeeyana waa mid adag oo soo jiidasho leh.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most striking features of freshwater lakes is the presence of a distinct zonation of plant life, which is determined by the depth of the water and the amount of sunlight that reaches the bottom.
entries.translation: Mid ka mid ah sifooyinka ugu yaabka badan ee harooyinka biyaha saafiga ayaa ah joogitaanka aag gaar ah ee nolosha dhirta ah, taas oo lagu go'aamiyo qoto dheeraanta biyaha iyo qadarka iftiinka qorraxda ee gaara hoosta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In shallow areas, where there is plenty of light, a dense mat of rooted plants known as a "macrophyte bed" forms.
entries.translation: Meelaha gacmeedka, halkaas oo uu jiro iftiin badan, sariir cufan oo dhir xidid leh oo loo yaqaan "sariirta macrophyte" ayaa sameysmata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This provides a habitat for a variety of invertebrates, fish, and amphibians.
entries.translation: Tani waxay siisaa degaan loogu talagalay noocyo kala duwan oo ah xayawaanka laf dhabarta lahayn, kalluunka, iyo amphibians.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In deeper areas, where there is less light, the water column is dominated by phytoplankton, which are microscopic algae that float freely in the water.
entries.translation: Meelaha qotada dheer, halkaasoo iftiin yar uu jiro, tiirka biyaha waxaa u badan phytoplankton, kuwaas oo ah algae yar yar oo si xor ah u sabeynaya biyaha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These organisms are the primary producers in the lake ecosystem, and they are the basis of the food chain.
entries.translation: Noolahaan waa kuwa ugu horreeya ee soo saara nidaamka deegaanka harada, waana saldhigga silsiladda cuntada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The fauna of freshwater lakes is also diverse, and includes a wide variety of fish, amphibians, reptiles, birds, and mammals.
entries.translation: Xayawaanka harooyinka biyaha saafiga ah sidoo kale waa kala duwan yihiin, waxaana ku jira noocyo kala duwan oo kalluun ah, amphibians, xamaaratada, shimbiraha, iyo naasleyda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Fish are the most abundant vertebrates in freshwater lakes, and they play a vital role in the food chain.
entries.translation: Kaluunka wa xayawanka laf-dhabarka leh ee ugu badan ee harooyinka biyaha saafiga ah, waxayna door muhiim ah ka ciyaaraan silsiladda cuntada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some of the most common fish species in freshwater lakes include trout, bass, pike, and perch.
entries.translation: Qaar ka mid ah noocyada kalluunka ee ugu caansan harooyinka biyaha saafiga ah waxaa ka mid ah kalluun, bass, pike, iyo perch.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The storage area is also regularly inspected by the fire department, so that any potential fire hazards can be identified and addressed before they become a problem.

entries.english: As a result of these measures, the storage area is a safe and secure place to store valuable goods.

entries.english: Facebook users are getting drunk and posting about their lives, and it's causing a stir.

entries.english: Some users are concerned that the trend is dangerous, as it could lead to people making poor decisions or doing things they regret.

entries.english: Others are simply amused by the antics of their fellow drunk Facebook users.

entries.english: One user posted a photo of herself passed out on the floor with the caption, "I'm so drunk I can't even stand up."

entries.english: Another user shared a video of herself dancing on a table while shouting, "I'm the life of the party!"

entries.english: "I like it," the toddler said.
entries.translation: "Waan ka helay," socod baradka ayaa yiri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I'm glad," Mommy said. "Plants are good for us. They help clean the air and make us feel better."
entries.translation: "Waan ku faraxsanahay," ayay tiri hooyo. "Dhirta way noo fiican yihiin, waxay naga caawiyaan nadiifinta hawada waxayna na dareensiiyaan wanaag."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The toddler continued to look at the plants. Then, he noticed a cable running along the floor.
entries.translation: Socod baradka ayaa sii waday inuu eego dhirta. Kadib, waxa uu arkay fiilo dhulka dhex maraysa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "What's that?" he asked.
entries.translation: "Waa maxay waxaas?" ayuu weydiiyay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "That's a cable," Mommy said.
entries.translation: "Taasi waa fiilo," Hooyadii ayaa tiri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "It's used to connect the TV to the wall."
entries.translation: "Waxaa loo isticmaalaa in lagula xiro TV-ga darbiga."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Can I touch it?" the toddler asked.
entries.translation: "Ma taaban karaa?" socod baradka ayaa weydiiyey.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "No, you can't," Mommy said. "Cables can be dangerous.They can give you a shock."
entries.translation: "Maya ma taaban kartid," Hooyadi ayaa tiri. "Fiilooyinka waxay noqon karaan khatar. Way kaa nixin karaan."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The toddler looked disappointed, but he didn't touch the cable.
entries.translation: Socod baradka ayaa u muuqday mid niyad jabsan, laakiin ma taaban fiilada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Birthdays are a time to celebrate the day you were born.
entries.translation: Maalamah dhalashada waa wakhti loo dabaaldego maalinta aad dhalatay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a day to reflect on all the good things in your life and to thank those who have made you who you are.
entries.translation: Waa maalin aad ka fikirto wax kasta oo wanaagsan oo noloshaada ah oodna u mahadceliso kuwa kaa dhigay qofka aad tahay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is also a day to set goals for the year ahead and to make plans for the future.
entries.translation: Sidoo kale waa maalin ay tahay in la dejisto hadafyada sanadka soo socda iyo in la dejiyo qorshayaasha mustaqbalka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: To make the most of your birthday, start by making a list of all the things you are grateful for.
entries.translation: Si aad uga faa'iidaysato maalinta dhalashadaada, ku billow samaynta liiska dhammaan waxyaalaha aad ka mahad naqayso.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This could include your family, friends, health, home, job, or anything else that is important to you.
entries.translation: Tan waxaa ku jiri kara qoyskaaga, asxaabtaada, caafimaadkaaga, gurigaaga, shaqada, ama wax kasta oo kale oo muhiim kuu ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once you have made your list, take some time to reflect on each item and how it has made your life better.
entries.translation: Marka aad samaysid liiskaaga, qaado wakhti aad dib ugu milicsato shay kasta iyo sida ay noloshaada u wanaajisay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Next, set some goals for the year ahead.
entries.translation: Marka xigta, daji qaar ka mid ah hadafyada sanadka soo socda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These goals can be anything you want them to be, but they should be specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound.
entries.translation: Hadafyadaan waxay noqon karaan wax kasta oo aad rabto inay noqdaan, laakiin waa inay ahaadaan kuwo gaar ah, la qiyaasi karo, la gaari karo, khuseeya, iyo wakhti xaddidan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, you might set a goal to lose weight, get a promotion at work, or travel to a new place.
entries.translation: Tusaale ahaan, waxaa laga yaabaa inaad dejiso hadaf aad ku dhimi karto miisaankaaga, aad ku heli karto dallacaad shaqo, ama aad u safarto meel cusub.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Finally, make plans for the day of your birthday.
entries.translation: Ugu dambeyntii, qorsheyso maalinta dhalashadaada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This could include spending time with your loved ones, eating your favorite foods, or doing something you have always wanted to do.
entries.translation: Tan waxaa ka mid noqon kara inaad wakhti la qaadato kuwa aad jeceshahay, cunista cuntooyinka aad jeceshahay, ama samaynta wax aad waligaa rabtay inaad samayso.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Person 1: Romantic Comedies are so unrealistic.
entries.translation: Qofka 1aad: Majaajilada jecaylka waa mid aan macquul aheyn.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Person 2: I know, right? The love interests always fall in love at first sight, and they never have any problems.
entries.translation: Qofka 2aad: Waan ogahay, sax? Xiisaha jacaylka had iyo jeer waxay ku dhacaan jacayl aragtida koowaad, weligoodna wax dhibaato ah ma qabaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Person 1: And the conflicts are always so contrived.
entries.translation: Qofka 1aad: Isku dhacyadana had iyo jeer waa kuwo la soo maleego.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Like, in one movie, the couple broke up because the guy's best friend was in love with the girl.
entries.translation: Sida hal filim, lamaanaha ayaa ku kala tagay sababtoo ah ninka saaxiibkiisa ugu fiican ayaa jeclaaday gabadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Person 2: That's so ridiculous. It's not like that happens in real life.
entries.translation: Qofka 2aad: Taasi waa wax aad u qosol badan. Ma aha sidaas oo kale inay dhacdo nolosha dhabta ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Person 1: Exactly. And even when they do get together, it's always so perfect.
entries.translation: Qofka 1aad: Dhab ahaantii. Xataa marka ay isu yimaadaan, had iyo jeer aad bay u qumman tahay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They never have any fights or disagreements.
entries.translation: Weligood dagaal iyo ismaandhaaf midna ma yeelan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Person 2: It's like the movies are trying to tell us that love is always easy and perfect.
entries.translation: Qofka 2aad: Waxay la mid tahay filimada ay isku dayayaan inay noo sheegaan in jacaylka marwalba yahay mid sahlan oo qumman.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But that's not the case.
entries.translation: Laakiin xaaladda sidaas maaha.
