entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Love is hard work.
entries.translation: Jecaylka waa shaqo adag.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It takes time and effort to build a lasting relationship.
entries.translation: Waxay qaadataa wakhti iyo dadaal si loo dhiso xiriir waara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Person 1: I know. That's why I don't watch rom-coms anymore.
entries.translation: Qofka 1aad: Waan ogahay. Taasi waa sababta aanan u daawan rom-coms dambe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They give people unrealistic expectations about love.
entries.translation: Waxay dadka siyaan filashooyin aan macquul ahayn oo ku saabsan jacaylka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My first day of school was a day I will never forget.
entries.translation: Maalintii ugu horeysay ee aan dugsiga bilaabay waxay ahayd maalin aanan ilaawi doonin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was both excited and nervous, not knowing what to expect.
entries.translation: Waxaan ahaa mid farxsan oo hadana kacsan, ma garanayn waxa aan filan karo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When I woke up that morning, I got dressed quickly and ate a quick breakfast.
entries.translation: Subaxaas markii aan soo toosay, si degdeg ah ayaan u labistay oo waxaan cunay quraac fudud.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Then, my mom drove me to school and walked me to my classroom.
entries.translation: Kadib, hooyaday waxay ii kaxaysay dugsiga waxayna ii soo lugaysiisay fasalkayga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When I walked into the classroom, I was immediately greeted by my teacher, Ms. Smith.
entries.translation: Markii aan soo galay fasalka, waxaa isla markiiba isalaamay macalinkayga, Marwo. Smith.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was a kind-looking woman with a warm smile.
entries.translation: Waxay ahayd haweenay naxariis badan oo dhoola cadeyn fiican.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She introduced herself to me and then showed me to my seat.
entries.translation: Way iskay bartay kadibna waxay itustay kursigaygii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I sat down next to a girl named Sarah.
entries.translation: Waxaan ag fadhiistay gabar la yiraahdo Sarah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She smiled at me and said, "Hi, I'm Sarah."
entries.translation: Way ii dhoola cadeysay waxayna itiri, "Haye, waxaan ahay Sarah."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I smiled back and said, "Hi, I'm Vera."
entries.translation: Dib ayaan ugu dhoola cadeeyey oo waxaan ku iri, "Haye, waxaan ahay Vera."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We talked for a few minutes before the bell rang for class to start.
entries.translation: Dhawr daqiiqo ayaan wada hadalnay ka hor inta aan gambaleelka la garaacin si uu fasalka u bilaabo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ms. Smith began by introducing herself and telling us about the rules of the classroom.
entries.translation: Marwo Smith waxay bilowday inay iskeen barto iyadoo noo sheegaysa wax ku sabsan sharciga fasalka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Then, she started teaching us about math.
entries.translation: Ka dibna, waxay bilowday inay wax naga barto xisaab.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was a little bit confused at first, but Ms. Smith explained everything clearly.
entries.translation: Markii hore waan yara wareeray, laakiin Marwo. Smith ayaa wax walba si cad u sharaxday.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After math class, we had a break.
entries.translation: Fasalka xisabta kadib waxan lahayn fasax.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sarah and I went outside to play on the playground.
entries.translation: Aniga iyo Sarah waxaan u baxnay banaanka si aan ugu ciyaarno garoonka ciyaarta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We played on the swings and the slide for a while, then we went back inside for lunch.
entries.translation: Waxaan ku ciyaarnay wiifoowyaasha iyo silixda, ka dib waxaan dib ugu laabanay gudaha si aan qado u cunno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When tissue is injured, the body’s immune system sends white blood cells to the area.
entries.translation: Marka nuddo uu dhaawacmo, habka difaaca jirka wuxuu u diraa unugyo cadcad oo dhiigga ah goobta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These cells release chemicals that cause blood vessels to dilate and become more permeable.
entries.translation: Unugyadani waxay soo daayaan kiimikooyin keena in xididdada dhiigga ay balaartaan oo ay noqdaan kuwo daloola.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This allows fluid and white blood cells to leak out of the blood vessels and into the injured tissue.
entries.translation: Tani waxay u oggolaanaysaa dareeraha iyo unugyada dhiigga cad inay ka soo baxaan xididdada dhiigga oo galaan nudaha dhaawacan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The fluid forms a clear, watery swelling called edema.
entries.translation: Dheecaanka wuxuu sameeyaa barar muuqda, oo biyo leh oo loo yaqaan barar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The white blood cells help to fight infection and to remove damaged tissue.
entries.translation: Unugyada dhiiga cad waxa ay caawiyaan la dagaalanka caabuqa iyo inay saaraan nudaha waxyeelooba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They also release chemicals that stimulate the growth of new tissue.
entries.translation: Waxay sidoo kale sii daayaan kiimikooyin kicinaya koritaanka nuddo cusub.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The classic signs of acute inflammation are redness, heat, swelling, and pain.
entries.translation: Calaamadaha caadiga ah ee bararka degdega ah waa casaan, kulayl, barar, iyo xanuun.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These signs are caused by the increased blood flow and the release of chemicals in the injured tissue.
entries.translation: Calaamadahaan waxaa sababa qulqulka dhiigga oo kordha iyo sii deynta kiimikooyinka ku jira nudaha dhaawacan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Redness is caused by the dilation of blood vessels.
entries.translation: Guduudka waxaa sababa balaarinta xididdada dhiigga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Heat is caused by the increased blood flow and the release of inflammatory chemicals.
entries.translation: Kulaylka waxaa sababa qulqulka dhiigga oo kordha iyo sii daynta kiimikooyinka bararka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Swelling is caused by the leakage of fluid from blood vessels into the injured tissue.
entries.translation: Bararka waxaa sababa dareeraha ka soo daadanaya xididdada dhiigga ee gala nudaha dhaawacan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pain is caused by the release of inflammatory chemicals and the pressure of the swelling.
entries.translation: Xanuunka waxaa sabab sii deynta kiimikooyinka bararka iyo cadaadiska bararka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Acute inflammation is a normal part of the healing process.
entries.translation: Bararaka ba'an waa qayb caadi ah oo ka mid ah habka bogsashada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, if it is severe or prolonged, it can damage healthy tissue.
entries.translation: Si kastaba ha ahaatee, haddii ay daran tahay ama ay daba dheeraato, waxay waxyeeleen kartaa nuddo caafimaad qaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In some cases, acute inflammation can lead to chronic inflammation, which is a long-term condition that can cause pain, disability, and even death.
entries.translation: Xaaladaha qaarkood, bararka degdega ah wuxuu horseedi karaa caabuq daba dheeraad ah, taas oo ah xaalad wakhti dheer ah oo sababi karta xanuun, naafo, iyo xitaa dhimasho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are a number of things that can cause acute inflammation, including infection, injury, and autoimmune diseases.
entries.translation: Waxaa jira dhowr waxyaalood oo sababi kara barar daba dheeraad ah, oo ay ku jiraan infegshonka, dhaawac, iyo cudurrada difaaca jirka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Infections are caused by bacteria, viruses, or fungi.
entries.translation: Infegshonka waxaa sababi karo bakteeria, cabuuq, ama fungi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When these organisms enter the body, they can trigger an immune response that leads to inflammation.
entries.translation: Marka ay noolahaan soo galaan jirka, waxay kicin karaan jawaab celin difaac taasoo keenta barar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Injuries can also cause inflammation.
entries.translation: Dhaawaca waxaa sidoo kale sababi kara barar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When tissue is damaged, it releases chemicals that attract white blood cells and other immune cells to the area.
entries.translation: Marka nudaha ay dhaawacmaan, waxay sii daayaan kiimikooyin u soo jiida unugyada dhiigga cad iyo unugyada kale ee difaaca goobta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These cells release chemicals that cause inflammation.
entries.translation: Unugyada waxay soo daayaan kiimikooyin sababaaya barar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Autoimmune diseases are caused by the body’s immune system attacking its own tissues.
entries.translation: Cudurada difaaca jirka waxaa keena habka difaaca jirka oo weeraro nuddayaashiisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can lead to inflammation in the affected tissues.
entries.translation: Tani waxay u horseedi kartaa barar ku dhaca nuddayaasha ay saameeyeen.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Acute inflammation is usually treated with pain relievers, such as ibuprofen or acetaminophen.
entries.translation: Caadiyan bararka ba'an waxaa lagu daaweeyaa xanuun baabi'iyayaal, sida ibuprofen ama acetaminophen.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In some cases, corticosteroids may be used to reduce inflammation.
entries.translation: Xaaladaha qaarkood, corticosteroids ayaa laga yaabaa in loo isticmaalo si loo yareeyo bararka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If the inflammation is caused by an infection, antibiotics may be prescribed.
entries.translation: Haddii bararka uu keenay infekshon, qalajiyayaal ayaa laga yaabaa in loo qoro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Chronic inflammation is a long-term condition that can cause pain, disability, and even death.
entries.translation: Bararka raaga waa xaalad wakhti dheer ah oo keeni karta xanuun, naafo, iyo xitaa dhimasho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is often caused by autoimmune diseases, such as rheumatoid arthritis and Crohn’s disease.
entries.translation: Inta badan waxaa keena cudurrada difaaca jirka, sida roomatiisinka lafaha iyo cudurka Crohn.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Chronic inflammation can also be caused by obesity, smoking, and air pollution.
entries.translation: Bararka raaga waxaa kale oo sababi kara cayilka, sigaarka, iyo wasakhowga hawada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There is no cure for chronic inflammation, but it can be managed with medication, lifestyle changes, and physical therapy.
entries.translation: Ma jirto wax daawo ah oo loogu talagalay caabuqa raaga, laakiin waxaa lagu maareyn karaa daawooyin, isbeddel qaab nololeedka, iyo daaweyn jireed.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Mozambican Civil War was a conflict that lasted from 1977 to 1992.
entries.translation: Dagaalkii Sokeeye ee Mozambique wuxuu ahaa dagaal socday 1977-kii ilaa 1992-kii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The war caused widespread devastation and displacement, and led to the deaths of an estimated 1 million people.
entries.translation: Dagaalka wuxuu sababay burbur iyo barakac baahsan, waxaana ku dhintay dad lagu qiyaasay 1 milyan oo qof.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The war began after RENAMO launched an insurgency against FRELIMO in 1977.
entries.translation: Dagalka wuxu bilowday kadib markii RENAMO ay bilooween kacdoon ka dhan ah FRELIMO 1977kii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: RENAMO was opposed to FRELIMO's socialist policies and its close ties to the Soviet Union.
entries.translation: RENAMO waxay ka soo horjeedeen siyaasadii hantiwadaaga ee FRELIMO iyo xiriirkii dhowaa ee ay la lahaayeen Midowgii Soofiyeedka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The war quickly escalated, and by the early 1980s, RENAMO had control of much of the countryside.
entries.translation: Dagaalka si degdeg ah ayuu u kordhay, horraantii 1980naadkii, RENAMO waxay inta badan gacanta ku hayyeen baadiyaha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: FRELIMO was forced to rely on Soviet and Cuban military aid to keep RENAMO at bay.
entries.translation: FRELIMO waxaa lagu qasbay inay ku tiirsanaadaan kaalmada milatari ee Soofiyeedka iyo Kuuba si ay RENAMO u ilaaliso.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1984, FRELIMO and RENAMO signed a peace agreement, but the fighting continued.
entries.translation: Sanadkii 1984kii, FRELIMO iyo RENAMO waxay saxiixeen heshiis nabadeed, laakiin dagaalka wuu sii socday.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1992, the two sides signed a new peace agreement, which called for a ceasefire and the holding of multiparty elections.
entries.translation: Sanadki 1992-kii, labada dhinac waxay saxiixeen heshiis nabadeed oo cusub, kaas oo dhigaya in xabadda la joojiyo, lana qabto doorashooyinka xisbiyada badan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a bright and sunny day in the small village of Locksmiths, and the festival of locks was in full swing.
entries.translation: Waxay ahayd maalin iftiimaysa oo qorrax ah tuulada yar ee Locksmiths, waxaana si xawli ah u socday xaflada qufulka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The streets were crowded with people, all eager to see the latest and greatest in lockmaking technology.
entries.translation: Waddooyinka waxaa buux dhaafiyay dad badan, kuwaas oo dhamaantood u hamuun qabay in ay arkaan tiknoolajiyada ugu dambeysay uguna weyn.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There were vendors selling everything from simple padlocks to complex combination locks, and artisans demonstrating their skills in lockpicking and locksmithing.
entries.translation: Waxaa jiray waratada wax walba iibinaya laga soo bilaabo qufulo fudud ilaa quful adag oo isku dhafan, iyo farsamoyaqaanno muujinaya xirfadahooda xirida iyo qufulida.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the center of the village square, a large stage had been set up for the day's festivities.
entries.translation: Bartamaha fagaaraha tuulada, ayaa waxaa la dhigay madal aad u ballaaran oo loogu talagalay dabaaldegyada maalintaas.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A group of musicians were playing lively tunes, and a crowd of people were gathered around, clapping and dancing.
entries.translation: Koox fanaaniin ah ayaa tumayay heeso xamaasad leh, waxaana la isugu soo baxay dad badan oo sacab iyo qoob ka cayaarayay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: On the stage, a skilled locksmith was demonstrating how to pick a lock, and the crowd was mesmerized by his skill.
entries.translation: Masraxa dhexdiisa, xirfadle locksmith ayaa ku soo bandhigayay sida loo doorto qufulka, dadweynihiina aad ayay ula dhaceen xirfadiisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As the sun began to set, the festival came to a close.
entries.translation: Markay qorraxda sii dhacayso, waxa soo xirmay xaflada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My friend, Abel, and I were walking home from school one day when we saw a blood drive being held at our local community center.
entries.translation: Aniga iyo saaxiibkay, Abel, waxaan ka soo baxaynay dugsiga oon u soconay guriga maalin markaan aragnay dhacdo dhiig shubis oo lagu hayo xarunta bulshada deegaankeena.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We were both 17 years old, and we had never donated blood before.
entries.translation: Labadeenaba 17 jir ayaan ahayn, waligeenna horay dhiig uma shubin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We decided to stop in and see what it was all about.
entries.translation: Waxaan go'aansanay inaan joogsano oo aan aragno waxay ku saabsan tahay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The process of donating blood was actually pretty simple.
entries.translation: Habka dhiig shubista runtii wuxuu ahaa mid fudud.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We both filled out a questionnaire and answered some questions about our health history.
entries.translation: Labadeenaba waxaan buuxinay xogwaraysi waxaana ka jawaabnay su'aalo ku saabsan taariikhdeena caafimaad.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Then, we had our blood pressure checked and our veins were checked to make sure they were big enough.
entries.translation: Kadib, waxaa nalaga cabiray cadaadiska dhiigaaga waxaana la fiiriyay xididaheena si loo hubiyo inay weyn yihiin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once we were cleared to donate, we each sat down in a chair and had a needle inserted into our arms.
entries.translation: Markii naloo caddeeyey in aan shubi karno, mid walba waxa uu ku fadhiistay kursi, waxaana gacmaheena la galiyay cirbad.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The blood was collected in a bag, and the whole process took about 15 minutes.
entries.translation: Dhiiga waxa lagu soo ururiyay bac, hawsha oo dhanna waxay qaadatay ilaa 15 daqiiqo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It felt good to know that we were helping to save lives.
entries.translation: Way fiicneed inaan ogaano inaan gacan ka gaysanaynay badbaadint nolosha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After we donated, we were given a juice box and a cookie to help us recover.
entries.translation: Ka dib markii aan shubnay, waxaa nala siiyay kartoon cabitaan iyo buskud si ay nooga caawiso inaan soo kabano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We also received a thank-you card from the blood bank.
entries.translation: Waxaa kale oo aan kaarka mahadnaqa ka guddoonnay bangiga dhiigga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm glad that Abel and I decided to donate blood.
entries.translation: Waan ku faraxsanahay in aniga iyo Abel aan go'aansanay inaan dhiig ku deeqno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a quick and easy way to make a difference in the world.
entries.translation: Waxay ahayd hab degdeg ah oo fudud oo aduunka isbeddel lagu samayn karo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I encourage everyone to consider donating blood if they are eligible.
entries.translation: Waxaan ku dhiirigelinayaa qof walba inuu tixgeliyo dhiig shubida haddii ay u qalmaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's a simple act of kindness that can help save lives.
entries.translation: Waa ficil yaroo naxariis ah taas oo gacan ka geysan kara badbaadinta nolosha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A solo traveler was found safe after spending two nights lost in the Swiss Alps.
entries.translation: Musaafir keligiis ah ayaa la helay isagoo bad qaba ka dib markii uu laba habeen ku dhex lumay buuraha Alps ee Swiss.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The 25-year-old woman, who has not been identified, was hiking in the mountains when she became separated from her group.
entries.translation: Haweeneydan 25 jirka ah, oo aan la aqoonsan, ayaa ku socotay buuraha markii ay kala lumeen kooxdeeda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was reported missing on Tuesday, and search teams were dispatched to find her.
entries.translation: Waxaa la sheegay in la waayay Talaadadii, kooxo baarayaash ayaana loo diray si ay u soo helaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The woman was eventually found on Thursday, about 10 miles from where she had been hiking.
entries.translation: Haweeneyda ayaa ugu dambeyntii laga helay Khamiistii, meel 10 mayl u jirta halkii ay ku socotay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was cold and dehydrated, but otherwise in good condition.
entries.translation: Waxay ahayd mid qabowday oo fuuqbaxday, laakiin sideeda kale xaaladdeeda way wanaagsanayd.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She told rescuers that she had been following a trail when she got turned around.
entries.translation: Waxay u sheegtay badbaadiyayaasha in ay daba socotay markii ay dhinac u leexatay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She spent the night in a cave, and she survived by eating snow and drinking from a stream.
entries.translation: Waxay ku hoyatay god, waxayna ku nooleed cunista barafka iyo cabista biyaha isha ka socday.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The woman's experience is a reminder of the importance of being prepared when hiking in the mountains.
entries.translation: Waayo-aragnimada haweeneyda waa mid xasuusinaysa muhiimadda ay leedahay in loo diyaargaroobo markaad buuraha ku socoto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hikers should always bring a map, compass, and a flashlight, and they should tell someone where they are going and when they expect to return.
entries.translation: Buur koroyaasha waa inay had iyo jeer la yimaadaan khariidad, jiheeye, iyo toosh, waana inay qof u sheegaan meesha ay u socdaan iyo goorta ay filayaan inay soo noqdaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When I was a kid, I would spend hours poring over magazines.
entries.translation: Markii aan yaraa, waxaan ku qaadan jiray saacado inaan akhriyo joornaalada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I would read every article, look at every picture, and cut out the ones I liked to put in my scrapbook.
entries.translation: Waan akhri jiray maqaal kasta, fiirin jiray sawir kasta, oo waan gooyn jiray kuwa aan ka helo si aan buug-gacmeedkayga ugu dhejiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I loved the way magazines could transport me to different worlds and make me think about things in new ways.
entries.translation: Waxaan jeclaa sida ay majaladaha iigu gudbin jireen aduunyo kala duwan oo ay iiga dhigi jireen in aan waxyaabaha uga fikiro siyaabo cusub.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, I was reading an article about brain science in a magazine.
entries.translation: Maalin maalmaha ka mid ah, waxaan akhrinayay maqaal ku saabsan sayniska maskaxda oo ku jira majalad.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The article was really interesting, and it made me think about how my brain works.
entries.translation: Runtii maqaalka wuxuu ahaa mid xiiso leh, wuxuuna igu dhaliyay inaan ka fikiro sida maskaxdayda u shaqeyso.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I realized that I could use my brain to learn anything I wanted, and that was an amazing feeling.
entries.translation: Waxaan ogaaday inaan maskaxdayda u isticmaali karo inaan ku barto wax kasta oo aan rabo, taasina waxay ahayd dareen cajiib ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I've been reading magazines ever since, and I still love the way they can open my mind to new ideas.
entries.translation: Tan iyo markaas waxaan akhrin jiray majaladaha, welina waan jeclahay sida ay maskaxdayda ugu furi karaan fikrado cusub.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The debate about whether animals are happier in the wild or in zoos is a complex one with no easy answers.
entries.translation: Doodda ku saabsan in xayawaanada ku faraxsan yihiin duurjooga beerta xanaanada waa mid adag oo aan jawaabo fudud lahayn.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many factors to consider, including the individual animal's needs, the type of zoo, and the quality of care provided.
entries.translation: Waxaa jira arrimo badan oo loo baahan yahay in la tixgeliyo, oo ay ku jiraan baahida xayawaanka gaarka ah, nooca xayawaanka, iyo tayada daryeelka la bixiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some animals, such as elephants, are highly social and need to interact with other elephants in order to thrive.
entries.translation: Xayawaanada qaar, sida maroodiga, waa kuwo aad u bulsho ah oo u baahan inay la falgalaan maroodiga kale si ay u koraan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the wild, elephants live in herds of up to 100 individuals.
entries.translation: Duur-joogta, maroodiga waxay ku nool yihiin raac gaaraya 100 xayawaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They spend their days foraging for food, playing, and socializing.
entries.translation: Maalmahooda waxay ku dhammaystaan ​​cunto-raadis, ciyaar, iyo is-dhexgal.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In a zoo, elephants may not have the same opportunities to interact with other elephants, which can lead to boredom and frustration.
entries.translation: Beerta xanaanada, maroodiga waxa laga yaabaa inaysan helin fursado isku mid ah oo ay kula falgalaan maroodiyaasha kale, taas oo keeni karta caajis iyo niyad jab.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Other animals, such as lions, are solitary hunters.
entries.translation: Xayawaanada kale, sida libaaxyada, waa ugaarsato keli ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the wild, lions live in prides of up to 15 individuals.
entries.translation: Duurjoogta, libaaxyada waxay ku nool yihiin koox ilaa 15 xayawaan ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, each lion within the pride has its own territory and does not interact with other lions very often.
entries.translation: Si kastaba ha ahaatee, libaax kasta oo kooxda ku jira wuxuu leeyahay dhul u gaar ah mana la macaamilo libaaxyada kale marar inta badan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In a zoo, lions may be able to live in larger enclosures with more space to roam, which can provide them with more opportunities to exercise and explore.
entries.translation: Beerta xanaanada, libaaxyada waxaa laga yaabaa inay ku noolaadaan xayndaabyo waaweyn oo leh meelo badan oo ay ku wareegaan, taas oo siin karta fursado badan oo ay ku jimicsadaan oo ay ku dalxiisaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The type of zoo also plays a role in the welfare of its animals.
entries.translation: Nooca beerta xanaanada ayaa sidoo kale door ka ciyaara daryeelka xoolaheeda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some zoos are very large and provide their animals with spacious enclosures, while others are smaller and may not have as much space.
entries.translation: Beeraha xanaanada qaar ayaa ah kuwo aad u weyn oo xoolahooda siiya xayndaab aad u waasac ah, halka kuwa kalena ay ka yar yihiin oo laga yaabo in aanay haysan meel aad u waasac ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As I'm driving down the road, I see a goat giving birth in the median.
entries.translation: Inta aan wadada ku sii socdo, waxaan arkayaa ri’ ku umushay dhexda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She's lying on her side and her two front legs are extended in front of her.
entries.translation: Dhinac ayay u jiiftaa oo labadeeda lugood ee hore ayaa horteeda ku fidsan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The baby goat is coming out of her right side and it's head is already visible.
entries.translation: Ariga yar ayaa ka soo baxaya dhinaceeda midig, madaxiisana durba waaba muuqdaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The mother goat looks up at me and I can see the fear in her eyes.
entries.translation: Ri'da hooyada ah ayaa kor ii fiirisay, waxaana indhaheeda ka arkayaa baqdinta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She's probably wondering if I'm going to hurt her or her baby.
entries.translation: Waxay u badan tahay inay la yaaban tahay inaan waxyeello u geysan doono iyada ama ilmaheeda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I stop the car and get out.
entries.translation: Gaariga ayaan joojiyaya waana kaasoo degtay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I walk over to the goat and kneel down next to her.
entries.translation: Waxaan u sii gudbay arigii oo aan ag jilba jabsaday.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I gently stroke her head and tell her that everything is going to be okay.
entries.translation: Si tartiib ah ayaan madaxa uga salaaxay oo u sheegay in wax walba ay hagaagayaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The baby goat starts to emerge and I can see that it's a little girl.
entries.translation: Cunugii ariga ahaa ayaa soo baxay waxaanan arkayaa inay tahay inan yar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She's crying and her mother licks her clean.
entries.translation: Way ooyaysaa, hooyadeedna way leeftay si ay u nadiifiso.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I watch as the mother goat and baby bond and I feel a sense of peace.
entries.translation: Waxaan daawanayaa sida hooyada ri'da ah iyo ilmaha ay isugu dhagan yihiin waxaana dareemayaa dareen nabadeed.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The city was a vast, sprawling metropolis, full of life and energy.
entries.translation: Magaalada waxay ahayd magaalo aad u baaxad wayn, oo fidsan, nolol iyo tamar ka buuxda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a place where anything was possible, and where dreams could come true.
entries.translation: Waxay ahayd meel ay wax walba ka suurtoobaan, oona riyooyinka rumoobaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But for every person who found success in the city, there were many more who struggled to make ends meet.
entries.translation: Laakiin qof kasta oo magaalada guul ka gaaray, waxaa jiray qaar kale oo badan oo u halgamay sidii ay nolol maalmeedkooda u heli lahaayeen.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These people lived in the slums, in tiny apartments that were often overcrowded and in disrepair.
entries.translation: Dadkaan waxay ku noolaayeen xaafadaha isku raranta ah, iyaga oo ku noolaa guryo yaryar oo inta badan ay buux dhaafiyeen oona burbursanaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They worked long hours for low pay, and they often had to go without basic necessities like food and healthcare.
entries.translation: Waxay ku shaqeeynayaan saacado dheer mushahar yar, waxayna badanaa ku qasbanaadaan inay iska baxaan iyagoon haysan baahiyaha aasaasiga ah sida cuntada iyo daryeelka caafimaadka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One such person was a young woman named Amelia.
entries.translation: Mid ka mid ah dadka noocaas ah waxay ahayd gabar yar oo la oran jiray Amelia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She had come to the city with big dreams, but she quickly found that reality was much different than she had imagined.
entries.translation: Waxay la timid magaalada riyooyin waaweyn, laakiin waxay si degdeg ah u ogaatay in xaqiiqadaas ka duwan tahay sidii ay moodaysay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She worked as a waitress in a small diner, and she could barely make enough money to pay her rent.
entries.translation: Waxay kabalyeeri ahaan uga shaqeysay maqaaxi yar oo casho ah, oo ay ku dhibtootay inay hesho lacag ku filan oo ay ku bixiso kiradeeda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She often went to bed hungry, and she was always worried about her future.
entries.translation: Inta badan iyada oo gaajaysan ayay seexan jirtay, mar walbana waxay ka walwalsanaan jirtay mustaqbalkeeda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, Amelia was walking home from work when she saw a man sitting on a bench.
entries.translation: Maalin maalmaha ka mid ah, Amelia iyada oo guriga u soo socota kana timid shaqada ayaa waxay aragtay nin ku fadhiya kursi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was homeless, and he was holding a sign that said, "Will work for food." Amelia felt sorry for the man, and she decided to buy him a sandwich.
entries.translation: Waxa uu ahaa guri la'aan, oo waxa uu sitay boor ay ku qoran tahay, "Waxaan u shaqayn doonaa cunto." Amelia way u naxday ninka, waxayna go'aansatay inay u soo iibiso sandwich.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As she was talking to the man, she learned that his name was Charlie.
entries.translation: Markii ay la hadlaysay ninkii, waxay ogaatay in magaciisa uu yahay Charlie.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Demonetization is the process of removing legal tender from circulation.
entries.translation: Lacag bedelida waa habka looga saarayo qandaraaska sharciga ah wareegga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In India, Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced on November 8, 2016, that all ₹500 and ₹1000 banknotes would cease to be legal tender from midnight.
entries.translation: Hindiya gudaheeda, Ra'iisul wasaare Narendra Modi wuxuu ku dhawaaqay 8-da Noofeembar, 2016, in dhammaan ₹500 iyo ₹1000 lacagta xaashida ah ay joojinayaan inay noqdaan hindise sharci ah laga bilaabo saqda dhexe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This move was intended to crack down on corruption and counterfeiting, but it also caused significant disruption and hardship for many people.
entries.translation: Talaabadan ayaa ula jeedadeeda ahayd in lagula dagaalamo musuqmaasuqa iyo wax yaabaha been abuurka ah, balse waxay dad badan ku keentay khalkhal iyo dhibaato xoogan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are several reasons to be skeptical of demonetization.
entries.translation: Waxaa jira dhowr sababood oo laga shakisan yahay lacag bedelida.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: First, it is not clear that it will be effective in reducing corruption.
entries.translation: Marka koowaad, ma cadda inay wax ku ool u noqon doonto dhimista musuqmaasuqa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Corruption is a complex problem that cannot be solved simply by removing cash from circulation.
entries.translation: Musuqmaasuqa waa dhibaato adag oo aan si fudud loogu xalin karin in lacagta caddaanka ah suuqa laga saaro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In fact, there is some evidence that demonetization may actually increase corruption, as it makes it more difficult for people to track and trace their money.
entries.translation: Xaqiiqdii, waxaa jira cadaymo muujinaya in lacag bedelida ay dhab ahaantii kordhin karto musuqmaasuqa, maadaama ay ku adkeynayso dadka inay raad raacaan oo ay raadiyaan lacagtooda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Second, demonetization is likely to have a negative impact on the poor.
entries.translation: Marka labaad, lacag bdelida waxay u badan tahay inay saameyn taban ku yeelato masaakiinta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Many poor people in India rely on cash for their daily transactions.
entries.translation: Dad badan oo sabool ah ee Hindiya ku nool ayaa ku tiirsan lacagta caddaanka ah ee wax kala iibsigooda maalin laha ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The sudden withdrawal of large-denomination banknotes made it difficult for them to buy food, pay their bills, and access other essential services.
entries.translation: Lacagaha xaashida ah ee sida lama filaanka ah looga baxshay ayaa ku adkeysay in ay cunto gataan, bixiyaan biilasha iyo adeegyada kale ee muhiimka ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Third, demonetization has caused significant disruption to the economy.
entries.translation: Mida sadaxad, lacag bedelida waxay u horseeday carqaladayn wayn dhaqaalaha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Businesses had to close for days or even weeks while they adjusted to the new currency.
entries.translation: Ganacsiyada waxay xireen maalmo ama xitaa isbuucyo inta ay la bedelayaan lacagta cusub.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The dish is said to have originated in the Philippines, where it is known as lechon.
entries.translation: Cuntada ayaa la sheegay in ay ka timid dalka Filibiin, halkaas oo loo yaqaanno lechon.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is also popular in other parts of Southeast Asia, such as Indonesia, Malaysia, and Thailand.
entries.translation: Waxay sidoo kale caan ka tahay qaybaha kale ee Koonfur-bari Aasiya, sida Indonesia, Malaysia, iyo Thailand.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: To make lechon, a whole pig is gutted and cleaned, then stuffed with a mixture of garlic, ginger, lemongrass, and other spices.
entries.translation: Si loo sameeyo lechon, doofaarka dhan ayaa la shiidaa oo la nadiifiyaa, ka dibna lagu shubaa isku dar ah toon, sinjibiil, liin, iyo carfiyayaal kale.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The pig is then roasted over a fire of charcoal or wood for several hours.
entries.translation: Doofaarka ayaa markaa lagu dubaa dab dhuxul ah ama qoryo ah dhowr saacadood.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The result is a juicy, flavorful meat that is perfect for a special occasion.
entries.translation: Natiijada waa hilib dhiidhiimaya, dhadhan leh oo ku habboon munaasabad gaar ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Lechon is often served with rice and vegetables.
entries.translation: Lechon waxaa badanaa lagu cunaa bariis iyo khudaar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It can also be eaten as a main course or as an appetizer.
entries.translation: Waxaa kale oo loo cuni karaa sida cuntada ugu weyn ama cunto kusii sugis.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are ever lucky enough to try lechon, you will not be disappointed.
entries.translation: Haddii aad waligaa nasiib u leedahay inaad isku daydo lechon, ma niyad jabi doontid.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is truly a unique and delicious dish.
entries.translation: Xaqiiqdii waa mid gaar ah iyo cunto macaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition to the traditional method of cooking lechon, there are also several modern variations.
entries.translation: Marka lagu daro hab dhaqameedka karinta lechon, waxaa sidoo kale jira dhowr nooc oo casri ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some chefs cook the pig in a pit oven, while others use a rotisserie.
entries.translation: Cunto kariyayaasha qaarkood waxay ku kariyaan doofaarka foornada godka, halka kuwa kalena ay isticmaalaan rotisserie.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are also recipes for making lechon in a slow cooker or in the oven.
entries.translation: Waxa sidoo kale jiro habab cunto karin ee loo sameeyo lechon kariye gaabiya ama foornada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: No matter how it is cooked, lechon is always a crowd-pleaser.
entries.translation: Si kasta oo loo kariyo, lechon had iyo jeer waa mid dadka ka farxiya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a hearty and flavorful dish that is perfect for any occasion.
entries.translation: Waa cunto macaan oo dhadhan fiican leh oo ku habboon munaasabad kasta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So if you are looking for a new and exciting dish to try, lechon is definitely worth a look.
entries.translation: Marka haddii aad raadinayso cunto cusub oo xiiso leh oo aad isku daydo, lechon xaqiiqdii waa u qalantaa in la fiiriyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Me: What's up with your car? It's been making a weird noise lately.
entries.translation: Aniga: maxa ku dhacay gaarigaaga? Wuxuu sameynayay qaylo yaab leh baryahaan dambe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Uncle: Yeah, I know. I'm taking it to the mechanic tomorrow.
entries.translation: Adeer: Haa, waan ogahay. Waxaan geynayaa makaanigga berrito.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Me: Is it going to be expensive.
entries.translation: Aniga: waxay noqonaysaa mid qaali ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Uncle: It might be. The car is old, and parts are hard to come by. But I'm hoping it's just a minor issue.
entries.translation: Adeer: Waa laga yaabaa. Gaariga waa duq, qaybahana way adagtahay in la soo helo. Laakiin waxaan rajeynayaa inay tahay arrin yar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Me: Well, good luck. Let me know what the mechanic says.
entries.translation: Aniga: Hagaag, nasiib wacan. ii soo sheeg waxa makaaniga dhaho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Uncle: I will. Thanks.
entries.translation: Adeer: Waan samayn doonaa. Waad mahadsantahay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Me: Hey, by the way, did you know that nuclear cars are a thing?
entries.translation: Aniga: Haye, hadaba, ma ogtahay in baabuurta Nukliyeerka ay wax yihiin?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Uncle: No, I didn't. That's interesting.
entries.translation: Adeer: Maya, ma ogi. Taasi waa mid xiiso leh.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Me: Yeah, they're pretty cool. They use nuclear power to generate electricity, which powers the car's motor.
entries.translation: Aniga: Haa, aad ayay u fiican yihiin. Waxay adeegsadaan tamarta Nukliyeerka si ay u dhaliyaan koronto, taas oo awood siinaysa matoorka gaariga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Uncle: That sounds like it would be really expensive.
entries.translation: Adeer: Taasi waxay u muuqataa inay runtii qaali noqon doonto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Me: It can be, but it's also a lot more efficient than traditional cars. Nuclear cars can go for hundreds of miles on a single tank of fuel.
entries.translation: Aniga: Way noqon kartaa, laakiin sidoo kale aad ayay uga waxtar badan tahay baabuurtii hore. Baabuurta Nukliyeerka ah waxay ku socon karaan boqollaal mayl hal fuusto oo shidaal ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Uncle: Hmm, I'll have to look into that.
entries.translation: Adeer: hhm, wa inaan taasna fiiriyaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A man walks into a comedy club and orders a filet mignon.
entries.translation: Nin ayaa soo galay goob majaajillo ah oona dalbaday filet mignon.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The waiter brings him the steak and he starts to eat it.
entries.translation: Kabalyeeriga waxa uu u keenay hilib waxa uuna bilaabay in uu cuno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After a few bites, he stops and says, "This steak is terrible! It's tough and tasteless."
entries.translation: Dhawr qaniinyo kadib, wuu joojiyay wuxuuna yiri, "Hilibkaan waa mid aad u qariban! Waa adag yahay dhadhanne malahan."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The waiter replies, "Well, sir, you did order a filet mignon."
entries.translation: Kabalyeeriga wuxuu ku jawaabay, "Hagaag, mudane, waxaad dalbatay mignon filet."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Yes, but I didn't order a raw filet mignon!"
entries.translation: "Haa, laakin ma dalban filet mignon cayrin!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Sir, all of our steaks are served raw. We require our customers to cook them themselves."
entries.translation: "Mudane, dhammaan hilibkeena waxaa lagu bixiyaa cayriin. Waxaan u baahanahay macaamiisheena inay iyaga laftooda karsadaan."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "But I don't know how to cook!"
entries.translation: "Laakiin ma garanaayo sida loo kariyo!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "That's not our problem. We're a comedy club, not a restaurant."
entries.translation: "Taas dhibkeena maaha. Waxaan nahay goob majaajillo, ee ma nihin makhaayad."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The man angrily gets up and storms out of the club.
entries.translation: Ninkii isagoo caraysan ayuu kacay kana soo baxay goobtii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He had been in a car accident, and he was unconscious.
entries.translation: Shil baabuur ayuu galay, wuuna miyir daboolmay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: His parents, who had been driving by when the accident happened, rushed to his side.
entries.translation: Waalidiintiisa oo markii uu shilka dhacay ay wada socdeen ayaa dhankiisa u soo yaacay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They were frantic with worry.
entries.translation: Walwal badan ayay qabeen.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The paramedics arrived and loaded the boy into an ambulance.
entries.translation: Waxaa goobta yimid kalkaaliyayaal caafimaad, waxayna ku rareen wiilka gaariga ambalaasta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: His parents followed in their car, their hearts pounding with fear.
entries.translation: Waalidiintiisa ayaa baabuurkooda ladaba raacay, wadnohooda la garaacmayo baqdin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: At the hospital, the doctors examined the boy and determined that he had a concussion and a broken leg.
entries.translation: Isbitaalka, dhakhaatiirta ayaa ku baareen wiilkan, waxaanay ogaadeen inuu miyir beelay oo lugna ka jabtay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They admitted him to the hospital and began treatment.
entries.translation: Isbitaalka ayay dhigeen waxayna u bilaabeen daaweyn.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The boy's parents stayed by his side, never leaving him alone.
entries.translation: Waalidiinta wiilka ayaa garabkiisa joogay, weligoodna kama tegin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They watched over him as he slept, their hearts filled with love and hope.
entries.translation: Waxay fiirinayeen ilaa uu ka hurdo, qalbiyadooda waxaa ka buuxsamay jacayl iyo rajo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Royalty," said the Blacksmith, "is a curious thing. It's a kind of magic, really.
entries.translation: "Boqortooyanimo," ayuu yiri Blacksmith, "waa shay cajiib ah. Waa nooc sixir ah, runtii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: People get all worked up about it, and they don't even know why.
entries.translation: Dadka intooda badan way ka shaqeeyaan, oo xitaa ma garanayaan sababta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's not as if kings and queens have any real power, these days. They're just figureheads.
entries.translation: Ma aha sida haddii boqorada iyo boqorrada ay leeyihiin wax awood dhab ah, maalmahan. Waa un kaliya madax.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But people still seem to need them.
entries.translation: Laakiin dadka weli waxay u muuqdaan inay u baahan yihiin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They need someone to look up to, someone to represent the idea of the nation." The Blacksmith paused.
entries.translation: Waxay u baahan yihiin cid ka warqabta, qof matasha fikradda qaranka." Blacksmith ayaa hakaday.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I suppose it's a kind of comfort," he continued.
entries.translation: "Waxaan u maleynayaa inay tahay nooc raaxo," ayuu sii raaciyay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "To know that there's someone out there who's better than you.
entries.translation: "Si aad u ogaato in uu jiro qof adiga kaa fiican.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Someone who's got it all sorted out.
entries.translation: Qof wax xalin kara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Someone who can make the world a better place.
entries.translation: Qof dunida ka dhigi kara meel wanaagsan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Of course, it's all an illusion. But that doesn't make it any less important.
entries.translation: Dabcan, dhammaan waa dhalanteed. Laakiin taasi kama dhigayso midaan muhiim ahayn.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: People need their illusions. They need to believe in something.
entries.translation: Dadka waxay u baahan yihiin dhalanteedkooda. Waxay u baahan yihiin inay wax rumaystaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And if that something is a king or a queen, then so be it."
entries.translation: Oo hadday waxaas yihiin boqor ama boqorrad, markaas way yihiin."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Blacksmith paused for a moment, then smiled.
entries.translation: Blacksmith ayaa cabbaar hakaday, ka dibna dhoola cadeeyay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Old Man and the Sea
entries.translation: Odaygii iyo Badda
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Santiago, an old Cuban fisherman, has gone eighty-four days without catching a fish.
entries.translation: Santiago, oo ah kalluumayste hore oo Kuubaan ah, ayaa siddeetan iyo afar maalmood qaban wax kalluun ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He is the oldest man in the village, and the youngest, Manolin, no longer wants to fish with him because the old man is unlucky.
entries.translation: Waa ninka ugu da'da weyn tuulada, kan ugu yar, Manolin, ma rabo inuu la kalluumeysto, sababtoo ah odayga nasiib malahan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, Santiago sets out in his skiff and hooks a giant marlin.
entries.translation: Maalin maalmaha ka mid ah, Santiago waxa uu soo xirxirtay doontiisii oona soo dabtay malaay weyn.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The marlin is so big that it pulls the skiff far out to sea.
entries.translation: Malaayga aad buu u weyn yahay oo wuxuu u soo jiidayaa doontii meel aad uga baxsan badda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Santiago fights the marlin for two days and nights, but he cannot bring it in.
entries.translation: Santiago wuxuu la dagaallamayay malayga laba maalmood iyo habeen, laakiin ma keeni karo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The marlin is too heavy, and the old man is too tired.
entries.translation: Malayga waa mid aad u culus, odaygana aad buu u daalan yahay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Finally, the marlin begins to tire.
entries.translation: Ugu dambeyntii, malaygii ayaa bilaabay inuu daallo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Santiago is able to get a harpoon into the marlin, and he kills it.
entries.translation: Santiago waxa uu awood u leeyahay in uu ganta soo galsho malayga, wuuna dilayaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But the marlin is so big that Santiago cannot bring it into the boat.
entries.translation: Laakiin malayga aad ayuu u weyn yahay oo Santiago ma keeni karo doonta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He ties the marlin to the side of the boat and begins to row back to shore.
entries.translation: Malayga ayuu ku xiray dhinaca doonta wuxuuna bilaabay inuu dib ugu soo laabto xeebta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A school of sharks follows the boat, and they begin to eat the marlin.
entries.translation: Xoon libaax baddeed ah ayaa soo raacay doonta, waxayna bilaabeen inay cunaan malayga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Santiago fights the sharks off, but he cannot stop them all.
entries.translation: Santiago wuxuu la dagaallamaa libaax badeeedyada, laakiin ma joojin karo dhammaantood.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By the time he reaches shore, only the head and the tail of the marlin are left.
entries.translation: Markii uu soo gaaray xeebta, kaliya madaxa iyo dabada malayga ayaa soo haray.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The police will likely take the person to the station and question him.
entries.translation: Booliiska waxay u badan tahay inay qofka geeyaan saldhigga oo ay su'aalo waydiiyaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They will want to know where he got the wallet and why he was carrying it.
entries.translation: Waxay rabaan inay ogaadaan meesha uu ka keenay boorsada iyo sababta uu u sitay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If the person cannot provide a satisfactory explanation, he may be arrested and charged with theft.
entries.translation: Haddii qofka aanan bixin karin sharraxaad lagu qanco, waxa laga yaabaa in la xiro oo lagu soo oogo xatooyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If the person is arrested, he will be taken to jail and held until his trial.
entries.translation: Haddii qofka la qabto xabsiga ayaa la geynayaa waxaana lagu hayn doonaa ilaa maxkamadeyntiisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: At his trial, the prosecution will have to prove beyond a reasonable doubt that he is guilty of theft.
entries.translation: Maxkamadeyntiisa, xeer ilaalinta waa inay caddeyso shaki macquul ah inuu dembiile u yahay xatooyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The defense will have the opportunity to present evidence and witnesses that may help to exonerate the person.
entries.translation: Difaacaha ayaa heli doona fursad uu ku soo bandhigo cadeymo iyo marqaatiyaal caawin kara in qofka laga saaro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If the person is found guilty, he may be sentenced to jail time, probation, or community service.
entries.translation: Haddii qofka lagu helo dambi, waxaa lagu xukumi karaa xabsi, tijaabo, ama adeeg bulsho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He may also be ordered to pay restitution to the victim of the theft.
entries.translation: Waxa kale oo laga yaabaa in lagu xukumo inuu siiyo magdhow dhibbanaha xatooyada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In some cases, the person may be able to avoid criminal charges by entering into a diversion program.
entries.translation: Xaaladaha qaarkood, qofka waxaa laga yaabaa inuu ka fogaado eedeymaha dembiga isagoo galaya barnaamijka weecinta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Diversion programs are designed to help people who have committed minor crimes avoid the criminal justice system.
entries.translation: Barnaamijyada weecinta waxaa loogu talagalay in lagu caawiyo dadka galay dambiyada fudud in ay ka fogaadaan nidaamka cadaaladda dembiyada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In a diversion program, the person may be required to complete community service, pay restitution, or attend counseling.
entries.translation: Barnaamijka weecinta, qofka waxaa laga yaabaa in looga baahdo inuu dhamaystiro adeega bulshada, bixiyo magdhow, ama ka qayb galo la-talinta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If the person is found not guilty, he will be released from jail and the charges against him will be dropped.
entries.translation: Haddii qofka lagu waayo wax dambi ah, waa laga sii dayn doonaa xabsiga, waxaana meesha laga saari doonaa eedeymaha loo haysto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He will be able to go on with his life without a criminal record.
entries.translation: Waxa uu awood u yeelan doonaa in uu noloshiisa sii wato isaga oo aan wax dambi ah lahayn.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is important to note that the above is just a general overview of what may happen to a presumed thief who is held by police.
entries.translation: Waxaa muhiim ah in la ogaado in kuwan kor ku xusan ay yihiin uun dulmar guud oo ku saabsan waxa ku dhici kara tuug la malaynayo oo ay booliska hayaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The specific circumstances of each case will vary, and the outcome may depend on a number of factors, such as the evidence available, the person's criminal history, and the judge or jury's decision.
entries.translation: Duruufaha gaarka ah ee kiis kastaa way kala duwanaan doonaan, natiijadana waxay ku xirnaan kartaa dhawr arrimood, sida caddaynta la hayo, taariikhda dembiga qofka, iyo go'aanka garsooraha ama xeerbeegtida.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The couple, a renowned linguist and a world-renowned pastry chef, had been trying for a baby for years.
entries.translation: Lammaanahan, oo ahaa af-yaqaan caan ah iyo cunto-kariye adduunka caan ka ah, ayaa muddo sannado ah isku dayay ilmo inay helaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They had been to every doctor and specialist they could find, but nothing seemed to work.
entries.translation: Waxay u tegi jireen dhakhtar kasta iyo taqasuse kasta oo ay heli kareen, laakiin waxba uma muuqan inay shaqaynayeen.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
