entries.english: I have to constantly monitor my blood sugar levels and make adjustments to my insulin doses as needed.
entries.translation: Waa inaan si joogto ah ula socdaa heerarka sonkorta dhiigga oo aan hagaajiyo qiyaasahayga insulin sida loo baahdo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The flavors dance on your tongue, creating a symphony of delight.
entries.translation: Dhadhanka ayaa ku qoob ka ciyaara carrabkaaga, iyagoo abuuraya farxad ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The pineapple is sweet and tart, the apple is crisp and juicy, the stone fruit is juicy and flavorful, and the pear is sweet and refreshing.
entries.translation: Cananaaska waa macaan oo dardhan yahay, tufaaxu waa mid jilicsan oo casiir leh, miraha dhagaxa waa casiir leh waana dhadhan badan yahay, peerkuna waa macaan oo cusbooneysiin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The flavors are perfectly balanced, and each one complements the others.
entries.translation: Dhadhanku waa isku dheelitiran yihiin, mid kastana wuxuu dhammaystiray kuwa kale.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The combination is simply irresistible.
entries.translation: Isku-darku waa mid si fudud u adkayn.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can enjoy this delicious fruit salad on its own, or as a topping for yogurt or ice cream.
entries.translation: Waxaad ku raaxeysan kartaa saladkan miraha macaan kaligood, ama kor kaga daraya yogurt ama jalaatada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is also a great addition to a summer picnic or potluck.
entries.translation: Waxa kale oo si weyn loogu dari karaa cuntada xagaaga ama potluck.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: No matter how you enjoy it, you are sure to love this fruit salad.
entries.translation: Si kastaba ha noqotee sida aad ugu raaxaysato, waxaad hubaal tahay inaad jeceshahay salad miraha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: Did you know that deforestation is one of the leading causes of climate change?
entries.translation: A: Ma ogtahay in xaalufinta dhirta ay tahay mid ka mid ah sababaha ugu horreeya ee isbedelka cimilada?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: B: No, I didn't.
entries.translation: B: Maya, ma ogi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: How does that work?
entries.translation: Sidee taasi u shaqeysaa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: Well, when we cut down trees, we're not just destroying the trees themselves.
entries.translation: A: Hagaag, markaan jarno geedaha, kaliya ma baabi'inayno geedaha laftooda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We're also destroying the habitats of countless animals and plants.
entries.translation: Waxaan sidoo kale burburineynaa deegaannada xayawaanka iyo dhirta aan la tirin karin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And when we lose these habitats, we also lose the benefits that they provide us.
entries.translation: Markaan lumino deegaannadaas, waxaan sidoo kale lumineynaa faa'iidooyinka ay na siiyaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: B: Like what?
entries.translation: B: Maxaa ka mid ah?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: Well, for example, trees help to regulate the climate.
entries.translation: A: Hagaag, tusaale ahaan, geedaha waxay gacan ka geystaan nidaaminta cimilada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They absorb carbon dioxide from the air and release oxygen.
entries.translation: Waxay ka soo nuugaan kaarboon dioxide hawada waxayna sii daayaan oksijiin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They also help to prevent soil erosion and flooding.
entries.translation: Waxay kaloo gacan ka geystaan ka hortagga nabaad-guurka ciidda iyo daadadka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And they provide food and shelter for animals.
entries.translation: Waxayna siiyaan cunto iyo hoy xoolaha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: B: So deforestation has a lot of negative effects.
entries.translation: B: Marka xaalufinta waxay leedahay saameyn badan oo taban.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: It does.
entries.translation: A: Way sameysaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And it's a problem that's only getting worse.
entries.translation: Waana dhibaato ka sii daraysa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Every year, we lose millions of acres of forest to deforestation.
entries.translation: Sannad kasta, waxaan ku luminaa malaayiin hektar oo kayn ah xaalufinta dhirta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And if we don't do something to stop it, the consequences will be devastating.
entries.translation: Hadana hadaanan sameyn wax aan ku joojino, cawaaqibka ayaa noqon doona mid aad u xun.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: B: What can we do to stop it?
entries.translation: B: Maxaan sameyn karnaa si aan u joojino?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: There are a number of things we can do.
entries.translation: A: Waxaa jira dhowr waxyaalood oo aan sameyn karno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We can reduce our demand for wood products.
entries.translation: Waxaan yareyn karnaa baahida loo qabo wax soo saarka alwaaxda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We can plant trees.
entries.translation: Waxaan beeri karnaa geedo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most important things I learned in high school was how to think critically and solve problems.
entries.translation: Mid ka mid ah waxyaabaha ugu muhiimsan ee aan ku bartay dugsiga sare wuxuu ahaa sida loo fikiro si xal ah loona xalliyo dhibaatooyinka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My AP English and math classes taught me how to analyze text and data, and my science classes taught me how to design and conduct experiments.
entries.translation: Fasallada AP Ingiriisiga iyo xisaabta ayaa i baray sida loo falanqeeyo qoraalka iyo xogta, fasalada sayniska ayaa i baray sida loo naqshadeeyo loona sameeyo tijaabooyin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These skills have been essential in my college courses and my career as a software engineer.
entries.translation: Xirfadahani waxay lagama maarmaan ahaayeen koorsooyinkeyga kulliyadda iyo xirfadayda injineer softiweer ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another important thing I learned in high school was how to work effectively with others.
entries.translation: Waxa kale oo muhiim ah oo aan ka bartay dugsiga sare waxay ahayd sida si wax ku ool ah ula shaqeeyo dadka kale.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These skills have been invaluable in my career, where I often have to collaborate with others to solve complex problems.
entries.translation: Xirfadahani waxay ahaayeen qiimo badan xirfadayda, halkaas oo aan inta badan ay tahay inaan la shaqeeyo dadka kale si aan u xalliyo dhibaatooyinka adag.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Finally, my high school experience helped me to develop a strong work ethic and a commitment to excellence.
entries.translation: Ugu dambeyntiina, waayo-aragnimadayda dugsiga sare ayaa iga caawisay inaan horumariyo anshax shaqo oo xoog leh iyo ballanqaad.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The challenging academic courses I took taught me the importance of hard work and perseverance, and the extracurricular activities I participated in taught me the value of teamwork and dedication.
entries.translation: Koorsooyinka tacliimeed ee adag ee aan qaatay waxay i baray muhiimadda shaqada adag iyo adkeysiga, iyo howlaha ka baxsan ee aan ka qayb galay ii baray qiimaha shaqeynta iyo u heellanshaha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These qualities have helped me to succeed in college and in my career.
entries.translation: Tayadaani waxay iga caawiyeen inaan ku guuleysto kulliyadda iyo xirfadayda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I am grateful for the opportunity to have attended a high school that provided me with such a strong educational foundation.
entries.translation: Waxaan ka mahadcelinayaa fursadda aan kaga qayb galay dugsi sare oo ii siiyay aasaas waxbarasho oo xoog leh.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I believe that the skills and knowledge I gained in high school have helped me to become a successful college student and a professional.
entries.translation: Waxaan aaminsanahay in xirfadaha iyo aqoonta aan ku helay dugsiga sare ay iga caawiyeen inaan noqdo arday kulliyadda guuleysta iyo xirfadle.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pottery is a craft that involves making objects out of clay.
entries.translation: Dhoobada waa farshaxan ku lug leh samaynta walxaha dhoobada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pottery is often used for utilitarian purposes, such as storing food or water, but it can also be used for decorative purposes.
entries.translation: Dhoobada waxaa badanaa loo isticmaalaa ujeedooyin waxtar leh, sida keydinta cuntada ama biyaha, laakiin sidoo kale waxaa loo isticmaali karaa ujeeddooyin qurxin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The process of making pottery begins with gathering clay.
entries.translation: Geedi socodka samaynta dhoobada wuxuu ku bilaabmaa ururinta dhoobada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Clay is a natural material that is found in the ground.
entries.translation: Dhoobo waa shey dabiici ah oo laga helo dhulka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once the clay has been gathered, it is mixed with water and kneaded until it is soft and pliable.
entries.translation: Marka dhoobada la soo ururiyo, waxaa lagu qasi karaa biyo oo la duubaa ilaa ay ka jilcanaato oo ka dabacdo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The potter then uses a variety of tools to shape the clay into the desired form.
entries.translation: Dheryasameeyaha ayaa markaa adeegsada qalab kala duwan si uu dhoobada ugu qaabeeyo qaabka la doonayo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once the clay is shaped, it is dried and fired in a kiln.
entries.translation: Marka dhoobada la qaabeeyo, waa la qalajiyaa oo lagu ridaa foornada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rainstorms are a common occurrence in many parts of the world, and they can have a significant impact on our lives.
entries.translation: Duufantu waa dhacdo caadi ka ah meelo badan oo adduunka ah, waxayna saameyn weyn ku yeelan karaan nolosheena.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can bring much-needed water to parched land, but they can also cause flooding, mudslides, and other damage.
entries.translation: Waxay keeni karaan biyo aad loogu baahan yahay dhul la beeray, laakiin sidoo kale waxay sababi karaan daadad, dhoobo, iyo waxyeelo kale.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rainstorms are caused by the rising of warm air, which causes water vapor to condense and form clouds.
entries.translation: Duufaanta roobka waxaa sababa kor u kaca hawo diirran, taas oo keenta uumiga biyuhu inuu isku ururiyo oo uu sameeyo daruuro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When the water droplets in the clouds become too heavy, they fall as rain.
entries.translation: Marka dhibcaha biyaha ee daruuraha ay noqdaan kuwo aad u culus, waxay u da'aan sidii roob.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The amount of rain that falls in a rainstorm is measured in inches.
entries.translation: Qadarka roobka ku da'a duufaanka waxaa lagu cabiraa inji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A light rainstorm might produce only a few inches of rain, while a heavy rainstorm can produce over a foot of rain.
entries.translation: Roob duufaan fudud ayaa laga yaabaa inay soo saarto dhawr inji oo roob ah, halka roob culus ay soo saari karto cagta roobka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rainstorms can have a variety of effects on our lives.
entries.translation: Roobabku waxay saameyn kala duwan ku yeelan karaan nolosheena.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can wash away dirt and debris, making roads and sidewalks impassable.
entries.translation: Waxay dhaqi karaan wasakhda iyo qashinka, iyagoo ka dhigaya waddooyinka iyo waddooyinka aan la mari karin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can also cause power outages and flooding.
entries.translation: Waxay kaloo sababi karaan koronto la'aan iyo daadad.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Flooding can be especially dangerous, as it can quickly sweep away people and property.
entries.translation: Daadadka ayaa si gaar ah khatar u noqon kara, maadaama ay si dhakhso leh u xaaqi karto dadka iyo hantida.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Despite the potential dangers, rainstorms can also be beneficial.
entries.translation: In kasta oo ay jiraan khataraha iman kara, roobabku sidoo kale faa'iido ayey yeelan karaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can help to improve soil quality and water the plants.
entries.translation: Waxay kaa caawin karaan hagaajinta tayada ciidda iyo waraabinta dhirta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rainstorms can also be a source of entertainment, as people enjoy watching the rain and listening to the thunder.
entries.translation: Roobabku sidoo kale waxay noqon karaan il madadaalo, maadaama dadku ku raaxaystaan daawashada roobka iyo dhageysiga onkodka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Eyes are complex organs that allow us to see.
entries.translation: Indhuhu waa xubno isku dhafan oo noo oggolaanaya inaan wax aragno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are located in the front of the head and are protected by the eyelids.
entries.translation: Waxay ku yaalliin dhinaca hore ee madaxa waxaana ilaaliya baararka indhaha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Each eye is made up of three layers: the sclera, the choroid, and the retina.
entries.translation: Il kasta waxay ka kooban tahay saddex lakab: sclera, choroid, iyo retina.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The sclera is the white part of the eye, the choroid is the dark layer behind the sclera, and the retina is the light-sensitive layer at the back of the eye.
entries.translation: Sclera' waa qaybta cad ee isha, choroid waa lakabka mugdiga ah ee ka dambeeya sclera, retina nane waa lakabka iftiinka xasaasiga ah ee isha gadaashiisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The retina contains millions of light-sensitive cells called rods and cones.
entries.translation: Retina waxay ka kooban tahay malaayiin unugyo xasaasi u ah iftiinka oo loo yaqaan ulaha iyo koonooyinka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rods are responsible for night vision, while cones are responsible for color vision.
entries.translation: Ulaha ayaa mas'uul ka ah aragtida habeenkii, halka koonooyinka ay mas'uul ka yihiin aragtida midabka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When light hits the retina, it is converted into electrical signals that are sent to the brain via the optic nerve.
entries.translation: Marka iftiinka ku dhaco qaybta retina, waxaa loo beddelaa calaamadaha korantada ee loo diro maskaxda iyada oo loo marayo dareemayaasha indhaha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My family has always kept animals.
entries.translation: Qoyskayga ayaa had iyo jeer xoollo dhaqda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When I was a child, we had a dog, a cat, and a few fish.
entries.translation: Markii aan yaraa, waxaan haysanay eey, bisad, iyo kalluun yar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As I got older, we added a few more animals to the mix, including a rabbit, a guinea pig, and a hamster.
entries.translation: Markii aan sii weynaaday, waxaan ku darnay dhowr xayawaan oo dheeri ah isku darka, oo ay ku jiraan bakayle, doofaarka guinea, iyo hamster.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I loved taking care of all of our animals and learning about their different needs.
entries.translation: Waxaan jeclaa inaan daryeelo dhammaan xayawaanadeena oo aan wax ka barto baahiyahooda kala duwan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of my favorite animals that we ever kept was a rabbit named Cocoa.
entries.translation: Mid ka mid ah xayawaankii aan jeclaa ee aan waligeen korsan jirnay wuxuu ahaa bakayle la yiraahdo Cocoa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Cocoa was a brown and white Holland Lop rabbit.
entries.translation: Cocoa wuxuu ahaa bakayle bunni iyo caddaan Holland bakayle ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was the sweetest animal I've ever met and she loved to be cuddled.
entries.translation: Waxay ahayd xayawaankii ugu macaanaa ee aan abid la kulmo waxayna jeceshahay in la koolkooliyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was also very smart and could learn tricks like sit, stay, and come.
entries.translation: Waxay sidoo kale ahayd mid aad u caqli badan waxayna baran kartaa tabaha sida fadhiista, joogista, iyo imaanshaha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, I was playing with Cocoa in the backyard when I noticed that she was chewing on something.
entries.translation: Maalin maalmaha ka mid ah, waxaan kula ciyaarayay Cocoa barxadda dambe markii aan ogaaday inay wax calalinayso.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I went over to investigate and saw that she was chewing on a piece of fiber from one of our clothes.
entries.translation: Waxaan u gudbay inaan baaro oo waxaan arkay inay ka calalinayso gabal fiber ah mid ka mid ah dharkeena.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I took the fiber away from her and showed it to my mom.
entries.translation: Waan ka qaaday fiberka iyada oo waxaan tusay hooyaday.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My mom explained that rabbits need to eat fiber in order to digest their food properly.
entries.translation: Hooyaday waxay sharraxday in bakaylaha ay u baahan yihiin inay cunaan fiber si ay si habboon u dheefshiidaan cuntadooda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She said that we should give Cocoa some hay to eat, which is a good source of fiber.
entries.translation: Waxay tiri waa inaan siino Cocoa xoogaa caws ah oo la cuno, taas oo ah il wanaagsan oo laga helo fiber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I gave Cocoa some hay and she loved it!
entries.translation: Waxaan siiyay Cocoa xoogaa caws ah wayna jeclaatay!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: An earthquake is a sudden and violent shaking of the Earth's crust that can cause great damage.
entries.translation: Dhulgariirku waa ruxitaan lama filaan ah oo rabshad leh oo ku dhaca qolofta dhulka oo sababi kara dhaawac weyn.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The most common cause of earthquakes is the movement of tectonic plates, which are large pieces of the Earth's crust that ride on top of the molten rock beneath the surface.
entries.translation: Sababta ugu badan ee dhulgariirku waa dhaqdhaqaaqa taarikada tectonic, kuwaas oo ah qaybo waaweyn oo ka mid ah qolofta dhulka oo dul fuulaya dusha sare ee dhagaxa dhalaalay ee dusha sare.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When these plates move past or collide with each other, they can cause the Earth's crust to break and produce seismic waves.
entries.translation: Markay taargooyinkan dhaafaan ama isku dhacaan midba midka kale, waxay sababi karaan in qolofka dhulka uu jabo oo uu soo saaro hirarka dhul gariirka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These waves travel through the Earth and can cause the ground to shake.
entries.translation: Mowjadahaani waxay ku dhex socdaalaan Dhulka waxayna sababi karaan in dhulku ruxmo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The magnitude of an earthquake is measured on the Richter scale, which ranges from 0 to 9.
entries.translation: Baaxadda dhulgariir waxaa lagu cabiraa qiyaasta Richter, oo u dhexeysa 0 ilaa 9.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The higher the magnitude, the more powerful the earthquake.
entries.translation: Baaxadda sare, dhulgariirku wuu sii xoog badan yahay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Earthquakes can cause damage in a variety of ways, including ground shaking, landslides, tsunamis, building collapses, fires, and loss of life.
entries.translation: Dhulgariirradu waxay sababi karaan waxyeelo siyaabo kala duwan, oo ay ku jiraan gariirka dhulka, dhulgariirka, tisunaamiga, burburka dhismaha, dabka, iyo luminta nolosha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Earthquakes can also trigger other hazards, such as avalanches.
entries.translation: Dhulgariirradu sidoo kale waxay kicin karaan khataro kale, sida qulqulatooyin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The damage caused by an earthquake depends on a number of factors, including the magnitude of the earthquake, the distance from the epicenter, the type of soil, and the construction of buildings.
entries.translation: Khasaaraha ka dhashay dhulgariirku wuxuu ku xiran yahay dhowr arrimood, oo ay ka mid yihiin baaxadda dhulgariirka, masaafada u jirta xudunta, nooca ciidda, iyo dhismaha dhismayaasha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You have no idea how the real world works, and you think that everything should be handed to you on a silver platter.
entries.translation: Ma haysan wax fikrad ah sida dunida dhabta ah u shaqeeyo, waxaadna u maleyneysaa in wax walba in lagu soo gudbiyo saxan lacag ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You're always complaining about something, and you never seem to be happy with anything.
entries.translation: Had iyo jeer waxaad ka cabaneysaa wax, waligana uma muuqan inaadan wax ku faraxsanayso.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You're a bunch of entitled brats, and I'm sick of it.
entries.translation: Waxaad tahay koox rag ah oo xaq u leh, aniguna waan ku xanuunsanayaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Grow up.
entries.translation: Weynoow.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The world doesn't owe you anything.
entries.translation: Aduunyadu waxba kuguma laha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You have to work hard to get what you want.
entries.translation: Waa inaad si adag u shaqeysaa si aad u hesho waxaad rabto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There's no such thing as a free lunch.
entries.translation: Ma jiro wax la yiraahdo qado bilaash ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you want something, you have to go out and earn it.
entries.translation: Haddii aad rabto wax, waa inaad baxdaa oo aad kasbato.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Stop whining and complaining.
entries.translation: Jooji calaacalka iyo cabashada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's not going to get you anywhere.
entries.translation: Meelne kuma gayn doonto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you have a problem, then solve it.
entries.translation: Haddii aad dhibaato qabto, ka dib xali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Don't just sit around and cry about it.
entries.translation: Kaliya ha fadhiisan oo haku ooyin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Be more mature.
entries.translation: Noqo qof bisil.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Act your age.
entries.translation: U dhaqan da'daada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You're not children anymore.
entries.translation: Ma tihiin carruur mar dambe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's time to start acting like adults.
entries.translation: Waa wakhtigii aad bilaabi lahaydeen u dhaqanka sida qof weyn.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm tired of dealing with your childish behavior.
entries.translation: Waan ka daalay inaan wax ka qabto dhaqankaaga carruurnimada ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you don't start acting like adults, then I'm going to have to cut you out of my life.
entries.translation: Haddii aadan bilaabin u dhaqanka sida qof weyn, markaa waa inaan kaa gooyaa noloshayda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I don't have time for your nonsense.
entries.translation: Ma u haayo wakhti macno daradaada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Grow up and start acting like adults, or I'm out of here.
entries.translation: Kor oo bilow u dhaqanka sida qof weyn, ama waan ka baxay halkan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was recently cleaning out my attic when I came across a box of old recipes that had been passed down from my grandmother.
entries.translation: Waxaan dhawaan nadiifinayay saqafka sare markii aan la kulmay sanduuq cuntooyin maadooyin ah oo laga soo helay ayeeyday.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some of them were quite old, dating back to the early 1900s.
entries.translation: Qaar ka mid ah iyaga ayaa ahaa kuwo gaboobay, ku taariikhaysan 1900-yadii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was curious to see what they were, so I started reading through them.
entries.translation: Waxaan xiiseynayay inaan arko waxa ay ahaayeen, sidaa darteed waxaan bilaabay inaan akhriyo iyaga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One recipe in particular caught my eye.
entries.translation: Hal maado oo gaar ah ayay indhahayga qabteen.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was for an anti-aging facial mask made with honey, yogurt, and oatmeal.
entries.translation: Waxay ahayd maaskaro wajiga ka hortagga gabowga oo lagu sameeyay malab, yogurt, iyo oatmeal.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I decided to give it a try, and I was amazed at the results!
entries.translation: Waxaan go'aansaday inaan isku dayo, waana la yaabay natiijooyinka!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My skin looked so much smoother and younger after using it.
entries.translation: Maqaarkaygu wuxuu u muuqday mid aad u jilicsan oo ka yar ka dib markii aan isticmaalay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm so glad I found this old recipe.
entries.translation: Aad ayaan ugu faraxsanahay inaan helay maadadaan hore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's a real treasure, and I'm sure it will remain in my family for many years to come.
entries.translation: Waa hanti dhab ah, waana hubaa inay sii haysan doonaan qoyskeyga sannado badan oo soo socda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The veteran sat alone in the hospital room, staring at the blank television.
entries.translation: Halyeeyga ayaa keligiis fadhiistay qolka isbitaalka, oo eegaya telefishanka maran.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He had been in the hospital for weeks, and he was starting to go stir-crazy.
entries.translation: Wuxuu ku jiray isbitaalka toddobaadyo, wuxuuna bilaabay inuu walaaqo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He had been in a lot of wars, and he had seen a lot of death and destruction.
entries.translation: Wuxuu ku jiray dagaallo badan, wuxuuna arkay dhimasho iyo halaag badan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But nothing had ever prepared him for this.
entries.translation: Laakiin waxba weligood uma diyaarin tan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The door to his room opened, and a young woman walked in.
entries.translation: Albaabka qolkiisa ayaa furmay, haweenay dhallinyaro ahna way soo gashay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was carrying a bouquet of flowers. "Hello," she said. "My name is Sarah.
entries.translation: Waxay waday xirmo ubax ah. “Haye,” ayay tiri. Magacaygu waa Sarah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm a volunteer here at the hospital."
entries.translation: Waxaan ahay iskaa wax u qabso halkan isbitaalka."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The veteran smiled. "It's nice to meet you, Sarah," he said.
entries.translation: Halyeeyga ayaa dhoola cadeeyay. “Way fiicantahay inaan kula kulmo, Sarah,” ayuu yidhi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "What are you doing here?"
entries.translation: “Maxaad halkan ka samaynaysaa?”
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I'm here to make you laugh," she said. "Laughter is the best medicine, you know."
entries.translation: “Waxaan halkaan u joogaa inaan kaa qosliyo,” ayay tiri. “Qosolku waa daawada ugu fiican, waad ogtahay.”
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The veteran laughed. "I'm not sure I can laugh," he said.
entries.translation: Halyeeyga ayaa qoslay. "Ma hubo inaan qosli karo," ayuu yiri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I've been through a lot."
entries.translation: “Wax badan ayaan soo maray.”
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I know," Sarah said. "But I'm going to make you laugh."
entries.translation: “Waan ogahay,” ayay tiri Sarah. “Laakiin waxaan doonayaa inaan kaa qosliyo.”
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And she did.
entries.translation: Oo iyana way samaysay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She told jokes and stories, and she even did some magic tricks.
entries.translation: Waxay u sheegtay kaftanka iyo sheekooyinka, waxayna xitaa sameysay qaar ka mid ah tabaha sixirka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The veteran laughed until his sides hurt.
entries.translation: Halyeeyga ayaa qoslay ilaa dhinacyadiisa ay dhaawacmeen.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: New Study Finds That Breast Cancer Screenings Can Lead to False Positives
entries.translation: Daraasad Cusub ayaa ogaatay in baaritaanka Kansarka Naasaha ay u horseedi karaan waxyaabo been abuur ah
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A new study published in the journal JAMA Internal Medicine has found that breast cancer screenings can lead to false positives.
entries.translation: Daraasad cusub oo lagu daabacay joornaalka JAMA Internal Medicine ayaa lagu ogaaday in baaritaanka kansarka naasaha uu u horseedi karo waxyaabo been abuur ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The study, which was conducted by researchers at the University of California, San Francisco, found that one in five women who underwent a mammogram had a false positive result.
entries.translation: Daraasaddan, oo ay sameeyeen cilmi-baarayaal ka tirsan Jaamacadda California, San Francisco, ayaa lagu ogaaday in shantii haweenba mid ka mid ah ee lagu sameeyay mammogram ay leeyihiin natiijo togan oo been abuur ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A false positive result is when a mammogram shows that a woman has breast cancer, when she actually does not.
entries.translation: Natiijo togan oo been abuur ah waa marka mammogram uu muujiyo in haweeneydu qabto kansarka naasaha, marka aysan dhab ahaantii dhicin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can lead to unnecessary anxiety and stress, as well as unnecessary medical procedures, such as biopsies.
entries.translation: Tani waxay u horseedi kartaa walaac iyo walaac aan loo baahnayn, iyo sidoo kale habab caafimaad oo aan loo baahnayn, sida dheecaan-qaadista.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The study found that the rate of false positives was higher among women who were younger, had dense breasts, and had a family history of breast cancer.
entries.translation: Daraasadu waxay ogaatay in heerka tognaanta beenta ah uu ka sarreeyo dumarka da'da yar, lahaa naaso cufan, oo leh taariikh qoys oo kansarka naasaha ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The study also found that the use of sound waves, known as ultrasound, to screen for breast cancer can help to reduce the number of false positives.
entries.translation: Daraasadu waxa kale oo ay ogaatay in isticmaalka mowjadaha dhawaaqa, ee loo yaqaan ultrasound, si loo baaro kansarka naasaha ay gacan ka geysan karto yaraynta tirada been-abuurka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ultrasound is a safe and non-invasive imaging technique that can be used to identify abnormalities in the breast.
entries.translation: Ultrasound waa farsamo sawir oo ammaan ah oo aan faafin oo loo isticmaali karo in lagu garto cilladaha naaska.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A typical day for a person in Nigeria might start with a cup of tea or coffee and a breakfast of bread, eggs, and plantains.
entries.translation: Maalinka caadiga ah ee qofka ku nool Nigeria wuxuu ku bilaaban karaa koob shaah ah ama kafee ah iyo quraac rooti ah, ukun, iyo plantains.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The workday typically starts around 8am and ends around 5pm, with a lunch break in the middle of the day.
entries.translation: Maalinta shaqada waxay caadi ahaan bilaabataa 8da subaxnimo waxayna dhammaataa agagaarka 5ta galabnimo, iyadoo ay jirto nasasho qado bartamaha maalinta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After work, people might relax at home with their families, go out to dinner, or attend a cultural event.
entries.translation: Shaqada ka dib, dadku waxay ku nasan karaan guriga qoysaskooda, u baxaan casho, ama ka qayb galaan munaasabad dhaqameed.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The evening is often spent socializing with friends and family.
entries.translation: Fiidka waxaa badanaa lagu qaataa isdhexgalka asxaabta iyo qoyska.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The daily routine of a Nigerian can vary depending on their location and lifestyle.
entries.translation: Jadwalka maalinlaha ah ee Nayjeeriyaanka wuu kala duwanaan karaa iyadoo ay ku xiran tahay meesha iyo hab nololeedka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In rural areas, people may wake up earlier to tend to their farms or livestock.
entries.translation: Meelaha miyiga ah, dadku waxay toosin karaan goor hore si ay ugu janjeeraan beerahooda ama xoolahooda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In urban areas, people may have more time for leisure activities.
entries.translation: Meelaha magaalooyinka, dadku waxay heli karaan wakhti dheeri ah oo ay ku qabtaan howlaha firaaqada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, some aspects of daily life are common across Nigeria, such as the importance of family and community.
entries.translation: Si kastaba ha noqotee, dhinacyo ka mid ah nolol maalmeedka ayaa caan ku ah guud ahaan Nigeria, sida muhiimadda qoyska iyo bulshada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nigeria is a diverse country with a rich culture, and the daily lives of its people reflect this diversity.
entries.translation: Nigeria waa waddan kala duwan oo leh dhaqan hodan ah, nolol maalmeedka dadkeeduna waxay ka tarjumayaan kala duwanaanshahan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: From the bustling cities of Lagos and Abuja to the more rural areas of the country, there is no one-size-fits-all description of what a typical day in Nigeria is like.
entries.translation: Laga soo bilaabo magaalooyinka nool ee Lagos iyo Abuja in meelaha miyiga ah ee dalka, ma jirto sifaynta hal-cabbir-ku habboon-dhammaan waxa maalinta caadiga ah ee Nigeria ay tahay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But one thing is for sure: no matter where you are in Nigeria, you will find people who are warm, welcoming, and eager to share their culture with you.
entries.translation: Laakiin hal shay ayaa hubaal ah: meel kasta oo aad ku sugan tahay Nigeria, waxaad ka heli doontaa dad diirran, soo dhaweyn leh, oo doonaya inay dhaqankooda kula wadaagaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Nyasaland African Congress (NAC) was founded in 1944 by Dr. Hastings Kamuzu Banda and other Malawian nationalists.
entries.translation: Nyasaland African Congress (NAC) waxaa aasaasay 1944-kii Dr. Hastings Kamuzu Banda iyo wadaniyiin kale oo reer Malawi ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The NAC was the first political party in Malawi to advocate for African independence from British colonial rule.
entries.translation: NAC wuxuu ahaa xisbigii ugu horreeyay ee siyaasadeed ee Malawi ee u ololeeya madaxbanaanida Afrika ee ka soo jeeda xukunka gumeysiga Ingiriiska.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1953, the NAC was banned by the British colonial authorities, but it continued to operate underground.
entries.translation: Sannadkii 1953-kii, NAC waxaa mamnuucay mas'uuliyiinta gumeysiga Ingiriiska, laakiin waxay sii waday inay ka shaqeyso dhulka hoostiisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1961, the NAC was legalized and renamed the Malawi Congress Party (MCP).
entries.translation: Sannadkii 1961-kii, NAC waa la sharciyeeyay oo loo baxshay Xisbiga Malawi Congress Party (MCP).
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The MCP won the first general elections held in Malawi in 1964, and Dr. Banda became the first Prime Minister of Malawi.
entries.translation: MCP ayaa ku guuleysatay doorashooyinkii guud ee ugu horreeyay ee lagu qabtay Malawi sanadkii 1964-kii, waxaana Dr. Banda uu noqday Ra'iisul Wasaarihii ugu horreeyay ee Malawi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1966, Malawi became a republic, with Dr. Banda as the first President.
entries.translation: Sanadkii 1966-kii, Malawi waxay noqotay jamhuuriyad, Dr. Banda uu yahay Madaxweynihii ugu horeeyay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Banda ruled Malawi as a one-party state for 30 years.
entries.translation: Dr. Banda wuxuu Malawi u xukumay sidii dowlad hal xisbi ah muddo 30 sano ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was a controversial figure, but he is also credited with modernizing Malawi and bringing it independence.
entries.translation: Wuxuu ahaa shaqsi muran badan dhaliyay, laakiin sidoo kale waxaa lagu tiriyaa inuu casriyeeyay Malawi isla markaana u keenay madaxbanaanida.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The physicians, who are members of the Southern Medical Association, say that the firm's building was not properly ventilated and that the employees were exposed to harmful chemicals.
entries.translation: Dhakhaatiirta oo xubno ka ah Ururka Caafimaadka ee Koonfurta, ayaa sheegaya in dhismaha shirkaddu uusan si fiican u hawo lahayn isla markaana shaqaaluhu ay la kulmeen kiimikooyin waxyeello leh.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "We were concerned about the health of the employees at this firm," said Dr. Raymond Neal-Kennedy, a spokesman for the SMA.
entries.translation: “Waxaan ka walaacsanahay caafimaadka shaqaalaha shirkadan,” ayuu yiri Dr. Raymond Neal-Kennedy, afhayeenka SMA.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "The building was not up to code and the employees were being exposed to dangerous chemicals. We had no choice but to shut the firm down."
entries.translation: “Dhismuhu ma ahayn mid sharci ah shaqaaluhuna waxay la kulmeen kiimikooyin khatar ah. Ma aanan haysan wax kale oo aan ahayn inaan xirno shirkadda.”
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The architecture firm, which has not been named, has denied the allegations.
entries.translation: Shirkadda dhismaha, oo aan la magacaabin, ayaa beenisay eedeymaha loo jeediyay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The firm's owner, Mr. Ishq Kasawa, says that the building was properly ventilated and that the employees were not exposed to any harmful chemicals.
entries.translation: Milkiilaha shirkadda, Mr. Ishq Kasawa, ayaa sheegay in dhismaha uu ahaa mid hawo fiican leh isla markaana shaqaalaha aysan la kulmin wax kiimiko ah oo waxyeello leh.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "We are disappointed by the actions of the SMA," said Mr. Kasawa.
entries.translation: “Waan ka niyad jabnay ficilada SMA,” ayuu yiri Mr. Kasawa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "We believe that we have been unfairly targeted. Our building is safe and our employees are healthy."
entries.translation: “Waxaan aaminsanahay in si cadaalad darro ah naloo bartilmaameedsaday. Dhismaheennu waa amaan, shaqaalaheenuna waa caafimaad qabaan.”
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The SMA says that it will continue to investigate the matter and that it will take further action if necessary.
entries.translation: SMA waxay sheegaysaa inay sii wadi doonto baaritaanka arrinta isla markaana ay qaadi doonto tallaabo dheeri ah haddii loo baahdo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Libyan Civil War is an ongoing armed conflict in Libya that began in 2011 with the overthrow of Muammar Gaddafi's government.
entries.translation: Dagaalkii sokeeye ee Liibiya ayaa ah colaad hubeysan oo ka socda dalka Liibiya oo bilowday sanadkii 2011-kii markii la afgembiyey xukuumaddii Muammar Qaddaafi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 2014, the Libyan House of Representatives (HoR) was elected in the eastern city of Tobruk, but the HoR has been unable to exercise effective control over the country.
entries.translation: Sanadkii 2014-kii, Golaha Wakiilada Liibiya (HoR) ayaa lagu doortay magaalada bari ee Tobruk, laakiin HoR ma awoodin in ay si wax ku ool ah gacanta ugu hayaan dalka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 2016, the Government of National Accord (GNA) was formed in Tripoli under the auspices of the United Nations, but the GNA has been unable to gain control of the country's eastern regions.
entries.translation: Sannadkii 2016-kii, Dowladda Heshiiska Qaranka (GNA) waxaa laga sameeyay Tripoli iyada oo ay hoos imaanayso Qaramada Midoobay, laakiin GNA ma awoodin inay gacanta ku dhigto gobollada bariga ee dalka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The LNA, led by Khalifa Haftar, has been fighting against the GNA and its allies in the west of the country.
entries.translation: LNA oo uu hogaamiyo Khalifa Haftar ayaa dagaal kula jirtay GNA iyo xulafadeeda ku sugan galbeedka dalkaasi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The conflict has led to a humanitarian crisis, with hundreds of thousands of people displaced from their homes.
entries.translation: Colaadda ayaa horseeday dhibaato bani'aadanimo, iyadoo boqolaal kun oo qof ay ka barakaceen guryahooda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The United Nations has called for an immediate ceasefire and the start of a political dialogue.
entries.translation: Qaramada Midoobay ayaa ku baaqday xabad joojin degdeg ah iyo in la bilaabo wadahadal siyaasadeed.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The soap opera centers around the lives of the residents of a small town.
entries.translation: Xarumaha saabuunta opera waxay ku wareegsan yihiin nolosha dadka deggan magaalo yar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The main character, Constance, is a young woman who is struggling to come to terms with the recent death of her husband.
entries.translation: Dabeecadda ugu weyn, Constance, waa haweenay dhalinyaro ah oo ku dhibtoonaysa inay la qabsato dhimashadii dhawaan ninkeeda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She is left to raise her two young children on her own, and she is struggling to find a way to handle her grief.
entries.translation: Waxaa loo daayay inay keligeed koriso labadeeda caruur ah, waxayna la halgameysaa sidii ay u heli lahayd hab ay wax uga qabato murugadeeda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, Constance meets a man named Frederick at the grocery store.
entries.translation: Maalin maalmaha ka mid ah, Constance wuxuu kula kulmay nin la yiraahdo Frederick dukaanka raashinka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Frederick is a kind and compassionate man, and he offers Constance his support.
entries.translation: Frederick waa nin naxariis badan, wuxuuna bixiyaa taageeradiisa Constance.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Constance begins to develop feelings for Frederick, but she is hesitant to start a new relationship because she is still grieving the loss of her husband.
entries.translation: Constance wuxuu bilaabay inuu horumariyo dareenka Frederick, laakiin waxay ka labalabeyneysaa inay bilowdo xiriir cusub sababtoo ah waxay wali la murugaysan tahay geerida ninkeeda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Eventually, Constance decides to give Frederick a chance.
entries.translation: Ugu dambeyntiina, Constance waxay go'aansatay inay siiyo Frederick fursad.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She starts dating him, and she quickly falls in love with him.
entries.translation: Waxay bilowday inay shukaansato isaga, waxayna si dhakhso ah ugu qaaday jacayl isaga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Frederick helps Constance to heal from her grief, and he gives her the strength to raise her children on her own.
entries.translation: Frederick wuxuu ka caawiyaa Constance inay ka bogsato murugadeeda, wuxuuna siiyaa awood ay ku koriso carruurteeda kaligeed.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Constance and Frederick get married, and they have a happy life together.
entries.translation: Constance iyo Frederick way is guursadeen, waxayna haystaan nolol farxad leh.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They raise their children together, and they support each other through good times and bad.
entries.translation: Way wada koriyaan carruurtooda, wayna is taageeraan wakhtiyada wanaagsan iyo kuwa xun.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Constance is grateful for Frederick's love and support, and she knows that she will never be able to thank him enough for everything he has done for her.
entries.translation: Constance waxay u mahadcelineysaa jacaylka iyo taageerada Frederick, waxayna ogtahay inaysan waligeed awood u yeelan doonin inay ugu mahadceliso wax kasta oo uu u qabtay iyada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The soap opera ends with a message of hope.
entries.translation: Saabuunta opera waxay ku dhammaanaysaa farriin rajo leh.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As the twentieth century drew to a close, computers and electronics were becoming increasingly intertwined.
entries.translation: Markii qarnigii labaatanaad uu soo dhowaaday, kombiyuutarada iyo elektaroonigga ayaa isu soo tarayay si isku dhafan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the early days of computing, these two fields were largely separate.
entries.translation: Maalmihii hore ee kombuyuutarka, labadan qaybood ayaa inta badan kala duwanaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Computers were large, expensive machines that were used for scientific and military purposes.
entries.translation: Kombiyuutaradu waxay ahaayeen mashiinno waaweyn oo qaali ah oo loo adeegsaday ujeeddooyin cilmiyeed iyo militari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Electronics were used in a variety of consumer products, such as radios, televisions, and telephones.
entries.translation: Elektaroonigga waxaa loo adeegsaday alaabooyin kala duwan oo macaamiisha ah, sida raadiyaha, telefishannada, iyo taleefannada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, as computers became smaller and more affordable, they began to be used in a wider variety of applications.
entries.translation: Si kastaba ha ahaatee, maadaama kombiyuutaradu noqdeen kuwo yaryar oo la awoodi karo, waxay bilaabeen in loo isticmaalo codsiyo badan oo kala duwan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This led to a blurring of the lines between computers and electronics.
entries.translation: Tani waxay horseeday in la isku dayo khadadka u dhexeeya kombiyuutarada iyo elektaroonigga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most significant developments in the history of computers and electronics was the invention of the personal computer (PC).
entries.translation: Mid ka mid ah horumarka ugu muhiimsan ee taariikhda kombiyuutarada iyo elektaroonigga ayaa ahaa abuurista kombiyuutarka gaarka ah (PC).
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The PC was first introduced in the 1970s, and it quickly became a popular tool for both personal and business use.
entries.translation: PC-ga waxaa markii ugu horreysay la soo saaray 1970-yadii, wuxuuna si dhakhso leh u noqday aalad caan ku ah adeegsiga gaarka ah iyo ganacsi labadaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: PCs were originally designed for use in homes and offices, but they soon found their way into other settings, such as schools and libraries.
entries.translation: Kumbuyuutarrada ayaa markii hore loogu talagalay in loogu isticmaalo guryaha iyo xafiisyada, laakiin waxay si dhakhso ah u heleen jidkooda goobo kale, sida iskuulada iyo maktabadaha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The PC's portability and versatility made it an ideal tool for a wide range of tasks, from word processing to gaming.
entries.translation: Kartida PC-ga iyo kala duwanaanshaheeda ayaa ka dhigtay aalad ku habboon hawlo badan oo kala duwan, laga bilaabo ka shaqeynta ereyga ilaa ciyaarta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The development of the PC also led to the development of a new industry: the software industry.
entries.translation: Horumarinta PC-ga ayaa sidoo kale horseeday horumarinta warshad cusub: warshadaha softiweerka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Software companies created programs that could run on PCs, and these programs quickly became essential tools for PC users.
entries.translation: Shirkadaha softiweerku waxay abuureen barnaamijyo ku shaqeyn kara kombuyuutarrada, barnaamijyadani waxay si dhakhso leh u noqdeen qalab muhiim u ah dadka isticmaala PC.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The satisfaction of a perfect touch was something that Aida had never experienced before.
entries.translation: Ku qanacsanaanta taabashada qumman waxay ahayd wax Aida aysan waligeed horay u soo marin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She had been with many men, but none of them had ever been able to give her the kind of pleasure that she craved.
entries.translation: Waxay la joogtay rag badan, laakiin midkoodna weligiis ma awoodin inuu siiyo nooca raaxada ay jeceshahay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She had often wondered if she was simply too demanding, or if she was just meant to be alone.
entries.translation: Waxay had iyo jeer la yaabi jirtay haddii ay si fudud u dalbanayso, ama haddii loola jeedo inay keligeed ahaato.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But then she met Hakim.
entries.translation: Laakiin markaa waxay la kulantay Hakim.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hakim was different from any man she had ever met before.
entries.translation: Hakim wuu ka duwanaa nin kasta oo ay waligeed la kulantay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was kind, gentle, and he seemed to understand her in a way that no one else ever had.
entries.translation: Wuxuu ahaa mid naxariis badan, jilicsan, wuxuuna umuuqday inuu fahmayo qaab aan cid kale waligeed qabin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He took his time with her, exploring her body with a tenderness that made her melt.
entries.translation: Wuxuu la qaatay wakhtigiisii iyada, isagoo jirkeeda ku sahaminaya jilicsanaan ka dhigtay inay dhalaasho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And when he finally touched her in that special way, she felt a wave of pleasure wash over her that was unlike anything she had ever felt before.
entries.translation: Markuu ugu dambeyntii u taabtay iyada qaabkaas gaarka ah, waxay dareentay mowjad farxad leh oo ka sarreysa iyada oo ka duwan wax kasta oo ay waligeed dareentay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was as if her body had been waiting for his touch all along.
entries.translation: Waxay u ahayd sidii in jirkeeda uu sugayay taabashadiisa oo dhan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She felt complete, whole, and for the first time in her life, she knew what it was to be truly satisfied.
entries.translation: Waxay dareentay dhammaystiran, buuxda, markii ugu horreysay nolosheedana, waxay ogaatay waxa ay ahayd in si dhab ah loogu qanciyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As Hakim continued to touch her, she felt herself losing control.
entries.translation: Markii Hakim sii waday taabashadeeda, waxay dareentay inay lumiso xakamaynta nafteeda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Her body was on fire, and she could feel the tension building inside of her.
entries.translation: Jirkeeda ayaa dab qabadsiiyay, waxayna dareemi kartaa xiisadda ka dhex jirta gudaha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She knew that she was about to come, and she wanted it more than anything she had ever wanted before.
entries.translation: Waxay ogaatay inay ku dhowdahay inay timaado, waxayna ka rabtay wax ka badan wax kasta oo ay waligeed rabtay ka hor.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The hajj is a once-in-a-lifetime pilgrimage to Mecca, Saudi Arabia, that is required of all Muslims who are physically and financially able to make the journey.
entries.translation: Xajka ayaa ah mid hal mar-nolosha lagu tago magaalada Maka ee dalka Sacuudiga, taasoo looga baahan yahay dhammaan dadka Muslimiinta ah ee awood jir ahaan iyo dhaqaale ahaanba inay safarka galaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The pilgrimage is one of the five pillars of Islam, and it is considered to be the most important spiritual journey a Muslim can make.
entries.translation: Xajka ayaa ka mid ah shanta tiir ee Islaamka, waxaana loo arkaa inuu yahay safarka ruuxiga ah ee ugu muhiimsan ee Muslimku sameyn karo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The hajj takes place over five days in the Islamic month of Dhu al-Hijjah.
entries.translation: Xajka wuxuu dhacaa in ka badan shan maalmood bisha Islaamiga ah ee Dhu al-Hijjah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: During the hajj, pilgrims perform a series of rituals that commemorate the life of Prophet Muhammad and the prophets who came before him.
entries.translation: Inta lagu guda jiro xajka, xujayda ayaa sameeyaan taxane ah cibaadaysi xusaya nolosha Nabiga Muxammad iyo nebiyadii isaga ka hor yimid.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The hajj is a physically and emotionally demanding journey, but it is also a time for Muslims to come together in worship and to reflect on their lives.
entries.translation: Xajku waa safar jir ahaan iyo maskax ahaanba u baahan, hase yeeshee waa wakhti ay muslimiintu cibaadada isugu yimaaddaan oo ay ka fikiraan noloshooda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a chance to renew their faith and to reaffirm their commitment to Islam.
entries.translation: Waa fursad ay ku cusbooneysiin karaan iimaankooda iyo in dib loo xaqiijiyo sida ay uga go'an tahay diinta Islaamka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For many Muslims, the hajj is a life-changing experience.
entries.translation: Muslimiin badan, xajka waa waayo-aragnimo nolosha wax ka beddeleysa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a time to leave behind the stresses of everyday life and to focus on their spiritual journey.
entries.translation: Waa wakhtigii laga tagi lahaa culeyska nolol maalmeedka iyo in diiradda la saaro safarkooda aakhiro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Freedom of the press is the freedom of communication and expression through mediums including printed media and the internet.
entries.translation: Xorriyadda saxaafadda waa xorriyadda isgaarsiinta iyo hadalka iyada oo loo marayo dhexdhexaadin ay ka mid yihiin warbaahinta daabacan iyo internetka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a fundamental human right recognized by Article 19 of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights and reaffirmed in Article 19 of the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights.
entries.translation: Waa xuquuqda aasaasiga ah ee aadanaha oo lagu aqoonsan yahay Qodobka 19aad ee Baaqa Caalamiga ah ee Xuquuqda Aadanaha waxaana lagu xaqiijiyay Qodobka 19aad ee Axdiga Caalamiga ah ee Xuquuqda Madaniga iyo Siyaasadda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The right to freedom of expression is recognized as a necessary precondition for the enjoyment of all other human rights.
entries.translation: Xuquuqda xorriyadda hadalka waxaa loo aqoonsan yahay inay tahay shuruud lagama maarmaan u ah ku raaxeysiga dhammaan xuquuqda kale ee aadanaha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Freedom of the press is essential for a healthy democracy.
entries.translation: Xorriyadda saxaafaddu waxay muhiim u tahay dimuqraadiyad caafimaad qabta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It allows citizens to access information and to hold their government accountable.
entries.translation: Waxay u oggolaaneysaa muwaadiniinta inay helaan macluumaadka iyo inay la xisaabtamaan dowladdooda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It also helps to ensure that all voices are heard, and that the public is informed about important issues.
entries.translation: Waxay kaloo gacan ka geysaneysaa hubinta in dhammaan codadka la maqlo, iyo in dadweynaha lagu wargeliyo arrimaha muhiimka ah.
