entries.translation: Qaybaha caagga ah way adkaan kartaa in la beddelo, biraha saqafka ah iyo qufullada albaabka haanta shidaalka ayaa qaali ah in la dayactiro ama la beddelo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In some cases, it may be more cost-effective to total the car and buy a new one.
entries.translation: Xaaladaha qaarkood, waxay noqon kartaa mid kharash badan oo waxtar leh in la wada geeyo baabuurka oo la iibsado mid cusub.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are considering buying a used car that has been in a minor accident, be sure to have it inspected by a qualified mechanic.
entries.translation: Haddii aad ka fekereyso inaad iibsato baabuur la isticmaalay oo shil yar galay, iska hubi inuu ku eego makaanik aqoon u leh.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They will be able to identify any damage that may not be visible to the naked eye, and they can advise you on whether or not the car is safe to buy.
entries.translation: Waxay awood u yeelan doonaan inay ogaadaan wixii dhaawac ah ee laga yaabo inayan arki karin isha, waxayna kugula talin karaan haddii baabuurka uu yahay mid badbaado leh oo la iibsan karo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A bicycle is a thing of beauty, sleek and streamlined, its wheels a blur of motion as it glides along the road.
entries.translation: Baaskiilka waa shay qurux badan, xarrago leh oo toosan, taayirkiisu waa guduudan dhaqdhaqaaqa marka uu ku dul wareegayo waddada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But what happens when you bring a bike into a small room?
entries.translation: Laakiin maxaa dhacaya marka aad soo qaadato baaskiil qol yar?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Suddenly, all that grace and efficiency is lost, and the bike becomes a clumsy, awkward intruder.
entries.translation: Isla markiiba, dhammaan nimcadaas iyo hufnaantaas ayaa lumay, oo baaskiilku wuxuu noqdaa mid qallafsan, oo si xun u soo galay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I once had a bike in a small room.
entries.translation: Waxaan bari baaskiil ku haystay qol yar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a cramped, dingy apartment in a rundown neighborhood, and the bike took up most of the space.
entries.translation: Waxa ay ahayd guri ciriiri ah, guri nasasho leh oo ku yaalla xaafad ciriiri ah, baaskiilkuna waxa uu qabsaday inta badan nafaaskii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I could barely get through the door without knocking it over, and I had to be careful not to trip over it when I was in the middle of the night.
entries.translation: Waxa aan si dirqi ah uga soo bixi kari waayay albaabka aniga oo aan garaacin, waxana ay ahayd in aan ka taxadaro in aan ka dul wareego marka aan habeen saq-dhexe joogo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But even though the bike was a nuisance, I couldn't bring myself to get rid of it.
entries.translation: Laakiin inkasta oo baaskiilku uu ahaa mid dhib badan, naftayda kama dhaadhicin karin inaad ka takhaluso.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a reminder of a better time, when I was young and free and full of hope.
entries.translation: Waxay ahayd xasuusin wakhti ka wanaagsan, markii aan yaraa oo xor ahaa oo rajo buuxda lahaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I would sit on the bike and dream of all the places I could go, all the adventures I could have.
entries.translation: Waxaan ku fadhiisan ljiray baaskiilka oo waxaan ku riyoon jiray dhammaan meelaha aan tagi karo, dhammaan tacaburrada aan heli karo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, I finally decided to get rid of the bike.
entries.translation: Maalin maalmaha ka mid ah, waxaan ugu dambeyntii go'aansaday inaan ka takhaluso baaskiilka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I took it to the curb and put it out for the trash.
entries.translation: Waxa aan geeyey geeskii oo aan ku tuuray qashinka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As I watched it being hauled away, I felt a pang of regret.
entries.translation: Markaan daawanayay iyadoo la fogeynayo, waxaan dareemay calool xumo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the early 1900s, Americans were introduced to the drug “morphine” through the use of over-the-counter cough syrups.
entries.translation: Horraantii 1900-meeyadii, dadka Maraykanka ah waxaa la geeyay dawada "morphine" iyadoo la isticmaalayo sharoobada qufaca oo aan farmashiyaha laga qorin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: While this drug was initially used to treat pain, it soon became addictive and led to a rise in the number of drug addicts in the United States.
entries.translation: Iyadoo dawadan markii hore loo isticmaalay in lagu daweeyo xanuunka, isla markiiba waxay noqotay mid lagu qabatimay oo keentay in ay kor u kacdo tirada daroogada ee Maraykanka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most tragic stories of this era is that of the “Kitten Lady”.
entries.translation: Mid ka mid ah sheekooyinka ugu naxdinta badan ee xilligan waa tii "Marwada Kitten".
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This woman was a morphine addict who had a litter of kittens.
entries.translation: Haweenaydaan waxay ahayd qof ku qabatimay morphine oo lahayd mukulaal yaryar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She loved her kittens very much and would often play with them for hours on end.
entries.translation: Aad bay u jeceshay mukulaasheeda oo inta badan way la ciyaari jirtay saacado ka dib.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, her addiction soon took over and she began to neglect her kittens.
entries.translation: Si kastaba ha ahaatee, balwaddeedii ayaa markiiba la wareegtay oo waxay bilowday inay dayacdo mukulaasheeda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She would leave them for days at a time, only coming back to feed them and give them water.
entries.translation: Waxay ka maqnaan jirtay maalmo, kaliya waxay u soo noqon jirtay inay quudiso oo ay siiso biyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The kittens eventually began to suffer from the neglect.
entries.translation: Bisadihii ayaa ugu dambeyntii bilaabay inay la ildarnaadaan dayaca.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They became thin and sickly, and their fur began to fall out.
entries.translation: Way caatoobeen oo bukoodeen, dhogortoodana waa daadatay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One by one, they started to die.
entries.translation: Mid mid ayay u dhintaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Kitten Lady was devastated by the loss of her kittens, but she was unable to stop her addiction.
entries.translation: Marwada Bisada waxa aad ayay uga xumaatay luminta bisadaheeda, laakiin way awoodi wayday inay joojiso balwadda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She eventually died of a morphine overdose, leaving her kittens behind.
entries.translation: Aakhirkii waxay u dhimatay qiyaas xad dhaaf ah oo morphine ah, iyadoo ka tagtay bisadaheedii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This story is a reminder of the dangers of drug addiction.
entries.translation: Sheekadaan waxay xasuusinaysaa khatarta balwada darogada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is also a reminder of the love and devotion that animals can have for their humans.
entries.translation: Waxay kaloo xusuusinaysaa jacaylka iyo daacadnimada ay xooluhu u yeelan karaan dadkooda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Lesbian, gay, bisexual, and transgender (LGBT) people are people who identify with a sexual orientation or gender identity that is different from the majority population.
entries.translation: Dumarka isku jinsiga ah, khaniis, lab iyo dhedig, iyo dadka jinsiyada bedeshay dadka (LGBT) waa dad lagu garto jihada galmoodka ama aqoonsiga lab iyo dhedig ka duwan inta badan dadka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sexual orientation refers to a person's romantic and sexual attraction to others, while gender identity refers to a person's internal sense of being male or female.
entries.translation: Jiheynta galamad waa qofka oo jeclado inu la galmood o dadka kale halka jinsiga ay tahay darenka gudaha ee qof inu rag ama dumar yahay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: LGBT people face discrimination in many areas of life, including employment, housing, and healthcare.
entries.translation: Dadka isku galmoodo oo isku jinsiga ah waxay wajahan faquuq meelo badan oo nolashooda haday tahay shaqada guryaha iyo gobaha cafimad.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are also more likely to experience violence and abuse.
entries.translation: Waxyan u badan tahay inay la kulmaan gacan ka hadal ama cay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There is no one single cause of LGBT identity.
entries.translation: Ma jiro hal wax oo sababay shakhsiyada LGBT.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some people are born with an innate sense of their sexual orientation or gender identity, while others develop these feelings over time.
entries.translation: Dadka qaar waxay ku dhashaan dhalanteed daren oo jihayn galmo ama aqoonsi jinsiyadeed halka dadka ay dareemaan marki wakhti kaso wareegto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: LGBT people are just as diverse as the rest of the population.
entries.translation: Dadka LGBT waa kuwo u badan sida tiradad dadka kale.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They come from all walks of life and have a wide range of interests and experiences.
entries.translation: Waxay ka imaadan nolasha socdaalkeda waxayn leeyihiin xiiseyn wayn iyo khibrad.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The medical community recognizes that sexual orientation and gender identity are not mental illnesses.
entries.translation: Qoomiyada cafimaadka waxay ogadeen inay jihaynta galmada ama aqoonsiga jinsiga aysan aheyn xanuun maskaxeed.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In fact, the American Psychiatric Association removed homosexuality from its list of mental disorders in 1973.
entries.translation: Dhab ahaantii, Ururka Cilmi-nafsiga ee Maraykanka ayaa ka saaray khaniisnimada liiska cudurrada dhimirka 1973-kii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: LGBT people should be able to live their lives openly and authentically.
entries.translation: Dadka LGBT ah waxay awoodaan inay ku nooladaan nolashooda iyo si la hubo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They deserve to be treated with respect and dignity.
entries.translation: Waxay mudan yihiin in si xushmad iyo qaddarin leh loola dhaqmo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In many countries, there are laws that protect LGBT people from discrimination.
entries.translation: Wadamo badan, waxaa jira sharciyo dadka LGBT ka ilaaliya takoorka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Hello, and welcome to your annual checkup.
entries.translation: Dhakhtar: Haye, ku soo dhawoow baaritaankaaga sanadlaha ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: How are you feeling today?
entries.translation: Sidee dareemaysaa maanta?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: I'm feeling pretty good, all things considered.
entries.translation: Bukaanka: Waxaan dareemayaa wanaag, markii wax walba la qiimeeyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I've been getting a little more sleep lately, and my diet has been pretty healthy.
entries.translation: Baryahaan waxaan yara dareemayay hurdo badan, cuntadaydana waxay ahayd mid caafimaad qabta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: That's great to hear.
entries.translation: Dakhtarka: Taasi waa wax wanaagsan inaan maqlo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm going to start by taking your vital signs.
entries.translation: Waxaan ku bilaabayaa qaadashada calaamadahaaga muhiimka ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: [The doctor takes the patient's blood pressure, pulse, and temperature.]
entries.translation: [Dhakhtarka wuxuu qaadaa cadaadiska dhiigga ee bukaanka, garaaca wadnaha, iyo qandhada.]
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Everything looks good here.
entries.translation: Dhakhtarka: Wax walba waxay u muuqdaan inay fiican yihiin halkan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Now, let's talk about your diet.
entries.translation: Hadda, aan ka hadalno cuntadaada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: What are you eating on a typical day?
entries.translation: Maxaad cuntaa maalinta caadiga ah?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: I usually have a bowl of cereal for breakfast, a sandwich for lunch, and a salad for dinner.
entries.translation: Bukaanka: Badanaa waxaan cunaa baaquli xabuub ah quraacda, sandwich qadada, iyo khudaar casho ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I also try to eat fruits and vegetables throughout the day.
entries.translation: Waxaan sidoo kale isku dayaa inaan cuno miraha iyo khudaarta maalintii oo dhan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: That sounds like a healthy diet.
entries.translation: Dhakhtarka: Taasi waxay u egtahay cunto caafimaad leh.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Are you getting enough exercise?
entries.translation: Ma qaadataa jimicsi kugu filan?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: I try to get at least 30 minutes of exercise most days of the week.
entries.translation: Bukaanka: Waxaan isku dayaa inaan sameeyo jimicsi ugu yaraan 30 daqiiqo maalmaha isbuuca badankiisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I walk to work, and I play basketball once or twice a week.
entries.translation: Waxaan u lugeeyaa shaqada, waxaana ciyaara kubbadda koleyga hal ama laba jeer toddobaadkii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: That's great. Exercise is an important part of a healthy lifestyle.
entries.translation: Dhakhtarka: Taasi waa wax fiican. Jimicsiga waa qayb muhiim ah oo ka mid ah qaab nololeed caafimaad leh.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: I know. I'm trying to be more active.
entries.translation: Bukaan: waan ogahay. Waxaan isku dayayaa inaan firfircoonaado.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is a country in Central Africa with a population of over 80 million people.
entries.translation: Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga ah ee Kongo (DRC) waa waddan ku yaal badhtamaha Afrika oo ay ku nool yihiin in ka badan 80 milyan oo qof.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is the second-largest country in Africa by area, and is endowed with vast natural resources, including copper, cobalt, diamonds, and gold.
entries.translation: Waa dalka labaad ee ugu weyn qaarada Afrika marka loo eego deegaan ahaan, waxaana lagu manaystay kheyraad aad u badan oo ay ka mid yihiin naxaasta, Cobalt, dheeman iyo dahab.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, the DRC has been plagued by conflict for decades, which has had a devastating impact on its people and economy.
entries.translation: Si kastaba ha ahaatee, DRC ayaa tobanaan sano waxaa ragaadiyay colaado, kuwaas oo saameyn xun ku yeeshay dadkeeda iyo dhaqaalahooda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The first major conflict in the DRC was the First Congo War, which lasted from 1996 to 1997.
entries.translation: Dagaalkii ugu weynaa ee DRC ka dhacay wuxuu ahaa kii ugu horreeyay ee Kongo, kaasoo socday 1996 ilaa 1997.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This war was fought between the government of Mobutu Sese Seko and a rebel group led by Laurent Kabila.
entries.translation: Dagaalkan ayaa waxa uu u dhexeeyay dawladda Mobutu Sese Seko iyo jabhad uu hoggaaminayo Laurent Kabila.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Kabila eventually succeeded in overthrowing Mobutu and taking power.
entries.translation: Kabila ayaa aakhirkii ku guulaystay in uu xukunka ka tuuro Mobutu oona xukunka la wareego.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, Kabila's rule was short-lived.
entries.translation: Si kastaba ha ahaatee, xukunka Kabila wuxuu ahaa mid gaaban.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1998, he was overthrown by a new rebel group led by Jean-Pierre Bemba.
entries.translation: Sannadkii 1998-kii, waxaa afgambiyay jabhad cusub oo uu hoggaaminayay Jean-Pierre Bemba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This led to the Second Congo War, which lasted until 2003.
entries.translation: Tani waxay keentay dagaalkii labaad ee Kongo, kaas oo socday ilaa 2003.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Second Congo War was the deadliest conflict in modern African history, and resulted in the deaths of over 5 million people.
entries.translation: Dagaalkii labaad ee Kongo wuxuu ahaa iskahorimaadkii ugu dhimashada badnaa taariikhda casriga ah ee Afrika, wuxuuna sababay dhimashada in ka badan 5 milyan oo qof.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The DRC has also been plagued by political instability.
entries.translation: DRC ayaa sidoo kale waxaa ragaadiyay xasillooni darro siyaasadeed.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Last week, my uncle was out in the field harvesting corn when he spotted a snake slithering across the ground.
entries.translation: Isbuucii hore, adeerkay isagoo beerta ku maqan oo sabuul goosanayay ayaa wuxuu arkay mas dhulka ku sii qulqulaya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He decided to take a closer look, and as he got closer, he realized that it was a huge rattlesnake!
entries.translation: Wuxuu go'aansaday inuu si dhaw u fiiriyo, markuu u soo dhawaaday, wuxuu gartay inay tahay mas weyn!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He quickly backed away, but the snake was already on the move.
entries.translation: Si degdeg ah ayuu uga laabtay, laakiin maskii hore ayuu u socday.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It headed straight for my uncle, who started to run.
entries.translation: Waxay si toos ah u soo aaday adeerkay oo orod bilaabay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He ran as fast as he could, but the snake was gaining on him.
entries.translation: Si degdeg ah ayuu u orday intuu awooday, laakiin maskii ayaa ka orod badiyay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Just when it seemed like the snake was going to catch him, my uncle tripped and fell.
entries.translation: Isla markii aad mooddo in masku soo qaban doono, ayaa adeerkay turunturooday oo dhacay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He landed in a big pile of manure, and the snake slid right past him.
entries.translation: Waxa uu ku soo degay digo aad u tiro badan, maskiina si toos ah ayuu u soo dhaafay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My uncle was so relieved that he had escaped, but he was also covered in manure.
entries.translation: Adeerkey aad ayuu u nafisay oo wuu baxsaday, laakiin digada ayaa qarisay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The plastic bag is a ubiquitous object in our modern world.
entries.translation: Boorsada bacda waa shay meel walbo yalo aduunka casriga ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is used for everything from carrying groceries to picking up dog poop.
entries.translation: Waxa loo isticmaalaa wax kasta laga soo bilaabo qaadidda raashinka ilaa soo qaadista eeyaha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But what is the true cost of this seemingly innocuous item?
entries.translation: Laakiin waa maxay qiimaha dhabta ah ee shaygan u muuqda mid aan dhib lahayn?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Plastic bags are made from a type of plastic called polyethylene, which is derived from fossil fuels.
entries.translation: Bacaha caagga ah waxaa laga sameeyaa nooc caag ah oo loo yaqaan polyetylen, kaas oo ka soo ka imaada shidaalka fosil.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The production of plastic bags requires a great deal of energy, and it also releases harmful pollutants into the environment.
entries.translation: Wax soo saarka bacda waxay uu u baahan yahay tamar badan waxayna soo sii daysaa wax yaalo wax tar an lahayn oo ay kus dayso degaanka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once plastic bags are discarded, they can take hundreds of years to decompose.
entries.translation: Marka bacaha la tuuro, waxay qaadan kartaa boqolaal sano inay baa'bado.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This means that they can accumulate in landfills and oceans, where they can harm wildlife and pollute our water supply.
entries.translation: Taas macneheedu waxa weeye in ay ku urursan karaan meelaha qashin-qubka ah iyo badaha, halkaas oo ay waxyeello u geysan karaan duur-joogta oo ay wasakhayn karaan biyahayaga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Plastic bags are also a major source of litter.
entries.translation: Bacaha balaastikada ah ayaa sidoo kale ah isha ugu weyn ee qashinka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can be found on beaches, in parks, and even in our own neighborhoods.
entries.translation: Waxaa laga heli karaa xeebaha, jardiinooyinka, iyo xitaa xaafadaheena.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Litter is unsightly and can be a hazard to wildlife.
entries.translation: Qashinka waa mid aan qurux badnayn waxayna khatar ku noqon kartaa duurjoogta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The plastic bag is a symbol of our throwaway culture.
entries.translation: Bacda waxay calaamad u tahay dhaqankeena tuurista.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We use them for a few minutes and then discard them, never giving a thought to the environmental consequences.
entries.translation: Waxaan u isticmaalnaa dhowr daqiiqo ka dibna tuurno, annagoo marnaba ka fikirin cawaaqibka deegaanka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We need to find ways to reduce our use of plastic bags.
entries.translation: Waxaan u baahanahay inaan helno siyaabo lagu dhimo isticmaalkeena bacaha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We can bring our own reusable bags when we go shopping, and we can recycle plastic bags whenever possible.
entries.translation: Waxaan soo qaadan karnaa bacahayada dib loo isticmaali karo marka aan dukaameyno, waxaana dib u warshadeyn karnaa bacaha mar kasta oo ay suurtagal tahay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We can also lobby our elected officials to pass laws that restrict the use of plastic bags.
entries.translation: Waxaan sidoo kale u ololayn karnaa masuuliyiintayada la doortay si ay u ansixiyaan sharci xaddidaya isticmaalka bacaha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Kofi and Sameer met in college at a bar that Kofi's father owned.
entries.translation: Koofi iyo Sameer waxay ku kulmeen macahadka ku yaalo baarka ay Koofi hooyadi leedahay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They became fast friends, even though they were very different people.
entries.translation: Waxay isku noqdeen saxiibo isku daacda ah in kasto ay kala duwan yihiin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Kofi was outgoing and adventurous, while Sameer was more introverted and studious.
entries.translation: Koofi wuxuu ahaa saxiib furfuran oo qataraha u bareero halka ay Sameer ahayd mid xishood badan isna ilaaliso.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But they had a lot in common, and they quickly bonded over their shared love of music, movies, and books.
entries.translation: Laakiin waxay lahaayeen wax badan oo ay wadaagaan, waxayna si degdeg ah isugu xidheen jacaylka ay wadaagaan ee muusiga, filimada, iyo buugaagta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They spent hours talking about their favorite bands, movies, and books, and they even started a band together.
entries.translation: Waxay ku qaadatay saacado inay ka sheekeeyaan kooxihii ay jeclaayeen, filimada, iyo buugaagta, waxayna xitaa bilaabeen koox.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After college, Kofi and Sameer moved to different cities, but they stayed in touch and visited each other regularly.
entries.translation: Koofi iyo Sameer markii ay jaamacada ka soo baxeen waxay u guureen magaalooyin kala duwan, laakiin way wada xidhiidhi jireen oo si joogto ah ayay isu soo booqan jireen.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They continued to be best friends, even though they lived far apart.
entries.translation: Waxay sii ahaan jireen saaxiibbo wanaagsan, inkastoo ay aad u kala fogaayeen.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They talked on the phone every week, and they always made time for each other when they were in town.
entries.translation: Waxa ay ku wadahadli jireen taleefoonka isbuuc walba, mar walbana wakhti ayay isku qaadan jireen marka ay magaalada joogaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Kofi and Sameer' friendship has lasted for over 30 years, and it shows no signs of slowing down.
entries.translation: Koofi iyo Sameer saaxiibtinimadoodu waxa ay socotay in ka badan 30 sano, mana muuqato wax calaamado ah oo hoos u dhac ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The air was thick with the smell of sweat and freshly cut grass as the athletes lined up for the start of the 100-meter dash.
entries.translation: Hawada ayaa qaro weyn ka muuqatay dhididka iyo cawska cusub ee la jaray iyadoo ciyaartooydu ay saf ugu jireen bilawga orodka 100-ka mitir.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Organ trafficking can have devastating consequences for victims.

entries.english: Not only do they suffer physical and psychological trauma, but they may also die from the surgery.

entries.english: Work is worship is a principle that states that all work, no matter how menial or insignificant it may seem, is sacred.
entries.translation: Shaqada waa cibaadada waa mabda' sheegaya in shaqada oo dhan, si kasta oo ay u muuqato mid liidata ama aan macno lahayn, ay tahay muqadas.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a belief that every task we perform, from cooking dinner for our children to cleaning the house, is an opportunity to honor God and our fellow man.
entries.translation: Waxaa la aaminsan yahay in hawl kasta oo aan qabanno, laga soo bilaabo cunto karinta carruurteena iyo nadiifinta guriga, ay tahay fursad aan ku xurmeyno Ilaah iyo dadka kale.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When we work with this mindset, we approach our tasks with a sense of reverence and respect.
entries.translation: Markaan ku shaqayno maskaxdan, waxaan u qabanaa shaqadeena si xushmad iyo ixtiraam leh.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We take pride in our work and do our best to do it well.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We also become more mindful of the people who will benefit from our work, and we are more likely to go the extra mile to make sure that it is done well.
entries.translation: Waxaan sidoo kale aad u baraarujinaynaa dadka ka faa'iideysan doona shaqadeena, waxaana ay u badan tahay in aan aado miyi dheeraad ah si aan u hubinno in si wanaagsan loo qabtay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Working as worship can also help us to connect with our families and communities.
entries.translation: U shaqaynta cibaadada oo kale waxay kaloo naga caawin kartaa inaan la xiriirno qoysaskeena iyo bulshooyinka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When we cook dinner for our children, we are not only providing them with nourishment, but we are also spending time with them and teaching them about the importance of food and family.
entries.translation: Marka aan cashada u karinno carruurteena, ma siinno oo keliya nafaqeynta, laakiin sidoo kale waxaan wakhti la qaadannaa oo aan baranaa muhiimadda cuntada iyo qoyska.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When we clean the house, we are not only making our living space more comfortable, but we are also creating a sense of order and peace.
entries.translation: Marka aan nadiifinno guriga, kaliya maahan inaan ka dhigno meel aan ku noolnahay si raaxo leh, laakiin sidoo kale waxaan abuureynaa dareen nidaam iyo nabad.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Work is worship is a powerful principle that can transform our lives and our relationships.
entries.translation: Shaqada waa cibaadado waa mabda' awood leh oo wax ka bedeli kara nolosheena iyo xiriirkeena.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When we work with this mindset, we can find meaning and purpose in even the most mundane tasks.

entries.english: "Don't judge a book by its cover" is a popular saying that means one should not make assumptions about something based on its outward appearance.

entries.english: This can be applied to people, places, and things.

entries.english: For example, you might meet someone who has a bad reputation, but after getting to know them, you realize that they are actually a kind and gentle person.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Or, you might see a building that looks old and rundown, but when you go inside, you find that it is actually a beautiful and historic place.
entries.translation: Ama, waxaad arki kartaa dhisme u eg mid duug ah oo burbursan, laakiin markaad gudaha gasho, waxaad ogaanaysaa inay dhab ahaantii tahay meel qurux badan oo taariikhi ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many reasons why it is important not to judge things by their appearance.
entries.translation: Waxaa jira sababo badan oo ay muhiim u tahay in aan wax lagu xukumin muuqaalkooda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: First, it can lead to making incorrect assumptions.
entries.translation: Marka hore, waxay u horseedi kartaa samaynta malo-awaal khaldan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Second, it can prevent us from seeing the true value of something.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Third, it can create unnecessary conflict and division.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The next time you are tempted to judge something by its appearance, take a moment to pause and reflect.

entries.english: The reality of acid rain is a four-letter word: ouch.

entries.english: It's a serious problem that's harming forests, lakes, and even people.

entries.english: Acid rain is caused when chemicals like sulfur dioxide and nitrogen oxide are released into the air by power plants, factories, and cars.
entries.translation: Roobka aashitada waxa keeno marka kiimikooyinka sida sulfuriga laba-oksijiin iyo nitrogen oxide ay hawada ku sii daayaan warshadaha korontada, warshado, iyo baabuur.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These chemicals react with water in the atmosphere to form acids, which then fall to the ground in rain, snow, or fog.
entries.translation: Kiimikooyinkani waxay la falgalaan biyaha ku jira jawiga si ay u sameeyaan aashito, ka dibna dhulka ugu soo dhacaya roobka ahaan, baraf, ama ceeryaamo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Acid rain can damage trees by making their leaves more acidic.
entries.translation: Roobka aashitada ahi waxa uu dhaawici karaa geedaha iyaga oo ka dhiga caleentooda mid aashita leh.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can cause the leaves to turn yellow and fall off, which can weaken the tree and make it more susceptible to disease.
entries.translation: Tani waxay keeni kartaa in caleemaha ay huruud noqdaan oo ay daataan, taas oo daciifin karta geedka oo ka dhigi karta mid aad u nugul cudurrada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Acid rain can also kill fish and other aquatic life by making the water too acidic.
entries.translation: Roobka ashitada aha wuxu dili kara kaluunka iyo noolaha kale ee badda isagoo ka dhigayo biyaha kuwoo aad aashitaysan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition, acid rain can damage buildings and statues by corroding the materials they're made of.
entries.translation: Intaa waxa dheer, roobka aashitada ahi waxa uu dhaawici karaa dhismayaasha iyo taalooyinka iyaga oo daxal-geliya agabka ay ka samaysan yihiin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are a number of things that can be done to reduce acid rain.
entries.translation: Waxa jiro dhawr shay oo lagu yareen karo roobka ashitada ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One is to switch to cleaner energy sources, such as solar and wind power.
entries.translation: Mid waa in lagu beddelo ilaha tamarta nadiifka ah, sida tamarta qorraxda iyo dabaysha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another is to install pollution controls on factories and power plants.
entries.translation: Mid kale waa in lagu rakibo xakameeyayaasha wasakhda warshadaha iyo warshadaha korontada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And finally, we can all do our part by driving less, recycling more, and using energy more efficiently.
entries.translation: Ugu dambayntii, dhammaanteen waxaan qaybteena ku gudan karnaa innagoo baabuur wadid yaraynayna, dib u warshadayn badan, oo si hufan u isticmaalna tamarta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So the next time you see a rainstorm, think about acid rain.
entries.translation: Markaa marka xigta oo aad aragto duufaan, ka fikir roobka aashitada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "College student's experiences with beer": As a college student, I have had my fair share of experiences with beer.

entries.english: Some of these experiences have been positive, while others have been less than ideal.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, one experience that I will never forget is the time I got "prison beer" delivered to my dorm room.

entries.translation: Waxa uu sheegay in qofka kale uu dalbaday kiish qamri ah, si kadis ahna uu noogu keenay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We were all a little hesitant at first, but we eventually decided to keep the beer.
entries.translation: Dhammaanteen markii horeba waan ka walaacnay, laakiin ugu dambeyntii waxaan go'aansannay inaan sii wadano qamriga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After all, it was free beer.
entries.translation: Intaa ka dib, waxay ahyd qamri bilaaash ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We opened the case of beer and started drinking.
entries.translation: Waxaan furnay kiishka qamriga oona bilownay inaan cabno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The beer was actually pretty good, and we all had a great time.
entries.translation: Qamriga wuxuu ahaa miid cajib ah oo fican, waxaana qaadanay wakhti fican.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My colleague was a hard worker, but she was always getting passed over for promotions.
entries.translation: Saxibkey wuxuu ahaa mid dadaal badan, laakiin had iyo jeer waxay u gudbi jirtay dallacaad.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was told that she needed to "work harder" or "be more visible," but it seemed like no matter what she did, she couldn't get ahead.
entries.translation: Waxa loo shegay inay u bahan tahay "inay dadaasho" ama "ay muuqato" laakiin waxay u muuqatay wax kasta oo ay sameyso, in aysan horay u socon karin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The manager was also a problem.
entries.translation: Maamulaha wuxuu kaloo ahaa dhibaato.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was always micromanaging everyone, and he was quick to criticize.
entries.translation: Wuxuu aha mid mar walbo xakameeyo qof walbo wuxuuna ahaa mid dhaqso wax cananta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He didn't seem to care about the employees' work-life balance, and he expected them to be available 24/7.
entries.translation: Waxa uu u muuqday in uusan dan ka lahayn isku dheelitirnaanta shaqada iyo nolosha shaqaalaha, waxana uu filayey in la heli karo iyaga 24/7.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My colleague eventually reached her breaking point.
entries.translation: Saxiibkey wuxu gaaray meeshi ugu danbaysay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She couldn't take the stress of the job anymore, and she knew that she wouldn't be able to advance her career there.
entries.translation: Way sii qaadan kari wayday culayska shaqada, waxayna ogaatay inaanay awoodi doonin inay shaqadeeda halkaa ka sii waddo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She gave her two weeks' notice and started looking for a new job.
entries.translation: Waxay siisay ogeysiis laba toddobaad ah waxayna bilowday inay raadiso shaqo cusub.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She found a new job that was a much better fit for her.
entries.translation: Waxay heshay shaqo cusub oo aad ugu habboon iyada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The pay was better, the hours were more reasonable, and the manager was supportive and understanding.
entries.translation: Mushaharka wuu fiicnaaday, sacadahana waxay ahaayeen kuwo macquul ah, maamuluhana wuu taageersanaa oo wuu fahmay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She's much happier now, and she's glad that she made the decision to leave her old job.
entries.translation: Hadda aad bay u faraxsan tahay, wayna ku faraxsan tahay inay qaadatay go'aanka ah inay ka tagto shaqadeedii hore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm not sure what the manager is doing now, but I hope that he's learned his lesson.
entries.translation: Ma hubo waxa maamuluhu sameynayo hadda, laakiin waxaan rajeynayaa inuu bartay casharkiisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He can't treat his employees like that and expect them to stay.
entries.translation: Shaqaalihiisa sidaas uma uula dhaqmi karo oo ma filayo inay sii joogaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If he wants to keep good people, he needs to change his ways.
entries.translation: Haddii uu doonayo inuu dadka wanaagsan ilaaliyo, wuxuu u baahan yahay inuu beddelo jidadkiisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As for my colleague, she's doing great in her new job.
entries.translation: Xagga saaxiibtay, shaqadeeda cusub ayay si fiican u qabanaysaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She's getting the recognition that she deserves, and she's finally able to advance her career.
entries.translation: Waxay helaysaa aqoonsiga ay u qalanto, waxayna ugu dambeyntii awood u leedahay inay horumariso xirfadeeda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She's a great example of what happens when you stand up for yourself and refuse to put up with a bad situation.
entries.translation: Waxay tusaale fiican u tahay waxa dhacaya markaad naftaada u istaagto oo aad diido inaad u dulqaadato xaalad xun.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Funny pictures and videos are a dime a dozen these days, but some of them stand out from the rest.
entries.translation: Sawirro iyo muuqaallo lagu qosolo waa wax iska caadi ah maalmahan, laakiin qaarkood ayaa ka fiican kuwa kale.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These are the ones that are so relatable or absurd that they make us laugh out loud.
entries.translation: Kuwaani waa kuwa aad iskula xiriiri kara ama aan caqli gal ahayn oo ay aad noogu qosliyaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One example is a recent video that went viral of a cat trying to fit into a small box.
entries.translation: Mid ka mid ah tusaale ahaan muuqaal dhowaan soo baxay oo caan baxay oo ah bisad isku dayaysa inay gasho sanduuq yar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The cat is clearly struggling, but it keeps trying, and the whole thing is just so funny.
entries.translation: Bisada si cad ayay u halgamaysaa, laakiin way sii wadaysaa isku daygeeda, wax walbana waa wax aad u qosol badan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another example is a picture of a dog wearing a hat that is way too big for it.
entries.translation: Tusaale kale waa sawirka ey koofiyad gashan oo ay aad ugu weyn tahay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The dog looks so ridiculous that it's impossible not to laugh.
entries.translation: Eeygu wuxuu u muuqdaa mid aad u qosol badan oo aan macquul ahayn in aan la qoslin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Memes often use familiar images or phrases, and they can be used to express a wide range of emotions.
entries.translation: Kaftanka badanaa waxaa loo adeegsadaa sawirro ama oraahyo la yaqaan, waxaana loo isticmaali karaa in lagu muujiyo shucuur kala duwan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One thing that must happen when a funny picture or video goes viral is that it is shared with others.
entries.translation: Mid ka mid ah shay ay tahay inay dhacaan marka sawir qosol leh ama muuqaal ah uu faafo waa in lala wadaago dadka kale.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is what makes memes so popular.
entries.translation: Tani waa waxa ka dhigaya kaftanka caan ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: People see a funny picture or video, and they want to share it with their friends so that they can laugh too.
entries.translation: Dadku waxay arkaan sawir ama muuqaal qosol leh, waxayna rabaan inay la wadaagaan asxaabtooda si ay iyaguna u qoslaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is why memes can spread so quickly across the internet.
entries.translation: Tani waa sababta kaftanka ay si degdeg ah ugu faafi karaan intarneedka oo dhan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mount Everest is the highest mountain in the world, standing at 8,848 meters above sea level.
entries.translation: Buurta Everest waa buurta ugu dheer aduunka, dheerarkeedane wuxuu yahay 8,848 mitir oo ka sarreysa heerka badda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is located in the Mahalangur Himal sub-range of the Himalayas.
entries.translation: Waxay ku taalaa Mahalangur Himal-hoosaadka Himalayas.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The mountain is a popular destination for mountaineers, and many people attempt to summit it each year.
entries.translation: Buurta ayaa ah meel ay caan ku yihiin dadka buuraleyda ah, waxaana dad badan ay isku dayaan in ay ku kulmaan sanad walba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, the climb is dangerous, and many people have died trying to reach the top.
entries.translation: Si kastaba ha ahaatee, fuulitaanka ayaa ah mid khatar ah, dad badan ayaana ku dhintay iyagoo isku dayaya inay meel sare gaaraan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The first recorded attempt to summit Everest was made in 1921 by a British expedition led by George Mallory.
entries.translation: Isku daygii ugu horreeyay ee la diiwaan geliyo ee shirwaynaha Everest waxaa sameeyay 1921-kii duullaan Ingiriis ah oo uu hogaaminayay George Mallory.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mallory and his climbing partner Andrew Irvine disappeared during their attempt, and their bodies were not found until 1999.
entries.translation: Mallory iyo saaxiibkiisii ​​fuulay Andrew Irvine ayaa la waayay intii ay isku dayeen, meydadkoodana lama helin ilaa 1999-kii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1953, Edmund Hillary and Tenzing Norgay became the first people to successfully summit Everest.
entries.translation: Sannadkii 1953-kii, Edmund Hillary iyo Tenzing Norgay waxay noqdeen dadkii ugu horreeyay ee si guul leh isugu yimaadda Everest.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Since then, thousands of people have followed in their footsteps.
entries.translation: Tan iyo markaas, kumannaan qof ayaa raacay jidkoodii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The climb to the summit of Everest is a long and arduous journey.
entries.translation: Fulitaanka sare ee Everest waa safar dheer oo dhib badan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It typically takes climbers about two months to complete the journey, and they must overcome a number of challenges along the way.
entries.translation: Caadi ahaan waxay qaadataa fuulayaasha ilaa laba bilood si ay u dhamaystiraan safarka, waana inay ka gudbaan caqabado badan oo jidka ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These challenges include altitude sickness, extreme weather conditions, and the risk of falling.
entries.translation: Caqabadahaan waxaa ka mid ah jirro jooga sare ah, xaaladaha cimilada oo aad u daran, iyo khatarta dhicista.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Despite the dangers, the climb to the summit of Everest is a rewarding experience.
entries.translation: Inkasta oo ay jiraan khataro, fuulitaanka sare ee Everest waa waayo-aragnimo faa'iido leh.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mother: The telescope is used to look at objects in space.
entries.translation: Hooyo: Qalabka cirka waxaa loo isticmaalaa in lagu fiiriyo walxaha samada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Child: Can I look through it?
entries.translation: Ilmaha: Maku fiirin karaa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mother: Sure, but be careful not to bump it.
entries.translation: Hooyo: Hubaal, laakin ka taxadar inaadan ku dhicin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The child looks through the telescope and sees a bright star.
entries.translation: Ilmaha wuxuu fiirinayaa qalabka cirka oo wuxuu arkay xiddig dhalaalaya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Child: Wow, it's so beautiful!
entries.translation: Ilmaha: Wow, aad ayuu u qurxoon yahay!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mother: Yes, it is. The stars are so far away, but with a telescope, we can see them up close.
entries.translation: Hooyo: Haa, way tahay. Xiddigaha aad bay u fog yihiin, laakiin qalabka cirka, waxaan ku arki karnaa meel dhow.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The child looks at other objects in space, including planets and moons.
entries.translation: Ilmaha wuxuu fiirinayaa walxaha kale ee samada, oo ay ku jiraan meerayaasha iyo dayaxa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are amazed by how small and insignificant they feel compared to the vastness of the universe.
entries.translation: Waxay la yaabban yihiin sida ay u yar yihiin oo aanay macno u lahayn marka loo eego baaxadda koonka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Child: I can't believe how big space is.
entries.translation: Ilmaha: Ma rumaysan karo sida samada u weyn tahay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mother: It is, but it's also full of amazing things.
entries.translation: Hooyo: Way tahay, laakiin sidoo kale waxaa ka buuxa waxyaabo yaab leh.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was worried that I might have contracted Lyme disease, but I went to the doctor and he said that I didn't have anything to worry about.
entries.translation: Waxaan ka walwalsanahay inuu igu dhacay cudurka Lyme, laakiin waxaan u tagay dhakhtarka wuxuuna ii sheegay inaanan qabin wax aan ka walwalo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He told me that the rash was probably just a reaction to the tick's saliva.
entries.translation: Wuxuu ii sheegay in finanku u badan yihiin inay fal-celin ka yihiin candhuufta shillinta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was relieved to hear that I didn't have Lyme disease, but I was still a little bit concerned about the rash.
entries.translation: Waan ku farxay markaan maqlay inaanan qabin cudurka Lyme, laakiin weli waxaan ka yara walaacsanahay finanka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The doctor told me that it would go away on its own, but it took a few weeks for it to completely disappear.
entries.translation: Dhakhtarku waxa uu ii sheegay in ay iskeed iska tagi doonto, laakiin waxa ay qaadataa dhawr toddobaad in ay gebi ahaanba meesha ka baxdo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the meantime, I tried to keep the rash clean and dry.
entries.translation: Dhanka kale, waxaan isku dayay inaan finanka nadiifiyo oo qalajiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I also applied some over-the-counter hydrocortisone cream to help relieve the itching.
entries.translation: Waxa kale oo aan dalbaday kiriim hydrocortisone ah oo aan farmashiyaha laga qorin si ay iiga caawiso cuncunka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The rash was itchy and unsightly, but it didn't cause me any other problems.
entries.translation: Finanaka waxay ahaayeen kuwo cuncun leh oo aan muuqan, laakiin wax dhibaato kale ah iima keenin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm just glad that I didn't have Lyme disease.
entries.translation: Kaliya waan ku faraxsanahay inaanan qabin cudurka Lyme.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you find a tick attached to your body, it's important to remove it as soon as possible.
entries.translation: Haddii aad aragto shilin ku dheggan jirkaaga, waxa muhiim ah in aad iska saarto sida ugu dhakhsaha badan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can use a pair of tweezers to grasp the tick as close to the skin as possible and pull it straight out.
entries.translation: Waxaad isticmaali kartaa labo-maroojiyeyaal si aad shilinta u qabato sida ugu dhow maqaarka ee suurtogalka ah oo aad si toos ah u soo saarto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Don't twist or jerk the tick, as this could cause the head to break off and remain in your skin.
entries.translation: Ha leexin ama ha gaabin shilinta, sababtoo ah tani waxay keeni kartaa in madaxu dillaaco oo ku haro maqaarkaaga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once you've removed the tick, wash the area with soap and water.
entries.translation: Markaad shilinta ka saarto, meesha ku dhaq saabuun iyo biyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can also apply a topical antibiotic ointment to help prevent infection.
entries.translation: Waxa kale oo aad mari kartaa boomaatada qalajiyaha la mariyo si ay kaaga caawiso ka hortagga infegshonka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's important to watch for signs of Lyme disease after being bitten by a tick.
entries.translation: Waa muhiim in la daawado calaamadaha cudurka Lyme ka dib marka ay shilinta qaniinto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These symptoms can include fever, headache, fatigue, muscle aches, and a characteristic rash.
entries.translation: Calaamadahaan waxaa ka mid noqon kara qandho, madax-xanuun, daal, murqo xanuun, iyo finan sifo ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you develop any of these symptoms, see your doctor right away.
entries.translation: Haddii aad isku aragto mid ka mid ah calaamadahan, u tag dhakhtarkaaga isla markaaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Lyme disease is a serious illness, but it can be treated with antibiotics.
entries.translation: Cudurka Lyme waa cudur halis ah, laakiin waxaa lagu daweyn karaa qalajiye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Early diagnosis and treatment is important to prevent serious complications.
entries.translation: Baaritaanka hore iyo daawaynta waa muhiim si looga hortago dhibaatooyin halis ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you have any questions about ticks or Lyme disease, talk to your doctor.
entries.translation: Haddii aad wax su'aalo ah ka qabto shilinta ama cudurka Lyme, la hadal dhakhtarkaaga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Three women are sitting at a table, talking about their cats.

entries.english: Constance: My cat, Sangeetha, is always there to greet me at the door when I come home from work.

entries.english: Ayanda: Me too! I have two cats of my own. They make me feel wanted.
entries.translation: Ayanda ana sido kale waxan leeyahay labo bisado aniga ii qaasa ah. Waxay i dareensiiyaan in aan u baahdo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Constance: I know what you mean. Sangeetha always makes me feel better when I'm having a bad day.

entries.english: Aditi: I've always wanted a cat, but I'm allergic.

entries.english: Ayanda: That's too bad. Cats are really great companions.

entries.english: Aditi:I know! I've always admired people who have cats. They seem to have such a special bond with their pets.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Constance: I think it's because cats are very independent animals. They don't need you to take care of them every minute of the day.
entries.translation: Constance: Waxaan u maleynayaa inay sabab u tahay bisadaha inay yihiin xayawaan aad u madax banaan. Uma baahna inaad daryeesho daqiiqad kasta oo maalinta ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But they still love you and enjoy your company.

entries.english: The history of Ethiopia is long and complex, with a rich and varied culture.
entries.translation: Taariikhda Itoobiya waa mid dheer oo balaaran, lehna dhaqan qani ah oo kala duwan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The earliest evidence of human settlement in Ethiopia dates back to the Paleolithic period, with the discovery of stone tools and other artifacts.
entries.translation: Caddaynta ugu horraysa ee deegaamaynta bani’aadamka ee Itoobiya waxay soo bilaabatay xilligii Paleolithic, iyada oo la helay qalab dhagax ah iyo waxyaabo kale oo farshaxan ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The first major civilization in Ethiopia was the Aksumite Empire, which flourished from the 1st century BC to the 8th century AD.
entries.translation: Xadaaraddii ugu horreysay ee Itoobiya ka dhacda waxay ahayd Boqortooyadii Aksumite, taasoo soo ifbaxday qarnigii 1aad ee BC ilaa qarnigii 8aad ee miilaadiga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Aksumites were a powerful trading empire that controlled much of the trade between Africa and the Middle East.
entries.translation: Aksumites waxay ahaayeen boqortooyo ganacsi oo xoog badan oo gacanta ku haysay inta badan ganacsiga Afrika iyo Bariga Dhexe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They also built many impressive monuments, including the Great Stelae of Aksum.
entries.translation: Waxay sidoo kale dhiseen taallooyin badan oo cajiib ah, oo ay ku jiraan Great Stelae of Aksum.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After the fall of the Aksumite Empire, Ethiopia was ruled by a series of different kingdoms and dynasties.
entries.translation: Burburkii Boqortooyadii Aksumite ka dib, Itoobiya waxaa ka talinaysay boqortooyooyin iyo saldanado kala duwan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the 16th century, Ethiopia was invaded by the Ottoman Empire, but the Ethiopians were able to defeat the Ottomans and maintain their independence.
entries.translation: Qarnigii 16-aad, Itoobiya waxaa soo galay Boqortooyadii Cusmaaniyiinta, balse Xabashida waxay awood u yeelatay inay ka adkaato Cusmaaniyiinta oo ay xornimadeeda ilaashato.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the 19th century, Ethiopia was ruled by Emperor Tewodros II, who is considered one of the greatest Ethiopian rulers.
entries.translation: Qarnigii 19-aad, Itoobiya waxa ka talinayay Imbaraadoor Tewodros II, oo lagu tiriyo mid ka mid ah talisyadii ugu waaweynaa ee Itoobiya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Tewodros II was a strong and ambitious ruler who sought to unite Ethiopia and to modernize the country.
entries.translation: Tewodros II waxa uu ahaa xukun adag oo hammi leh oo isku dayayey in uu mideeyo Itoobiya iyo sidii uu dalka u casriyeyn lahaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Salesperson: What kind of style are you looking for?

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Customer: I'm mostly interested in something neutral and understated.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Salesperson: We have a few options that might work. This one is made from wool and has a simple geometric pattern.
