entries.english: Sickness has been a part of human life since the beginning of time.
entries.translation: Xanuunka waxa uu ahaa qayb ka mid ah nolosha bini'aadamka tan iyo bilawgii wakhtiga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: From the common cold to the bubonic plague, countless diseases have ravaged our species, causing pain, suffering, and death.
entries.translation: Laga soo bilaabo hargabka caadiga ah ilaa daacuunka bubonic, cudurro aan la tirin karin ayaa naafeeyay nooceena, kuwaas oo keenay xanuun, rafaad iyo dhimasho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But where did these illnesses come from?
entries.translation: Laakin xagee ka imaadeen xanuunadan?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One popular myth about the origin of sickness is that it was caused by a curse from the gods.
entries.translation: Hal khuraafaad caan ah oo ku saabsan asalka jirrada ayaa ah in uu ka dhashay habaar ka yimid ilaahyada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: According to this myth, the gods were angered by the behavior of humans, so they sent down a plague to punish them.
entries.translation: Sida ay khuraafaadkaan sheegayso, ilaahyadu way ka caroodeen hab-dhaqanka bini’aadamka, sidaa darteed waxay soo dejiyeen belaayo si ay u ciqaabaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: While this myth is certainly a powerful story, there is no evidence to support it.
entries.translation: Inkasta oo khuraafaadkani ay tahay sheeko awood leh, ma jiraan wax caddayn ah oo taageeraya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In fact, most scientists believe that sickness is caused by natural factors, such as bacteria and viruses.
entries.translation: Dhab ahaantii, saynisyahannada intooda badani waxay aaminsan yihiin in jirrooyinka ay sababaan arrimo dabiici ah, sida bakteeriyada iyo fayrasyada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These pathogens are always present in our environment, and they can cause disease when they enter our bodies.
entries.translation: Jeermisyadan ayaa had iyo jeer ku jira deegaankeena, waxayna keeni karaan cudur marka ay galaan jirkeena.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Of course, the myth of the gods' curse is just one of many stories about the origin of sickness.
entries.translation: Dabcan, khuraafaadka inkaarka ilaahyada waa uun mid ka mid ah sheekooyin badan oo ku saabsan asalka cudurka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many other myths and legends that attempt to explain why we get sick.
entries.translation: Waxaa jira khuraafaadyo kale oo badan oo isku dayaya inay sharaxaan sababta aan u jirranno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I can't believe we're going to be learning how to cook Indian food today," said 10-year-old Priya excitedly.

entries.english: "It's delicious," said Priya "It's usually very flavorful, with a lot of spices. And there are so many different dishes to choose from."

entries.english: The assassination of Mohamed Bouazizi was a major turning point in the Tunisian Revolution.
entries.translation: Dilkii shirqoolka ahaa ee Mohamed Bouazizi wuxuu ahaa isbedel weyn oo ka dhacay Kacaankii Tunisia.

entries.english: Bouazizi was a 26-year-old street vendor who set himself on fire in December 2010 in protest of police harassment and corruption.
entries.translation: Bouazizi waxa uu ahaa 26-sano-jir wax ku iibiya wadooyinka waxa uu is gubay bishii December 2010 isaga oo ka mudaaharaadayay dhibaataynta iyo musuq maasuqa booliiska.

entries.english: His death sparked a wave of protests across Tunisia that eventually led to the overthrow of President Zine El Abidine Ben Ali.
entries.translation: Dhimashadiisa waxa ay dhalisay mudaaharaadyo ka dhacay guud ahaan dalka Tunisia kuwaas oo aakhirkii horseeday in xukunka laga tuuro madaxweynihii hore ee dalkaasi Zine El Abidine Ben Ali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Bouazizi's death was widely seen as a symbol of the Tunisian people's frustration with the government's economic policies and its authoritarian rule.
entries.translation: Geerida Bouazizi ayaa dad badan loo arkayay inay astaan ​​u tahay dadka Tuniisiya sida ay uga xun yihiin siyaasadda dhaqaale ee dowladda iyo xukunkeeda kali-taliska ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The protests that followed his death were met with violent repression by the government, but they ultimately succeeded in toppling Ben Ali.
entries.translation: Mudaaharaadyadii ka dambeeyay dhimashadiisa ayaa waxaa kala kulmay dowladda cadaadis xooggan, balse ugu dambeyntii waxay ku guuleysteen inay xukunka ka tuuraan Ben Ali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Tunisian Revolution was a major turning point in the Arab world.
entries.translation: Kacaankii Tunisia waxa uu ahaa isbedel weyn oo ka dhacay dunida Carabta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It inspired other uprisings in the region, and it led to the overthrow of several authoritarian regimes.
entries.translation: Waxay kicisay kacdoono kale oo ka dhacay gobolka, waxayna horseedday in la rido dhowr maamul oo kali-talis ahaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The revolution also had a significant impact on Tunisian society.
entries.translation: Kacaanka wuxuu kaloo saameyn weyn ku yeeshay bulshada Tunisia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It led to the adoption of a new constitution, and it ushered in a new era of democracy and freedom.
entries.translation: Waxa ay horseedday in la qaato dastuur cusub, waxana uu keenay waa cusub oo dimoqraadiyad iyo xorriyad ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Bouazizi's death is a reminder of the importance of human rights and the need for political change.
entries.translation: Dhimashada Bouazizi waxay xasuusinaysaa muhiimada xuquuqul insaanka iyo baahida loo qabo isbedel siyaasadeed.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: His sacrifice helped to bring about a more just and democratic Tunisia.
entries.translation: Naf-hurnimadiisa waxay gacan ka gaysatay inuu keeno Tunisia cadaalad iyo dimuqraadi ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Gift-giving is an important part of Chinese culture, and there are many different rules and customs to follow.
entries.translation: Haddiyadda-bixinta waa qayb muhiim ah oo ka mid ah dhaqanka Shiinaha, waxaana jira xeerar iyo caadooyin kala duwan oo la raaco.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Whenever you are invited to a Chinese person's home, it is customary to bring a gift.
entries.translation: Mar kasta oo lagugu martiqaado guriga qof Shiinees ah, waa caado inaad hadiyad u soo qaadato.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The type of gift you bring will depend on the occasion and the relationship you have with the host.
entries.translation: Nooca hadiyadda aad keento waxay ku xirnaan doontaa munaasabadda iyo xiriirka aad la leedahay martigeliyaha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, if you are attending a birthday party, you might bring a gift of flowers or fruit.
entries.translation: Tusaale ahaan, haddii aad ka qayb galayso xaflad dhalasho, waxaa laga yaabaa inaad keento hadiyad ubax ama miro ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are visiting a friend's home, you might bring a small gift, such as a bottle of wine or a box of chocolates.
entries.translation: Haddii aad booqanayso guriga saaxiibkaa, waxa aad soo qaadan kartaa hadiyad yar, sida dhalo khamri ah ama sanduuq shukulaatada ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is important to wrap the gift nicely and to present it with both hands.
entries.translation: Waa muhiim in hadiyadda si fiican loo duubo oo lagu dhiibo labada gacmood.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When you receive a gift, it is customary to open it immediately and to express your appreciation.
entries.translation: Marka aad hesho hadiyad, waxaa caado ah in aad isla markiiba furto oo aad muujiso mahadnaq.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You should also reciprocate by giving a gift of equal value whenever you are invited to someone's home.
entries.translation: Waa inaad sidoo kale u celisaa hadiyad qiimo la mid ah mar kasta oo lagugu martiqaado qof gurigiisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are unsure of what to give, you can always ask a friend or family member for advice.
entries.translation: Haddii aadan hubin waxa aad siinayso, waxaad had iyo jeer waydiisan kartaa saaxiib ama xubin qoyskaaga ah talo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The young woman held her hand out to the man, her eyes pleading.
entries.translation: Haweenaydii yareed ayaa gacanta u taagtay ninkii, iyadoo indhaheeda qiiraysan yihiin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Please," she said. "I need your help."
entries.translation: "Fadlan," ayay titi. "Caawintaada ayaan u baahanahay."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The man looked at her, his expression hard.
entries.translation: Ninkii ayaa fiiriyay iyada, isagoo dareenkiisu aad u adag yahay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I don't know what you're talking about," he said.
entries.translation: "Ma garanayo waxaad ka hadlayso," ayuu yiri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I'm from Toronto," she said. "I was kidnapped and brought here.
entries.translation: "Waxaan ka soo jeedaa Toronto," ayay tiri. "Waa la i soo afduubay oo halkan ayaa la i keenay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I need to get back home."
entries.translation: Waxaan u baahanay inaan guriga ku laabto."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The man shook his head. "Get out of here before I call the police."
entries.translation: Ninkii ayaa madaxa ruxay. "Halkan ka tag intaanan booliiska u wicin."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The woman's heart sank.
entries.translation: Haweenaydii qalbigeeda waa quustay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was so close, but it looked like she was going to be caught again.
entries.translation: Aad ayay ugu dhowayd, laakiin waxay u ekayd in mar kale la qaban doono.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She turned to run, but the man grabbed her arm. "I said get out of here!" he shouted.
entries.translation: Si ay u cararto ayay u jeesatay, laakiin ninkii baa gacanta ka qabtay. "Waxaan ku iri halkan ka tag!" ayuu ku qayliyey.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The woman struggled, but the man was too strong.
entries.translation: Haweenaydii way halgantay, laakiin ninka aad buu u xoog badnaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He pulled her close and slapped her across the face.
entries.translation: Intuu u soo dhawaaday ayuu wejiga kaga ka dharbaaxay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "You're not going anywhere," he said. "You're my property now." The woman cried out in pain and fear.
entries.translation: "Meelna uma socotid," ayuu yiri. "Hadda waxaad tahay hantidayda." Haweenaydii ayaa xanuun iyo baqdin darteed la qaylisay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She didn't know what to do.
entries.translation: Ma garanayn waxa ay samayso.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was trapped.
entries.translation: Waa la xayiray.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Action films have undergone a major transformation in recent years.
entries.translation: Ficilada filimaanta waxay so mareen isbadalo waa weyn sanadihi u danbeeyay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Gone are the days of simple, one-dimensional heroes and villains.
entries.translation: Waxaa meesha ka baxay maalmihii geesiyaasha fudfudud, hal-geesoodka ahaa iyo sharwadayaashii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Today's action films are more complex, with characters who undergo significant transformations over the course of the film.
entries.translation: Malmahan filimada ficilada waa kuwa baaxad weyn kuwaas oo dadka jilayo ay mareen isbadalo muhiim ah intu sodcay filimka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This transformation is often a reflection of the film's themes, which can range from the importance of family to the power of love.
entries.translation: Isbadalnaaan waxay ka sawir ka bixiyaan filimada muqaaladooda kaaso loo haagaajiyo laga so bilaabo muhimada ay qoyska ila awooda jecayl.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Several recent action films have featured this type of transformation.
entries.translation: Filimadi ficilka ee kala duwan ee u danbeyay waxa kaso muuqaday isbadaladaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the film "The Batman," for example, the title character goes from being a vengeful vigilante to a symbol of hope for the city of Gotham.
entries.translation: Filmka "Batman" tusaale ahaan ciwaanka jilaaga wuxuu ahaa laga bilaabo inuu sharciga gacmaha ku qaato ilaa uu ka noqdo hormuudka rajada ee casimada gotham.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In "Black Panther," T'Challa must learn to embrace his role as king of Wakanda, even though it means giving up some of his personal freedoms.
entries.translation: Filimka "Black Panther," T'Challa wa inuu bartaa inuu xajista si dareen leh shaqada boqornimo ee Wakanda inkastoo ay la micno tahay inuu bixiyo qaar ka mid ah xornimadisa gaarka ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And in "Captain Marvel," Carol Danvers must learn to control her powers and use them for good.
entries.translation: Iyo in "Captain Marvel," Carol Danvers waa inay barato inay maamusho awoodeeda oo ay u isticmaasho wanaag.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These films show that action films can be more than just mindless violence.
entries.translation: Filimantan waxay muujinayaan in filimada ficilka ay noqon karaan kuwa gacan ka hadal fikir laan ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can also be used to explore complex themes and characters.
entries.translation: Waxa sido kale loo isticmaaali kara inu lagu wax laga barto ayadoo la banan geynayo oo muqaalo baaxad leh jilayaal.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The debate of man vs. machine is a long-standing one, with no easy answer.
entries.translation: Dooda bini'aadamka iyo mashiinka waa mid soo jireen oo dheer ayadoo jawaab sahlan an lahayn.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: On the one hand, machines are becoming increasingly sophisticated and capable, and they are already performing many tasks that were once thought to be the exclusive domain of humans.
entries.translation: Dhinaca kale, mishiinada waxa ay noqonayaan kuwo casri ah oo awood leh, waxana ay durba qabanayaan hawlo badan oo markii hore loo malaynayay in ay yihiin kuwa u gaarka ah bini’aadamka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: On the other hand, humans have a unique set of skills and abilities that machines are unlikely to ever replicate, such as creativity, empathy, and intuition.
entries.translation: Dhanka kale, bini'aadamku waxay leeyihiin xirfado iyo karti u gaar ah oo mashiinadu aanay u badnayn inay weligood dib u soo celiyaan, sida hal-abuurka, dareenka, iyo garashada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the key areas where machines are rapidly outpacing humans is in the field of artificial intelligence (AI).
entries.translation: Mid ka mid ah meelaha ugu muhiimsan ee mashiinadu si degdeg ah uga dheereeyaan bini'aadamka waa dhinaca sirdoonka macmalka (AI).
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: AI is a branch of computer science that deals with the creation of intelligent agents, which are systems that can reason, learn, and act autonomously.
entries.translation: AI waa laan ka mid ah cilmiga kombuyuutarka oo ka shaqeeya abuurista wakiillo caqli-gal ah, kuwaas oo ah nidaamyo caqli-gal ah, baran kara, oo u dhaqmi kara si madaxbannaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: AI is already being used in a wide range of applications, from self-driving cars to medical diagnosis.
entries.translation: AI waxa horey logu isticmaalay qabab badan oo dhisid ablikeeshino laga so bilaabo gaariga is wadi karo ila baritaan cafimaad.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And as AI continues to develop, it is likely to become even more powerful and capable.
entries.translation: Iyo sida AI ay u sii wado horumarinta, waxay u badan tahay inay noqoto mid ka sii xoog badan oo karti leh.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, there are also a number of areas where humans are likely to retain a significant advantage over machines.
entries.translation: Si kastaba ha ahaatee, waxaa sidoo kale jira tiro meelo ah oo ay u badan tahay in bini'aadamku ay faa'iido weyn ka helaan mishiinnada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, humans are much better at dealing with ambiguity and uncertainty.
entries.translation: Tusaale ahaan bini'aadamka waxay ku fiican yihiin inay la tacaalaan waxyaalaha mugga wayn iyo waxyaalaha an macquulka ahyan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We can also draw on our experience and intuition to make decisions in complex situations.
entries.translation: Waxaan sidoo kale ku feegaari karnaa qibradeena iyo fahankena ayadoo fikir u bahnayn si loo gaaro go'aan xaalad isku dhex qasan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And finally, humans have a unique capacity for creativity and innovation.
entries.translation: Ugu dambayntiina, aadamuhu waxa ay leeyihiin awood gaar ah oo ay u leeyihiin hal-abuur iyo hal-abuurnimo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Two men, one in his 30s and one in his 50s, are sitting at the bar, drinking.
entries.translation: Labo nin oo mid 30-yo jir yahay kan kalana 50-yo waxay fadhiyaan baar, waxna cabaya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Young Man: So, I heard that the new head of the liquor board is really cracking down on local stores.
entries.translation: Ninka yarka: sidaas waxan maqlay madaxa cusub ee madaxa qamriga ka shekeynayay sheeko deganeed.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Old Man: Yeah, I heard that too. They're saying that he's going to be doing random inspections of bars and restaurants to make sure that they're not selling liquor to minors.
entries.translation: Ninka Wayn: Haa, waan maqlay sidoo kale waxay leeeyihin wuxuu socdaa inuu soo kor meero ama uu ogaaado baararka iyo maqayadaha si uu u hubiyo inay sun ka iibinayaan qamriga dadka yar yar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Young Man: That's a good thing.
entries.translation: Ninka Yar: Taas waa shay fiican.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I mean, it's not fair to the responsible businesses that are following the rules when some other places are just selling liquor to anyone who walks in the door.
entries.translation: Waxaan ula jedaa wa cadalad ma ah inay ganacsiyada masuulka inay raacan sharciyada halka meelaha kale ay qamriga ka gadayan qof walbo oo alababkoda so maro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Old Man: I agree. But I'm also worried about how it's going to affect my business.
entries.translation: Ninka da'da ah: Waa kugu racay. Laakin waxan sido kale ka walal sanahay sida ay u sameyn doonto ganacsigayga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I mean, I'm a good guy. I don't sell liquor to minors.
entries.translation: Waxan ka wada waxan ahay nin ficaan kama gado qamriga dadka yar yar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But I'm also not going to let some government bureaucrat tell me who I can and can't sell liquor to.
entries.translation: Laakiin aniga uma socdo inan dadka dawlada u qabilsan qabka sharciyada inan usheego qofka awood inu gado iyo qof an awoodin inusan gadi karin qamriga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Young Man: I get what you're saying. But you have to be careful.
entries.translation: Ninka Yar: Waan gartay waxad leedahay laakiin wa inad taxdartaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Family planning in India has been a topic of debate for many years.
entries.translation: Qorshaynta qoyska ee Hindiya waxay ahayd mawduuc doodeed sannado badan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1976, the Indian government passed the controversial National Emergency Act, which imposed a forced sterilization program on men and women.
entries.translation: Sannadkii 1976-kii, dawladda Hindiya waxa ay ansixisay sharciga xaaladda degdegga ah ee qaranka ee muranka dhaliyay, kaas oo ku soo rogay barnaamijka jeermiska qasabka ah ragga iyo dumarka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This program was met with widespread resistance and eventually overturned by the Indian Supreme Court.
entries.translation: Barnaamijkan waxaa la kulmay iska caabin baahsan waxaana ugu dambeyntii meesha ka saartay maxkamadda sare ee Hindiya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In recent years, the Indian government has taken a more progressive approach to family planning.
entries.translation: Sanadihii la soo dhaafay, dawladda Hindiya waxay qaaday hab horumar leh oo ku aaddan qorsheynta qoyska.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 2010, the government launched the National Family Planning Program, which provides free contraception and sterilization services to all Indian citizens.
entries.translation: Sannadkii 2010-kii, dawladdu waxay bilawday Barnaamijka Qorshaynta Qoyska ee Qaranka, kaas oo bixiya adeegyo ka-hortagga uur-qaadida iyo jeermiska bilaashka ah dhammaan muwaadiniinta Hindiya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The program has been successful in reducing the fertility rate in India, but it still faces challenges, such as a lack of awareness and access to services.
entries.translation: Barnaamijka waxa uu ku guulaystay in uu hoos u dhigo heerka bacriminta ee Hindiya, laakiin waxa uu weli wajahayaa caqabado, sida wacyigelin la'aan iyo helitaanka adeegyada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most important challenges to family planning in India is the lack of awareness about the benefits of family planning.
entries.translation: Mid ka mid ah caqabadaha ugu muhiimsan ee qorsheynta qoyska Hindiya waa ka warqab la'aanta ku saabsan faa'iidooyinka qorsheynta qoyska.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Many Indian couples believe that it is their duty to have as many children as possible.
entries.translation: Lammaanayaal badan oo Hindi ah ayaa aaminsan inay waajib ku tahay inay dhalaan carruur badan intii suurtagal ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This belief is often reinforced by cultural and religious norms.
entries.translation: Caqiidadan waxaa badanaa lagu xoojiyaa caadooyinka dhaqanka iyo diinta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another challenge to family planning is the lack of access to services.
entries.translation: Caqabadda kale ee ku wajahan qorsheynta qoyska waa helitaan la'aanta adeegyada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In rural areas, there are often few or no family planning clinics.
entries.translation: Meelaha miyiga ah, inta badan waxaa jira kilinigyada qorsheynta qoyska oo yar ama ma jiraan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This makes it difficult for couples to access the services they need.
entries.translation: Tani waxay adkeynaysaa lammaanaha inay helaan adeegyada ay u baahan yihiin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Despite these challenges, the Indian government is committed to providing family planning services to all its citizens.
entries.translation: Iyadoo ay jiraan caqabadahaas, dowladda Hindiya waxaa ka go'an inay siiso dhammaan muwaadiniinteeda adeegyada qorsheynta qoyska.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Science is a systematic enterprise that builds and organizes knowledge in the form of testable explanations and predictions about the natural world.
entries.translation: Saynisku waa shirkad nidaamsan oo dhista oo abaabusha aqoonta qaab sharraxaad iyo saadaal la tijaabin karo oo ku saabsan dunida dabiiciga ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In its broadest sense, science encompasses all human knowledge and activity motivated by a desire to understand the natural world and its phenomena.
entries.translation: Macnihiisa ugu ballaadhan, saynisku waxa uu koobayaa dhammaan aqoonta bini'aadamka iyo waxqabadka ay dhiirigelisay rabitaanka ah in la fahmo dunida dabiiciga ah iyo ifafaaleheeda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Science is also often seen as a particular body of knowledge derived from such investigation, as well as a method of discovery.
entries.translation: Sayniska ayaa sidoo kale inta badan loo arkaa inuu yahay cilmi gaar ah oo ka soo jeeda baaritaankan, iyo sidoo kale habka daahfurka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The earliest roots of science can be traced to Ancient Greek philosophy, particularly the works of Aristotle, who attempted to explain natural phenomena through observation and reason.
entries.translation: Xididdada ugu horreeya ee sayniska waxaa laga heli karaa falsafada Giriiggii hore, gaar ahaan shuqulladii Aristotle, kaas oo isku dayay in uu sharaxo dhacdooyinka dabiiciga ah iyada oo la eegayo iyo sabab.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Over the centuries, science has developed into a more rigorous discipline, with the development of the scientific method, which emphasizes evidence, hypothesis testing, and repeatability.
entries.translation: Qarniyo badan, saynisku wuxuu u horumaray edbin aad u adag, iyadoo la sameeyay habka sayniska, kaas oo xoogga saaraya caddaynta, tijaabinta mala-awaalka, iyo dib-u-celinta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Science has had a profound impact on human society, leading to the development of new technologies, medicines, and understanding of the natural world.
entries.translation: Saynisku wuxuu saameyn weyn ku yeeshay bulshada aadanaha, taasoo keentay horumarinta tignoolajiyada cusub, daawooyinka, iyo fahamka adduunka dabiiciga ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It has also played a role in shaping social and political thought.
entries.translation: Waxa kale oo ay door ka qaadatay qaabaynta fikirka bulshada iyo siyaasadda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Today, science is a major part of modern life, and it continues to play an important role in the advancement of knowledge and understanding.
entries.translation: Maanta, cilmigu waa qayb weyn oo ka mid ah nolosha casriga ah, wuxuuna sii wadaa inuu door muhiim ah ka ciyaaro horumarinta aqoonta iyo fahamka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: I'm so behind on my work!
entries.translation: A: Waxaan aad u dambeeyaa shaqadayda!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I have a paper due tomorrow, and I haven't even started it.
entries.translation: Waxaan haystaa warqad berri ku eg, xitaa ma bilaabin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: B: Oh no! What are you going to do?
entries.translation: B: Allaa maya! Maxaad samaynayn doontaa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: I don't know.
entries.translation: A: Ma garanayo.

entries.english: I guess I'll just have to stay up all night and finish it.
entries.translation: Waxaan u maleynayaa inay tahay kaliya inaan soo jeedo habeenkii oo dhan oo aan dhammeeyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: B: That sounds like a terrible idea.
entries.translation: B: Taasi waxay u egtahay fikrad qariban.

entries.english: You'll just end up being more tired and stressed, and you won't do your best work.
entries.translation: Kaliya waxaad ku dambeyn doontaa inaad daal badan iyo culeysato dareento, mana sameyn doontid shaqadaada ugu fiican.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: I know, but I don't have any other choice.

entries.english: B: There is always another choice.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You could start working on it now, and take breaks throughout the day.
entries.translation: Waxaad bilaabi kartaa inaad hadda ka shaqeyso, oo aad fasax qaadan kartaa maalinta oo dhan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Or, you could ask for an extension from your professor.

entries.english: I've already asked for one this semester, and I don't want to seem like I'm not taking my classes seriously.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The flapper era is in full swing, and young women are enjoying their newfound freedom.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are dressing in short skirts and bobbed hair, smoking cigarettes, and drinking cocktails.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are also dating more freely than ever before.
entries.translation: Xilligii baallaha ayaa si xawli ah ku socda, dumarka da'da yarna waxay ku raaxeeyeen kooddooda cusub.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One such flapper is named Josephine.

entries.english: She is not interested in finding a husband, but she does enjoy the attention of men.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, Josephine is at a party when she meets a young man named Jack.
entries.translation: Maalin maalmaha ka mid ah, Josephine waxay joogtay xaflad markay la kulantay nin dhallinyaro ah oo la yiraahdo Jack.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Jack is everything that Josephine is not.

entries.english: He is conservative, polite, and serious.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But there is something about him that Josephine finds attractive.

entries.english: Egypt faces a number of challenges, including:
entries.translation: Masar waxa ay wajaheysaa caqabado dhowr ah oo ay ka mid yihiin:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * A rapidly growing population. Egypt's population is expected to grow from 100 million today to 140 million by 2050.
entries.translation: Koritanka tirada dadka wakhti yar oo koban. Tiradad dadka ee Masar waxaa la rajeynaya inay kor oga kacdo 100 miliyan hada ila 140 milyan sanadka marku noqdo 2050-ka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This will put a strain on the country's resources, including its food supply, water supply, and infrastructure.
entries.translation: Tani waxay cadadis sareysa qayrad wadanka waxan ka mid ah sahayda cuntada, sahayda biyaha iyo kabayasha dhaqalaha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * A widening gap between the rich and the poor. Egypt has a high Gini coefficient, which measures inequality.
entries.translation: Si waynanta farqiga u dhaxeeyo masakinta iyo tajirinta Egypt waxay leedahay isku dhafnan lanta daqli tas oo qiyasayso sinan laa'anta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This means that the wealth is concentrated in the hands of a few, while the majority of the population lives in poverty.
entries.translation: Tani waxay la micno tahatay in hantida ay iskugu ururidoonto dad koban in ugu badana tirada dadkan ay ku nooladan saboolnimo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * High unemployment. Egypt's unemployment rate is around 12%.
entries.translation: Sareenta shaqa laanta. Heerka shaqa laanta Masar waa 12% khiyaas ahaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is especially high among young people.
entries.translation: Tani waxay ku badan tahay dahalinyarada dhexdooda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * A lack of economic opportunity. Egypt's economy is heavily reliant on tourism and agriculture.
entries.translation: * Fursad dhaqaale oo maqan. Dhaqaalaha Masar ayaa si weyn ugu tiirsan dalxiiska iyo beeraha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These sectors are vulnerable to external shocks, such as the global financial crisis and the Arab Spring.
entries.translation: Waaxyahaasi waxay u nugul yihiin jahawareerka dibadda, sida xiisadda dhaqaale ee adduunka iyo kacdoonka Carabta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This instability has made it difficult for the government to implement reforms and improve the economy.
entries.translation: Xasilooni la'aantan ayaa keentay in dowladdu ay ku adkeyso in ay hirgeliso dib u habeyn iyo horumarinta dhaqaalaha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Vehicle repair and maintenance is essential for keeping your car in good condition and preventing costly repairs down the road.
entries.translation: Dayactirka iyo dayac-tirka baabuurka ayaa lama huraan u ah in gaarigaaga xaaladiisu wanaagsanaato loogana hortago dayactirka qaaliga ah ee wadada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are a number of things you can do to maintain your vehicle, such as changing the oil and filters regularly, checking the tire pressure, and keeping the fluids topped up.
entries.translation: Waxa jira dhawr waxyaalood oo aad samayn karto si aad u ilaaliso gaadhigaaga, sida in aad si joogto ah u beddesho saliidda iyo shaandhada, hubinta cadaadiska taayirka, iyo ilaalinta dareerayaasha kor u kaca.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you're not comfortable doing these things yourself, you can take your car to a qualified mechanic.
entries.translation: Haddii aadan adigu ku qanacsanayn inaad waxyaalahan samayso, waxaad gaari kartaa makaanik aqoon leh.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When it comes to vehicle repair, there are a number of different paths you can take.
entries.translation: Marka ay timaado dayactirka baabuurta, waxaa jira dhowr waddo oo kala duwan oo aad mari karto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can go to a dealership, an independent repair shop, or a chain repair shop.
entries.translation: Waxaad aadi kartaa dukaanka iibiya, dukaanka dayactirka madax banaan, ama dukaanka dayactirka silsiladaha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Each type of shop has its own advantages and disadvantages.
entries.translation: Dukaan kasta wuxuu leeyahay faa'iidooyin iyo khasaare u gaar ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dealerships typically have the most experience working on specific makes and models of cars, but they can also be more expensive than other options.
entries.translation: Ganacsiyada sida caadiga ah waxay leeyihiin khibradda ugu badan ee ka shaqaynta samaynta gaarka ah iyo moodooyinka baabuurta, laakiin sidoo kale way ka qaalisan karaan fursadaha kale.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Independent repair shops are often less expensive than dealerships, but they may not have the same level of expertise.
entries.translation: Dayactirayasha madax banan ee baabuurta marar wa kuwo ana qaali aheyn marka loo firo kuwa baabuurta kala gado ama ibsada laakin waxay lahayn heer qibradeed.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Chain repair shops typically offer a middle ground between dealerships and independent repair shops, with competitive prices and a variety of services.
entries.translation: Dukaamada dayactirka silsiladdu waxay caadi ahaan bixiyaan meel dhexe oo u dhaxaysa iibiyeyaasha iyo dukaamada dayactirka ee madax-bannaan, oo leh qiimo tartan iyo adeegyo kala duwan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: No matter which path you choose, it's important to find a reputable shop that you can trust.
entries.translation: Si kasta oo aad doorato, waa muhiim inaad hesho dukaan sumcad leh oo aad ku kalsoonaan karto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can do this by asking for recommendations from friends or family, or by doing some online research.
entries.translation: Waxa aad tan samayn kartaa adiga oo waydiiso talooyinka asxaabta ama qoyska, ama samaynta cilmi-baadhis online ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: [A group of people are gathered in a large room. They are all wearing white robes and have their heads bowed.]
entries.translation: [Koox dad ah ayaa qol weyn lagu soo ururiyey. Dhammaantood waxay xidheen khamiisyo cadcad, madaxana way foorarsadeen.]
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: [A man in a black robe walks up to the front of the room.]
entries.translation: [Nin maro madoow xidhan ayaa soo kacaya xagga hore ee qolka.]
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Man: "We are gathered here today to exercise our right to free speech.
entries.translation: Ninkii: "Waxaan maanta halkan isugu nimid si aan uga faa’ideyno xaqa aan u leenahay xorriyatul-qawlka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We are here to protest the injustice that is being done to our people.
entries.translation: Waxaan u nimid inaan ka dhiidhinno cadaalad darada lagu hayo dadkeena.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We are here to demand that our voices be heard.
entries.translation: Waxaan halkan u joognaa in aan dalbanno in codkeenna la maqlo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: [The people raise their heads and look at the man.]
entries.translation: [Dadkii madaxa kor u qaaday oo ninkii eegay.]
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Man: "We are not here to cause violence.
entries.translation: Ninki: "Uma nimaan halkaam inaan rabshado abuurno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We are not here to destroy property.
entries.translation: Halkaan uma joogno inan hanti burburino.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We are here to exercise our right to be heard.
entries.translation: Waxaan halkaan u joognaa inaan ku shaqeyno xaqa aan u leenahay in nala maqlo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: [The people begin to chant, "We want to be heard! We want to be heard!"]
entries.translation: [Dadku waxay bilaabeen inay ku dhawaaqayaan, "Waxaan rabnaa in nala maqlo, waxaan rabnaa in nala maqlo!"]
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Man: "We will not be silenced! We will not be ignored! We will not be denied our rights!
entries.translation: Ninki: "Nala aamusi maayo, nala dayn maayo, xaqeena nalama duudsiinaayo!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: [The people continue to chant.]
entries.translation: [Dadku waxay sii wadaan inay qayliyaan.]
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Man: "We are the people! We are the future! We will not give up!
entries.translation: Ninki: "Anaga waxaa nahay dadka! Waxaan nahay mustaqbal! ma quusan doono!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The museum was a treasure trove of history, artifacts, and stories.
entries.translation: Matxafka waxa uu ahaa meel qaali ah oo lagu kaydiyo taariikhda, agabka iyo sheekooyinka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: From the ancient Egyptian mummies to the modern-day paintings, there was something for everyone to enjoy.
entries.translation: Laga soo bilaabo mummiiyadii hore ee Masaarida ilaa sawirada casriga ah, waxaa jiray wax qof kastaa ku raaxaysto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most interesting exhibits was the collection of old toys.
entries.translation: Mid ka mid ah bandhigyada ugu xiisaha badan ayaa ahaa ururinta alaabtii hore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There were dolls from the Victorian era, toy soldiers from the Civil War, and even a set of wooden blocks from the early 1900s.
entries.translation: Waxaa jiray caruusadaha laga soo bilaabo xilligii Fiktooriya, boombala askar tah oo ka timid Dagaalkii Sokeeye, iyo xitaa qaybo alwaax ah oo laga soo bilaabo horraantii 1900-yadii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Each toy had its own story to tell, and it was fascinating to see how they had changed over time.
entries.translation: Boombala kastaa waxa uu lahaa sheeko u gaar ah oo uu uga sheekeeyo, waxa ay ahayd mid aad u xiiso badan in la arko sida ay isu beddeleen muddo ka dib.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the toys that caught my eye was a small wooden car.
entries.translation: Mid ka mid ah alaabta ay ishayda qabatay waxa ka mid ahaa baabuur yar oo alwaax ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was made in the 1950s, and it was in perfect condition.
entries.translation: Waxaa la sameeyay 1950-yadii, waxayna ahayd xaalad qumman.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The paint was still bright, and the wheels were still smooth.
entries.translation: Rinjiga weli wuu dhalaalayay, giraangirahana weli way siman yihiin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I picked it up and examined it closely.
entries.translation: Waan soo qaaday waxaana u baaray si fiican.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a simple toy, but it was also very well-made.
entries.translation: Waxay ahayd boombile fudud, laakiin sidoo kale aad ayaa loo hagaajiyay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I wondered who had played with this car all those years ago.
entries.translation: Waxaan la yaabay yaa ku ciyaarayay gaarigan sannadahaas oo dhan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: What were their dreams and aspirations?
entries.translation: Maxay ahaayeen riyooyinkoodii iyo hammigoodii?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: What did they think the future held?
entries.translation: Maxay u maleeyeen in mustaqbalka la qaban doono?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I put the car back in its display case and continued on my way.
entries.translation: Baabuurkii ayaan ku celiyay kiiskiisii ​​bandhiga oo aan sii socday.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As I walked through the museum, I thought about all the things that had changed in the world since these toys were made.
entries.translation: Markii aan dhex socday madxafka, waxaan ka fikiray dhammaan waxyaalihii iska beddelay adduunka tan iyo markii la sameeyay alaabtan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Islam is a religion that emphasizes surrender to the will of God.
entries.translation: Islaamku waa diin xoogga saaraysa in la isu dhiibo doonista Eebbe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This concept of surrender, or "Islam" in Arabic, is often misunderstood as meaning submission or defeat.
entries.translation: Fikradan is-dhiibida, ama "Islaamka" ee Carabiga, ayaa inta badan loo fahamsan yahay inay la macno tahay hoos-u-dhigga ama guul-darrada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, in Islam, surrender is actually seen as a positive act, a way to achieve peace and happiness.
entries.translation: Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Islaamka, dhiibista dhab ahaantii waxaa loo arkaa fal togan, hab lagu gaaro nabad iyo farxad.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When a Muslim surrenders to God, they are not giving up their own free will.
entries.translation: Qofka muslimka ahi markuu Ilaahay isu dhiibo, kama tanaasulaan rabitaankooda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rather, they are acknowledging that God is the one who has the power to control all things, and that by surrendering to His will, they are actually finding true freedom.
entries.translation: Hase yeeshe, waxay qirayaan in Illaah yahay kan awoodda u leh inuu wax walba xukumo, iyo in ay isu dhiibaan doonistiisa, ay dhab ahaantii helayaan xorriyad dhab ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This concept of surrender is beautifully illustrated in the story of the Prophet Muhammad.
entries.translation: Fikraddan is-dhiibida ayaa si qurux badan loogu sharraxay qisada Nebi Muxammad.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When Muhammad was first called to be a prophet, he was very afraid.
entries.translation: Markii ugu horreysay ee Muxammad loogu yeedhay inuu nebi noqdo, aad buu u cabsaday.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He didn't want to be responsible for spreading God's message.
entries.translation: Isagu ma uu doonayn in uu masuul ka noqdo faafinta farriinta Eebbe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, after much prayer and reflection, Muhammad eventually surrendered to God's will.
entries.translation: Si kastaba ha ahaatee, duco iyo fikir badan ka dib, Muxammad aakhirkii wuxuu isu dhiibay doonista Ilaah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He realized that it was not his own strength that would allow him to succeed, but the strength of God.
entries.translation: Waxa uu gartay in aanay ahayn tabar isaga u saamaxaysa in uu guulaysto, balse ay tahay xoogga Alle.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Muhammad's story is a reminder that surrender is not about giving up.
entries.translation: Sheekada Muxammad waxa ay xasuusin u tahay in is-dhiibidda aysan ahayn in la quusto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I grew up in a small village in the middle of nowhere.
entries.translation: Waxaan kusoo koray tuulo yar oo meel dhaxo ku taalo oo waxana uu dhaweyn.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There were only a few hundred people living there, and everyone knew everyone else.
entries.translation: Halkaas waxaa ku noolaa dhawr boqol oo qof, qof walbana wuu yaqaanay dadka kale.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We had a small school, a general store, and a post office.
entries.translation: Waxaan lahayn dugsi yar, dukaan guud, iyo xafiiska boostada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The pace of life was slow and relaxed, and there was always time to stop and chat with a neighbor.
entries.translation: Xawliga noloshu waxa uu ahaa mid gaabis ah oo nasasho leh, waxaana mar walba jiray wakhti aad ku joogsan lahayd oo aad la sheekaysan lahayd deriska.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When I was 18, I moved to the city to go to college.
entries.translation: Markii aan 18 jirsaday, waxaan u soo guuray magaalada si aan u galo kulliyad.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: At first, I was overwhelmed by the noise, the traffic, and the crowds.
entries.translation: Markii hore, waxa i camiray sawaxankii, sawaxankii, isu socodkii iyo dadkii badnaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It took me a while to adjust to city life, but eventually I came to love it.
entries.translation: Waqti ayay igu qaadatay inaan la qabsado nolosha magaalada, laakiin ugu dambeyntii waan jeclaaday.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I found that there were endless opportunities in the city, and I made some lifelong friends.
entries.translation: Waxaan ogaaday in magaalada ay ka jiraan fursado aan dhammaad lahayn, waxaanan yeeshay saaxiibo nolosha oo dhan ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After college, I got a job in the city and stayed there for a few years.
entries.translation: Kuliyadda ka dib, waxaan shaqo ka helay magaalada oo aan joogay dhawr sano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But eventually, I started to miss the slower pace of life in the village.
entries.translation: Laakin ugu dambayntii, waxa aan bilaabay in aan seego xawaaraha nolosha ee tuulada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I wanted to be able to raise a family in a place where I knew everyone and everyone knew me.
entries.translation: Waxaan rabay inaan qoys ku korin karo meel aan cid walba aqaano qof walbana wuu i yaqaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So a few years ago, I moved back to the village where I grew up.
entries.translation: Haddaba dhawr sano ka hor, waxaan dib ugu soo laabtay tuuladii aan ku soo koray.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was like coming home.
entries.translation: Waxay ahayd anigoo imid gurigeeni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm now raising my family in the same small house where I grew up, and I'm so happy to be back.
entries.translation: Hadda waxaan qoyskeyga ku korinayaa isla guri yar oo aan ku soo koray, aad ayaan ugu faraxsanahay inaan soo laabto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In a time long past, there lived a blind beggar who made his living by demonstrating the art of soil sculpting.
entries.translation: Waa hore, waxaa noolaa tuug indhoole ah oo nolol maalmeedkiisa ka soo saara isagoo muujinaya farsamada carrada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He would sit on the street corner, surrounded by his tools and materials, and invite passersby to watch him work.
entries.translation: Waxa uu fadhiisan jiray waddada geeskeeda, isaga oo ay ku hareeraysan yihiin agabkiisa iyo agabkiisa, waxa uu ku casuumi jiray dadka jidka maraya si ay u daawadaan isaga oo shaqaynaya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: With his deft fingers, he would mold the soil into intricate shapes, creating animals, plants, and even entire landscapes.
entries.translation: Farihiisa qalloocan, wuxuu ciidda u samayn lahaa qaabab qalafsan, isaga oo abuuraya xayawaan, dhir, iyo xitaa muuqaallo dhan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: His work was so beautiful that it was said to bring tears to the eyes of even the most hardened cynic.
entries.translation: Shaqadiisu waxay ahayd mid aad u qurux badan oo la sheegay inay ilmada ka ilmeeyaan xitaa kuwa ugu qallafsan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, a young woman named Amara was walking through the market when she saw the blind beggar.
entries.translation: Maalin maalmaha ka mid ah ayaa gabadh la odhan jiray Camaara oo suuqa dhex maraysay ayaa waxa ay aragtay ninkii tuugsiga ahaa ee indho la’aa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was immediately captivated by his work, and she stopped to watch him for a long time.
entries.translation: Isla markiiba waxay la dhacsan tahay shaqadiisa, waxayna u istaagtay inay daawato isaga muddo dheer.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When he was finished, she approached him and asked if she could learn how to sculpt soil.
entries.translation: Markii uu dhameeyay ayay u soo dhawaatay oo waydiisay bal inay baran karto sida carrada loo sawiro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The beggar smiled and told her that he would be happy to teach her.
entries.translation: Tuugsadihii intuu dhoola caddeeyey ayuu u sheegay inuu ku farxi doono inuu wax baro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Amara spent the next few weeks learning from the beggar.
entries.translation: Camaara waxa uu dhawrkii todobaad ee soo socday wax ka baranayay tuugsadaha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He taught her the basics of soil sculpting, and he showed her how to create different shapes and textures.
entries.translation: Waxuu baray aasaaska carrada farshaxanimada, wuxuuna tusay sida loo sameeyo qaabab iyo muuqaalo kala duwan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Amara was a quick learner, and she soon became very skilled at the art.
entries.translation: Camaara waxa ay ahayd qof degdeg wax fahma, waxa ay markiiba noqotay mid aad ugu xeel dheer farshaxanka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, the beggar told Amara that it was time for her to demonstrate her skills.
entries.translation: Maalin maalmaha ka mid ah, ayaa tuugsadihii u sheegay Camaara in la gaaray xilligii ay xirfaddeeda muujin lahayd.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Vigilante justice is a term used to describe the act of taking the law into one's own hands, typically by meting out punishment to those who have been deemed to have committed crimes.
entries.translation: Cadaalada feejigan waa erey loo isticmaalo in lagu qeexo falka sharciga gacmihiisa ku qaatay, sida caadiga ah ciqaabta lagu fuliyo kuwa loo arko inay dambi galeen.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: While vigilante justice may seem like a quick and easy way to get justice, it can often lead to more problems than it solves.
entries.translation: Iyadoo cadaalada feejigan ay u ekaan karto hab degdeg ah oo fudud oo cadaalad lagu heli karo, waxay inta badan u horseedi kartaa dhibaatooyin ka badan inta ay xalinayso.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the biggest problems with vigilante justice is that it is typically not done in a fair and impartial manner.
entries.translation: Mid ka mid ah dhibaatooyinka ugu waaweyn ee caddaaladda feejignaanta ayaa ah in aan sida caadiga ah loo samayn si caddaalad ah oo dhexdhexaad ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Vigilantes are often motivated by anger and emotion, which can lead them to make rash decisions and take actions that are not in the best interests of everyone involved.
entries.translation: Feejignaanta inta badan waxaa sababa caro iyo shucuur, taas oo u horseedi karta inay qaataan go'aano degdeg ah oo ay qaadaan tallaabooyin aan dani ugu jirin qof kasta oo ku lug leh.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Additionally, vigilantes often lack the training and experience necessary to properly handle criminals.
entries.translation: Intaa waxaa dheer, feejignaantu waxay inta badan ka maqan yihiin tababbarka iyo waayo-aragnimada lagama maarmaanka u ah si ay si habboon ugu qabtaan dembiilayaasha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can lead to situations where innocent people are harmed or even killed.
entries.translation: Tani waxay horseedi kartaa xaalado ay dad aan waxba galabsan la waxyeeleeyo ama xitaa la dilo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another problem with vigilante justice is that it can quickly spiral out of control.
entries.translation: Dhibaato kale oo leh cadaalada feejignaanta ayaa ah inay si dhakhso ah uga gudbi karto xakamaynta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When one person takes the law into their own hands, it sends a message to others that they can do the same.
entries.translation: Marka hal qof uu sharciga gacmihiisa ku qaato, waxay u dirtaa fariin dadka kale inay sidaas oo kale samayn karaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can lead to a cycle of violence and retribution that can be difficult to stop.
entries.translation: Tani waxay keeni kartaa rabshado isdaba joog ah iyo ciqaab ay adagtahay in la joojiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the long run, vigilante justice is rarely effective in deterring crime.
entries.translation: Mustaqbalka fog, cadaalada feejignaanta waa dhif wax ku ool ah joojinta dembiyada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In fact, it can often have the opposite effect, making criminals more likely to commit crimes in the future.
entries.translation: Dhab ahaantii, waxay inta badan yeelan kartaa saameyn liddi ku ah, taasoo ka dhigaysa dembiilayaasha inay u badan tahay inay dembi galaan mustaqbalka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Son, did you know that there's a new array of craters on the moon?
entries.translation: Wiilka, ma ogtahay in ay jiraan falaaro jeexjeexyo cusub oo dayaxa dul saaran?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Scientists say that they were formed by a series of impacts from asteroids and comets.
entries.translation: Saynis yahanadu waxa ay sheegeen in ay ku abuurmeen saameyno isdaba joog ah oo ka yimid baraf iyo caro qoraxda u dhow.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The largest crater is about 100 miles across and is named after the Greek god of war, Ares.
entries.translation: Godka ugu weyn ayaa qiyaastii 100 mayl u jira waxaana loogu magac daray ilaaha Giriigga ee dagaalka, Ares.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The craters are so bright that they can be seen from Earth with the naked eye.
entries.translation: Godadku aad bay u iftiimeen oo indhaha furan ayaa Dhulka laga arki karaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They stand out against the dark surface of the moon like silver coins on a black velvet cloth.
entries.translation: Waxay u taagan yihiin meel gudcur ah oo dayaxa sida qadaadiic lacag ah oo ku taal maro madaw.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Water is essential for life.
entries.translation: Bixiyaha wa shay an laga marmi kara nolasha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It makes up over 60% of our body weight and is involved in many important bodily functions, such as regulating body temperature, transporting nutrients and oxygen to cells, and removing waste products.
entries.translation: Waxay ka kooban tahay ila 60% misaanka jirkeena taaso la hawl gasho oo shaqo muhim ah qabto sida inay maamusho heerkulka jirkena, safarinta nafaqada iyo neefata oo ay unugyada u geyso iyo kasarida wasaqda jirka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Water also helps to lubricate joints and protect organs and tissues.
entries.translation: Biyaha waxay sacidaysa xagalaha waxay difacdaa xubanaha iyo waxayaha ay jirka sameyaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many reasons why we should conserve water.
entries.translation: Waxa jiro siyaabo badan ay tahay inan biyaha ilaalino oo an dayacin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One reason is that water scarcity is a growing problem around the world.
entries.translation: Hal sabab biyaha la'anta ama biyaha ay si la si yaranay wa dhibka si korayo aduunka dhan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In many parts of the world, people do not have access to clean water, and even in areas where water is plentiful, it is becoming increasingly scarce due to climate change.
entries.translation: Meelo badan aduunka ka mid ah dadka uma haysan fasaxa inay biyaha nadiifsan iyo meelaha ay biyaha ku badan waxay noqdeen inay kor dhaan laanta is badal cimilida.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another reason to conserve water is that it is a valuable resource.
entries.translation: Sababta kale oo biyaha lagu ilaalin karo wa inay biyaha qiimo leeyihiin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It takes a lot of energy to treat and transport water, and it is important to use water wisely so that we do not waste this precious resource.
entries.translation: Waxay qadata tamar inay ka ku ilaaliyaan safarinta biyaha ii loo istcicmaalo si caqliyeeysan si aan loo dhumin dhaqaligaan qaaliga ah.
