entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many things we can do to conserve water.
entries.translation: Waxa jiro siyaabo badan oo an biyaha ku ilaalin karno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We can take shorter showers, fix leaky faucets, and water our lawns less often.
entries.translation: Waxan qadan karna inan yareyno qabeeska, hagajinta firshka haleysan iyo qaybinta biyaha ama ii qaybinta biyaha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We can also choose to buy products that are made with recycled water.
entries.translation: Waxaan sido kale dorana inan gadano alabta kuwaaso laga sameyo in biyaha dib loo isticmaalo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By making small changes in our daily lives, we can help to conserve water and ensure that this vital resource is available for future generations.
entries.translation: Sameynat isbadalo yar yar ee nolasheena malmeedka waxan ku cawin karna ilalinta biyaha oo xaqijinayno hilitaank daqligaan helitankisa mutaqalka qoomiyaadaha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Floods are a natural disaster that can cause widespread damage and loss of life.
entries.translation: Daadadku waa masiibo dabiici ah oo sababi karta khasaare baahsan iyo khasaare nafeed.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are often caused by heavy rainfall or snowmelt that exceeds the capacity of a river or other waterway, resulting in the overflow of water onto land.
entries.translation: Inta badan waxaa sababa roobab culus ama baraf dhalaalaya oo ka sarreeya awoodda webiga ama marin-biyoodka kale, taasoo keenta in biyuhu ay ku soo qulqulaan dhulka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Floods can also be caused by dams or levees breaking, or by tsunamis.
entries.translation: Daadadku waxa kale oo ay sababi karaan biyo-xireenno ama biyo-xireenno jaban, ama sunaamiyada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The most common types of floods are river floods, which occur when a river overflows its banks, and flash floods, which occur when a large amount of rain falls in a short period of time.
entries.translation: Noocyada ugu badan ee fatahaadaha ayaa ah fatahaadda webiga oo ka dhasha marka uu wabigu qariyo, iyo daadad ka dhasha fatahaadaha, kuwaas oo ka dhasha roob aad u badan oo da’a muddo kooban.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Floods can also occur in coastal areas due to storm surges, which are large waves that are pushed inland by strong winds.
entries.translation: Daadad ayaa sidoo kale ka dhici kara dhulka xeebaha ah iyadoo ay ugu wacan tahay dabeylaha wata dabeylaha, kuwaas oo ah mowjado waaweyn oo dabeylo xooggani ay gudaha u soo galaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Floods can cause a wide range of damage, including loss of life, property damage, and environmental damage.
entries.translation: Daadadku waxay sababi karaan khasaare kala duwan oo ay ka mid yihiin khasaare nafeed, burbur hantiyeed iyo burbur deegaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can also disrupt transportation and communication, and lead to food and water shortages.
entries.translation: Waxay kaloo carqaladayn karaan isu socodka iyo isgaadhsiinta, waxayna u horseedi karaan cunto iyo biyo yaraan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The resulting loss of homes and livelihoods can force people to relocate, which can lead to social and economic problems.
entries.translation: Guryaha iyo maciishada ka dhalan karta waxay dadka ku qasbi kartaa inay guuraan, taasoo keeni karta dhibaato bulsho iyo mid dhaqaale.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Our archive contains over 100 million records, including census records, birth records, death records, and marriage records.
entries.translation: Mesha an ku kaydin tariiqda waxaa keyd ahaan u yaalo ilaa in ka badn 100 milyan oo rikoordiiwaanno ah oo ay ka mid yihiin diiwaanada tirakoobka, diiwaanada dhalashooyinka, iyo diiwaanada guurka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We also have a large collection of family group sheets and manuscripts.
entries.translation: Waxaan sidoo kale haysanaa uruurin badan oo ah xaashiyada kooxda qoyska iyo qoraal-gacmeedyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: To search for your ancestors, you can use our surname search tool.
entries.translation: Si aad u raadiso awoowayaashaa, waxaad isticmaali kartaa aaladda raadinta magaca qoyska.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This tool allows you to search by surname, first name, and date of birth.
entries.translation: Qalabkan wuxu ku ogalanyaa inaad bartid magaca awoowga magac koowaad tariiqda iyo tariiqda dhalashada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can also search by location.
entries.translation: Waxa kalo ka baari kartaa degaankaaga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once you have found your ancestors, you can view their records.
entries.translation: Mar hadaad hesho awoowyaashaa, waxaa ka fiirin kartaa diiwaankooda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can also print copies of their records.
entries.translation: Waxaa sidoo kale kala bixi kartaa nuqul diiwaanadooda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We also offer a subscription service that allows you to access our entire archive.
entries.translation: Waxa kale oo aan bixinaa adeeg rukumasho kaas oo kuu oggolaanaya inaad gasho dhammaan kaydkeena.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This service is perfect for genealogists who are looking for a comprehensive collection of records.
entries.translation: Adeegaan wuxuu ku fiican yahay farac raacayaasha ee raadinaya ururinta diiwaanka oo dhamaystiran.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you have any questions about our archive or our surname search tool, please do not hesitate to contact us.
entries.translation: Haddii aad qabtid wax su'aalo ah oo ku saabsan kaydkeena ama aaladda raadinta magaca qoyska, fadlan ha ka waaban inaad nala soo xiriiro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We are here to help you find your ancestors.
entries.translation: Waxaan halkaan u joognaa inaan kaa caawino helida awoowyaashaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Juan who loved tacos.
entries.translation: Hadda ka hor, waxaa jiray wiil yar oo la dhihi jiray Juan kaas oo jeclaa cunna dhaqameedka maksikaannka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He loved them so much that he would eat them for breakfast, lunch, and dinner.
entries.translation: Said ayuuu jeclaa ila uu ka dhigan jiray quraac, qado iyo casho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, Juan's mother decided to make him a special taco.
entries.translation: Maalin maalmaha ka mid ah, Juan hooyadii waxay go'aansatay inay u samayso cunna dhaqameedka maksikaannka gaar ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She filled it with all of his favorite ingredients: ground beef, lettuce, tomatoes, cheese, and sour cream.
entries.translation: Waxay ka buuxisay dhammaan walxaha uu jecel yahay: hilibka lo'da lashiiday, khudaarta, yaanyada, jiiska, iyo labeen dhanaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Juan was so excited for his taco that he could barely wait to eat it.
entries.translation: Juan aad ayuu ugu faraxsanaa cunna dhaqameedka maksikaanka oo uu sugi waayay inuu cuno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When Juan finally took a bite of his taco, he was amazed at how delicious it was.
entries.translation: Markii Juan ugu dambeyntii uu goostay cunna dhaqameedka maksikaanka, wuxuu la yaabay sida ay u macaan tahay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The flavors of the meat, vegetables, and cheese all combined perfectly to create a taste that Juan had never experienced before.
entries.translation: Dhadhanka hilibka, khudaarta, iyo jiiska ayaa dhamaantood si fiican la isugu daray si ay u abuuraan dhadhan uu Juan waligiis hore u arag.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He ate every bite of his taco, and then he asked his mother to make him another one.
entries.translation: Wuxuu cunay mid kasta oo cunna dhaqameedka maksikaanka ah, ka dibna wuxuu ka codsaday hooyadii inay u sameyso mid kale.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Juan's mother was happy to make him another taco, and she even let him help her in the kitchen.
entries.translation: Hooyadii Juan ayaa ku faraxsaneyd inay u sameyso cunna dhaqameedka maksikaanka mar kale, xitaa waxay u ogolaatay inuu ka caawiyo jikada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Juan learned how to measure the ingredients, how to cook the meat, and how to assemble the tacos.
entries.translation: Juan waxa uu bartay sida loo cabbiro maaddooyinka, sida hilibka loo kariyo, iyo sida la iskugu daro cunna dhaqameedka maksikaanka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He had so much fun helping his mother that he decided that he wanted to be a chef when he grew up.
entries.translation: Aad ayuu u baashaalayay caawinta hooyadii, wuxuuna go'aansaday inuu doonayo inuu noqdo cunto kariye markii uu koray.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Juan continued to love tacos throughout his childhood.
entries.translation: Juan wuxuu sii waday inuu jeclaado cunna dhaqameedka maksikaanka ilaa caruurnimadiisii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He ate them at home, at school, and at restaurants.
entries.translation: Wuxuu ku cunay guriga, dugsiga, iyo makhaayadaha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The federal government is considering adding a new species of colorful fish to the list of protected species.
entries.translation: Dawladda federaalku waxay ka fikiraysaa inay liiska noocyada la ilaaliyo ku darto nooc cusub oo kalluun midab leh.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The fish, known as the "rainbow mouth" fish, is found only in a small area of the Pacific Ocean.
entries.translation: Kalluunka, oo loo yaqaan "Afka qaanso-roobaadka" kalluunka, ayaa laga helaa oo keliya meel yar oo ka mid ah Badweynta Baasifigga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is named for its bright colors and distinctive mouth, which is shaped like a rainbow.
entries.translation: Waxaa loogu magac daray midabo dhalaalaya iyo afkeeda gaarka ah, kaas oo u qaabbaysan qaansoroobaad.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The members of the Fish and Wildlife Service are divided on whether or not to add the rainbow mouth fish to the list of protected species.
entries.translation: Xubnaha Adeegga Kalluunka iyo Duurjoogta ayaa ku kala qaybsan in lagu daro kalluunka afka qaanso-roobaadka iyo in kale liiska noocyada la ilaaliyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some members argue that the fish is not in danger of extinction and does not need federal protection.
entries.translation: Xubnaha qaar ayaa ku doodaya in kalluunka aan khatar ugu jirin inuu dabar go’o oo aan u baahnayn ilaalin federaali ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Others argue that the fish is unique and should be protected from overfishing.
entries.translation: Qaar kale ayaa ku doodaya in kalluunku uu yahay mid gaar ah oo ay tahay in laga ilaaliyo kalluumeysiga xad dhaafka ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The decision of whether or not to add the rainbow mouth fish to the list of protected species is likely to be a difficult one.
entries.translation: Go'aanka ah in lagu daro kalluunka afka qaanso-roobaadka iyo in kale liiska noocyada la ilaaliyo waxay u badan tahay inay noqoto mid adag.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Feel the warmth of the blanket seeping into your body, and let your muscles relax.
entries.translation: Dareen diirimaadka bustaha uu jirkaaga u keeno, oo u daa in muruqyadaadu debciyaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Close your eyes and take a deep breath.
entries.translation: Indhaha isku qabo neefna qaado.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Inhale through your nose and exhale through your mouth.
entries.translation: Neeftada jiid adigo sanka ka jiidayo neefta ka bixi afka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Repeat this several times, letting your mind clear and your body become still.
entries.translation: Ku celi marar badan kana dhig miskaxdaada mid nadiif ah jirkagana mid wali caadi ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As you relax, imagine yourself in a beautiful place.
entries.translation: Markaad nasato, ku khiyaas naftaada meel qurux badan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It could be a beach, a forest, or a mountaintop.
entries.translation: Waxay noqon kartaa xeeb, kayn ama buur.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Whatever place you choose, make it a place where you feel happy and at peace.
entries.translation: Meel kasta oo aad doorato, ka dhig meel aad ku dareemayso farxad iyo nabad.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: See the sights, hear the sounds, and smell the smells of your chosen place.
entries.translation: Arag muuqaallada, maqal dhawaaqyada, oo carafso carafta meesha aad dooratay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Feel the sun on your skin and the breeze in your hair.
entries.translation: Ka dareen qorraxda maqaarkaaga neecawdana timahaaga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Let yourself relax in this place for as long as you like.
entries.translation: Naftaada u ogolow meeshan inaad ku nasato inta aad rabto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When you're ready to return to the present, take a few deep breaths and open your eyes.
entries.translation: Hadad rabtid inaad ku soo laabato wakhti xaadirka waxaad qaadataa neefsasho dheer oo indhahaaga fur.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You'll feel refreshed and rejuvenated, ready to take on the day.
entries.translation: Waxaad dareemi doontaa nafis iyo fudfudayd, diyaarna u ah inaad qaabisho maalinta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is just one example of a relaxation technique that you can use to relieve stress and improve your overall well-being.
entries.translation: Tani waa hal tusaale oo ka mid ah farsamada nasashada oo aad isticmaali karto si aad u yareyso diiqada oo aad u wanaajiso wacnaanta guud.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many other relaxation techniques available, so find one that works for you and make it a part of your daily routine.
entries.translation: Waxaa jira farsamooyin kale oo badan oo nasasho ah oo la heli karo, markaa raadso mid adiga kuu shaqeeya oo ka dhig qayb ka mid ah hawl maalmeedkaaga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: With a little practice, you'll be able to relax on command, whenever you need to.
entries.translation: Tababar yar, waxaad awoodi doontaa inaad ku nasato amarka, markasta oo aad u baahato.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's important to remember that dog attacks are rare, and that most dogs are well-behaved and loving creatures.
entries.translation: Waa muhiim in la xasuusto in weerarrada eyga ay naadir yihiin, iyo in eeyaha badankood yihiin makhluuqaad wanaagsan oo jecel leh.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, there are certain circumstances that can increase the risk of a dog attack, such as if the dog is not properly trained, if it is feeling threatened, or if it is in a confined space.
entries.translation: Si kastaba ha ahaatee, waxaa jira xaalado gaar ah oo kordhin kara halista weerarka eyga, sida haddii eygu aan si fiican loo tababarin, haddii uu dareemayo hanjabaad, ama haddii uu ku jiro meel xaddidan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the case of the recent dog attack in which a grandmother was killed, it appears that the dog was not properly trained and that it was feeling threatened by the grandmother's presence.
entries.translation: Marka la eego falkii eyga ee dhawaan lagu dilay ayeeyo, waxa ay u muuqataa in eyga aan si fiican loo tababarin, isla markaana laga dareemayay cabsi ku aadan joogitaanka ayeeyada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The dog was a large, powerful breed that had been adopted from a shelter just a few months before the attack.
entries.translation: Eygu waxa uu ahaa mid weyn oo xoog badan kaas oo laga soo qaatay hoy dhawr bilood ka hor weerarka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The grandmother had been visiting her son and his family, and she was sitting on the couch when the dog suddenly attacked her.
entries.translation: Ayeeyada ayaa booqanaysay wiilkeeda iyo qoyskiisa, waxayna ku fadhiday sariirta markii uu eeyga si lama filaan ah u weeraray.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The dog bit her multiple times on the head and neck, and she died at the scene.
entries.translation: Eyga ayaa dhowr jeer madaxa iyo qoorta ka qaniinay, waxayna ku geeriyootay goobta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The dog's owner has said that he was unaware of any history of aggression in the dog, and that he believes the attack was triggered by the grandmother's sudden movement.
entries.translation: Milkiilaha eyga ayaa sheegay in uusan ka warqabin wax taariikh ah oo gardaro ah oo lagu sameeyay eyga, waxaana uu aaminsan yahay in weerarka uu ka dhashay dhaq dhaqaaq kedis ah oo ay ayeeyada sameysay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, it is important to note that even well-trained dogs can become aggressive if they are not properly socialized or if they are feeling threatened.
entries.translation: Si kastaba ha ahaatee, waxaa muhiim ah in la ogaado in xitaa eeyaha si fiican u tababaran ay noqon karaan kuwo dagaal badan haddii aan si habboon is dhexgal loola samayn ama haddii ay dareemaan hanjabaad.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This tragic incident highlights the importance of responsible dog ownership.
entries.translation: Dhacdadan naxdinta leh waxay muujineysaa muhiimada ay leedahay lahaanshaha eey mas'uul ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hamid Al-fitr, the famed storyteller, tells of a time when he was injured in battle.
entries.translation: Hamid Al-fitr, oo ah sheeko-yaqaanka caanka ah, ayaa ka warramaya wakhti uu ku dhaawacmay dagaalka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I was a young man, just a green recruit, when I first saw battle.
entries.translation: "Waxaan ahaa nin dhalinyaro ah, oo kaliya cusbaa, markii ugu horeysay ee aan arkay dagaal.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The fighting was fierce, and I was quickly overwhelmed.
entries.translation: Dagaalka wuxuu ahaa mid cabsi ah, degdegna waa la igaga adkaaday.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was struck down by a blow to the head, and I lay on the ground, bleeding and dazed.
entries.translation: Madaxa jug ayaa iga dhacday, dhulka ayaan jiiftay, aniga oo dhiig baxaya oo dawakhsan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As I lay there, I thought about my life and how it might end.
entries.translation: Markii aan meesha jiifay, waxaan ka fikiray noloshayda iyo sida ay ku dhammaan karto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I thought about my family and friends, and how they would miss me.
entries.translation: Waxaan ka fikiray qoyskayga iyo asxaabtayda, iyo sida ay iigu xiisi doonaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I also thought about the rank I had aspired to, and how it would now be impossible for me to achieve.
entries.translation: Waxa kale oo aan ka fikiray darajada aan ku taamayay, iyo sida ay hadda ii suurtoobi weyday in aan gaaro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I closed my eyes and prepared for death.
entries.translation: Indhaha ayaan isku qabtay oo geeri baan isu diyaariyey.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But then, I heard a voice.
entries.translation: Laakin ka dib, waxan maqlay cod.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was the voice of an old man, and he was saying, "Don't give up.
entries.translation: Wuxuu ahaa cod nin oday ah, wuxuna lahaa, " Ha is dhiibin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You're not done yet" I opened my eyes and saw the old man standing over me.
entries.translation: Weli ma kuu dhammaan" Indhaha ayaan kala qaaday, waxaan arkay odaygii oo i dul taagan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was a healer, and he had come to help me.
entries.translation: Wuxuu ahaa bogsiiye, wuxuuna u yimid inuu i caawiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He treated my wounds, and he gave me some words of encouragement:
entries.translation: Wuxuu daweeyay nabarradaydii, wuxuuna i siiyay erayo dhiirigelin ah:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Don't let this injury define you,' he said.
entries.translation: Yaan dhaawacaan ku qeexin,' ayuu yiri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "You're still a warrior, and you still have a lot to offer the world.
entries.translation: "Weli waxaad tahay dagaalyahan, welina waxaad haysataa wax badan oo aad ku tarto adduunka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Health and fitness are important for feeling your best and living a long, happy life.
entries.translation: Caafimaadka iyo jirdhiska ayaa muhiim u ah dareenkaaga ugu fiican iyo inaad ku noolaato nolol dheer oo farxad leh.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A healthy diet and regular exercise can help you maintain a healthy weight, reduce your risk of chronic diseases, and improve your mood and energy levels.
entries.translation: Cunto caafimaad leh iyo jimicsi joogto ah ayaa kaa caawin kara inaad ilaaliso miisaan caafimaad leh, waxay yaraynaysaa halista cudurrada dabadheeraadka ah, waxayna hagaajin kartaa niyaddaada iyo heerarka tamartaada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Eating a healthy diet means eating plenty of fruits, vegetables, and whole grains.
entries.translation: Cunista cunto caafimaad leh waxay la macno tahay cunista miraha, khudaarta, iyo xabuuqa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It also means limiting unhealthy fats, processed foods, and sugary drinks.
entries.translation: Waxa kale oo ay ka dhigan tahay xaddididda dufanka aan caafimaadka lahayn, cuntooyinka warshadaysan, iyo cabitaannada sonkorta leh.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Regular exercise can include activities such as walking, running, swimming, biking, or dancing.
entries.translation: Jimicsiga joogtada ah waxaa ka mid noqon kara dhaqdhaqaaqyada sida socodka, orodka, dabaasha, baaskiilka, ama qoob ka ciyaarka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is important to get at least 150 minutes of moderate-intensity aerobic activity or 75 minutes of vigorous-intensity aerobic activity each week.
entries.translation: Waxaa muhiim ah in la helo ugu yaraan 150 daqiiqo oo ah dhaqdhaqaaq aerobic dhexdhexaad ah ama 75 daqiiqo oo dhaqdhaqaaq aerobic ah oo xoog leh toddobaad kasta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You should also do muscle-strengthening activities at least twice a week.
entries.translation: Waa inaad sidoo kale sameyso dhaqdhaqaaqyada xoojinta murqaha ugu yaraan laba jeer toddobaadkii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When you make healthy choices for your health and fitness, you are not only improving your own life, but you are also setting a positive example for others.
entries.translation: Marka aad u samaysid doorashooyin caafimaad qaba caafimaadkaaga iyo jirdhiskaaga, kaliya ma hagaajinaysid noloshaada, laakiin sidoo kale waxaad tusaale wanaagsan u noqonaysaa kuwa kale.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By making healthy choices, you are helping to create a healthier community and a healthier world.
entries.translation: Markaad samayso doorashooyin caafimaad qaba, waxaad caawinaysaa inaad abuurto bulsho caafimaad qabta iyo adduun caafimaad qaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The most recent major news event in Eritrea was the 2018 Eritrean–Ethiopian peace agreement.
entries.translation: Dhacdadii ugu weyneyd ee ka dhacday Eritrea waxay ahayd heshiiskii nabadeed ee Eritrea iyo Itoobiya ee 2018.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This agreement ended a 20-year war between the two countries and resulted in the reopening of borders and the resumption of trade.
entries.translation: Heshiiskan ayaa soo afjaray dagaal socday 20-sano oo labada dal u dhaxeeyay, wuxuuna keenay in dib loo furo xuduudaha, ganacsigiina uu dib u bilowdo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a significant step forward for regional stability and peace.
entries.translation: Waxay ahayd tallaabo muhiim ah oo horay loogu qaaday xasilloonida iyo nabadda gobolka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another recent development is the 2019 Eritrean presidential election.
entries.translation: Horumar kale oo dhawaan soo shaac baxay ayaa ah doorashada madaxtinimada Eritrea ee 2019-ka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Isaias Afwerki, who has been president of Eritrea since 1993, was re-elected for a fifth term with 99% of the vote.
entries.translation: Isaias Afwerki, oo tan iyo 1993-kii soo ahaa madaxweynaha Eritrea, ayaa mar kale loo doortay mar shanaad, isagoo helay 99% codadkii la dhiibtay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The election was widely criticized by international observers as not being free or fair.
entries.translation: Doorashadan ayaa waxaa si weyn u dhaliilay goob-joogayaasha caalamiga ah oo ku tilmaamay mid aan xor iyo xalaal ahayn.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition to these major events, there have also been a number of smaller news stories in Eritrea over the past few years.
entries.translation: Marka laga soo tago dhacdooyinkan waaweyn, waxa kale oo jira tiro warar yar yar oo ka jiray Eritrea dhawrkii sano ee la soo dhaafay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These include the 2016 closure of the United Nations office in Eritrea, the 2017 release of several political prisoners, and the 2018 visit of Pope Francis to the country.
entries.translation: Kuwaas waxaa ka mid ah xiritaanka xafiiska Qaramada Midoobay ee Eritrea 2016, siideynta 2017 maxaabiis badan oo siyaasadeed iyo booqashadii 2018 ee Pope Francis ee dalka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Overall, the past few years have been a period of relative stability and progress for Eritrea.
entries.translation: Guud ahaan, dhowrkii sano ee la soo dhaafay waxay Eritrea u ahayd xasillooni iyo horumar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The country has made significant steps towards peace and reconciliation with its neighbors, and there have been some positive developments on the human rights front.
entries.translation: Dalka wuxuu qaaday tallaabooyin wax ku ool ah oo ku aaddan nabadda iyo dib-u-heshiisiinta deriskiisa, waxaana jiray horumarro wanaagsan oo dhinaca xuquuqul insaanka ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The distribution of beauty services and spas is changing, with a growing number of men seeking out these services.
entries.translation: Qaybinta adeegyada is qurxinta iyo is nuurinta ayaa is beddelaya, iyadoo ay sii kordhayaan tirada ragga doonaya adeegyadan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the United States, the number of male spa-goers has increased by 30% in the past five years, and men now account for 20% of all spa visits.
entries.translation: Dalka Maraykanka, tirada ragga is nuurinaya ayaa kor u kacday 30% shantii sano ee la soo dhaafay, ragguna hadda waxay ka yihiin 20% dhammaan booqashooyinka is nuurinta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As the demand for male beauty services grows, spas are starting to cater more specifically to men's needs.
entries.translation: Maaddaama baahida loo qabo adeegyada qurxinta ragga ay sii kordheyso, is qurxinta waxay bilaabayaan inay si gaar ah u daboolaan baahiyaha ragga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This includes offering a wider range of services, such as beard trims and massages, as well as creating a more masculine environment.
entries.translation: Tan waxa ku jira in la bixiyo adeegyo kala duwan, sida garka jarida iyo duugista, iyo sidoo kale abuurista jawi murqa dhisid.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some spas are even offering men-only days or hours, so that men can feel comfortable getting pampered without feeling self-conscious.
entries.translation: Meelaha is qurxinta qaarkood waxay xitaa ragga siiyaan maalmo ama saacado, si ay ragga u dareemaan raaxo in la koolkooliyo iyagoon dareemin miyir-qab.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The growth of the male beauty market is a sign of a changing attitude towards men's grooming.
entries.translation: Kobaca suuqa quruxda labka waa calaamad muujinaysa hab-dhaqanka isbeddelaya ee ku wajahan qurxinta ragga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A brave little robin was flying through the forest when he saw a group of birds gathered around a large tree.
entries.translation: Robin yar oo geesi ah oo kaynta dhex duulaya ayaa waxa uu arkay koox shimbiro ah oo geed weyn ku soo uruuray.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He landed on a branch nearby and listened to what they were saying.
entries.translation: Laan u dhow ayuu ku degay oo dhegaystay waxay ku hadlayaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "We've been investigating this tree for weeks," said a raven.
entries.translation: "Waxaan baaraynay geedkan isbuucyo," ayuu yiri tuke.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "We're not sure what's causing it to lean so precariously!" said a little sparrow.
entries.translation: "Ma hubno waxa ka dhigaya inay si taxadar leh u tiirsato!" ayay tiri shimbir yar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "But we're worried that it's going to fall and hurt someone!" cried an eagle.
entries.translation: "Laakiin waxaan ka walaacsanahay inay dhici doonto oo ay qof dhaawacayso!" gorgor baa ku qayliyey.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The robin looked at the tree and saw that it was indeed leaning very heavily to one side.
entries.translation: Shimbirkii wuxu firiyay geedki wuxuna arkay inuu gees u liico si culus waliba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He knew that he had to do something to help, but he didn't know what.
entries.translation: Wuu ogaa inay tahay inuu sameeyo wax uu ku caawiyo, laakiin ma uu garanayn waxa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Suddenly, an idea came to him.
entries.translation: Durbadiiba, fikrad ayaa ku soo dhacday.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He flew down to the ground and gathered a large load of leaves.
entries.translation: Inta uu dhulka ku duulay ayuu caleen badan soo urursaday.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He then flew back up to the tree and started to stuff the leaves into the hole where the roots were exposed.
entries.translation: Kadibna geedkii ayuu dib ugu duulay oo bilaabay inuu caleentii ku shubo godkii ay xididadu ka soo baxeen.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The birds below watched in amazement as the robin worked.
entries.translation: Shimbirihii hoos ku sugnaa ayaa si yaab leh u daawaday sida uu shimbirku u shaqaynayo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They couldn't believe that such a small bird could have so much strength.
entries.translation: Way rumaysan kari waayeen in shimbirkaan yar uu yeelan karo awood intaas le'eg.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After a few hours, the robin had filled the hole completely.
entries.translation: Dhowr saacadood ka dib, shimbirka ayaa si buuxda u buuxiyay godka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The tree was now standing upright and stable.
entries.translation: Geedka hadda kor ayuu u taagnaa oo waa qumnaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The other birds cheered and thanked the robin for saving the day.
entries.translation: Shimbiraha kale ayaa ku farxay oo u mahad celiyay shimbirkii badbaadiyay maalintaas.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The world is a very different place than it was just a few decades ago.
entries.translation: Dunida waa meel aad uga duwan sidii ay ahayd dhawr iyo toban sano ka hor.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nationalism has taken hold in many countries, and people are more divided than ever.
entries.translation: Wadamo badan ayay ka hirgashay qarannimada, dadkana waxay u kala qaybsan yihiin sidii hore si ka badan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In one country, a group of nationalists have taken control of the government and are using their power to suppress dissent.
entries.translation: Dal ka mid ah, koox wadaniyiin ah ayaa talada dalka gacanta ku dhigay, waxayna awoodooda u adeegsadaan caburinta mucaaradka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They have banned all forms of media that they deem to be "unpatriotic," and they have arrested and even killed people who speak out against the government.
entries.translation: Waxay mamnuuceen nooc kasta oo warbaahin ah oo ay u arkaan in aysan ahayn “wadaniyiin”, waxa ay xir-xireen oo ay dileen dadka dawladda kasoo horjeeda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, a young woman named Rebecca is walking home from school when she is stopped by a group of nationalist soldiers.
entries.translation: Maalin maalmaha ka mid ah, gabar yar oo la dhihi jiray Rebecca ayaa ka soo lugaysay guriga, markii ay istaajiyeen koox askar wadaniyiin ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They accuse her of being a traitor, and they take her to a secret prison.
entries.translation: Waxay ku eedeeyeen inay tahay khaa'inul waddan, waxayna geeyeen xabsi qarsoon.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rebecca is tortured and interrogated, but she refuses to give up any information.
entries.translation: Rebecca waa la jirdilay oo waxaa la waydiiyay su'aalo, laakiin way diiday inay siiso wax macluumaad ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After several weeks, Rebecca is finally released from prison.
entries.translation: Dhowr toddobaad ka dib, Rebecca ayaa ugu dambeyntii laga sii daayay xabsiga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She is weak and malnourished, but she is determined to fight back against the nationalists.
entries.translation: Way tabar daran tahay oo nafaqo darro ayaa haysa, laakiin waxa ka go’an inay la dagaalanto wadaniyiinta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She joins a resistance movement, and she becomes a valuable asset to the cause.
entries.translation: Waxay ku biirtay dhaqdhaqaaqa iska caabinta, waxayna u noqotay hanti qiimo leh dhaqdhaqaaqa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rebecca uses her knowledge of technology to help the resistance communicate and coordinate their attacks.
entries.translation: Rebecca waxay isticmaashaa aqoonteeda tiknoolajiyada si ay uga caawiso iska caabbinta inay la xiriiraan oo ay isku duba ridaan weerarradooda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She also uses her skills as a hacker to infiltrate the nationalists' computers and steal their data.
entries.translation: Waxay sidoo kale u isticmaashaa xirfadaheeda wax jabsiga si ay u dhex gasho kombuyuutarada waddaniyiinta oo ay u xaddo xogtooda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Vast archives of military photos have been digitized and made available online, allowing researchers to study them from anywhere in the world.
entries.translation: Kaydka baaxadda leh ee sawirada milatariga ayaa la casriyeeyay oo laga dhigay in laga heli karo onlayn, taas oo u oggolaanaysa cilmi-baarayaasha in ay wax ka bartaan meel kasta oo adduunka ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This has led to a number of new discoveries, as researchers are able to compare photos from different sources and identify previously unknown individuals.
entries.translation: Tani waxay keentay in la ogaado tiro waxyaalo cusub ah, iyadoo cilmi-baarayaasha ay awoodaan inay isbarbardhigaan sawirada ilo kala duwan oo ay aqoonsadaan shakhsiyaad aan hore loo aqoon.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In one case, researchers were able to identify a soldier who had been missing for over 70 years using photos from a military archive.
entries.translation: Hal xaalad, cilmi-baarayaasha waxay awoodeen inay aqoonsadaan askari ka maqnaa in ka badan 70 sano iyagoo isticmaalaya sawirro laga soo qaaday kaydka milatariga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The soldier's family was overjoyed to finally learn what had happened to him, and they were able to hold a proper funeral for him.
entries.translation: Qoyska askariga ayaa aad ugu farxay in ugu dambeyntii ay ogaadaan waxa ku dhacay, waxaana u suuragashay in ay aas sax ah u sameeyaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Poetry is a universal language that transcends time and place.
entries.translation: Maansada waa af caalami ah oo wakhti iyo goob dhaafsiisan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It can be used to express emotions, tell stories, and explore complex ideas.
entries.translation: Waxaa loo isticmaali karaa in lagu muujiyo shucuurta, ka sheekaynta sheekooyinka, iyo sahminta fikradaha balaaran.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As a translator, I have the privilege of helping to bring poetry to new audiences by rendering it in another language.
entries.translation: Turjubaan ahaan, waxaan nasiib u leeyahay inaan gacan ka geysto sidii aan gabayada ugu keeni lahaa daawadayaasha cusub anigoo ku turjumaya luuqad kale.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is a challenging but rewarding task, as I must not only convey the literal meaning of the poem, but also its beauty and power.
entries.translation: Tani waa hawl dhib badan, balse faa’iido badan leh, maadaama aan gabayga macnihiisa ku koobnayn oo keliya, laakiin sidoo kale quruxdeeda iyo cududeedaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most important things to consider when translating poetry is the rhythm and meter.
entries.translation: Waxyaabaha ugu muhiimsan ee ay tahay in la tixgeliyo marka la turjumayo gabayada waxaa ka mid ah laxanka iyo miisaanka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These elements are essential to the poem's overall effect, and they can be difficult to reproduce in another language.
entries.translation: Qodobbadaan waxay lama huraan u yihiin guud ahaan saamaynta maansada, wayna adkaan kartaa in af kale lagu soo saaro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In some cases, I may need to adjust the rhythm or meter slightly in order to make the poem flow more naturally in the target language.
entries.translation: Xaaladaha qaarkood, waxa laga yaabaa in aan u baahdo in aan wax yar hagaajiyo laxanka ama maansada si aan maansada uga dhigo mid si dabiici ah ugu socota afka bartilmaameedka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, I always take care to preserve the poem's original meaning and intent.
entries.translation: Si kastaba ha ahaatee, waxaan had iyo jeer ka taxadaraa in aan ilaaliyo gabayga macnihiisa asalka ah iyo ujeedada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another important consideration is the use of figurative language.
entries.translation: Tixgelin kale oo muhiim ah ayaa ah adeegsiga luqadda tusaalaha ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Poets often use metaphors, similes, and other figures of speech to create vivid imagery and add depth to their work.
entries.translation: Gabayada waxay inta badan adeegsadaan sarbeebo, waxyaalka isu eg, iyo tusaalayaal kale si ay u abuuraan sawir muuqda oo ay ugu kordhiyaan shaqadooda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When translating these devices, I must find equivalents in the target language that will have the same impact on the reader.
entries.translation: Marka la turjumayo aaladahaan, waa in aan helaa wax u dhigma luqadda bartilmaameedka ah oo saameyn la mid ah ku yeelan doonta akhristaha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dolls and doll accessories are a popular way for children to play and learn.
entries.translation: Boombilayaasha iyo qalabka boombilaha waa hab caan ah oo carruurta ku ciyaaraan oo ay wax ku bartaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dolls can represent people, animals, or even imaginary creatures.
entries.translation: Boombilayaahsa waxay ka turjumaan dadka, xayawaanka, ama xitaa makhluuqa khiyaaliga ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can be dressed up in different clothes, given different furniture to play with, and placed in different settings.
entries.translation: Waxaa loogu labisi karaa dhar kala duwan, waxaana la siin karaa alaab guri oo kala duwan oo ay ku ciyaaraan, waxaana la dhigi karaa meelo kala duwan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Children can use dolls to act out stories, explore different roles, and learn about the world around them.
entries.translation: Caruurta waxay isticmaalo bombalo si ay ugu falceliyaan shekada oo ay taaba galiyaan shaqo kala duwan waxayna bartaan wax ku sabsan aduunka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, a child might use a doll to pretend to be a doctor, a teacher, or a firefighter.
entries.translation: Tusaale ahaan, ilmaha wuxuu isticmaali karaa boombile si uu isaga dhigo dhakhtar, macalin, ama dabdemis.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's not just about what you wear, but how you wear it.
entries.translation: Ma aha oo kaliya waxa aad xirato, laakiin waa sida aad u xirato.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you're always slouching and your clothes are rumpled, it shows that you don't care about yourself.
entries.translation: Haddi aad had iyo jeer libiqsato oo dharkaaga la ruxo, waxay ku tusinaysaa inaadan dan ka lahayn naftaada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: People will notice and they'll make assumptions about you.
entries.translation: Dadka way ogaan doonaan waxayna samayn doonaan malo adiga kugu saabsan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They might think that you're lazy or unkempt.
entries.translation: Waxaa laga yaabaa inay u maleeyaan inaad caajislow tahay ama dhmaystirnayn.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They might even think that you're not a good person.
entries.translation: Waxay xitaa u malayn karaan inaadan ahayn qof wanaagsan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Of course, there are times when we all wear shabby clothes.
entries.translation: Dabcan, waxaa jira wakhtiyo aan dhammaanteen xiranno dhar jilicsan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Maybe we're just running errands or we're doing chores around the house.
entries.translation: Waxa laga yaabaa in aana hawlo shaqo ku jirno ama aan guriga ka samaynayno hawlo kale.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But if you find yourself wearing shabby clothes all the time, it's time to take a look at yourself.
entries.translation: Laakin haddii aad isku aragto in aad xiran tahay mar walba dhar qafiif ah, waa markii aad is-fiirin lahayd.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Are you really happy with the way you look?
entries.translation: Runtii ma ku faraxsan tahay qaabka aad u egtahay?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If not, then it's time to make a change.
entries.translation: Haddaysan ahayn, markaas waa wakhtigii isbeddel la samayn lahaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Start by taking some time to think about your personal style.
entries.translation: Ku billow inaad qaadato wakhti si aad uga fikirto qaabkaaga gaarka ah.

entries.english: What kind of clothes do you feel good in?
entries.translation: Dhar noocee ah ayaad ku faraxsan tahay?

entries.english: What kind of clothes make you feel confident?
