entries.english: Once you know what you like, start shopping for clothes that fit your personality.
entries.translation: Markaad ogaato waxa aad jeceshahay, bilow inaad soo iibsato dhar ku habboon shakhsiyadaada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's also important to make sure that your clothes are clean and well-fitting.
entries.translation: Waxa kale oo muhiim ah inaad hubiso in dharkaaga nadiif yahay oo si fiican kuula egyihiin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If they're rumpled or stained, it will only make you look worse.
entries.translation: Haddi ay isku jajaban yihiin ama wasakhaysan yihiin, waxa ay kaa dhigi doontaa oo kaliya mid ka sii daran.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Take the time to iron your clothes and make sure they fit properly.
entries.translation: Wakhti qaado si aad ku feerayso dharkaaga oo hubi inay si fiican kuula eg yihiin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Finally, don't be afraid to experiment with different styles.
entries.translation: Ugu dambeyntii, ha ka baqin inaad tijaabiso qaabab kala duwan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You might be surprised at what you find.
entries.translation: Waxaa laga yaabaa inaad la yaabto waxa aad hesho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are so many different ways to dress, so don't be afraid to try new things.
entries.translation: Waxaa jira siyaabo badan oo kala duwan oo loo labisto, markaa ha ka baqin inaad isku daydo waxyaabo cusub.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The more you experiment, the more likely you are to find a style that you love.
entries.translation: Mar walba oo aad tijaabiso, waxay u badan tahay inaad hesho qaab aad jeceshahay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When you dress well, it shows that you take pride in yourself.
entries.translation: Markaad si fiican u labisato, waxay ku tusinaysaa inaad isla wayntahay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It also makes you feel more confident.
entries.translation: Waxay kaloo kaa dhigaysaa inaad dareento kalsooni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So if you're looking for a way to boost your self-confidence, start by taking a look at your wardrobe.
entries.translation: Marka haddii aad raadinayso hab aad kor ugu qaaddo kalsoonidaada, ku billow in aad eegto dharkaaga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A few new clothes can make a big difference.
entries.translation: Dhowr dhar oo cusub ayaa sameyn kara farqi weyn.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ghana is a country with a rich and diverse culture, and its traditional customs are a major part of that.
entries.translation: Ghana waa wadan qani oo dhaqan balaran leh iyo dhaqankooda cadad u ah wa kuwa weyn.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most important customs is the naming ceremony, which is held for a newborn child.
entries.translation: Caadooyinka mida ugu mhuimsan waa magacabida xaflada taaso loo qabto cunuga markuu dhasho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The ceremony is typically presided over by a traditional priest or elder, and it involves the naming of the child, as well as prayers and blessings for the child's future.
entries.translation: Xaflada waxa la wareego culumo dhaqameed ama dad waa weyn taaso ay ku jirto magacabida cunuga iyo u duceynta cunuga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another important custom is the funeral ceremony, which is held for a deceased person.
entries.translation: Caado kale oo muhiim ah ayaa ah xafladda duugta, oo loo sameeyo qof dhintay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The ceremony is typically very elaborate and involves music, dancing, and food.
entries.translation: Xaflada waxay la jaanqada in la sameeyo musiga qoob ka ciyaar iyo cunno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The deceased person is typically buried with their belongings, and a shrine is often built in their honor.
entries.translation: Qofka dhintay waxa lagu duugaa wuxu leyahay waxan loo sameya naxash oo lagu maamusayo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ghana is also home to a number of traditional festivals, such as the Odwira festival, which is held in the Ashanti region.
entries.translation: Ghana waa guriga tiro badan ee dhaqan xafladeeda sida xaflada Odwira taso lagu qabtay gobolka Ashanti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The festival is a time for celebration and thanksgiving, and it involves traditional music, dancing, and food.
entries.translation: Xaflda waa wakhti la dabaal dago iyo mahadnaq waxaana la socdo muusig, qoob ka ciyaar, iyo cunto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In recent years, some traditional customs in Ghana have been adapted to modern life.
entries.translation: Sannadihii u dambeeyay, qaar ka mid ah caadooyinka dhaqameedka Ghana ayaa la qabsaday nolosha casriga ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, some naming ceremonies now include electronic devices such as computers and projectors.
entries.translation: Tusaale ahaan magacabida xaflada waxa ku jiro alad sida kumbuyutar iyo bahasha shaqada lagu qabto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This allows for the ceremony to be more interactive and engaging for the participants.
entries.translation: Tani waxay u ogaleynsaa xafladaha inay noqoto mid shaqo leh taaso ka qayb qadasho leh.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Overall, traditional customs in Ghana are a major part of the country's culture, and they continue to be practiced today.
entries.translation: Guud ahaan dhaqanka caadooyinka ee Ghana waxay qayb ka yihiin dhaqanka wadanka waxayna sii wadaan in l sameeyo malin kasta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Klaus was a heavy smoker.
entries.translation: Klaus wuxuu aha mid sigaar cabid badan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He smoked a pack of cigarettes a day, and he had been doing so for over 20 years.
entries.translation: Wuxu cabi jiray baakat sigaar ah maalinkii wuxuuna sidaas sameyn jiray in ka badan 20 sano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He knew that smoking was bad for his health, but he couldn't seem to quit.
entries.translation: Wuxuu aha mid ogaa cabista inay u daran tahay cafimaadka laakiin wuxuu u muuqday inuu iska dayn karin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, Klaus was walking down the street when he saw a strange man.
entries.translation: Maalin maalmaha ka mid ah, Klaus oo wadada marayey ayaa wuxuu arkay nin cusub.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The man was wearing a long white coat and had a strange device in his hand.
entries.translation: Ninkaan waxa uu xirnaa jaakad cad oo dheer, wuxuuna gacanta ku sitay qalab yaab leh.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Excuse me," Klaus said. "What are you doing?"
entries.translation: "Iga raali ahow," ayuu yiri Klaus. "Maxaad samaynaysaa?"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I'm a scientist," the man said. "I'm working on a new device that will help people quit smoking."
entries.translation: “Anigu waxaan ahay saynis yahan” ayuu yiri ninkii. "Waxaan ka shaqaynayaa qalab cusub oo dadka ka caawinaya inay joojiyaan sigaarka."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Really?" Klaus said "That's amazing!"
entries.translation: "Runtii?" Klaus ayaa yiri "Taasi waa yaab!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Yes, it is," the man said.
entries.translation: "Haa, way tahay," ninkii aya yiri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "This device will send you to another space where you will be able to see the effects of smoking on your health."
entries.translation: "Qalabkaan wuxuu kuu diri doonaa meel kale oo aad awoodi doonto inaad aragto saameynta sigaarka ku leeyahay caafimaadkaaga."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "That sounds incredible," Klaus said. "I'd like to try it."
entries.translation: "Taasi waxay u muuqataa wax cajiib ah," ayuu yiri Klaus. "Waxaan jeclaan lahaa inaan isku dayo."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The man smiled. "Very well," he said. "Just step into this device and I'll start the process."
entries.translation: Ninkii ayaa dhoola cadeeyey. "Si fiican," ayuu yiri. "Kaliya u gudub qalabkan waxaana bilaabi doonaa habka."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Klaus stepped into the device and the man closed the door behind him.
entries.translation: Klaus ayaa soo galay aaladda, ninkiina albaabka ka dambeeyay ayuu soo xiray.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a beautiful day for a picnic, so my family and I decided to go to the park.
entries.translation: Waxay ahayd maalin qurux badan oo loo dalxiis tago, markaa aniga iyo qoyskayga waxaan go'aansanay inaan aadno beerta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We packed a lunch and set out early in the morning.
entries.translation: Qado ayaan soo qaadanay waxaana soo dhaqaaqnay subaxii hore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When we got to the park, we found a nice spot to spread out our blanket and eat our lunch.
entries.translation: Markii aan gaarnay beerta, waxaan helnay meel wanaagsan oo aan ku kala bixino bustaheena oo aan ku cunno qadadeena.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We had sandwiches, chips, fruit, and cookies.
entries.translation: Waxan cunnay sandwiches, bardho, miro, iyo buskud.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After we ate, we played some games and just enjoyed spending time together.
entries.translation: Ka dib markaan wax cunnay, waxaan ciyaarnay xoogaa ciyaaro ah waxaanan ku raaxaysanay inaan wakhti wada qaadano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We didn't think about anything except having fun.
entries.translation: Waxba kamaan fikirin marka laga reebo madadaalo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a perfect day.
entries.translation: Waxay ahayd maalin dhameystiran.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This hotel is a great choice for those looking for a central location in Lisbon.
entries.translation: Hoteelkaan waa dooq aad u wanaagsan kuwa raadinaya meel dhexe ee Lisbon.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is located just a short walk from the city center and the waterfront, and it offers stunning views of the port.
entries.translation: Wuxuu ku yaalaa meel xoogaa socod ah u jirto bartamaha magaalada iyo jiidda biyaha, waxayna bixisaa aragtiyo cajiib ah oo dekedda ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The rooms are spacious and well-appointed, and the staff is friendly and helpful.
entries.translation: Qolalka waa waasac oo si wanaagsan loo magacaabay, shaqaaluhana waa kuwa saaxiibtinimo leh iyo caawinaad.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The hotel is also very quiet, which is ideal for those who want to get a good night's sleep.
entries.translation: Hoteelka waa mid dagan, kaas oo u ah fakar fiican kuwo rabo meel fican ay seexdeen habeenkii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The rooms are soundproofed, and the hotel is located in a quiet area away from the hustle and bustle of the city center.
entries.translation: Qolalka wa kuwo aan qaylada kasoo gudbeen, hoteelkana waa mid dagan oo ka dheer buuqa iyo sawaxanka ee casimada dhexdeda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Recycling is a vital process that helps to protect the environment and conserve natural resources.
entries.translation: Dib-u-warshadaynta waa hannaan muhiim ah oo ka caawiya ilaalinta deegaanka iyo ilaalinta kheyraadka dabiiciga ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By recycling, we can reduce the amount of waste that goes to landfills and incinerators, conserve energy, and save money.
entries.translation: Dib-u-warshadaynta, waxaan ku yarayn karnaa xadiga qashinka ah ee taga meelaha qashinka lagu guro iyo kuwa lagu gubo, waxaana kaydin karnaa tamarta, waxaanu kaydin karnaa lacag.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The process of recycling begins with the collection of recyclable materials.
entries.translation: Habka dib u warshadaynta waxay ku bilaabataa ururinta alaabta dib loo warshadayn karo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These materials are then sorted and processed into raw materials that can be used to create new products.
entries.translation: Qalabkan ayaa markaa la kala soocaa oo loo farsameeyaa alaab ceeriin ah oo loo isticmaali karo in lagu sameeyo badeecooyin cusub.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Recycling has many benefits.
entries.translation: Dib-u-warshadaynta waxay leedahay faa'iidooyin badan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It helps to reduce the amount of waste that goes to landfills and incinerators, which can help to protect the environment and conserve natural resources.
entries.translation: Waxay kaa caawinaysaa in la yareeyo xadiga qashinka ah ee taga meelaha qashinka lagu guro iyo kuwa lagu gubo, kuwaas oo gacan ka geysan kara ilaalinta deegaanka iyo ilaalinta khayraadka dabiiciga ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Recycling also conserves energy, as it takes less energy to produce products from recycled materials than it does from raw materials.
entries.translation: Dib-u-warshadaynta sidoo kale waxay ilaalisaa tamarta, maadaama ay qaadato tamar yar si loo soo saaro alaabta dib loo warshadeeyay marka loo eego alaabta ceeriin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition, recycling can save money, as it can reduce the need to extract and process raw materials.
entries.translation: Intaa waxaa dheer, dib u warshadaynta waxay badbaadin kartaa lacag, sababtoo ah waxay yareyn kartaa baahida soo saarista iyo farsamaynta alaabta ceeriin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The launch of new recycling programs in most countries has ended the color-coded recycling system.
entries.translation: Daah-furka barnaamijyada dib-u-warshadaynta cusub ee waddammada intooda badan waxay soo afjartay nidaamka dib-u-warshadaynta koodhka-midabka leh.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is because the new programs are designed to accept all recyclable materials, regardless of their color.
entries.translation: Tani waa sababta oo ah barnaamijyada cusub waxaa loogu talagalay inay aqbalaan dhammaan alaabta dib loo warshadayn karo, iyadoon loo eegin midabkooda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The new programs are also more efficient, as they use automated sorting systems to process recyclable materials.
entries.translation: Barnaamijyada cusub sidoo kale aad bay u hufan yihiin, maadaama ay adeegsadaan hababka kala-soocidda otomaatiga ah si ay uga baaraandegaan alaabta dib loo warshadayn karo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The flowers were expensive, but I didn't care.
entries.translation: Ubaxyada waa kuwo qaali ah laakin waxbo iga ma galin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I had to have them.
entries.translation: Waa inaan helo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They were the most beautiful flowers I had ever seen, and I knew they would make her happy.
entries.translation: Ubaxyada ugu badan ee quruxda badn kuwaaso waligood la arkin wana ogahay waxay iga dhigayaan mid faraxsan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I bought a dozen roses, all different colors.
entries.translation: Waxaan soo gaatay qayb ubaxyo ah oo kalaradood kala duwan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I arranged them in a vase and set them on the table next to her bed.
entries.translation: Waxan u hagajiyay si qurxoon oo isleh oo ku safay miis kaasoo ayada ku xigay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She smiled when she saw them. "They're beautiful," she said. "Thank you."
entries.translation: Way dhoola cadeysay wayna aragtay. "Way qurux badan yihiin," ayay tiri. "Waad mahadsantahay."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I smiled back. "You're welcome." I sat down next to her bed and took her hand.
entries.translation: Dib ayaan u dhoola cadeeyey. "Adaa mudan." Sariirteeda agteeda ayaan fadhiistay oo aan gacanta qabtay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She looked up at me with her big, brown eyes.
entries.translation: Waxay igu soo eegtay indhaheeda waaweyn ee maariinka ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I'm so glad you're here," she said. "I'm glad I'm here too," I said.
entries.translation: "Waan ku fraxsnahay inaad inta jogto," ayay tiri. "Waan ku faraxsanahay sidoo kale inaan halkaan joogo," ayaan iri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We talked for a long time.
entries.translation: Waan wadahadalnay in badan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We talked about our dreams, our hopes, and our fears.
entries.translation: Waxaan ka wadahadalnay riyooyinka, rajadena, iyo baqdinteena.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We talked about the future.
entries.translation: Waxaan ka wada hadalnay mustaqbalka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When it was time for me to go, she gave me a hug.
entries.translation: Marki la gaaray wakhtigii aan bixi lahaa, laabta ayay igalisay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Thank you for coming," she said. "I love you."
entries.translation: "Waad ku mahadsantahay imaanshiyaha," ayey tiri. "Waan ku jeclahay."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I love you too," I said.
entries.translation: "Anigana waan ku jeclahay," ayaan ku iri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I kissed her on the forehead and then I left.
entries.translation: Foolka ayaan ka dhunkaday ka dibna waan ka tagay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Cork flooring is a popular choice for many homeowners because it is durable, stylish, and easy to maintain.
entries.translation: Sharaxada dhulka guryaha waa dooq caan dad badan oo guryaha iska leh sababto ah wa mid adag wan ku qurux wan mid la haysan karo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, it is important to know how to properly care for cork flooring in order to extend its lifespan and keep it looking its best.
entries.translation: Si kastaba ha ahaatee, waxa muhimah sida la ogado sida saxda ee sagxada guriga loo ilaaliyo si loo dheereyo si haynta oo ay u ekaato mid fican.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most important things you can do to care for your cork flooring is to sweep, dust, or vacuum it regularly.
entries.translation: Wax yaalaha ugu muhimsan ee looga waraqabi kro sagxada waa in laga nadiifiyo busta iyo aaryada lagu afuuso si joogta ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This will help to remove dirt and debris that can build up on the surface of the flooring and cause it to become damaged.
entries.translation: Tani waxay ka cawini in laga saaro wasaqda oo la buufiyaa foqa kore ee sagxada taso sababi karto dhawac.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you have pets, it is especially important to vacuum your cork flooring regularly to remove pet hair and dander.
entries.translation: Hadaad haysato xayawanka la tarbiyeeyo waxa muhim ah in la farujiyo sagxada malin walbo si loga bixiyo timaha xayawanka iyo dhogorta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition to sweeping, dusting, or vacuuming, you should also occasionally wipe your cork flooring with a damp mop.
entries.translation: Marka lagu daro qaxinta busta ama dabeysha waxad sido kale ka masixi karta sagxada ama la tirtiro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This will help to remove any dirt or grime that has been missed by the vacuum cleaner.
entries.translation: Tani waxay ka cawin inay ka bixiso wasaqda taaso laga tagay hawada nadiifiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, it is important to use a damp mop and not a wet mop, as too much water can damage the cork flooring.
entries.translation: Si kastaba waxa muhim ah inad isticmasho tirtiraha oo adan tirtiro qoyan. In kasto biyaha badan ay dhawici karan sagaxada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you have any spills on your cork flooring, it is important to clean them up as soon as possible.
entries.translation: Hadaad candhuuf ku aragto waxa muhim ah inad isla markiba nadiifiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Use a clean cloth to blot up the spill and then wipe the area with a damp mop.
entries.translation: Isticmaal maro nadiif ah oo ku camujuji ka dibna ku tirtir mesha ayada tirtiraha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If the spill is sticky, you may need to use a mild detergent to clean it up.
entries.translation: Haday candhuufta ku dhagto waxad u bahan tahay omo si aad ugu nadiifiso.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is also important to protect your cork flooring from scratches and dents.
entries.translation: Waxaa sido kale muhim ah in la ilaaliyo sagxada ayado laga ilalinayo dhil dhilaca iyo dhag dhaga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: To do this, you can place felt pads under furniture legs and avoid dragging heavy objects across the floor.
entries.translation: Si ad san u sameyso waxad dhigtaa kartaa suuf fadhiga lugihisa iskana ilali inad ku jiido alabta culus sagxada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You should also avoid using sharp objects on your cork flooring, as this can damage the surface.
entries.translation: Waa inaad sido kale ka ilaisa alabta dilacin karta sagxada midan madama ay dhawici karto qeebta kore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By following these tips, you can help to keep your cork flooring looking its best for years to come.
entries.translation: Adigoo racayo tilabahan muhimka ah waxad ku cawin karta sagxada inay ahato mid fican sanadaha so socdo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition to the tips above, there are a few other things you can do to care for your cork flooring.
entries.translation: Marka lagu daro tilaboyinka kuwa hore waxa jiro siyaboyin kale oo lagu ilalin karo sagxada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: First, avoid using harsh chemicals on your cork flooring, as these can damage the surface.
entries.translation: Marka hore iska ilaali madoyinka kulul inaad ku isticmasho sagxada madama ay tan dhawici karto dusha sare.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Second, do not expose your cork flooring to direct sunlight for long periods of time, as this can cause the color to fade.
entries.translation: Mraka labad haku dayn sagxada qoraxda waqti dheer madama ay tan rinjiga ka dhameyn karo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Finally, if you are planning to move your furniture around, be careful not to drag it across the floor, as this can also damage the surface.
entries.translation: Ugu danbeyn hadaad qorshaynaysay inaad bixiso alabta guriga ha ku jiidin sagxada madama ay tan dhawici karto fooqa kore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By following these tips, you can help to extend the life of your cork flooring and keep it looking its best for years to come.
entries.translation: Adigo racayo tilaboyinkan waxad ku cawin karta inaad dheereyso jirtanka sagxada kana dhig mid fican waqti badan oo so socdo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Refrigerators and freezers are essential appliances for keeping food and beverages fresh.
entries.translation: Firiijyada iyo qabojiyasha waa qalab muhim ah kuwaso ka dhigo cuntada iyo cabitanada kuwo cusub.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The refrigerant then passes through the condenser coils, where it releases the heat to the outside air * Thermostat: This controls the temperature inside the refrigerator and freezer.
entries.translation: Qaboojiyaha wuxu mariya meertada qabojiyaha halkas oo ay soo si dayso kuleelka bananka kaydiye heer kulka wuxu mamula heerkulka gudagha firiijka iyo qabojiyaha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The total amount of heat that a refrigerator or freezer can remove from its contents is called the cooling capacity.
entries.translation: Isku darka kuleylka ee qaboojiyaha iyo firijak ay so si dayan aya waxa la dhaha qaboojiye side.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The cooling capacity is measured in British thermal units (BTUs) per hour.
entries.translation: Qaboojiye side waxaa lagu cabiraa British thermal unit (BTUs) saacadi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Refrigerators and freezers are typically rated by their total cooling capacity.
entries.translation: Firijka iyo qaboojiyaha waxa lagu qimeyaa isku darka qiimaha qaboowga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The history of Burkina Faso is long and complex, but one of the most important events in the country's history was the 1983 coup d'état that brought Thomas Sankara to power.
entries.translation: Tariiqda burkisa faso waa mid dheer oo balaran laakin dhacdooyinka ugu muhimsan ee tariiqada wadanka afgambigi 1983 ee uu sameyay Thomas Sankara ee awoodo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sankara was a young military officer who was deeply committed to social justice and economic development.
entries.translation: Sankara askari yar oo sargal ah kaso ay ka go nayd cadalada bulshada iyo hormarinta dhaqlaha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He quickly implemented a series of radical reforms, including nationalizing banks and industry, redistributing land, and promoting women's rights.
entries.translation: Wuxuu si dhaqsa ah u dar dara galiyay dib u habenta xagjirnimada oo ay ka mid yihiin wadaniyeenta bangiyada iyo dib u qaybinta wrashadaha iyo hormarinta xuuquqda dumarka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sankara's policies were popular with many Burkinabés, but they also alienated powerful interests, both within the country and abroad.
entries.translation: Shurucda Sankara waxay ahyeen kuwo caan ah dadka badan oo reer Burkinabes laakin waxa sido kale fogaday xiisent awooda mala isku daro gudaha iyo dibada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1987, Sankara was assassinated in a coup d'état led by Blaise Compaoré.
entries.translation: 1987-kii Sankara waxa lagu dilay afgambi uu hogaminayay Blaise Compaore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Compaoré ruled Burkina Faso for 27 years, during which time he reversed many of Sankara's reforms and established a repressive authoritarian regime.
entries.translation: Compaore wuxu hogamiyay Burkina Faso 27 sano waqtigisa wuxu so celiyay habenti Sankara wuxuna dhisay waqti awood caburineed.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 2014, Compaoré was overthrown in a popular uprising, and Burkina Faso is currently in a fragile state of transition.
entries.translation: Compaore waa la afgambiyay 2014-kii kicista caanta Burkina Faso hadda waa wadan nugul oo isbadal ku jira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Despite the challenges it faces, Burkina Faso has a long history of resilience and progress.
entries.translation: Intaas marka laga so tago caqabadah ay wajahday, Burkin Faso waa wadan tariiq dheer leh oo adkeysi leh iyo hor usocod.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The country has a rich culture and a strong sense of national identity.
entries.translation: Wadanka wuxuu qani ku yahay dhaqan iyo dareen shaqsiyad wadaninimo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Burkinabés are a proud people who are determined to build a better future for themselves and their children.
entries.translation: Burkinabes waa dad ku faano oo ay ka go'antahay inay dhisaan mustaqbal fican ayaga iyo carururtoda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As the sun began to set, a young boy named Raman made his way home from school.
entries.translation: Markay qoraxda si dhacay wiil yar oo lagu magacabo Raman aya kaso baxay dusiga una socday xafada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As he walked, he noticed a stray dog following him.
entries.translation: Intuu socday wuxu ogaday aya daba socdo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The dog was dirty and skinny, but it had a friendly face.
entries.translation: Ayga wuxu ahaa mid wasaq ah oo caato ah laakin wuxu laha waji saxibtinimo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Raman felt sorry for the dog, so he decided to take it home with him.
entries.translation: Ramana wuxu daremay ka xuman ee ayga wuxu go'ansaday inuu guriga u qato.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When Raman got home, he told his parents about the dog.
entries.translation: Marku guriga imaday wuxu waladiinta usheegay xalada ayga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They were hesitant at first, but they eventually agreed to let him keep the dog.
entries.translation: Marki hore way ka laba labeyeeen laakin waxay ku aqbaleen inuu ayga uu hayo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Raman named the dog Buddy, and they quickly became best friends.
entries.translation: Raman wuxu ku magacabay ayga Buddy si dhaqsa ah ayeeyna saxibo unoqdeen.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Buddy was always there for Raman, no matter what.
entries.translation: Buddy wuxu had iyo jeer ahaa mid ka warqabo Ramana meel kasto iyo marxald kasto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was there to greet him at the door when he came home from school, and he was there to comfort him when he was feeling down.
entries.translation: Wuxuu ahaa mid salamo marku dugsiga ka yimado sido kalana u laba qaboojiyo marku yara xumaado.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, Raman was playing in the park when he fell and scraped his knee.
entries.translation: Maalin maalmaha ka mid ah, Ramana wuxuu aha mid ku ciyaray beerta marku dhacay oo jilibka ka xoqmay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He started to cry, and Buddy came running over to lick his wound.
entries.translation: Wuxu bilabay inuu ooyo, Budyy ayaa kusoo orday wuxuna bilabay inu ka leefo dhawaca.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The dog's gentle tongue helped to soothe Raman's pain, and he soon forgot all about his injury.
entries.translation: Carabka ayga ee jilicsana aya ka cawiyay inuu Ramana xanunka ka yarado wuxuna hilamamay dhawicii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Raman and Buddy shared many happy years together.
entries.translation: Ramana iyo Buddy waxay wada qateen wakhti badan oo farxad ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They went on walks, played fetch in the park, and cuddled up on the couch together.
entries.translation: Socod ayay galeen, beerta nasashada ayay ku ciyaareen, oo sariirtii ayay isla koolkooliyeen.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The sci-fi movie industry has been on a downward slide in recent years, with fewer and fewer films being produced.
entries.translation: Warashadaha filimaanta waxay hoos u dhaceen sanadihi lasoo dhaafay ayagoo soo saarayay filimo yar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In fact, a recent study by the Motion Picture Association of America found that the number of sci-fi films released in theaters declined from 20 in 2010 to just 10 in 2015.
entries.translation: Dhab ahaantii, daraasad dhowaan ay samaysay Ururka Sawirada Motion Picture of America waxay ogaatay in tirada filimada sci-fi ee lagu sii daayay tiyaatarada ay hoos uga dhacday 20 ee 2010 ilaa 10 kaliya 2015.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are a number of reasons for this decline, including the rise of superhero movies and the increasing popularity of streaming services.
entries.translation: Waxa jiro tiro sababyso dib u dhacaan, waxaana ka mid ah kor u kaca filimada kuwan an caadiga ahyn iyo koritaanka caannimada adeega joogtada ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Superhero movies have become increasingly popular in recent years, thanks to the success of franchises like the Marvel Cinematic Universe and the DC Extended Universe.
entries.translation: Filimanta Superhero waxay noqdeen ay si koreysaa canimadooda ee la sanadihi laso dhafay wad mahadsn tihin guusha franchises sida Marvel Cinematic Universe iyo DC Extended Universe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These films offer audiences a mix of action, adventure, and spectacle that is often lacking in sci-fi films.
entries.translation: Filimadani waxay siiyaan daawadayaasha waxqabadyo isugu jira, tacabur, iyo muqaal kuwaas oo inta badan ka maqan filimada sci-fi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Streaming services have also had a negative impact on the sci-fi movie industry.
entries.translation: Adeegyada qulqulka ayaa sidoo kale saameyn xun ku yeeshay warshadaha filimada sci-fi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These services offer a wide variety of content, including sci-fi films, at a relatively low cost.
entries.translation: Adeegyadani waxay bixiyaan waxyaabo badan oo kala duwan, oo ay ku jiraan filimada sci-fi, oo qiimo jaban ah.

entries.english: Urinary tract infections (UTIs) are a common problem, especially for women.

entries.english: In some cases, UTIs can lead to more serious problems, such as kidney infections.

entries.english: In some cases, bladder stones can block the urethra, which can lead to a life-threatening emergency.

entries.english: In some cases, kidney diseases can lead to kidney failure, which is a fatal condition.

entries.english: "Yes, I am," the man said. "I've been studying dinosaurs for many years."
entries.translation: "Haa, waan ahay," ayuu ninkii yiri. "Waxaan baranayay dinosaurs sanado badan."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The boy was excited to meet a real paleontologist, and he asked him many questions about dinosaurs.
entries.translation: Wiilku aad ayuu ugu farxay inuu la kulmo khabiir paleontologist dhab ah, wuxuuna waydiiyay su'aalo badan oo ku saabsan dinosauryada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The man answered all of his questions patiently, and the boy learned a lot about these fascinating creatures.
entries.translation: Ninkii ayaa su’aalihiisii ​​oo dhan uga jawaabay si dulqaad leh, wiilkuna wax badan ayuu ka bartay makhluuqan soo jiidashada leh.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After a while, the boy's parents called him over, and he said goodbye to the paleontologist.
entries.translation: Muddo ka dib, waalidkii wiilka ayaa u yeedhay, wuxuuna ku macsalaameeyay dhakhtarkii paleontologist.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Freedom: A Personal Perspective
entries.translation: Xorriyadda: Aragti Shaqsiyeed
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Freedom is a word that has been used and abused by so many people, in so many contexts, that it has almost lost its meaning.
entries.translation: Xoriyaddu waa erey ay dad badani adeegsadeen oo ay ku takri faleen, marka laga eego duruufo badan, oo ay ku sigtay inay macnihiisii ​​lumaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But for me, freedom is a very simple thing.
entries.translation: Laakiin aniga, xorriyaddu waa shay aad u fudud.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is the ability to live my life on my own terms, without being controlled or oppressed by others.
entries.translation: Waa kartida aan noloshayda ugu noolaan karo si gooni ah, iyada oo aan cid kale xukumin ama dulmin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was born into a time and place where women were not considered to be fully equal to men.
entries.translation: Waxaan ku dhashay waqti iyo meel aan dumarka loo tixgalin inay si buuxda ula siman yihiin ragga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We were expected to stay at home, raise children, and take care of our husbands.
entries.translation: Waxaa nala sugayay inaan guriga joogno, caruurna korinno, oo aan daryeelno nimankeena.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But I never wanted to live that kind of life.
entries.translation: Laakiin weligay ma jeclayn inaan ku noolaado nolosha noocaas ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I wanted to be free to pursue my own dreams, to learn and grow, and to make a difference in the world.
entries.translation: Waxaan doonayey in aan xor u ahaado in aan riyooyinkayga raadsado, in aan barto oo aan koro, oo aan isbeddel ku sameeyo adduunka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was fortunate to have parents who supported my ambitions.
entries.translation: Waxaan nasiib u yeeshay inaan haysto waalid taageersan hamigayga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They encouraged me to go to college, to get a job, and to live my life on my own terms.
entries.translation: Waxa ay igu dhiirigaliyeen in aan aado kulliyad, si aan shaqo u helo, iyo in aan noloshayda ku noolaado si aan kaligeyga rabo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And I am grateful for the opportunities that I have had to travel, to meet new people, and to learn about different cultures.
entries.translation: Oo waxaan ka mahadcelinayaa fursadaha aan helay inaan ku safro, la kulmo dad cusub, iyo inaan barto dhaqamo kala duwan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But I know that not everyone is as lucky as I was.
entries.translation: Laakiin waan ogahay in aan qof walba nasiib u helin sidii aan ahay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are still many people in the world who are denied their freedom, simply because of their race, their gender, or their religion.
entries.translation: Wali waxaa jira dad badan oo aduunka ku nool oo loo diiday xoriyadooda, sababtuna waa isirkooda, jinsigooda ama diintooda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A hospital is a healthcare institution providing patient treatment in an inpatient setting.
entries.translation: Cisbitaalka waa meel cafimaad taso bixiso daweyn iyo meel bukaanka joogo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Inpatient care is provided by hospital inpatient departments, emergency departments and outpatient clinics.
entries.translation: Daryeelka bukaank jiifka ka war qabkisa waxa lagu bixiyaa bukan jiifka waxada, waxada dag daga iyo kuwa bukaan socodka faramashiyaas.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hospitals are usually staffed by professional and registered nurses, physicians, and other health professionals.
entries.translation: Cusbitalada waxa u qadmeeyo dad u taba baran iyo kalakalisooyinn dadka dawada ku taqsusay dadka kale kutaqsusay cafimaadka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A hospital can also include a number of support departments, such as medical records, pharmacy, laboratory, radiology, and rehabilitation.
entries.translation: Cusbitaalka waxa ka mid ah waxa tageero ah sida dajinta cafimadka, farmashiga shaybaar, iyo kuwa mashimaha iyo kuwa dhaqancelinta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hospitals are often classified by the type of care they provide, such as general hospitals, specialty hospitals, and psychiatric hospitals.
entries.translation: Cusbitalada waxa lagu kala sara waxaqabka ay bixiyaan sida cusbitalka guud midka taqsuska kan miskaxad.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: General hospitals provide a wide range of services, including medical, surgical, obstetrical, and pediatric care.
entries.translation: Cusbutalka guud, waxay bixiyaan adeegyo badan waxa ka mid ah dawoyinta qalin, nafaqeynta umusha dhaqtarka caruurta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Specialty hospitals focus on a particular type of care, such as cancer care, cardiac care, or orthopedic care.
entries.translation: Cusbitalada qaaska ah waxay muujada saran qab ka warqabka mid ah kansarka daryeelka, daryelka wadnaha, daryeel lafaha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Psychiatric hospitals provide care for people with mental illness.
entries.translation: Cusbitalada dhimirka wuxu daryel siyaa dadka maskaxada laga hayo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hospitals are an important part of the healthcare system.
entries.translation: Cusbitaalka waa qayb muhim ah ee cafimadka isku xiro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They provide care for a variety of illnesses and injuries, and they play a vital role in the prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of disease.
entries.translation: Waxay bixiyaan daryeelo xanuno iyo dhawacyo waxayna ka ciyareen door muhim ah si looga hortago, ogaansho iyo dawenta cudurka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hospitals also provide education and training for healthcare professionals, and they conduct research to improve the quality of care.
entries.translation: Cusbital wuxu cafimaad iyo tababar cafimaad daryeel ee heer saro, waxay sameyeen baritaan ay ku hormarinaysaa qimeynta daryeel.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The history of hospitals dates back to ancient times.
entries.translation: Tariiqda cusbitaalka waxay dib ogu labatay waqtigi hore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The first hospitals were established in India, China, and Greece.
entries.translation: Cusbitalki ugu horeyay waxa laga dhisay Hindiya, Jayna, iyo Giriga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the Middle Ages, hospitals were often run by religious organizations.
entries.translation: Wakhtigi dhexe cusbitalada waxa gacanta ku ahyn jiray mamulo diimeed.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The first time I tried embroidery, I was determined to make a small, intricate design.
entries.translation: Marki ugu horeeyo waxan isku dayay fanka waxan go'ansaday inaan sameeyo dhiseyn.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I chose a pattern with lots of tiny stitches, and I started working on it with great enthusiasm.
entries.translation: Waxaan doortay lambaro kuwaaso godad leh waxana bilabay inan shaqeeyo si daren qimeyn leh.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, after a few hours, I realized that I was making a mistake.
entries.translation: Si kastaba ha ahaatee, waxaan ogaday inaan khalad sameynayo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The stitches were too small and tight, and my hand was cramping up.
entries.translation: Tolmada way yartahay wayna adgatahay gacanata way casrisanayd.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I decided to put the project aside and try something else.
entries.translation: Waxan go'ansaday inaan qorshaha meel dhigo oo isku dayo wax.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The next time I tried embroidery, I chose a larger pattern with looser stitches.
entries.translation: Marka danabo isku dayo fankan waxan dortay lambar kaso tolmo yar leh.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This made a big difference!
entries.translation: Tani waa kala duwanan weyn!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was able to work on the project for longer periods of time without getting tired, and the stitches were easier to make.
entries.translation: Waxana awooday inaa shaqada si qabto wakhti badan anigoona ka daalayn tolamada waxay ahayd mid fudud.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was also able to create a more beautiful result.
entries.translation: Waxaan awooday inaan sameeyo jawaaba qurux badan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you're new to embroidery, I recommend starting with a larger pattern with looser stitches.
entries.translation: Hadaad ku cusubtahay shaqada fanka waxaan kugu dhiri galinlahaa inaad ka bilowdo batanada tolmada waa weyn.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This will make it easier to learn the basic stitches and techniques.
entries.translation: Tani waxay ka dhigaysaa mid fudud inaad barato aas aaska tolmada iyo farsameeda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once you've mastered the basics, you can start experimenting with smaller patterns and tighter stitches.
entries.translation: Markaad barto aas aaska waxad bilaabi kartaa kuwo yar iyo kuwo adag.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The capital and largest city in Malawi is Lilongwe.
entries.translation: Caasimada iyo magaala madaxdada ugu weyn Malawi waa Lilongwe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Malawi is a diverse country with a rich culture and history.
entries.translation: Malwai wa wadan kala duwan oo qani ku ah dhaqnka iyo tariiqda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some of the most important places in Malawi include Lake Malawi, the Shire River, and the Nyika Plateau.
entries.translation: Meelaha ugu muhimsan ee Malawi waa dooxada Malawi, wabiga Shire, iyo kaynta Nyika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Lake Malawi is the third-largest lake in Africa and is home to a wide variety of fish and other wildlife.
entries.translation: Dooxda Malawi waa dooxda sedexaad ee ugu weyn Afrika waxayna guri utahay noocyo badan oo kaluun iyo duurjoog ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Shire River is a major tributary of the Zambezi River and is an important source of water for irrigation and transportation.
entries.translation: Wabiga Shire waa qayb weyn oo ka mid ah Wabiga Zambezi waana muhim wuxuuna il dhaqaale u yahay isku socodka dadka iyo beeraha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Nyika Plateau is a highland region in northern Malawi and is home to a variety of wildlife, including elephants, lions, and leopards.
entries.translation: Kaynta Nyika waa gobol dhul-dheer ah ee waqooyiga Malawi wuxuna guri yahay duurjoogta ay ka mid yihiin maroodiga, libaaxa iyo shabeelka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some of the most important historical figures in Malawi include David Livingstone, John Chilembwe, and Hastings Kamuzu Banda.
entries.translation: Mida ugu muhimsan ee tariiqda Malawi waxa ka mid ah David Livingstone, John Chilmebwe iyo Hasting Kamuzu Banda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Livingstone was a Scottish missionary and explorer who was instrumental in the abolition of the slave trade in Africa.
entries.translation: Livingstone wuxu aha mid iskotish ah oo diinta iyo dalxiise kaas oo ka qaybqaatay gacanasiga doonta ee Afrika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Chilembwe was a Malawian Baptist minister who led an uprising against British colonial rule in 1915.
entries.translation: Chilembwe wuxu aha masiixi dadka wacdiyo kaas oo kasoo jeeda gumeystihi ingiriska mamulkooda 1915-kii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Banda was the first president of Malawi and ruled the country from 1964 to 1994.
entries.translation: Banda wuxu aha madaxweynahay dalka Malawi soo hogaamiyay lag soo bilaabo 1964-kii ila 1994-kii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Golden Temple, a shimmering monument to human vanity and folly, stands as a testament to the destructive power of desire.
entries.translation: Masjidki dahabka ahaa malmihi nuurayay ee bina adamka qiimaha u lahayd ee gacanta lagu qurxiyay waxay u tagan tahay kala hagitaanka awooda la qaribay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a place where dreams are made and broken, where hopes are raised and dashed, and where love and hate, life and death, are all inextricably intertwined.
entries.translation: Waa meel riyooyinka lagu dhiso ama lagu dumiyo rajada lagu muujiyo ama laga tago mesha jacelka ama naceeb nolasha iyo geerida kuli ay ku bur buran ama lagu dhiso.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The temple was built by a wealthy maharaja who wanted to create a place where he could worship his god in peace.
entries.translation: Macbadka waxa dhisay malqabeenka maharaja kaso rabay inuu ka dhigo meel uu ku caabudo Allah si nabad ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, the temple quickly became a magnet for pilgrims from all over the world, and it soon became a place of commerce and trade.
entries.translation: Si kastaba ha ahaatee, macbadka wuxuu noqday meel soo jidato dadka xajiyo ee adunka ka kala yimado waxayna mar dhaw noqotay meed ganacsi iyo beec mushtar ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The maharaja's dream of a peaceful place of worship was quickly shattered, and the temple became a place of greed, corruption, and violence.
entries.translation: Riyada Maharaja ee meel nabad ah oo wax lagu caabudo waxa si dhaqsa ah loo badalay waxayna noqotay meel hungiri loo isticmaalo oo musuq ma suq iyo gacan ka hadal ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, a young man named Amritsar arrived at the temple.
entries.translation: Maalin maalmaha ka mid ah, wiil yar oo lagu magacaabo Amritsar ayaa imaaday macbadkii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was a simple man with a simple dream: to find peace and happiness.
entries.translation: Wuxuu ahaa nin iska fudud oo riyo fudud leh: kaas oo rabo inuu helo nabad iyo farxad.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, Amritsar soon found that the temple was no place for peace.
entries.translation: Si kastaba ha ahaatee, sheekada noocaan ah waxa laga dhex helaa inay aysan aheyn meel nabad ah macbadka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was drawn into the vortex of greed and corruption, and he eventually lost everything he had.
entries.translation: Wuxu dhex galay oo dabshay oo hunguriga iska qaday, iyo musuq maasuq xaqiiqadi wax walbo wuu wayay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Amritsar's story is a cautionary tale about the dangers of desire.
entries.translation: Shekada Amristar dadka dareenkooda kicinayso oo looga ilalinayo qatarta ay leedahay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a reminder that the things we crave most may not be what is best for us.
entries.translation: Waxay na xasusinaysaa shayyaasha aan isku dhajino kuwaas oo noo ficnayn.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So, where are we headed today?
