entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But at the reunion, she finally saw that they were wrong.
entries.translation: Laakindib usoo labashadeeda waxay ugu danbeyn ogaatay inay qaldanyeen.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was worthy of love, and she deserved to be happy.
entries.translation: Waxay u qalan tay in la jeclaado waxay ku habonayd inay faraxsanan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Bella's anger was healthy because it was a response to the injustice she had faced.
entries.translation: Bella xanaqeeda waa mid caafimad leh sabbto ah waxaya ahayd falcelin teeda cadalad daro ay wajahday.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was angry that she had been made to feel ashamed of herself, and she was angry that she had been denied her right to love.
entries.translation: Waxay ku xanaqsanayd inay dareen ceeb oo ayada aqbasho waxay ahayd mid ka xanqasan in loo diday xaq ay wax ku jeclaato.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But her anger was also productive.
entries.translation: Laakiin xanaaqeeda ayaa sidoo kale ahaa mid waxtar leh.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It motivated her to fight for her rights, and it helped her to reclaim her sense of self-worth.
entries.translation: Waxa dhiri galiyay inay u dagalanto xuuquqdeda waxay ka cawisay inay dib u hesho dareen qiimo leh.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: At the reunion, Bella finally found the strength to stand up for herself.
entries.translation: Dib usoo labashadeeda, Bella waxay ugu dambeyntii heshay xoog ay ugu istaagto nafteeda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A young woman is searching for food in a dumpster.
entries.translation: Gabar dhalinyaro ah ayaa meel qashin qub ah cunto ka raadinaysa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She is wearing tattered clothing and her hair is matted.
entries.translation: Waxay xidhatay dhar jeexjeexan, timaheedana waa gogoshay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She looks around cautiously, as if she is afraid of being caught.
entries.translation: Si taxadar leh ayay hareeraha u eegtay, sidii iyadoo ka baqaysa in la qabto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She finds a few cans of food and puts them in a bag.
entries.translation: Waxay heshay dhawr qasac oo cunto ah waxayna ku ridday bac.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She then walks away, her mind filled with thoughts of how she will feed herself and her children.
entries.translation: Dabadeed way iska sii socotaa, iyadoo maskaxdeeda ay ka buuxaan fikrado ku saabsan sidii ay nafteeda iyo carruurteeda u quudin lahayd.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The little girl stood on the street corner, shivering in the cold.
entries.translation: Gabadhi yareed waxay istaag tay koonaha wadad ayadoo jareynayso qabowga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She had been trying to sell matches all day, but no one had bought any.
entries.translation: Waxay isku dayeeysay inay wax u hesho laakin qof wax u gaday malahan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was about to give up when she saw a man approaching.
entries.translation: Waxay mid kasi niyad jabysay ila marki danbe ay aragtay nin aya kuso wajahan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He looked like he was in a hurry, but he stopped when he saw the little girl.
entries.translation: Wuxu u muuqaday inuu dag dagayo laakin wuu istagay marku gabadhi yareed arkay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "What are you doing out here all alone?" he asked.
entries.translation: "Maxaad ka samaynaysaa halkaan kaligaa?" ayuu waydiiyay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I'm trying to sell matches," the little girl said. "But no one will buy them."
entries.translation: "Waxan isku dayayaa inaan taraq gado," ayeey tiri gabadha yar. "Laakin qofna igama gadanaayo."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Well, I'll buy one," the man said "But you have to give me a rose in exchange."
entries.translation: "Hagaag, mid waan iibsan doonaa," ayuu ninkii yiri "Laakiin waa inaad i siisaa ubax aad ku beddesho."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The little girl was surprised, but she agreed.
entries.translation: Gabdhi yareed way yaabtay wayna aqbashay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She ran home and picked a beautiful rose.
entries.translation: Waxay u carartay gurigi waxayna qadatay ubixi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Then she went back to the man and gave him the match and the rose.
entries.translation: Waxay dib ugu labatay ninki waxayna sisay ubixi iyo taraqii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Thank you," the man said "You're a kind girl." He took the match and lit it.
entries.translation: "Mahadsanid," ayuu ninkii yiri "Waxaad tahay gabar naxariis badan." Kabriidkii ayuu qaaday oo shiday.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As the flame grew, the little girl saw that it was a magic match.
entries.translation: Holaci aya si siyaday gabdhi yareedna waxay u aragtay inuu yahay taraq sixiroolo ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It turned into a beautiful bouquet of roses.
entries.translation: Waxay isku badashay xirmo ubaxyaal ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The little girl was so happy.
entries.translation: Gabadhi yareed ad ayeey u faraxday.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The elephants can roam freely without fear of being hunted, and the farmers can be sure that their crops will not be destroyed.
entries.translation: Maroodiga wuu wareegi kara asagona ka baqayn in la wax yeleeyo beera laydana waxay hubaan inan beerahooda la bur burinayn.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Radio collars are small devices that are attached to an animal's neck.
entries.translation: Qalbka yarka oo lagu xakameyo duur joogta aya lagu xiraa luqunta xayawanka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They emit a signal that can be tracked by a receiver.
entries.translation: Qalbka lagu la xiriro waxa la socdo qofka helay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This allows scientists to track the animal's movements over time.
entries.translation: Tani waxay u ogalanysa saynis yahaynada inay la socdaan dhaq dhaqa xayawanka waqti ya hore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the case of elephants, this information can be used to create maps of their home ranges and to identify areas where they are most likely to come into conflict with humans.
entries.translation: Arinat maroodiga aqbaartan waxa lo isticmaali kaaraa in lagu dhiso qariirad guri oo xadidan oo laga ogaado mesha ay isku qilafan bina adamka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Farmers can use this information to take steps to protect their crops from elephants.
entries.translation: Beera layda wax isticmaali karaan aqabartan si ay kaga hortagan maroodiga dalagooda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can build fences, plant thorny bushes, or use other methods to deter elephants from entering their fields.
entries.translation: Waxay dhisi karaan darbi oo ku oodayo gedaha qodaxda leh ama qabab kale oo kaga hortago maroodiga garoonkooda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By working together, scientists and farmers can help to keep both elephants and humans safe.
entries.translation: Wada shaqynta saynis yahanada iyo beera layda waxay ka cawin karaan in labadaba maroodiga iyo dadka ay bad badan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Here is an example of how radio collars have been used to help elephants and farmers.
entries.translation: Tani waa tusaale sidu u cawin jiray qalbakan maroodiga iyo beeralayda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In Kenya, scientists from the University of Cambridge have been working with local communities to track the movements of elephants.
entries.translation: Kenya, saynis yahanada jamacada Cambridge waxay ka shaqaynayeen dadka magalada inay la socdaan dhaq dhaqaq maroodiga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This information has been used to create maps of the elephants' home ranges.
entries.translation: Aqaartan waxa loo isticmalay qarirad qiyaasta guriga maroodiga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The maps have been shared with farmers, who have used them to build fences around their fields.
entries.translation: Qarirada waxa loo qaybiyay beeralayda kuwaso u isticmalay inay dhistaan dayr ku wareegsan berahooda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This has helped to reduce the number of conflicts between elephants and humans.
entries.translation: Tani waxay ka cawisay inay qar ka mid qilaafka u dhaxeeyay dadka iyo maroodiga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Radio collars are a valuable tool for studying elephants and for helping to reduce human-elephant conflict.
entries.translation: Collars raadiyaha waa qalab qiimo leh oo lagu barto maroodiga iyo caawinta yaraynta iskahorimaadka maroodiga iyo bini'aadamka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They provide scientists with valuable information about elephant behavior, and they can help farmers to protect their crops.
entries.translation: Waxay siyanis yahaynada bixyaan aqaar wax ku ool ah oo mku sabsan dabecada maroodiga taso cawin karta beralayda inay ilalistaan dagalagooda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By working together, scientists and farmers can help to create a future where elephants and humans can live together in harmony.
entries.translation: Marka la wada shaqeeyo, saynisyahannada iyo beeralaydu waxay gacan ka geysan karaan abuuritaanka mustaqbal halkaas oo maroodiga iyo bini'aadamku ay ku wada noolaan karaan si wada jir ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Mali Empire was a West African empire that reached its peak in the 13th and 14th centuries.
entries.translation: Boqortooyadii Maali waxay ahayd boqortooyo galbeedka Afrika ah oo gaadhay heerkii ugu sarreeyey qarniyadii 13aad iyo 14aad.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was founded by Sundiata Keita in 1235 and stretched from the Atlantic Ocean to the Niger River.
entries.translation: Waxaa aasaasay Sundiata Keita 1235 waxayna ku fidsan tahay badweynta Atlantic ilaa webiga Niger.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Mali Empire was a major center of trade and learning, and its rulers were known for their wealth and power.
entries.translation: Boqortooyada Maali waxay ahayd xarun weyn oo ganacsi iyo waxbarasho, madaxdeedana waxay caan ku ahaayeen maal iyo awood.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The empire declined in the 15th century, and was eventually conquered by the Songhai Empire in the 16th century.
entries.translation: Boqortooyada ayaa hoos u dhacday qarnigii 15aad, waxaana ugu dambeyntii qabsaday Boqortooyada Songhai qarnigii 16aad.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most important events in Mali's history was the Battle of Kirina in 1235.
entries.translation: Mid ka mid ah dhacdooyinka ugu muhiimsan ee taariikhda Maali wuxuu ahaa Dagaalkii Kirina ee 1235.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This battle marked the end of the Ghana Empire and the rise of the Mali Empire.
entries.translation: Dagaalkani waxa uu calaamad u ahaa dhamaadkii Boqortooyadii Ghana iyo soo ifbaxa Boqortooyadii Maali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sundiata Keita, the founder of the Mali Empire, led his army to victory over the forces of the Ghana Empire.
entries.translation: Sundiata Keita, oo ahaa aasaasihii Boqortooyada Mali, ayaa ciidankiisa u horseeday guul ay ka gaareen xoogagii Boqortooyada Ghana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This victory gave Sundiata Keita control of the gold mines of the Sahel region, and helped to establish the Mali Empire as a major power in West Africa.
entries.translation: Guushan waxay Sundiata Keita siisay inay gacanta ku dhigto macdanta dahabka ee gobolka Saaxil, waxayna gacan ka gaysatay aasaaska Boqortooyada Mali oo ah awood weyn oo ku taal Galbeedka Afrika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another important event in Mali's history was the reign of Mansa Musa.
entries.translation: Dhacdo kale oo muhiim u ah taariikhda Mali waxay ahayd xukunkii Mansa Musa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mansa Musa was the third ruler of the Mali Empire, and he reigned from 1312 to 1337.
entries.translation: Mansa Musa wuxuu ahaa taliyihii saddexaad ee Boqortooyada Maali, wuxuuna xukunka hayay 1312 ilaa 1337.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In a Google spreadsheet, an absolute reference will always refer to the same cell, regardless of where it is copied or moved to.
entries.translation: Xaashida faafinta Google, tixraac dhammaystiran ayaa had iyo jeer tixraaci doona isla unugga, iyada oo aan loo eegin meesha laga guuriyo ama loo guuro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Absolute references are useful for cells that contain data that you do not want to change when you copy or move the formula.
entries.translation: Tix raca dhamaystiran waxay wax u taran godadka xashida taaso ay ku jiraan xog oo aadan rabin inay badalaan marka dabacdid mid la mid ah ama dhaqajisid qaacidada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, if you have a formula that calculates the total sales for each month, you would want to use an absolute reference for the cell that contains the starting date.
entries.translation: Tusaale ahaan hadad haysid qaacido wax lagu xisabiyo isku darka waxa lagaday bil kasta waxa u bahan tahay inad isticmaasho tix raaca saxda ee godka kaso ku kaydsan tahay bilowga tariiqda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This way, the formula will always refer to the same cell, even if you copy it to a different row or column.
entries.translation: Qaabkan qaacida waxay ola jeedi doonta gud isku mid ah hadi xitaa aad ka bixiso mid la mid ah adoo safaf iyo dheerar kala kuwan ula jeeda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can create an absolute reference by adding a dollar sign ($) to the row number and column letter of the cell reference.
entries.translation: Waxaad samayn kartaa tixraac dhammaystiran adigoo ku daraya calaamad dollar ($) lambarka safka iyo xarafka tixraaca unugga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, the absolute reference for the cell A1 would be $A$1.
entries.translation: Tusaale ahaan, tixraaca saxda ah ee unugga A1 wuxuu noqonayaa $ A$1.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can also use absolute references to reference a range of cells.
entries.translation: Waxa kale oo aad isticmaali kartaa tixraacyo dhammaystiran si aad u tixraacdo tiro unugyo ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: To do this, add a dollar sign to the row number and column letter of each cell in the range.
entries.translation: Si taas loo sameeyo, ku dar calaamad dollar lambarka safka iyo xarafka safka ee unug kasta oo kala duwan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, the absolute reference for the range A1:B1 would be $A$1:$B$1.
entries.translation: Tusaale ahaan, tixraaca dhammaystiran ee kala duwanaanta A1:B1 waxay noqonaysaa $A$1:$B$1.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Absolute references are a powerful tool that can be used to make your formulas more flexible and easier to use.
entries.translation: Tixraacyada dhammaystiran waa qalab awood leh oo loo isticmaali karo in hab-raacyadaada laga dhigo kuwo dabacsan oo sahlan in la isticmaalo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By understanding how to use absolute references, you can create formulas that will work even when you copy or move them to different locations.
entries.translation: Si ad u fahanto tix raca saxda waxad u bahan tahay inad dhisto qaacido taso ka shaqynayso xita marka aad labo jibaarto ama aad udhaqajiso meel ka duwan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Here are some additional tips for using absolute references:
entries.translation: Halkaan waa qayb dheeri ah oo qish loo isticmaali karo tix raaca saxda:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Use absolute references for cells that contain data that you do not want to change.
entries.translation: Isticmaal tix raca saxda godka kaso kaydinayo xogta adan rabin inad badasho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Use relative references for cells that contain data that you do want to change.
entries.translation: Isticmaal tix raaca la badali karo godka kaaso hayo xogta aadan rabin inaad badasho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Be careful when using mixed references, which are references that contain both absolute and relative references.
entries.translation: Iska ilaali marka isticmalaysid tix racyo isku jiro kaso ay ku jiraan tix racayada la badali karo iyo kuwo aan la badali karin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Use the F4 key to toggle between absolute, relative, and mixed references.
entries.translation: Isticmaal furaha F4 si aad u leex leexiso inta u dhaxeeyso mid kala badali karo kan la badli karin iskuna dar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By following these tips, you can use absolute references to create powerful and flexible formulas that will make your work in Excel easier and more efficient.
entries.translation: Adigo racayo qishkan waxad isticmaali karta tix raca isbadalka si ad u abuurto mid xoogan oo dabacsan kaso ka dhigayo shaaqadad Excel mid fudud oo nadiisan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is because they do not feed on blood.
entries.translation: Tani waa sababta aysan uu quudan dhiig.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Instead, they feed on nectar from flowers.
entries.translation: Badal keda waxay qutaan qayb miraha ubaxa ka mid ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Female mosquitoes, on the other hand, do feed on blood.
entries.translation: Dhediga kaneecada dhinaca kale waxay qutaan dhiiga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They need blood in order to produce eggs.
entries.translation: Waxay qutan dhiiga si ay uso saran ukumo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Male mosquitoes are attracted to light, so they are often found near windows and doors.
entries.translation: Labka kaneecada waxay soo jiito leerka marka in ta badan waxa laga helaa melaha daqada iyo albabada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are also attracted to the smell of sweat and CO2.
entries.translation: Waxay sido kale so jiitan shiirka dhididka iyo CO2.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Female mosquitoes are attracted to the same things, but they are also attracted to the smell of certain chemicals in human blood.
entries.translation: Dhediga kanecada waxa so jiito waxa la mid ah laakin waxa sido kale so jiito shiirka qarka kimikoyinka dhiga dadka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When a female mosquito bites a human, she injects saliva into the skin.
entries.translation: Marka kanecada dhadiga ay ku qaninto dadka waxay ku durtaa candhuuf jirka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This saliva contains anticoagulants, which prevent the blood from clotting.
entries.translation: Candhuuftan waxay waxa ku jiro anticoagulants taso ka hortagto xinjirowga dhiiga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The mosquito then sucks up the blood.
entries.translation: Ka dibna kaneecada waxay so dhuuqda dhiiga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mosquito bites can cause itching and swelling.
entries.translation: Kanecada waxay sababi karta cun cun iyo barar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In some cases, they can also cause an allergic reaction.
entries.translation: Mar mar waxay sababi kartaa alarji ficil.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The most common type of allergic reaction to mosquito bites is hives.
entries.translation: Mid ka ugu caansan waa alarjikga ficil kaso ka dhasho qaninka kanecada shinida gobaheeda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hives are red, raised bumps that appear on the skin.
entries.translation: Ficilka wa mid casan ah kaso su muujiyo burduqyo jirka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can be itchy or painful.
entries.translation: Waxay noqon karaan mid cuncunta ama xanun leh.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In rare cases, mosquito bites can cause more serious problems.
entries.translation: Mar mar yar qaninka kanecada waxay sababi kartaa dhibaato daran.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, some people can develop an infection at the site of the bite.
entries.translation: Tusaale ahan dadka qaar waxay so bixin karaan cabuq mesha ay ka qaninto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In some cases, mosquito bites can even lead to death.
entries.translation: Mar mar qaar qaninyada kanecada waxay sababi kartaa dhimasho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The best way to avoid mosquito bites is to wear long sleeves and pants when you are outdoors.
entries.translation: Sida ugu fican oo la iskaga ilaalin karo qaninyada kanecada waa in la xirto gacamo dheero iyo hoos galis marka bananka joogto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You should also use insect repellent.
entries.translation: Waa ina sido kale isticmasha cayayan cayriye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you do get bitten by a mosquito, you can apply a cold compress to the bite to relieve the itching and swelling.
entries.translation: Haday ku qaninto kaneeco waxad isticmaali tujin si qabow si ad iska yareyso oo u nafisto cuncunka iyo bararka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can also take an over-the-counter antihistamine to relieve the symptoms of an allergic reaction.
entries.translation: Waxad qadan kartaa dawada antihistamine si u xanunka kaga yarado oo calamadaha alarjika ficlkoda oga bad baado.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mosquitoes are important carriers of disease.
entries.translation: Kaneecada waa kuwa ugu muhimsan oo cudarada qaado.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can transmit a variety of diseases, including malaria, dengue fever, and yellow fever.
entries.translation: Waxay gud bin karaan cuduro badan ay ka mid yihin duumada qandhada kulul iyo qandhada daran.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mosquitoes are responsible for the deaths of millions of people each year.
entries.translation: Kaneecada waxay ka masuul tahay dhimashada malayin dadka ah o sanadkasta dhinto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are a number of things that can be done to control mosquito populations.
entries.translation: Waxa jiro siyaabo badan oo lagu xakameyn karo tirada kaneecada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One way is to reduce the number of places where mosquitoes can breed.
entries.translation: Hal wado wa inay yareyso meelaha ay ku taranto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can be done by draining standing water and clearing away vegetation.
entries.translation: Tani waxa la sameyn karaa ayado biyaha la daadiyo oo la nadiifiyo geedaha yar yar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another way to control mosquito populations is to use insecticides.
entries.translation: Qabka kale ee lagu xakameyn karo tirada kanecada waa dawada cayayanka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Insecticides can be used to kill mosquitoes both indoors and outdoors.
entries.translation: Dawada cayayanka waxa loo isticmaali kara in lagu dilo xayawanada kuwa gudaha iyo kuwo bananka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mosquitoes are a major public health problem.
entries.translation: Kanecada waa dhib wayn ee cafimaaad.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, there are a number of things that can be done to control mosquito populations and reduce the risk of mosquito-borne diseases.
entries.translation: Si kasta waxa jiro wax badan kaso la sameyn karo oo lagu xakameyn karo tirada kanecada oo lagu dhimi karo qatarta cudurka la dhalashada kaneecada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He taught that all beings are caught in a cycle of birth, death, and rebirth, and that this cycle is perpetuated by our attachments to things in the world.
entries.translation: Wuxu u maleyay waxayalah dhan waxay ku wareegsadan dhalasho, dhimasho iyo dib u dhalsho tasi waa meertada lagu waarayo oo ku lifaaqan shay yaasha aduunka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These attachments can be to anything, from material possessions to ideas and beliefs.
entries.translation: Lifaaqyadan waxay noqon karaan wax walbo sida shay yasha booskoda ila fikirka iyo aminsananta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When we are attached to something, we become possessive and controlling, and we suffer when we lose or cannot have what we want.
entries.translation: Markan wax shay ku liifaqno waxan noqonaa kuwo islahansiiyo oo maamulo wana dhibatona markan wayno ama heli wayno waxan rabnay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Buddha taught that the way to end suffering is to let go of our attachments.
entries.translation: Buddha wuxu na baray sida loo dhamayo dhibatada waa inaan fasaxno lifaaqyadena.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is not easy, but it is possible through meditation and other spiritual practices.
entries.translation: Tani ma aha mid fudud laakin waa macquul ayado loo marayo qabka niyad dajin ta iyo tababarad nafta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When we let go of our attachments, we become free from the cycle of birth, death, and rebirth, and we can experience true peace and happiness.
entries.translation: Markan fasaxno liifaq yadena waxan noqona xor waregi dhalashada, dhimashada iyo dib u dhalshada waxan ku qadan karna nabada dhabta iyo farxad.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most important things to remember when trying to let go of our attachments is that we are not our possessions.
entries.translation: Mida ugu muhimsan ee la xasusto wa marka aan iska daynayno lifaaqan anaga meel u ahayn.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We are not our ideas or beliefs.
entries.translation: Ma nihin kuwo fikir ah ama la amini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We are simply beings who are experiencing the world through our senses.
entries.translation: Waxanahay mid fudud kuwaaso ku cibro qadanayno aduunka anago u mareyno darenkena.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When we can see ourselves in this way, it becomes easier to let go of the things that we think we need to be happy.
entries.translation: Hadda waxan isku arkeyna sidan waxay noqotay mid fudud inaan fasaxano waxyalaha aan u maleynayno inan ku farxeeno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Letting go of our attachments does not mean that we have to give up everything.
entries.translation: Inaan fasaxno waxa yalaha nagu liifaqan ma ahan micanheeda inan wax walbo ka niyad jabno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It simply means that we need to be able to let go of things when it is time.
entries.translation: Waxay si cad la micno tahay waxan u bahanay inan shay yasha fasaxno marki waqtigooda la gaaro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We need to be able to let go of the things that are no longer serving us, and we need to be able to let go of the things that we are attached to out of fear or insecurity.
entries.translation: Waxan u bahanay inan fasaxno shay yasha an waxabo noo tareyn waxan u bahanay inaan fasaxno waxa yaalaha ku lifaqan cabsideena iyo kalsooni la'anta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When we can let go of our attachments, we open ourselves up to a new world of possibilities.
entries.translation: Markan fasaxno lifaaqena waxan isku furna macqulaha aduunka cusub.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We become free to live our lives in a way that is true to ourselves, and we become free to experience the joy and happiness that is our birthright.
entries.translation: Waxan xor unahay inan nolashena ku nolaano wado run u ah nolashena waxana noqona xor qibradeysan oo faraxsan taso ah wadad an xaqa ku dhalanay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Trains have been a vital part of transportation for centuries.
entries.translation: Tareenka waa qayb muhiim ah isku socodka ee qarniga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are a safe, efficient, and reliable way to travel long distances.
entries.translation: Waa mid amni ah oo hagagsan, waa mid la isku haleyn karo masafada dheer.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, the railroad industry requires regular updates to keep pace with the changing needs of passengers.
entries.translation: Si kastaba warshada dareenka ee wadad waxay ubahan tahay dayac tir joogta ah si loo joogteeyo socodka dadka ee si badalayo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most important updates that trains need is the installation of new safety features.
entries.translation: Mid ugu muhiimsan ee isbadalka tareenka waxay u bahana tahay in lagu daro qabab cusub oo badbaada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In recent years, there have been a number of high-profile train accidents, which have highlighted the need for better safety measures.
entries.translation: Sanadihi danbe, waxa jiray shilal tareen soo batay kaas oo soo muujiyay bahida loo qabo nabad qab fiican.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: New safety features such as positive train control (PTC) can help prevent accidents by automatically stopping trains that are traveling too fast or that are about to collide with another train.
entries.translation: Qabka cusub ee badqab waa togananta mamulka tareenka (PTC) wuxu ka cawin kara shilka si qab lagu istaaajin karo kuwaso ku safrayo xawaro dheereyo oo lagaga ilaalinayo inay isku dhacaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another important update that trains need is the installation of new technology.
entries.translation: Mida kalo muhiim ah ee u bahan in la badalo ee tareenka u bahan yahay waa in la galiyo teknoolajiyad cusub.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the past, trains were powered by steam engines.
entries.translation: Wakhti yadii hore, tareenada waxa wadi jiray ana dhaqa jin jiray matoorka uurada ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, steam engines are inefficient and pollute the environment.
entries.translation: Si kataba matoorka uurada waa mid an ku filnayn oo wasaqeeyo deegaanka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Today, most trains are powered by diesel engines or electric motors.
entries.translation: Maanta tareenada waxa cawiyo matoorka nafatda ama maroorka dabka leh.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These engines are more efficient and environmentally friendly.
entries.translation: Matoorada nocaa ah wa kuwo fican oo dhameystiran oo degaan ka saaxib la ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition to safety and technology updates, trains also need to be updated to accommodate the needs of passengers.
entries.translation: Marka lagu daro cusboonaysiinta badbaadada iyo tignoolajiyada, tareenada ayaa sidoo kale u baahan in la cusboonaysiiyo si ay u daboolaan baahiyaha rakaabka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In recent years, there has been an increase in the number of passengers who travel by train.
entries.translation: Sanadihi u danbayeyay waxa jiray ko u kaca dadka ku safrayo tareenada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This has led to overcrowding on trains, which can make for a less comfortable and enjoyable experience.
entries.translation: Tani waxay hor seeday in dadka isku batan taso ka dhigtay mid an raaxo ahyen oo lagu qibradaysan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She had always been a talented painter, but after her loss, she found that she was no longer interested in painting pretty landscapes or still lifes.
entries.translation: Waxay mar walbo ahayd mid qabiir ku ah xar dhida laakin ka dib markay wayday waxay heshay inay la heyn xiiseen xardhida muqaal ama nolal.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Instead, she began to create dark, brooding works of art that reflected her inner turmoil.
entries.translation: Taa beddelkeeda, waxay bilawday inay abuurto shaqooyin farshaxan oo mugdi ah, oo xamaasad leh oo ka tarjumaya qalalaasaha gudaha ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of her most famous paintings, "The Death of My Son," is a stark and disturbing image of a young boy lying in a coffin.
entries.translation: Mid ka mid ah sawir gacmeedkeeda ugu caansan, "Dhimashada Wiilkayga," waa sawir aad u adag oo walaac leh oo ah wiil yar oo ku jiifa naxashka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The boy's face is peaceful, but his body is twisted and contorted in pain.
entries.translation: Wiilka wejigiisu waa nabad, laakiin jidhkiisu waa qalloocan oo xanuun baa haya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The painting is full of symbolism, and it is clear that Mary is using her art to process her grief and anger.
entries.translation: Sawir gacmeedka waxaa ka buuxa calaamado, waxaana cad in Maryan ay adeegsanayso farshaxankeeda si ay u socodsiiso murugadeeda iyo xanaaqeeda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mary's work eventually found an audience, and she became one of the most respected artists of her time.

entries.english: Mary's paintings are a testament to the power of art, and they continue to inspire people to this day.

entries.english: Sudan is a country in northeastern Africa.
entries.translation: Suudaan waa wadan ku yaal waqooyi bari Afrika.

entries.english: It is bordered by Egypt to the north, Libya to the northwest, Chad to the west, the Central African Republic to the southwest, South Sudan to the south, Ethiopia to the southeast, and Eritrea to the east.
entries.translation: Waxa ay xad la wadaagtaa Masar dhanka waqooyi, Liibiya dhanka waqooyi-galbeed, galbeedka Chad, Koonfur-galbeed Jamhuuriyadda Afrikada Dhexe, Koonfur-Sudan oo ka xigta, Itoobiya koonfur-bari, iyo Eritrea oo bari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sudan has a population of over 40 million people and a land area of over 1.8 million square kilometers.
entries.translation: Suudaan waxa ku nool in ka badan 40 milyan oo qof iyo dhul baaxadiisu ka badan tahay 1.8 milyan oo kiiloomitir laba jibaaran.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sudan's history is long and complex.
entries.translation: Taariikhda Suudaan waa mid dheer oo balaaran.

entries.english: The area has been inhabited by humans for thousands of years, and the first known civilization in Sudan was the Kingdom of Kush, which flourished from around 750 BC to 350 AD.
entries.translation: Dhulkan waxa ku noolaa kumanaan sano, ilbaxnimadii ugu horeysay ee lagu yaqiin Suudaan waxa ay ahayd boqortooyadii Kush, taas oo soo ifbaxday qiyaastii 750 BC ilaa 350 AD.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Kush was a powerful kingdom that controlled much of the Nile River valley.
entries.translation: Kush waxay ahayd boqortooyo xoog badan oo gacanta ku haysay inta badan dooxada webiga Niil.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the 7th century AD, Sudan was conquered by the Arabs, who brought Islam to the region.
entries.translation: Qarnigii 7-aad ee Miilaadiyada, Suudaan waxaa qabsaday Carab, kuwaas oo Islaamka keenay gobolka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sudan was ruled by a series of Arab sultanates for centuries, until it was conquered by Egypt in 1821.
entries.translation: Suudaan waxaa ka talinayay dhowr suldaanno Carbeed muddo qarniyo ah, ilaa ay Masar qabsatay 1821kii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Egypt ruled Sudan until 1885, when it was conquered by the Mahdi, a religious leader who led a rebellion against Egyptian rule.
entries.translation: Masar waxa ay Sudan ka talinaysay ilaa 1885, markaas oo uu qabsaday Mahdi, oo ahaa hogaamiye diimeed oo hogaaminayay jabhado ka soo horjeeday xukunkii Masar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Mahdi's rule was short-lived, and Sudan was reconquered by the British in 1898.
entries.translation: Mahdigu xukunkiisu waxa uu ahaa mid kooban, Sudan waxa dib u qabsaday Ingriisku 1898-kii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My dear daughter, I know you've been wondering about the nature of light and darkness.
entries.translation: Gabadhayda qaaliga ah, waan ogahay in aad is waydiinaysay dabeecadda iftiinka iyo mugdiga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's a big question, and one that scientists have been trying to answer for centuries.
entries.translation: Waa su'aal weyn, waana mid ay saynisyahannadu isku dayeen inay ka jawaabaan qarniyo badan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But I think I can give you a simple explanation that will help you understand it a little better.
entries.translation: Laakiin waxaan filayaa inaan ku siin karo sharraxaad fudud oo kaa caawin doonta inaad si ka sii fiican u fahanto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Light is a kind of energy that travels in waves.

entries.english: We can see light because it enters our eyes and stimulates the retina, which is a light-sensitive tissue at the back of the eye.
entries.translation: Waxaan arki karnaa iftiin sababtoo ah wuxuu galaa indhaheenna wuxuuna kiciyaa retina, taas oo ah unug dareen leh oo ku yaal dhabarka isha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The retina sends signals to our brain, which interprets them as images.
entries.translation: Retina waxay soo dirtaa calaamado maskaxdeena, taas oo u fasirta sawir ahaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Darkness is the absence of light.
entries.translation: Mugdigu waa iftiin la'aan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When there is no light, we can't see anything.
entries.translation: Marka iftiin la waayo, waxba ma arki karno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Light and darkness are two opposites, but they're also two sides of the same coin.
entries.translation: Iftiinka iyo mugdiga waa laba iska soo horjeeda, laakiin sidoo kale waa laba dhinac oo isku mid ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Light is needed for us to see, but darkness is also important.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Darkness helps us to rest and sleep.

entries.english: It also creates a sense of mystery and wonder.

entries.english: So next time you're outside at night, take a moment to appreciate the darkness.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's just as important as light, and it has its own beauty.

entries.english: Human African Trypanosomiasis is primarily found in rural Africa and is transmitted through the bite of the tsetse fly.
entries.translation: Hurdo wareerka oo loo yaqaan Human African Trypanosomiasis waxaa asal ahaan laga helaa Afrika (Afrikada Saxaraha Ka Hooseysa) waxaana lagu kala qaadaa qaniinyada tikhsiga gandiga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Have you recently travelled to sub-Saharan Africa?

entries.english: It's crucial to see a doctor to get a proper diagnosis.

entries.english: They will likely ask you detailed questions about your symptoms, medical history, travel history, and lifestyle.
entries.translation: Waxaa laga yaabaa in ay ku weydiyaan su'aallo qotodheer oo ku saabsan astmaahaaga, taariikhdaada caafimaad iyo taariikhdaada safar iyo qaab-nololeedka.

entries.english: They might also recommend some tests, like blood work, to rule out other potential causes.
entries.translation: Waxaa sidookale laga yaabaa in ay soo jeediyaan in la qaado tijaabooyin sida shaqeynta dhiigga si meesha looga saaro waxyaabaha kale ee keeni kara
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Do not self-treat or attempt to diagnose yourself with sleeping sickness.
entries.translation: Adiga ha is-daaweynin ama ha isku dayin inaad adiga laftaada isku sheegtid jirrada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's a serious disease that requires specialized medical care and specific medications.
entries.translation: Waa jirro aad u daran oo u baahan daryeel caafimaad oo takhasus leh iyo daawooyin khaas ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Trying to treat it yourself could delay a proper diagnosis and treatment for the real cause of your symptoms.
entries.translation: Isku dayidda inaad adiga is daaweyso waxaay dib u dhigi kartaa ogaanshaha iyo daaweynta saxda ah ee waxa sida dhabta ah u keenaya astamaahaaga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So, to manage your fatigue and sleep disturbances, your first and most important step is to schedule an appointment with your doctor as soon as possible.
entries.translation: Sidaa daraaddeed, si aad u maareyso daalkaaga iyo hurdadaada qasan, tallaabadaada ugu horreysa ugu na muhiimsan waa in aad ballan ka qabsataa dhakhtarkaaga sida ugu dhakhsiyaha badan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Explain your concerns and be honest about your symptoms.
entries.translation: U sharrax dhibaatada ku heysata, kana run sheeg astaamahaaga.

entries.english: They are the best resource to help you figure out what's going on and recommend the right course of action.
