entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the meantime, try to practice good sleep hygiene: maintain a regular sleep schedule, create a relaxing bedtime routine, and avoid caffeine and alcohol before bed.
entries.translation: Intaa kahor, isku day in aad dhaqan geliso caado hurdo: joogtee jadwal hurdo oo joogto ah, caadeyso waqti nasasho sariirta ah, iska na ilaali qaxwada iyo khamriga waqtiga sariirta kahor.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Question: My female friend complains of bleeding, neck pain and thinks she has Crimean-Congo Hemorrhagic Fever and asks, I hope it is not a dreadful thing?
entries.translation: Su'aal: Saaxibteyda ayaa ka cabaneysa dhiig-dareer, qoor xanuun waxaayna u maleyneysaa in uu hayo xanuunka Crimean-Congo Hermorrhagic Fever, iyadoo wedyiineysa, Waxaan rajeynayaa in uusan ahayn wax laga cabsado?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Answer: Tell your friend to immediately go to a hospital or doctor.
entries.translation: Jawaab: U sheeg saaxibkaaga in uu si degdeg ah u aado isbitaal ama arko dhakhtar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Crimean-Congo Hemorrhagic Fever (CCHF) is a serious viral disease and requires prompt medical attention.
entries.translation: Jirrada Crimean-Congo Hermorrhagic Fever (CCHF) waa jirro faafta oo aad u daran, waxayna u baahan tahay daryeel caafimaad oo degdeg ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's not something to take chances with.
entries.translation: Ma aha wax la yareysan karo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Trying to self-diagnose or treat it is dangerous.
entries.translation: In qofka isaga isku sheego ama is-daaweeyo waa khatar..
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: While bleeding and neck pain can be symptoms of CCHF, they are also symptoms of many other illnesses, some far less serious.
entries.translation: Inkastoo dhiig-dareer iyo qoor xanuun ay noqon karaan astaamaha CCHF, waxaay sidookale astaamo u yihiin xanuunno kale, qaar aad halistooda aad u yar tahay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A doctor will be able to determine what's actually causing her symptoms and provide appropriate treatment.
entries.translation: Dhakhtar ayaa ogaan doona waxa dhabta ah ee keenaya astamaaheeda, sidookale na siin doonaa daaweyn habboon.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Reassure her that getting checked out is the best course of action, regardless of the cause.
entries.translation: Markale u xaqiiji in baaritaan uu yahay tallaabada ugu fiican ee ay qaadi karto, iyadoo la eegeyn waxa sababay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Early diagnosis and treatment are crucial for CCHF and many other conditions.
entries.translation: In waqti hore la ogaado cudurka la na daaweeyo ayaa muhiim u ah CCHF iyo xaalado caafimaad oo kale oo badan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Question: My male neighbor complains of jaundice, fever, bleeding and thinks he has Yellow Fever and asks, What are the causes
entries.translation: Su'aal: Nin deriskeyga ayaa ka cabanaya cagaarshoow, qandho, wuxuu na u maleynayaa in uu hayo cudurka Qandho Caseeyaha (Yellow Fever) isagoo weydiinaya, Waa maxay waxyaabaha sababa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Answer: While your neighbor's symptoms do overlap with Yellow Fever, it's crucial to understand that self-diagnosing is dangerous, especially with a serious illness like Yellow Fever.
entries.translation: Jawaab: Inkastoo astaamaha deriskaaga ay u eg yihiin Qandho Caseeye, waa muhiim in la ogaado in in la isku sheego ay halis tahay, khaasatan xunuun aad u daran sida Qandho Caseeye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He needs to see a doctor immediately for proper testing and diagnosis.
entries.translation: Wuxuu u baahan yahay in uu si degdeg ah dhakhtar u arko si si sax ah loo baaro loo na ogaado.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Yellow fever is caused by the yellow fever virus, which is spread through the bite of an infected Aedes aegypti mosquito.
entries.translation: Qandho caseeye waxaa keena fayraska qandho caseeye kaasi oo lagu kala gudbiyo qaniinyada kaneecad Aedes aegypti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These mosquitoes also transmit diseases like Zika and Dengue.
entries.translation: Kaneecooyinkani waxaay sidookale gudbiyaan cudurrada sida Zika iyo Kaduudiye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's not contagious from person to person.
entries.translation: Waa cudur dadka kala qaadaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Essentially, the only cause of Yellow Fever is infection with the yellow fever virus transmitted by the bite of an infected mosquito.
entries.translation: Asal ahaan, waxa kaliya keena Qandho Caseeye waa caabuq ka dhasha fayraska qandho caseeye oo ku gudba qaniinyada kaneeco cudurka wadata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There's no other way to contract it.
entries.translation: Ma jiro qaab kale oo lagu qaado.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's important to reiterate that your neighbor needs professional medical attention.
entries.translation: Waa muhiim in carrabka lagu adkeeyo in deriskaaga u baahan yahay daryeel caafimaad oo rasmi ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: His symptoms could be from a number of other illnesses, some serious, and delaying proper diagnosis and treatment can have serious consequences.
entries.translation: Astaamahiisa waxaay ka imaan karaa xanuunno kale, qaar halis ah, in la dib dhigo ogaanshaha iyo daaweynta na waxaa ka imaan kara cawaaqib aad halis u ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Question: My female classmate complains of fever, chills, headache and thinks she has Malaria and asks, Malaria is more common with people coming from Mozambique.
entries.translation: Su'aal: Gabadh aan isku fasal nahay ayaa ka cabaneysa qandho, qarqar, madax xanuun waxaayna u maleyneysaa in ay heyso Malaariya, iyadoo wedyiineysa, Malaariya waxaa badanaa qaba dadka ka yimaada Mozambiig.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So are you from there and how do you know you got it?
entries.translation: Marka ma halkaas baad ka timid, sideedse ku ogaatay in aad qabto?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Answer: "I understand you're not feeling well and are worried about malaria.
entries.translation: Jawaab: "Waa dareemayaa in aadan si fiican dareemeyn, aadna ka walwalsan tahay malaariya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's definitely important to take symptoms like fever, chills, and headache seriously.
entries.translation: Aad ayay muhiim u tahay in astaamaha sida qandho, qarqar iyo madax xanuun kuwo halis ah loo qaato.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, I can't diagnose you, and self-diagnosing can be risky.
entries.translation: Hase yeeshee, aniga ma kugu sheegi karo, inaad adiga isku sheegtid na halis ayay noqon kartaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Lots of illnesses share those symptoms.
entries.translation: Xanuunno badan ayaa wadaaga astaamahan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As for your question about where I'm from and my health, I’d prefer not to share personal details.
entries.translation: Markaay timaaddo su'aashaada ahna halka aan ka yimid iyo caafimaadkeyga, waxaan jeclahay in aan qofna la wadaagin macluumaadkeyga shakhsiyeed.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The most important thing right now is for you to see a doctor to figure out what's going on and get the right treatment.
entries.translation: Waxa ugu muhiimsan iminkan waa in aad dhakhtar aragtaa si aad u ogaato waxa ku haya, aadna u hesho daaweyn sax ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can run tests to determine if it’s malaria or something else and give you the best advice.
entries.translation: Waxaay qaadi karaan baaritaanno si ay u ogaadaan in ay tahay malaariya iyo in ay wax kale yihiin, ayna kuu siiyaan talooyinka ugu fiican.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Delaying proper medical care can be harmful, so please make an appointment as soon as possible."
entries.translation: Dib-u-dhigista daryeel caafimaad ayaa noqon karta mid waxyeello leh, marka fadlan ballan qabso sida uga dhakhsiyaha badan."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Answer: Tell your classmate that it's crucial she doesn't self-treat and sees a doctor immediately for diagnosis and treatment.
entries.translation: Jawaab: U sheeg gabadha fasalkaaga in ay muhiim tahay in ay iyada is-daaweyn, ayna aragto dhakhtar si degdeg ah si loo ogaado xanuunkeeda loo na daaweeyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Malaria can be serious, even fatal, if not treated promptly.
entries.translation: Malaariya aad ayay halis u noqon kartaa, xitaa dhimasho keeni karta haddii aanan si fiican loo daaweyn.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Suspecting malaria isn't the same as having a confirmed diagnosis.
entries.translation: In la iskaga shakiyo malaariya ma ka dhigna in la xaqiijiyey in aad qabto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once she has seen a doctor and if she is diagnosed with malaria and completes her prescribed medication, these are some precautions she can take to prevent recurrence:
entries.translation: Marka ay aragto dhakhtar, lana ogaado in ay qabto malaariya kaddibna dhameyso daawadii loo qoray, waa kuwan taxaddarro ay qaadi karto si ay uga hortagto soo laabashadeeda:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Continue preventative medication as prescribed: Her doctor may prescribe medication to be taken regularly during and after travel to malaria-endemic areas.
entries.translation: Sii wad daawooyinka kahortagga sida laguugu qoray: Dhakhtarkeeda ayaa laga yaabaa in uu u qoro daawooyin la qaato si joogto ah inta aad ku maqan tahay ama markaad ka timaaddo meel malaariya aad u baahsan tahay.:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It’s crucial to adhere to the prescribed regimen.
entries.translation: Waa muhiim in la raaco sida daawada laguugu soo qoray.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mosquito bite prevention is paramount:
entries.translation: Kahortagga qaniinyada kaneeco ayaa aad muhiim u ah:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sleep under insecticide-treated mosquito nets (ITNs): Ensure the net is properly tucked in and has no holes.
entries.translation: Seexo dhandarwo la buufiyey (ITNs): Iska hubi in aad shandarwada si fiican u gelgeliso, ayna lahayn wax duleyl.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Wear long-sleeved clothing and long pants, especially during dawn and dusk: Mosquitoes are most active during these times.
entries.translation: Xiro dhar gacmo dhaadheer iyo lugo dhaadheer, khaasatan inta u dhaxeysa fiidki ilaa aroorti: Kaneecada xilliyadaa ayay aad u kacsan tahay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Use insect repellents containing DEET (diethyltoluamide), picaridin, or IR3535: Follow the instructions on the product label.
entries.translation: Isticmaal waxyaabaha caabbiya cayayaanka oo wata maaddooyinka DEET (diethyltoluamide), picaridin, ama IR3535: Raac tilmaamaha ku qoran sheeyga aad isticmaaleyso.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Consider using mosquito coils or insecticide-treated vaporizers indoors.
entries.translation: Isticmaal weelka kaneecada ama gudaha ku shid uumiyeyaasha cayayaanka laga buufiyey.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Eliminate mosquito breeding grounds around her home: This includes removing standing water from flower pots, buckets, and other containers.
entries.translation: Hoygeeda haka saarto wax kasta oo dhalin kara kaneeco: Tani waxaa ka mid biyaha oo laga saaro qasacadaha dhirta, baaldiyada iyo weelasha kale.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Be aware of potential relapse symptoms and seek immediate medical attention if they occur: Even after treatment, malaria parasites can sometimes persist in the liver and cause a relapse.
entries.translation: Iska jir astaamaha soo noqnoqo kara, raadso na daryeel caafimaad haddii aad isku aragto: Daaweynta xitaa kaddib, dulinka malaariya waxaay mararka qaar ku hari karaan beerka, dibna u soo laaban karaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Again, the most important first step is to encourage her to seek immediate medical attention.
entries.translation: Markale, tallaabada koowaad ee ugu muhiimsan waa in aad ku dhiirigeliso in ay raadsato daryeel caafimaad oo degdeg ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Don't delay!
entries.translation: Ha dib dhigin!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Question: What precautions should I take to prevent the spread of typhoid fever to others, particularly my household members or close contacts?
entries.translation: Su'aal: Waa maxay taxaddarrada aan qaadi karo si aan uga hortago in aan xanuunka tiifoow u gudbiyo dadka kale, khaasatan qoyskeyga iyo dadka igu dhaw?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Answer:
entries.translation: Jawaab:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Typhoid fever is a serious bacterial infection that can spread easily to others through contaminated food and water or close contact.
entries.translation: Xanuunka tiifoow waa caabuq baktiiriya oo halis ah kaasi oo si fudud loogu gudbin karo dadka kale iyadoo laga qaado cunno iyo biyo wasakheysan ama in la isla falgo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Here's a breakdown of the precautions:
entries.translation: Waa kuwan qaababka taxaddarka oo faahfaahsan:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Handwashing: This is the single most important measure.
entries.translation: Gacmo-dhaqis: Tani waa tallaabada kaliya ee ugu muhiimsan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Thorough handwashing with soap and water, especially after using the toilet and before handling food, removes bacteria and prevents transmission.
entries.translation: Gacmaha oo saabbuun iyo biyo lagu dhaqo, khaasatan marka la isticmaalo musqusha iyo cunta cunista kahor waxaay meesha ka saaraan baktiiriyada, ayna ka hortagaan gudbinta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Disinfecting Contaminated Surfaces: Typhoid bacteria can survive on surfaces.
entries.translation: Jeermis-ka-dillida Goobaha Wasakheysan: Baktiiriyada tiifoowga waxaay ku noolaan kartaa sagxadaha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Regularly disinfecting frequently touched surfaces like countertops, doorknobs, and bathroom fixtures with a household disinfectant helps prevent spread.
entries.translation: In si joogto ah jeermiska looga dilo sagxadaha aadka loo taabto sida miisaska, gacanka albaabyada iyo tuubooyinka musqusha ayaa kahortagi karta faafidda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Food Handling Precautions: Individuals with typhoid fever should not prepare or serve food for others while they are ill and for a period after recovery as determined by a healthcare professional.
entries.translation: Taxaddarka Xakameynta la Falgalka Cunnada: Dadka qaba xanuunka tiifoow waa in aysan cunno karinin ama dadka u keenin inta ay xanuunsan yihiin iyo ilaa muddo markaay soo caafimaadaan, sida uu go'aamiyo xirfadle caafimaad.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This prevents contamination of food.
entries.translation: Tani waxaay kahortageysaa wasakheynta cunnada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Avoid Sharing Personal Items: Sharing personal items like towels, utensils, and drinking glasses can spread the bacteria.
entries.translation: Iska Ilaali Wadaagidda Alaabtaada Shakhsiyeed : In aad dadka la wadaagto alaabtaada shakhsiyeed sida shukumaan, maacuun ama koobabka biyaha lagu cabbo waxaay faafin kartaa baktiiriyada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Each individual should use their own dedicated items.
entries.translation: Shakhsi kasta waa in uu isticmaalaa alaabtiisa u gaarka ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Vaccination: Typhoid vaccines are available and can provide substantial protection against the disease.
entries.translation: Tallaal: Tallaallada tiifoow waa la helaa, waxaayna ku siin karaan difaac aad muhiim u ah oo ka dhan ah jirrada..
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Vaccination is recommended for travelers to areas where typhoid is common and for individuals with close contact with a typhoid carrier.
entries.translation: Tallaal ayaa lagu talinayaa dadka u safraya meelo tiifoow ku badan yahay iyo shakhsiyaadka la falgala dadka tiifoow qaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Prompt Treatment: Getting prompt medical treatment with appropriate antibiotics helps shorten the duration of illness and reduces the risk of complications and spread to others.
entries.translation: Daaweyn Degdeg ah: Helidda daawo caafimaad oo degdeg ah oo leh antibayootik ayaa kaa caawin kara gaabinta muddada xanuunka iyo yareynta halista ka sii daridda iyo ku faafinta dadka kale.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's also crucial to complete the full course of antibiotics even if symptoms improve.
entries.translation: Sidookale waa muhiim in la dhammeystodaawada dhan ee antibayootika haddii xitaa astaamaha soo fiicnaadaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Answer: "It sounds pretty rough dealing with what you think is malaria multiple times.
entries.translation: Jawaab: "Waa wax iska dhib badan in lala tacaalo waxa aad u maleyneyso malaariya oo soo noqnoqotay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's definitely worth getting checked out by a doctor each time to confirm the diagnosis and get the right treatment, because recurring fevers can be a sign of other things too.
entries.translation: Dhab ahaantii waxaa habboon in dhakhtar ku eego markasta si aad u hubiso jirrada oo aadna hesho daawada saxda ah sababtoo ah qandho soo laablaabatay waxaay calaamad u noqon kartaa waxyaabo kale.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Self-treating can sometimes mask the real problem.
entries.translation: Is-daaweynta ayaa mararka qaar dabooli karta xanuunka saxda ah ee ku haya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As for prevention, there are a few things you can do, especially if you're in an area where malaria is common.
entries.translation: Markaay timaaddo kahortagga, waxaa jiro waxyaabo dhawr ah oo aad sameyn karto, khaasatan haddii aad ku nooshahay meel malaariya ku badan tahay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Using mosquito nets, especially ones treated with insecticide, is really important.
entries.translation: Isticmaalka shandarwo, khaasatan marka la buufiyo, aad ayay muhiim u tahay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Also, wearing long sleeves and pants, particularly during dawn and dusk when mosquitoes are most active, can help.
entries.translation: Sidookale, xirashada sheey gacmo dhaadheer iyo surwaal, siba inta u dhaxeysa fiidkii ilaa aroortii marka ay kaneecada aad u kacsan tahay ayaa ku caawin kara
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are also insect repellents containing DEET or picaridin that are effective.
entries.translation: Waxaa sidookale jira caabiyeyaasha cayayaanka ee wata maaddooyinka DEET iyo picaridin ee waxtarka leh
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can assess your individual risk and make sure you're aware of any potential side effects."
entries.translation: Waxaay qiimeyn karaan halistaada shakhsiyeed, sidookale na hubin karaan inaad ka warqabto wixi waxyeello kaa soo gaari kara"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Answer: Tell your neighbor he needs to see a doctor immediately to get a proper diagnosis and treatment.
entries.translation: Jawaab: U sheeg deriskaaga in uu u baahan yahay in uu dhakhtar arko sida ugu dhakhsiyaha badan si uu u helo ogaansho iyo daaweyn sax ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rift Valley Fever can be serious, and self-treating is dangerous.
entries.translation: Xanuunka Rift Valley Fever wuxuu noqon karaa mid aad u daran, in la is-daaweeyana waa wax halis ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: While waiting for medical attention, he should take the following precautions to minimize the risk of spreading the disease (if it is indeed RVF):
entries.translation: Inta uu daaweyn caafimaad sugayo, waa in uu tallaabooyinka kahortagga ee soo socda qaadaa si uu u yareeyo khatarta in uu faafiyo cudurka (waa haddii uu yahay xanuunka RVF)
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mosquito bite prevention: This is paramount.
entries.translation: Kahortagga qaniinyada kaneecada: Tani aad ayay muhuum u tahay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He should use mosquito repellent containing DEET, picaridin, or IR3535 liberally.
entries.translation: Waa in uu isticmaalaa waxlaha caabbiya kaneecada ee wata maaddooyinka DEET, picaridin ama IR3535.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He should wear long sleeves, long pants, and socks whenever possible, especially during dawn and dusk when mosquitoes are most active.
entries.translation: Waa in uu xirtaa dhar gacmo dhaadheer, surwaal luga dheer iyo sikisaan inta intuu karo, khaasatan inta u dhaxeysa fiidka iyo aroortii oo ah xilliyada kaneecada aadka u kacsan tahay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mosquito netting around his bed would also be helpful.
entries.translation: In uu shandarwo ku wareejiyo sariirtiisa ayaa sidookale caawin karta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Eliminate standing water around his home where mosquitoes breed (e.g., flower pots, buckets, discarded tires).
entries.translation: Meesha haka saaro wixi biyo ee fadhiya gurigiisa halkaa oo ah meesha kaneecada ka dhalato (sida weelasha ubaxa, baaldiyaasha iyo taayirrada la tuuray).
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Animal contact precautions: Avoid contact with any animals, especially livestock, that appear sick or are dead.
entries.translation: Kahortagga la falgalka xayawaannada: Iska ilaali in aad ku dhawaato xayawaan kasta khaasatan xoolaha xanuun ka muuqdo ama bakhtiyey.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If he must handle animals (e.g., he's a farmer), he should wear protective clothing, including gloves and a mask.
entries.translation: Haddii ay ka furan weyso in uu u adeego xayawaan (tusaale hadduu yahay xoolo-dhaqde) waa in uu xirtaa dhar difaacaya, ay   ka mid yihiin gacmo galis (galoof) iyo maaskaro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He should not slaughter any animals himself and should report any suspicious animal deaths to the local veterinary authorities.
entries.translation: Waa in uusan isaga qalin wax xayawaan ah, waa na in uu dawladda hoose ee xannaanada xoolaaha u soo sheegaa xayawaan kasta oo waxa uu u dhintay aysan caddeyn.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Raw milk should not be consumed – it must be pasteurized.
entries.translation: Caanaha waa in sida lagu soo lisay lagu cabin - waa in la sifeeyaa .
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hygiene: Frequent handwashing with soap and water is crucial, especially after handling animals or animal products.
entries.translation: Nadaafadda: Waa muhiim in si joogto ah gacmaha lagu dhaqaa saabbuun iyo biyo, khaasatan marka loo adeego xayawaannada ama gacanta lagu qabto wax xayaawannada ka yimid.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Avoid touching his eyes, nose, and mouth with unwashed hands.
entries.translation: Iska ilaali in aad indhihiisa, sankiisa iyo afkiisa ku taabato gacmo aan la dhaqin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He should also practice good hygiene when coughing or sneezing, covering his mouth and nose with a tissue or his elbow.
entries.translation: Waa in uu sidookale caadeystaa nadaafad wanaagga markuu qufacayo ama hindhisayo, isagoo afkiisa iyo sankiisa ku daboolaya tiish ama jiqilkiisa
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He should avoid sharing personal items like towels, eating utensils, and drinking glasses.
entries.translation: Waa in uu iska ilaaliyaa in dadka uu la isticmaalo waxyaabaha khaaska u ah sida shukumaanka, maacuunta wax lagu cuno iyo koobabka wax lagu cabbo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Isolation (to a reasonable extent): While complete isolation might not be necessary at this stage (before a diagnosis), he should limit close contact with others as much as possible until he sees a doctor.
entries.translation: Isgooni yeelid (ilaa inta macquul): Inkastoo in la is karantiilo ay muhiim ahayn hadda (kahor inta aanan lagaa helin) waa in uu xaddidaa in uu dadka kale ku soo dhawaado inta uu karo ilaa uu ka arko dhakhtar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is particularly important for pregnant women, who are at higher risk of severe complications from RVF.
entries.translation: Tani muhiim ayay u tahay haweenka uurka leh khaasatan,  kuwaasi oo khatar dheeri ah ugu jira xanuun daran haddii uu ku dhaco xanuunka RVF.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Emphasize to your neighbor again that these are precautionary measures and do not replace the need to see a doctor immediately.
entries.translation: Ku adkee deriskaaga mar kale in kuwani ay yihiin tallaabooyin looga hortagi karo, mana aha kuwo baddelaya baahida in la arko dhakhtar si degdeg ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A blood test is needed to confirm the diagnosis and appropriate treatment will be necessary.
entries.translation: Tijaabo dhiig ayaa lagama maarmaan ah si loo xaqiijiyo xanuunka, daaweyn sax ayaana loo baahan doonaa
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Also, if he suspects he has RVF, he needs to inform local health authorities so they can monitor the situation and take appropriate public health measures.
entries.translation: Sidookale, haddii uu ka shakiyo in uu qabo xanuunka RVF, waa in uu ku wargeliyaa mas'uuliyiinta caafimaad ee deegaanka si ay ula socdaa xaaladda, ayna u qaadaan tallaabooyin caafimaad dadweyn ee habboon
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Answer: Yes, absolutely.
entries.translation: Jawaab: Haa, aad iyo aad.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: While malaria is a possibility, especially with travel to a malaria-endemic region, several other illnesses can cause fever, chills, and headache.
entries.translation: Inkastoo malaariya suurtogal tahay, khaasatan maaddaama aad u safartay dhul malaariya ku baahsan tahay, xanuunno kale oo badan ayaa sidookale sababi kara qandho, qarqar iyo madax-xanuun.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Depending on where she traveled, some of the possibilities include:
entries.translation: Iyadoo ay ku xiran tahay meesha ay u safartay, haddana waxyaabaha loo maleyn karo waxaa ka mid ah:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Other mosquito-borne illnesses: Dengue fever, Zika virus, Chikungunya virus, and West Nile virus all share similar symptoms with malaria.
entries.translation: Xanuunnada kale ee ka dhasha kaneecada: Kaduudiye, caabuqa Zika, caabuqa Chikungunya iyo caabuqa West Nile ayaa dhammaan leh astaamo la mid ah kuwa malaariya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Viral infections: Influenza, common cold, COVID-19, and other viral infections can cause these symptoms.
entries.translation: Caabuqyada faafa: Hargabka safmarka, hargabka caadiga, COVID-19 iyo caabuqyada kale ee faafa ayaa keeni kara astaamahani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Bacterial infections: Typhoid fever, urinary tract infections, and bacterial pneumonia can also present with fever, chills, and headache.
entries.translation: Caabuqyada baktiiriya: Tiifoow, caabuqyada kaadi mareenka iyo burukiitada baktiiriyada keento ayaa sidookale wadan kara qandho, qarqar iyo madax-xanuun.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Tick-borne illnesses: Lyme disease, Rocky Mountain spotted fever, and other tick-borne illnesses can cause these symptoms, though headache is less prominent in some.
entries.translation: Xanuunnada ka dhasha shilinta: xanuunka Lyme, xanuunka lagu arko Rocky Mountain iyo xanuunnada kale ee ka dhasha shilinta ayaa keeni kara astmaahan, inkastoo qaarkood madax-xanuun ku yar yahay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Heat stroke/heat exhaustion: If she was in a hot climate and exerted herself, this could be a cause.
entries.translation: Kuleyl daran/qaadashafa kuleyn badan: Haddii ay ku noolayd cimillo kuleyl ah ayna aad u qaadatay, taa na way keeni kartaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Other less common infections: Depending on the region of travel, things like leptospirosis or brucellosis could be considered, although these are less common.
entries.translation: Caabuqyada kale ee aan aadka loo aqaan: Iyadoo ay ku xiran tahay meesha ay u safartay waxyabaaha qaar sida leptospirosis ama brucellosis ayaa la tixgelin karaa, inkastoo kuwani sidaa u badneyn.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's crucial that she tell her doctor exactly where she traveled and what she did there (e.g., hiking, swimming in fresh water, eating street food).
entries.translation: Waa muhiim in ay dhakhtarkeeda u sheegto meesha ay u safartay iyo waxa ay halkaa ka sameysay (sida in ay buur-fuushay, biyo saafi ah ku dabaalatay ama ay cuntay cunnada waddooyinka lagu iibiyo).
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This information will help the doctor narrow down the possibilities and order the appropriate tests.
entries.translation: Macluumaadkan ayaa dhakhtarka ka caawin kara in uu soo koobo xanuunka suurtagalka ah, uuna u dalbo baaritaannada saxda ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's important she doesn't self-treat and seeks professional medical advice.
entries.translation: Waa muhiim in aysan is-daaweyn ayna raadsato talooyin caafimaad oo rasmi ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Answer: Tell your friend to see a doctor immediately to get tested and treated if he does have malaria.
entries.translation: Jawaab: U sheeg saaxibkaaga in uu si dhakhsi ah u arko dhakhtar si loo baaro loona daaweeyo haddii uu qabo malaariya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's not something to mess around with.
entries.translation: Ma aha wax la fududeysto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As for his question about prevention, here's what you can tell him:
entries.translation: Marko loo yimaado su'aashiisa ku saabsan kahortagga, sidaan ayaad u sheegi kartaa:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Malaria prevention is multi-pronged and depends heavily on where he's travelling, as different regions have different mosquito species and resistance patterns.
entries.translation: Kahortagga malaariya waa qaabab badan tahay, waxaayna aad ugu tiirsan tahay halka uu u safrayo maaddaama meel kasta ay leedahay nooc gooni ah oo kaneeco ah iyo iska caabin kala duwan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He should consult a travel health specialist or his doctor for personalized recommendations, but generally speaking, here are the key precautions:
entries.translation: Waa in uu la tashadaa dhaktar ku takhasusay caafimaadka safarrada ama dhakhtarkiisa si uu u helo talooyinka u gooni ah. Laakiin guud ahaan waa kuwan tallaabooyinka taxaddarka ee ugu muhiimsan:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Antimalarial medication: This is crucial.
entries.translation: Daawada kahortagga malaariyada: Tani waa muhiim.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are several different types, and the best one for him will depend on his destination, medical history, and other factors.
entries.translation: Waxaa jira dhawr nooc oo kala duwan, midda isaga u fiican na waxaay ku xiran tahay meesha uu u socdo, taariikhdiisa caafimaad iyo waxyaabo kale.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A doctor needs to prescribe this, and it's often taken before, during, and after the trip.
entries.translation: Waa in uu dhakhtar u qoraa middan, badanaa na waxaa la qaataa safarka kahor, inta aad maqan tahay iyo markaad soo laabato.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Do not self-medicate.
entries.translation: Ha is-daaweynin adiga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mosquito bite prevention: This is the cornerstone of malaria prevention and includes:
entries.translation: Kahortagga qaniinyada kaneecada: Waa waxa laf-dhabar u ah kahortagga malaariya, waxaana ka mid ah:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Insect repellent: Use repellents containing DEET (20-50%), picaridin (20%), or IR3535 (20-30%).
entries.translation: Waxyaabaha caabbiya cayayaanka: Isticmaal caabbiyeyaasha wata maddooyin ku jiraan DEET (20-50%), picaridin (20%) ama IR3535 (20-30%).
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Apply to exposed skin and clothing, following product instructions.
entries.translation: Mari jirka oo qaawan iyo dharka, adigoo raaca tilmaamaha sheeyga aad isticmaaleyso.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Long-sleeved clothing and pants: Wear loose, light-colored clothing that covers most of your body, especially during dawn and dusk when mosquitoes are most active.
entries.translation: Dhar gacmo iyo lugo dhaadheer: Xiro dhar kugu dhaganeyn oo khafiif ah oo daboolaya inta badan jirkaaga, khaasatan inta u dhaxeysa fiidka ilaa aroorti oo ah waqtiga kaneecada aadka u kacsan tahay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Treat clothing with permethrin insecticide for added protection (don't apply directly to skin).
entries.translation: Dharka ku buufi suntda watada permethrin si aad u hesho difaac dheeri ah (toos ha u marinin jirkaaga).
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mosquito nets: Sleep under insecticide-treated mosquito nets, ensuring they are properly tucked in and have no holes.
entries.translation: Shandarwo: Dhex seexo shandarwo la buufiyey, adigoo xaqiijinaya inaad si fiican u galgalisay, wax duleyl na uusan jirin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mosquito-proof accommodation: Stay in places with screened windows and doors, or use air conditioning to keep mosquitoes out.
entries.translation: Hoy aan lahayn kaneeco: dag meel daaqadaha iyo albaabyada la buufiyey ama isticmaal marwaaxado si kaneecada iska bixiso.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Consider mosquito coils or vaporizers if needed.
entries.translation: Tixgeli inaad isticmaasho sunta kaneecada ama uumiyeyaal haddii loo baahdo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Environmental control: While this is more of a public health measure, being aware helps.
entries.translation: Xakameynta bi'ada: Inkastoo tani tahay tallaabo badqabka dadweynaha guud ahaan, in aad ka warqabto ayaa ku caawin karta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Minimizing standing water around accommodations can reduce breeding grounds for mosquitoes.
entries.translation: Yareynta biyaha fariista goobaaha la degan yahay ayaa hoos u dhigi kara in kaneecada taranto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Be aware of symptoms: Even with precautions, there's a small risk of contracting malaria.
entries.translation: Ka warqab astaamaha: Xitaa haddii la taxaddaro weli waxaa jira khatar yar oo lagu qaadi karo malaariya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Knowing the symptoms (fever, chills, sweats, headache, muscle aches, fatigue, nausea, vomiting) is crucial.
entries.translation: In la ogaado astaamaha (qandho, qarqar, dhidid, madax-xanuun, murqo xanuun, daal, lallabo, matag) ayaa muhiim ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If he develops any of these during or after travel to a malaria-endemic area, he should seek medical attention immediately.
entries.translation: Haddii uu isku arko intaan midkood inta uu ku maqan yahay ama ka soo laabtay meel malaariya ku baahsan tahay, waa in uu dhakhtar arkaa sida ugu dhakhsiyada badan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Early diagnosis and treatment are essential.
entries.translation: In la ogaado la na daaweeyo waqti hore waa muhiim.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Again, emphasize to your friend that seeing a doctor right away is the most important step right now for his health.
entries.translation: Markale, ku adkee saaxibkaaga in dhakharka oo isla markaaba la arko ay tahay tallaabada ugu muhiimsan caafimaadkiisa hadda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These prevention tips are for future trips.
entries.translation: Tallooyinkan kahortagga waxaa loogu galay safarrada mustaqbalka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Question: My male neighbor complains of fever, rash and thinks he has Dengue Fever and asks, "What specific precautions should I take to prevent dengue fever complications?"
entries.translation: Su'aal: Nin deriskeyga ayaa ka cabanaya qandho, nabro wuxuu na u maleynayaa in uu qabo Kaduudiye isagoo weydiinaya "Waa maxay taxaddarada khaaska ah ee ay tahay in aan qaado si aan uga hortago xanuun kaduudiye?"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Answer: Tell your neighbor that since he suspects dengue fever, it's crucial he see a doctor immediately for proper diagnosis and management.
entries.translation: Jawaab: U sheeg deriskaaga in haddii uu ka shakiyey in uu hayo kaduudiye in ay muhiim tahay in uu arko dhakhtar isla markaaba si si sax ah loo ogaado loo na xakameeyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dengue can be dangerous, and complications can arise quickly.
entries.translation: Kaduudiye wuxuu noqon karaa mid daran, xanuunkiisa na dhakhso ah ayuu kor ugu kici karaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Self-treating is risky.
entries.translation: Is-daaweyntu waa khatar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: While waiting for his appointment, he should:
entries.translation: Inta uu sugayo ballantiisa dhakhtarka, waa in uu:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rest: This helps the body fight the infection.
entries.translation: Nastaa: Tani waxaay jirka ka caawineysaa in uu la dagaalo caabuqa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He needs to avoid strenuous activities.
entries.translation: Wuxuu u baahan yahay in uu iska ilaaliyo hawlaha xoog u baahan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hydrate: Drink plenty of fluids, like water, electrolyte solutions, or broths, to prevent dehydration, which is a common dengue complication.
entries.translation: Dareeraha badsado: Dareere badan qaato, sida biyo, dareeraha kiimikada ama maraq si uu uga hortago qoyaan la'aanta jirka, taasi oo waxyaabaha badanaa siyaadiya kaduudiyaha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Avoid sugary drinks.
entries.translation: Iska ilaali cabitaannada sonkorta leh.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pain Relief: He can take over-the-counter pain relievers like acetaminophen (Tylenol) to manage fever and pain.
entries.translation: Xanuun baabi'iye: Wuu qaadan xanuun baabi'iyeyaasha dhakhtar u soo qorin sida acetaminophen (Tylenol) si uu u maareeyo qandhada iyo xanuunka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Absolutely avoid ibuprofen (Advil, Motrin), aspirin, and naproxen (Aleve) as these can increase the risk of bleeding, a serious dengue complication.
entries.translation: Aad iskaga ilaali daawooyinka ibuprofen (Advil, Motrin), aspirin iyo naproxen (Aleve) maaddaama ay kordhin karaan dhiig dareerka, taasi oo xanuunka kaduudiyaha mid daran ka dhigi karta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Monitor for Warning Signs: He should watch closely for any warning signs like severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, bleeding gums, rapid breathing, or fatigue/restlessness.
entries.translation: La Soco Calaamadaha Aan Caadiga Ahayn: Waa in uu si hoose  ula socdaa wixi calaamado oo digniin ah sida xanuun daran oo qaybta hoose ee jirka, matag joogto ah dhiig-baxa ciridka, neefsasho badan ama daal/nasasho la'aan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If any of these occur, he should seek immediate medical attention, potentially going to the emergency room.
entries.translation: Haddii intaan mid ka mid ah ay jiraan, waa in uu dhakhtar raadsadaa isla markaaba, isagoo weliba aadaya qaybta degdegga ee isbitaalka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These could indicate severe dengue.
entries.translation: Tani waxaay noqon kartaa kaduudiye aad u daran.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mosquito Control: Even though he's already likely infected, he should prevent further mosquito bites to avoid spreading dengue to others.
entries.translation: Xakameynta Kaneecada: Inkastoo ay suutogal tahay in uu marhore qaaday, waa in uu kahortagaa in kaneeco sii qaniinto si uu uga ilaaliyo in kaduudiyaha ku faafiyo dadka kale.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This means using mosquito repellent, wearing long sleeves and pants, and sleeping under a mosquito net.
entries.translation: Tani waxaay ka dhigan tahay in la isticmaalo waxyaabaha caabbiya kaneecada, xirashada sheey gacmo iyo lugo dhaadheer iyo in aad xirato shandarwo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Emphasize again that he needs to see a doctor as soon as possible.
entries.translation: Ku adkee markale in uu u baahan in uu arko dhakhtar sida ugu dhakhsiyaha badan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This advice is not a substitute for professional medical care.
entries.translation: Talooyinkaan ma aha kuwo baddelayaan daryeel caafimaad oo rasmi ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Answer: It's important to preface this by saying I am not a medical professional.
entries.translation: Jawaab: Waa muhiim in aan marka hore sheegaa in aanan ahayn xirfadle caafimaad.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Your friend needs to see a doctor, not ask the internet, especially since she believes she has multiple diseases.
entries.translation: Saaxibkaa wuxuu u baahan yahay in uu arko dhakhtar, ma aha in uu intarnetka weydiiyo, siba haddii ay aaminsan tahay in ay qabto dhawr jirro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Self-diagnosing zoonotic diseases is particularly dangerous as some can be serious if left untreated.
entries.translation: Inaad isku sheegto jirrooyinka dadka iyo xayawaannada kala qaadaan ayaa khaas ahaan kuwo daran maaddaama ay qaarkood ay halis noqon karaan haddaanan la daaweynin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I can give some general information, but it should not be taken as medical advice.
entries.translation: Waxaan bixin karaa macluumaad guud, balse waa in aanan loo qaadanin talo caafimaad ahaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: To answer her question properly, she needs to provide more information to a doctor.
entries.translation: Si su'aasheeda si sax ah looga jawaabo, waa in ay macluumaad dheeri ah siiso dhakhtar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, some common zoonotic diseases and associated risk factors include:
entries.translation: Hase yeeshee, jirrooyinka badanaa dadka iyo xayawaannada kala qaadaan iyo khatarraha la xiriira waxaa ka mid ah:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Common Zoonotic Diseases & Associated Risk Factors:
entries.translation: Jirrooyinka Dadka iyo Xayawaannada Kala-qaadaan ee La Ogyahay iyo Khataraha la Xiriira:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Lyme disease: Transmitted by ticks.
entries.translation: Jirrada Lyme: Waxaa gudbiya shilinta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Risk factors include spending time in wooded or grassy areas, having pets that go outdoors, and not performing regular tick checks.
entries.translation: Waxyaabaha keena waxaa ka mid ah in waqti lagu qaato goobo alwaaxyo ama xows leh, carbinta xayawaan dibedda aadda iyo in shilinta si joogto ah la isaga eegin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rocky Mountain spotted fever: Also tick-borne.
entries.translation: Jirrada Rocky Mountain: Wuxuu sidookale ka dhashaa shilinta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Similar risk factors to Lyme disease.
entries.translation: Waxyaabaha keena waxaa ka mid ah kuwa Lyme keenna.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Toxoplasmosis: Caused by a parasite often found in cat feces and undercooked meat.
entries.translation: Jirrada Toxoplasmosis: Waxaa keenna dulin badanaa laga helo saxarada bisadda iyo hilibka si fiican u karin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pregnant women and individuals with weakened immune systems are at higher risk.
entries.translation: Haweenka uurka ah iyo dadka nidaamkooda difaaca jirka nugul yahay ayaa halis sare ugu jira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Gardening and handling cat litter are risk factors.
entries.translation: Dhireynta iyo la falgalka wasakhda bisadda ayaa keeni kara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rabies: Transmitted through the bite of an infected animal (e.g., bats, raccoons, skunks).
entries.translation: Raabita: Oo lagu gudbiyo qaniinyada xayawaan qaba (sida fiidmeer, xoor-dabacadde, xoor-dubur).
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Risk factors include contact with wildlife, especially if the animal is behaving strangely.
entries.translation: Waxyaabaha laga qaado waxaa ka mid ahin lala falgalo xayawannada duurjoogta khaasatan haddii xayawaanka u dhaqmayo si la qariibsado.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Salmonella and Campylobacter: Bacterial infections often acquired through contact with contaminated food (especially poultry, eggs, and unpasteurized milk), reptiles, or contaminated water.
entries.translation: Salmonellla iyo Campylobacter: Caabuq ka dhasha baktiiriya oo badanaa laga qaado cunno wasakheysan (khaasatan waxyaabaha digaagta, ukumaha iyo caanaha aan la sifeyn) xayawaannada xamaratada iyo biyaha wasakheysan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ringworm: A fungal infection that can be transmitted from animals (especially cats and dogs) to humans through direct contact.
entries.translation: Jirrada Gariirka: Caabuq keena fangi oo lagu qaado xayawannada (khaasatan bisadaha iyo eyga) oo toos u taabta bani'aadamka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Psittacosis (Parrot Fever): A bacterial infection spread by birds, particularly parrots, parakeets, and pigeons.
entries.translation: Psittacosis (Parrot Fever): Caabuq baktiiriya oo ay faafiyeen shimbiraha, khaasatan baqbaqaaq, barakiit iyo qoolleey.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Risk factors include handling infected birds or inhaling dust from their droppings.
entries.translation: Waxyaabaha laga qaado waxaa ka mid ah qabashada shimbiro jirrada qaba ama qaadashada bus xayawaannadaa ka timid.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Leptospirosis: A bacterial infection spread through contact with the urine of infected animals (e.g., rodents, livestock).
entries.translation: Leptospirosis: Caabuq baktiiriya oo ku faafa ku dhawaanshaha kaadida xayawaanno qaba jirrada (sida jiirka, xoolaha).
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Risk factors include exposure to contaminated water or soil.
entries.translation: Waxyaabaha lagu kala qaado waxaa ka mid ah u dhawaanshaha biyo ama carro wasakheysan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Prevention:
entries.translation: Kahortagga:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: General preventative measures for zoonotic diseases often include:
entries.translation: Tallaabooyinka guud ee kahortagga cudurrada dadka iyo xayawannada kala qaadaan badanaa waxaa kamid ah:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Regular handwashing: Especially after handling animals, their food, or waste.
entries.translation: Gacmo dhaq joogto ah: Khaasatan markaad la falgasho xayawaan, cunnadooda ama wasakhdooda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Safe food handling: Cook meat thoroughly, wash fruits and vegetables, and avoid unpasteurized dairy products.
entries.translation: Maareynta cunnada si badqabta: Si fiican u kari cunnada, dhaq miraha iyo khudradda iska na ilaali noocyada caanaha aan la sifeynin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Tick checks: After spending time outdoors, thoroughly check yourself, your children, and your pets for ticks.
entries.translation: Iska ilaalinta shilinta: Markaad banaanka ka soo laabato, adiga, carruurtaada iyo xayawaankaaga carbisan ba si fiican uga fiiri shilin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Remove them promptly and correctly.
entries.translation: Si sax ah uga qaad isla markaaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Vaccinations: Vaccinate your pets against rabies and other diseases.
entries.translation: Tallaal: Xayawaankaaga carbeed ka tallaal raabita iyo jirrooyinka kale.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are also human vaccines for some zoonotic diseases (e.g., rabies).
entries.translation: Waxaa sidookale tallaal ay dadka ka qaadan karaan jirrooyinka dadka iyo xayawaannada ay kala qaadaan (sida raabitada).
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pest control: Control rodent and insect populations in and around your home.
entries.translation: Xakameynta cayayaanka: Jiirka iyo waxyaabaha kale ee cayayaankaba ka ilaali gudaha iyo agagaarka hoygaaga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Avoid contact with wildlife: Do not handle or feed wild animals.
entries.translation: Iska ilaali la falgalidda duurjoogta: ha qabanin ama quudinin xayawaannada duurjoogta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Be cautious around unfamiliar animals, especially those exhibiting unusual behavior.
entries.translation: Is ilaali markaad ka ag dhaw dahay xayawaanno aadan garaneyn, khaasatan kuwa aad ku aragto dabeecad aan caadi ahayn.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Protective clothing: Wear long sleeves, pants, and closed-toe shoes in areas where ticks or other disease-carrying insects may be present.
entries.translation: Dhar difaac ah: Xiro dhar gacmo dhaadheer, surwaal iyo kabo suulasho u daboolan markaad joogto meel ay joogaan shilinta ama cayayaanka kale ee jirro laga qaado.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Use insect repellent containing DEET.
entries.translation: Isticmaal waxyaabaha cayayaanka caabbiya ee wata DEET.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Again, this is not medical advice.
entries.translation: Markale, tani ma aha talo caafimaad.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Your friend needs to consult a doctor.
entries.translation: Saaxibkaaga wuxuu u baahan yahay in uu arko dhakhtar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Her concerns about having multiple zoonotic illnesses warrant professional medical evaluation.
entries.translation: Walaaceeda ku saabsan in ay qabto dhawr xanuun oo kuwa dadka iyo xayawaannada kala qaadaan waxaay khasbeysaa in ay marto qiimeyn caafimaad oo rasmi ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's possible her symptoms have a different underlying cause altogether.
entries.translation: Waa suurtogal in astamaaheeda ay leeyihiin sababo aan kor laga ogaan karin gebi ahaanba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Encourage her to seek medical attention as soon as possible.
entries.translation: Ku dhiirigeli in ay raadsato talo caafimaad sida u dhakhsiyaha badan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Question: My female classmate complains of fever, chills and thinks she has Malaria and asks, What is the best way to treat malaria?
entries.translation: Su'aal: Gabadh isku fasal nahay ayaa ka cabaneysa qandho, qarqar, waxaayna u maleyneysaa in ay qabto Malaariya, iyadoo weydiineysa, Waa maxay qaabka ugu fiican ee lagu daaweyn karo malaariya?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Answer: She needs to see a doctor immediately.
entries.translation: Jawaab: Waxaay u baahan tahay degdeg u aragto dhakhtar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Malaria is a serious illness and requires a proper diagnosis and prescription medication.
entries.translation: Malaariya waa xanuun aad u daran, waxaayna u baahan tahay ogaansho sax iyo daawooyin dhakhtar qoray.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Self-treating can be dangerous and delay effective treatment, leading to complications.
entries.translation: Is-daaweynta ayaa khatar ah, waxaayna dib u dhigi kartaa daaweynta wax ku ool ka ah, iyadoo horseedi karta in ay ka sii darto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Tell her to go to a doctor or clinic as soon as possible to get tested and receive the appropriate care.
entries.translation: U sheeg in ay aragto dhakhtar ama tagto xarun caafimaad oo bukaan-socod sida ugu dhakhsiyaha badan si loo baaro, ayna u hesho daryeel sax ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Answer: Tell your neighbor that he absolutely should not attempt to self-treat suspected onchocerciasis with over-the-counter supplements.
entries.translation: Jawaab: U sheeg deriskaaga waa in uu sinnaba isku dayin daawooyinka bannaanka ee aan dhaktar soo qorin haddii uu isaga shakisan yahay onchocerciasis.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are no over-the-counter supplements that prevent or treat river blindness.
entries.translation: Ma jiraan daawoyin banaankaa oo la qaato oo ka hortaga ama daaweyn kara jirrada tikhsiga webiga laga qaado.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: His symptoms (severe itching, blindness) are serious and warrant immediate medical attention from a qualified doctor.
entries.translation: Astaamahiisa (cuncun aadka ah, arag la'aan) waa halis, waxayna u baahan yihiin in loo tago dhakhtar rasmi ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He needs to be properly diagnosed and, if he does have onchocerciasis, receive the appropriate prescription medication.
entries.translation: Wuxuu u baahan yahay in si sax ah loo ogaado jirrada, haddii uu onchocerciasis qaba na si uu u helo daawo sax ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Delaying proper medical care can lead to permanent vision loss and other serious complications.
entries.translation: Dib u dhigista daryeel caafimaad ayaa horseed karta aragga oo si joogto ah loo waayo iyo dhibaatooyin kale oo daran.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He should see a doctor as soon as possible.
entries.translation: Waa in uu dhakhtar arkaa sida ugu dhakhsiyaha badan..
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Answer: No, schistosomiasis is not a genetic disease and cannot be passed directly from parents to their children through genes.
entries.translation: Jawaab: Maya, schistosomiasis ma aha jirro la iska dhaxlo, waalidkana si toos ma ugu wareejin karo carruurta iyadoo loo marayo hidde-sideyaal
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's a parasitic infection caused by flatworms called schistosomes.
entries.translation: Waa caabuq dulin ka dasha oo gooryaan fidksan oo lagu magacaabo schistosomes.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You get it by coming into contact with contaminated freshwater where the parasite larvae live.
entries.translation: Waxaad qaadeysaa markaad la falgasho biyo webi oo ay ku nool yihiin dulin tixiri (larvae).
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These larvae penetrate the skin and develop inside the body.
entries.translation: Tixiriyadan ayaa ka gudba maqaarka kuna tarma jirka gudihiisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So, while family members might be at higher risk if they share the same contaminated water source, it's due to shared environmental exposure, not inheritance.
entries.translation: Sidaa daraadeed, inkastoo xubnaha qoyska ay halis dheeri ah ugu jiraan haddii isla isticmaalaan hal biyo oo wasakheysan, haddana waxaa lagu kala qaadaa in hal bi'o lagu wada nool yahay, ma aha wax la kala dhaxlo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He should definitely see a doctor to get diagnosed and treated properly, as untreated schistosomiasis can lead to serious long-term health issues.
entries.translation: Waa khasab in uu dhakhtar arko si loo ogaado oo si sax ahna loo daaweeyo maaddaama schistosomiasis aan la daaweynin ay horseedi karto arrin caafimaad oo daran oo muddo dheer qaatada.
