entries.english: Nurse: Hi, good morning, Ms. Barbosa. I see you're getting ready to head home after your radiation therapy. How are you feeling today?
entries.translation: Kalkaaliye Caafimaad: Haye, subax wanaagsan, Ms. Barbosa. Waxaan arkaa inaad u diyaar garoobeyso inaad guriga aaddo ka dib daaweynta shucaaca. Sidee dareemaysaa maanta?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ms. Barbosa: I'm feeling a bit tired, but okay overall. Ready to be in my own bed, that's for sure.
entries.translation: Ms. Barbosa: Waxaan dareemayaa daal yar, laakiin guud ahaan waan fiicanahay. Waxaan diyaar u ahay inaan aado sariirteyda, run ahaantii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ms. Barbosa: Sure, it's Xiaoli Roberts, and my date of birth is March 12th, 1965.
entries.translation: Ms. Barbosa: Haa, waa Xiaoli Roberts, taariikhda dhalashadaydu na waa March 12-keedii, 1965.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: Perfect, thank you. Now, looking at your discharge instructions, it says you had radiation therapy for breast cancer. Is that correct?
entries.translation: Kalkaaliye Caafimaad: Waa sidi la rabay, mahadsanid. Hadda, markaan eegno tilmaamahaaga bixitaanka, wuxuu dhigayaa in aad qaadatay daaweynta shucaaca ee kansarka naasaha. Ma sax baa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ms. Barbosa: Yes, that's right.
entries.translation: Ms. Barbosa: Haa, waa sidaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: Okay. And how are you managing any pain or discomfort?
entries.translation: Kalkaaliye Caafimaad: Haye. Sideese u maareyneysaa xanuun kasta ama raaxo la'aan?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ms. Barbosa: The pain is manageable with the medication they gave me. I've been taking it as directed.
entries.translation: Ms. Barbosa: Xanuunka waa mid la maareyn karo daawada ay i siiyeen. Waxaan u qaadanayey sidii la i faray.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ms. Barbosa: I will, thank you.
entries.translation: Ms. Barbosa: Waan sammeyn doonaa, mahadsanid.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: Also, do you have someone at home to help you out for a bit?
entries.translation: Kalkaaliye Caafimaad: Sidoo kale, ma haysataa qof guriga jooga oo ku yara caawiya?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ms. Barbosa: Yes, my husband will be there. He's taking a few days off work.
entries.translation: Ms. Barbosa: Haa, ninkeyga ayaa ila joogi doona. Wuxuu dhawr maalmood oo fasax ah ka qaadanayaa shaqada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: That's great. Having support is important. Do you have any questions for me before you leave?
entries.translation: Kalkaaliye Caafimaad: Waa wax aad u fiican. In taageero la helo waa muhiim. Ma jiraa wax su'aallo ah oo aad i weydiineyso intaadan bixin?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ms. Barbosa: No, I think I'm good. The instructions seem pretty clear.
entries.translation: Ms. Barbosa: Maya, waxaan u maleynayaa inaanan wax su'aal ah qabin hadda. Tilmaamuhu waxaay u muuqdaan kuwo cad.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: Alright then. We'll get your discharge paperwork finalized and you'll be on your way shortly. Take care, Ms. Barbosa.
entries.translation: Kalkaaliye Caafimaad: Hagaag haddaba. Waan soo gabagabeyn doonnaa waraaqahaaga bixitaanka oo mardhaw waan ku fasixi doonnaa. Is ilaali, Ms. Barbosa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ms. Barbosa: Thank you, nurse. You too.
entries.translation: Ms. Barbosa: Mahadsanid, kalkaaliye. Adiguna sidoo kale.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: INSTRUCTIONS FOR PATIENT:
entries.translation: TILMAAMAHA LOOGU TALAGALAY BUKAANKA:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 1.  Monitor Symptoms: Closely watch for any worsening or new symptoms, including:
entries.translation: 1.  La Soco Astaamaha: Si dhow u la soco astaamo kasta oo ka sii daraya ama kuwo cusub, oo ay ku jiraan:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: *   Severe headaches, especially those worsened by coughing or straining.
entries.translation: *   Madax xanuun daran, gaar ahaan kuwa qufac ama dhibid ka sii dara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: *   Neck pain or stiffness.
entries.translation: *   Xanuun qoorta ah ama qoor adayg.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: *   Balance or coordination problems.
entries.translation: *   Dhibaatooyinka dheelitirnaanka ama isku xirnaanta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: *   Changes in vision or speech.
entries.translation: *   Isbeddellada aragga ama hadalka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: *   Weakness or numbness in the arms or legs.
entries.translation: *   Tabar yari ama kabuubyo gacmaha ama lugaha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: *   Difficulty swallowing.
entries.translation: *   Dhib dhanka cunno liqidda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 2.  Rest and Avoid Strenuous Activity: Take it easy and avoid activities that could increase pressure in the head or neck, such as heavy lifting, intense exercise, or contact sports.
entries.translation: 2.  Naso oo Ka Fogoow Hawlaha Tamar Badan Kaaga Baahan: Iska fududee oo iska ilaali hawlaha kordhin kara cadaadiska madaxa ama qoorta, sida qaadista walxaha culus, jimicsiga daran, ama ciyaaraha la is taabto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 4.  Seek Immediate Medical Attention: Go to the nearest emergency room or call 911 if you experience:
entries.translation: 4.  Raadso Daryeel Caafimaad oo Degdeg ah: Tag qolka gargaarka degdegga ah ee kuugu dhow ama wac 911 haddii aad isku aragto:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: *   Loss of consciousness.
entries.translation: *   Miyir beelid.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: *   Severe, persistent vomiting.
entries.translation: *   Mantag daran, oo joogto ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: *   Sudden onset of severe headache.
entries.translation: *   Si lama filaan ah u bilawda madax xanuun daran.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: *   Difficulty breathing.
entries.translation: *   Neefsashada oo ku dhibta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: *   Changes in bowel or bladder control.
entries.translation: *    Isbeddellada ku yimaada saxarada ama kaadi heysta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 5.  Follow-up Appointment: Schedule an appointment with Dr. Margaux Caron, Pediatric Neurologist, as soon as possible for further evaluation and management. Her office number is 555-0198.
entries.translation: 5.  Ballan Dabagal: Ballan ka qabso Dikt. Margaux Caron, Dhakhtarka neerfaha ee Carruurta, sida ugu dhaqsaha badan si qiimeyn dheeri loo sammeeyo loona maareeyo. Nambarka xafiiskeedu waa 555-0198.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 6.  Keep a Symptom Log: Note the time, duration, and severity of any symptoms, as well as any triggers or relieving factors. Bring this log to your appointment.
entries.translation: 6.  Hayso Diiwaan Astaamo: Xusuusnow waqtiga, muddada, iyo darnaanta astaamo kasta, iyo sidoo kale wax kasta oo kiciya ama yareeya. La imoow diiwaankan waqtiga ballantaada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Additional Information:
entries.translation: Macluumaad Dheeraad ah:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: *   Hydration: Drink plenty of fluids to stay hydrated.
entries.translation: *   Biyo-siinta jirka: Cab cabitaanno badan si aad u ahaato mid jirkaaga biyo u helo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: *   Sleep: Get adequate rest and sleep.
entries.translation: *   Hurddada: Hel nasasho iyo hurdo kugu filan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: *   Diet: Maintain a healthy diet.
entries.translation: *   Cuntada: Joogtee cunto caafimaad leh.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Please contact Dr. Caron's office at 555-0198 if you have any questions or concerns before your appointment.
entries.translation: Fadlan kala xiriir xafiiska Dikt.. Caron 555-0198 haddii aad qabto wax su'aallo ah ama walaac ah kahor ballantaada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Provider: Good afternoon. I'm Dr. Chen. What brings you in today?
entries.translation: Adeeg bixiyahaa: Galab wanaagsan. Waxaan ahay Dikt. Chen. Maxaa maanta ku keenay halkan?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Hi, Dr. Chen. I'm here for fertility testing. My wife and I have been trying to conceive for a year without success, and I'm getting a little worried.
entries.translation: Bukaanka: Sidee tahay, Dikt. Chen. Waxaan u imid baaritaanka awoodda dhalmada. Xaaskeyga iyo aniga waxaan isku dayeynay inaan uur yeelanno muddo sanad ah iyadoo aan ku guulaysan,  waxaana bilaabay inaan yara walwalo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Provider: Okay, those are important details. Environmental exposures and stress can potentially impact fertility. We'll definitely take those into consideration as we move forward with testing.
entries.translation: Bixiyaha Adeegga: Hagaag, intaasi waa faahfaahin muhiim ah. Bey'ada aad ku hawlgasho iyo walwalka waxaay saameyn ku yeelan karaan awoodda dhalmada. Hubaal waan tixgelin doonaa kuwaas markaan u gudbeyno baaritaanka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: What kind of tests will I need to do?
entries.translation: Bukaanka: Waa maxay nooca baaritaannada aan u baahan doono inaan sameeyo?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: That sounds reasonable. Is there anything I can do in the meantime to improve my chances?
entries.translation: Bukaanka: Taasi waxaay u muuqataa mid macquul ah. Ma jiraa wax aan sameyn karo xilligan oo aan kor ugu qaadi karo fursadaheyga?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Thanks for the advice, Dr. Chen. I'll definitely try to make some changes.
entries.translation: Bukaanka: Waad ku mahadsan tahay talada, Dikt. Chen. Hubaal waxaan isku dayi doonaa inaan nolosheyda wax ka baddello.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Thank you, doctor. I appreciate your help.
entries.translation: Bukaanka: Waad ku mahadsan tahay, dhakhtar. Waan kaaga mahadcelinayaa caawimaaddaada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pre-Operative Instructions for Excessive Sweating Treatment
entries.translation: Tilmaamaha Kahor Qalliinka ee Daawaynta Dhididka Xad-Dhaafka ah
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Adebayo: No problem at all, Sophie. I see you had surgery on your knee a few weeks ago. How are you feeling?
entries.translation: Dikt. Adebayo: Wax dhib malahan, Sophie. Waxaan arkaa in qalliin jilibka lagaa sameeyay dhowr usbuuc kahor. Sidee ayaad dareemaysaa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: I'm doing okay, thanks. The pain is definitely better than it was right after surgery, but it's still there, especially when I try to move around too much.
entries.translation: Bukaanka: Waan roonahay, mahadsanid. Xanuunka xaqiiqdii wuu ka fiican yahay sidii uu ahaa qalliinka kaddib, laakiin weli wuu jiraa, gaar ahaan marka aan isku dayo inaan wax badan sosocdo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Adebayo: That's understandable. Post-operative pain can be tricky to manage sometimes. Have you been taking any medication for it?
entries.translation: Dr. Adebayo: Taasi waa wax la fahmi karo. Xanuunka qalliinka ka dib mararka qaarkood way adkaan kartaa in la maareeyo. Ma u qaadaneysay wax daawo ah?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Yeah, I've been taking some ibuprofen, but I don't like relying on pills too much. That's why my doctor suggested acupuncture.
entries.translation: Bukaanka: Haa, waxaan qaadanayay xoogaa ibuprofen, laakiin ma jecli inaan aad ugu tiirsanaado kaniiniyada. Taasina waa sababta dhakhtarkaygu u soo jeediyay acupuncture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: No, never. I'm a little nervous about the needles, to be honest.
entries.translation: Bukaanka: Maya, waligeed. Waxaan ka yara walwalsanahay irbadaha, run ahaantii
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: That sounds good. So, how does it work exactly?
entries.translation: Bukaanka: Taasi waxaay u muuqataa arrin fiican. Haddaba, sidee bay u shaqeysaa dhab ahaantii?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Okay, that makes sense. How many sessions will I need?
entries.translation: Bukaanka: Waayahay, waa wax macquul ah . Immisa kulan ayaan u baahan doonaa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Sounds like a plan. When can we start?
entries.translation: Bukaanka: Waxaay u egtahay qorshe fiican. Goorma ayaan billaabi karnaa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Adebayo: We can start right now if you're ready. Just have a seat on the table and we'll get started.
entries.translation: Dikt. Adebayo: Hadda ayaan billaabi karnaa haddii aad diyaar tahay. Kaliya ku fadhiiso miiska waana billaabi doonnaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Okay, great. Thanks, Dr. Adebayo.
entries.translation: Bukaanka: Waayahay, si fiican. Mahadsanid, Dikt. Adebayo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Adebayo: You're welcome, Sophie. Let's get you feeling better.
entries.translation: Dikt. Adebayo: Adaa mudan, Sophie. Aan kaa caawinno in aad fiicnaato.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Ncube: Good afternoon, Mr. Novikov. I understand you're experiencing some abdominal discomfort today. Can you tell me a bit more about what's going on?
entries.translation: Dikt. Ncube: Galab wanaagsan, Mr. Novikov. Waxaan fahamsannahay inaad la kulanto xoogaa dhib caloosha ah maanta. Wax yar ma iiga sheegi kartaa waxa ku haya?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Ncube: I see. And have you noticed any changes in your urination habits? Like needing to go more often, or any pain or burning sensation?
entries.translation: Dikt. Ncube: Waan arkaa. Oo ma dareentay wax isbeddel ah oo ku yimid caadooyinkaaga kaadida? Sida inaad u baahan tahay inaad tagto marar badan, ama wax xanuun ah ama dareen gubasho ah?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Novikov: Well, now that you mention it, I have been getting up a few times at night to pee. And sometimes my ankles get a bit swollen, especially by the end of the day.
entries.translation: Mr. Novikov: Hagaag, maaddaama aad xustay, waxaan dhowr jeer habeenkii si ku kacayey kaadi. Mararka qaarkoodna anqawyadaydu xoogaa way bararaan, gaar qaybaha dambe ee maalinta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Ncube: Okay, those are important details. Have you been diagnosed with any other health conditions recently, Mr. Novikov?
entries.translation: Dr. Ncube: Hagaag, waa faahfaahin muhiim ah. Ma laguugu arkay xaalado caafimaad oo kale dhawaan, Mr. Novikov?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Novikov: Just high blood pressure, Doc. My regular doctor put me on some pills for it a few years back. But I haven't been the best at taking them regularly, to be honest.
entries.translation: Mr. Novikov: Kaliya dhiig karka, dhakhtar. Dhakhtarkayga caadiga ah ayaa ii qoray kiniinno dhawr sano ka hor. Laakiin kuma fiicnayn inaan si joogto ah u qaato, run ahaantii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Novikov: Tests? Does that mean something's seriously wrong with my kidneys?
entries.translation: Mr. Novikov: Baaritaanno? Taasi miyey ka dhigan tahay inay wax ka qaldan yihiin kelyaheyga?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Novikov: Alright, Doc. Whatever you think is best. I just want to feel better and get back to my normal self.
entries.translation: Mr. Novikov: Waa hagaag, dhakhtar. Wax kasta oo aad u malayneyso in ay ugu fiican yihiin. Kaliya waxaan rabaa inaan dareemo fiicnaan oo aan ku noqdo naftayda caadiga ahayd.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Alright, Mr. Durand, let's take a look at those bites," the nurse practitioner said, reaching for a magnifying glass. "Where exactly are they bothering you?"
entries.translation: "Waayahay, Mr. Durand, aan eegno qaniinyadaas," ayuu yiri kalkaaliyaha caafimaadka, isagoo u sii fidinaya muraayadda weynaysa. "Xaggee ayay khaasatan ku xanuunjinayaan?"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "No, just the itching and the swelling," Mr. Durand said, scratching absentmindedly at one of the bites. "But they're really starting to bug me, especially when I'm working out in the sun."
entries.translation: "Maya, kaliya cuncunka iyo bararka," ayuu yiri Mr. Durand, isagoo mid ka mid ah qaniinyada xoqaya. "Laakiin dhab ahaantii waxaay billaabayaan inay i dhibaan, gaar ahaan marka aan jimisi ku sameynayo qorraxda."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: " just some over-the-counter antihistamines," Mr. Durand replied. "And I've been putting ice on them when I get home."
entries.translation: "kaliya qaar ka mid ah daawada antihistamines-ka ee farmashiyaha laga iibsado," ayuu Mr. Durand ku jawaabay. "Oo baraf ayaan saarayay markaan guriga tago."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Okay, thanks," Mr. Durand said, looking relieved. "I appreciate it."
entries.translation: "Hagaag, mahadsanid," ayuu yiri Mr. Durand, isagoo u muuqda mid nafis dareemay. "Waan ka mahadnaqayaa."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "No problem," the nurse practitioner smiled. "Just take it easy out there, and try to avoid getting stung again if you can help it."
entries.translation: "Dhib ma leh," ayuu yiri kaalkaaliyaha oo dhoola caddeynaya. "Kaliya si fudud u qaado halkaa, oo isku day inaad iska ilaaliso in mar kale lagu qaniino haddii aad karto."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Will do," Mr. Durand said, gathering his things. "Thanks again."
entries.translation: "Waan sameyn doonaa," ayuu yiri Mr. Durand, isagoo alaabtiisa urursanaya. "Mar kale waad mahadsan tahay."

entries.translation: Daawooyinka xanuunka ee farmashiyaha laga iibsado (ibuprofen ama acetaminophen) haddii loo baahdo
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient Instructions
entries.translation: Tilmaamaha Loogu Talogalay Bukaanka

entries.english: Diet: Maintain a balanced diet with plenty of fruits, vegetables, and whole grains. Limit processed foods and sugary drinks. Stay hydrated by drinking plenty of water throughout the day.
entries.translation: Cuntada: Joogtee cunto isku dheelitiran oo ay ku jiraan miro, khudaar, iyo badar. Xaddid cuntooyinka warshadaysan iyo cabitaannada sonkorta leh. Waraabi jirkaaga adigoo cabbaya biyo badan maalintii oo dhan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Activity: Engage in regular physical activity as tolerated, such as walking or light gardening. Avoid strenuous activities that may cause fatigue or increase confusion.
entries.translation: Dhaqdhaqaaqa: Ka qaybqaado dhaqdhaqaaq jireed oo joogto ah inta aad awooddo, sida socodka ama beerta oo looga shaqeeyo si fudud. Iska ilaali hawlaha culus ee keeni kara daal ama kordhin kara wareerka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Medications: Take Donepezil 10mg daily at bedtime. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember, but do not double up on doses.
entries.translation: Daawooyinka: Qaado Donepezil 10mg maalin kasta wakhtiga hurdada. Haddii aad seegto qiyaas, qaado isla markaad xasuusato, laakiin ha labalaabin qiyaasta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Support: Connect with local support groups or organizations for individuals with dementia and their caregivers. These resources can provide valuable information and emotional support.
entries.translation: Taageerada: La xiriir kooxaha taageerada maxalliga ah ama ururrada dadka qaba asaasaqa iyo daryeelayaashooda. Waxyaabahan ayaad ka heli kartaa macluumaad qiimo leh iyo taageero shucuureed.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Emergency: If you experience sudden chest pain, difficulty breathing, or loss of consciousness, call 911 immediately.
entries.translation: Xaaladda Degdegga ah: Haddii aad isku aragto xanuun laabta ah oo degdeg ah, neefsashada oo kugu adkaata, ama miyir-beel, wac 911 isla markaaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hello again, Mr. Molnar. I see you're back because your symptoms haven't improved. Let's discuss the next steps.
entries.translation: Halloow mar kale, Mr. Molnar. Waxaan arkaa inaad soo laabatay sababtoo ah astaamahaaga ma fiicnaanin. Aan ka hadalno tallaabooyinka xiga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Please remember to bring a list of all your current medications and any questions you may have to our next appointment. Thank you for your patience and cooperation. We'll get to the bottom of this.
entries.translation: Fadlan xusuusnow inaad keento liiska dhammaan daawooyinkaaga hadda iyo wixii su'aallo ah oo aad qabtid ballanta xigta. Waad ku mahadsan tahay dulqaadkaaga iyo iskaashigaaga. Waan gaari doonnaa gunta arrintan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Good morning, Mr. Teixeira. How are you feeling today?
entries.translation: Dhakhtarka: Subax wanaagsan, Mr. Teixeira. Sidee tahay maanta?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Morning, Doctor. To be honest, not great. I've been having some trouble, especially with my, uh, private area. It's been quite painful when I have to urinate.
entries.translation: Bukaanka: Subax wanaagsan, Dhakhtar. Run ahaantii, ma fiicni. Waxaa i haysatay dhibaato, gaar ahaan xubinteyda taranka. Way i xanuunaysaa markaan kaadinayo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: I'm sorry to hear that. Can you describe the pain a bit more for me? Is it a burning sensation, a sharp pain, or something else?
entries.translation: Dhakhtarka: Waan ka xumahay inaan maqlo taas. Waxyar ma ii sii sharrixi kartaa xanuunka? Ma gubasho baa, mise xanuun kugu taagan, mise wax kale?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Yeah, it's more of a burning feeling, Doc. Every time I have to go, it's like... fire down there. And I feel like I have to go all the time, even if just a little comes out.
entries.translation: Bukaanka: Haa, badanaa waa gubasho, Dhakhtar. Markasta oo aan doono tago, waa sida... dab ka kacaya halkaas. Waxaan dareemayaa in aan mar kasta rabo in aan tago, xitaa haddii wax yar iga imaadaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: That sounds uncomfortable. Have you noticed any other symptoms along with the painful urination? Any blood in your urine, or perhaps a foul smell?
entries.translation: Dhakhtarka: Taasi waxaay u muuqataa mid dhib badan. Ma isku aragtay astaamo kale oo la socda kaadida xanuunka leh? Wax dhiig ma ku jiraa kaadidaada, mise laga yaabaa in ay ur xun leedahay?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: I see. Increased sweating can sometimes be a sign of infection or other underlying issues. Have you had a fever or felt feverish recently?
entries.translation: Dhakhtarka: Waan arkaa. Dhididka badan mararka qaarkood wuxuu calaamad u noqon karaa caabuq ama arrimo kale oo hoose. Ma leedahay qandho ama ma qandheysneyd dhowaanahan?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Maybe a little warm sometimes, but I haven't taken my temperature. Just feeling generally run down, you know? Not as much energy as usual.
entries.translation: Bukaanka: Waxaa laga yaabaa inaan yar diirranahay mararka qaarkood, laakiin ma aanan cabbirin heerkulkayga. Kaliya waxaan dareemayaa guud ahaan hoos u dhac, ma garanaysaa? Tamar badan ma haysto sidii caadiga ahayd.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Understood. And have you had any recent changes in your medication or any new health concerns that we should be aware of?
entries.translation: Dhakhtarka: Waan fahmay. Ma ku sameysay wax isbeddel ah daawadaada dhowaan ama ma jiraan walaacyo caafimaad oo cusub oo ay tahay in aan ka warqabno?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Not really, Doc. Just the usual stuff for my blood pressure and cholesterol. Haven't started anything new lately.
entries.translation: Bukaanka: Run ahaantii maya, Dhakhtar. Kaliya waxa ihaya waa un waxyaalaha caadiga ah ee dhiig karkayga iyo kolestaroolka. Dhowaan ma aanan billaabin wax cusub.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Whatever you think is best, Doctor. Just want to get this sorted out. It's been bothering me for a few days now.
entries.translation: Bukaanka: Wax kasta oo aad u maleyneyso inay fiican yihiin. Kaliya waxaan rabaa inaan xal u helo xanuunkan. Dhowr maalmood ayay i dhibaysay hadda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Will do, Doc. Thanks for seeing me today.
entries.translation: Bukaanka: Waan sameyn doonaa, Dhakhtar. Waad ku mahadsan tahay inaad i aragtay maanta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: You're welcome, Mr. Teixeira. We'll do our best to get you feeling better soon. Let's get those tests started, shall we?
entries.translation: Dhakhtarka: Adaa mudan, Mr. Teixeira. Waxaanaad ugu dedaali doonnaa inaan sida ugu dhaqsaha ugu soo roonaato. Aan billaabno baaritaannadaasi, sow ma aha?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Understanding Your Migraine and Lab Results
entries.translation: Fahamidda Madax-xanuunkaaga Dhanjafka iyo Natiijooyinka Sheybaarka
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: What We Found
entries.translation: Waxa Aan Ogaannay
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: What This Means

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Your Migraine Plan
entries.translation: Qorshaagaha Dhanjafka
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Since we've ruled out other causes, our focus will be on:
entries.translation: Maadaama aan meesha ka saarnay sababaha kale, diiraddayadu waaxay noqon doontaa:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Lifestyle Adjustments: Simple changes like staying hydrated, maintaining a regular sleep schedule, and gentle exercise can make a big difference.
entries.translation: Isbeddelada Hab-nololeedka: Isbeddello fudud sida joogteynta biyo cabidda, ilaalinta jadwal hurdo oo joogto ah, iyo jimicsi fudud ayaa keeni kara isbaddel weyn.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Next Steps
entries.translation: Tallaabooyinka Xiga
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Keep a headache diary noting when your headaches start, how long they last, and what you were doing or eating beforehand.
entries.translation: Heyso buug xusuus qor ah oo aad ku qorto goorta madax-xanuunkaagu billowdo, inta uu socdo, iyo waxa aad  samayneysay ama cuneysay ka hor xanuunka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Bring this diary to your next appointment in 4 weeks.
entries.translation: La imoow buuggan xusuus qorka ah ballantaada xigta oo ah 4 toddobaad gudahood.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Call the office if your headaches change significantly, become more frequent, or if you experience new symptoms like vision changes or weakness.
entries.translation: Wac xafiiska haddii madax-xanuunkaagu si weyn isu baddelo, noqdo mid soo noqnoqda, ama haddii aad isku aragto calaamado cusub sida isbeddelka aragga ama daciifnimo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Remember
entries.translation: Xusuusnow
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Please let me know if you have any questions. We are here to support you.
entries.translation: Fadlan ii soo sheeg haddii aad qabto wax su'aallo ah. Halkan waxaan u joognaa inaan ku taageerno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Wairimu: Good morning, Mr. Ramirez. I'm Dr. Wairimu. I see you've been having some trouble with your breathing. Could you tell me a little more about that?
entries.translation: Dikt. Wairimu: Subax wanaagsan, Mr. Ramirez. Waa Dikt. Wairimu. Waxaan arkaa inaad xoogaa dhib ah ku qabto neefsashada. Wax yar ma iiga sheegi kartaa waxa ku haya?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Wairimu: Okay, I understand. Have you had any other symptoms, like a cough, fever, or chest pain?
entries.translation: Dikt. Wairimu: Waa hagaag, waan fahmay. Ma leedahay wax astaamo kale, sida qufac, qandho, ama xabad xanuun?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Ramirez: I've had a bit of a cough, but it's dry. No fever or chest pain, though.
entries.translation: Mr. Ramirez: Waxaan lahaa qufac yar, laakiin waa mid qalalan. Qandho ama xabad xanuun ma lahey laakiin..
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Wairimu: Alright. And have you been using your inhalers regularly?
entries.translation: Dikt. Wairimu: Waa hagaag. Miyaad si joogto ah u isticmaaleysaa dawooyinkaaga neefta?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Ramirez: Yes, I use my rescue inhaler when I need it, and I take my maintenance inhaler every morning.
entries.translation: Mr. Ramirez: Haa, waan isticmaalaa daawooyinkeyga neefta badbaadinta marka aan u baahdo, waxaanan qaataa daawadeyda ilaalinta neefta subax kasta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Wairimu: That's good. I'm going to listen to your lungs now. Can you please take a deep breath for me?
entries.translation: Dikt. Wairimu: Taasi waa wax wanaagsan. Hadda waxaan dhageysanayaa sambabadaada. Fadlan neef qoto dheer ii qaado?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Ramirez: Sure. (Takes a deep breath)
entries.translation: Mr. Ramirez: Haye. (Qaado neef qoto dheer)
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Ramirez: Okay, that sounds fine.
entries.translation: Mr. Ramirez: Waa hagaag, taasi waa wax fiican.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Wairimu: While we wait for the results, I'm going to give you a nebulizer treatment to help open up your airways. It should make you feel a bit better.
entries.translation: Dikt. Wairimu: Inta aan sugayno natiijooyinka, waxaan ku siinayaa daaweynta neefsashada si ay kaaga caawiso furitaanka marinnada neefta. Waa in aad ku yar roonaataa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Ramirez: Thank you, doctor. I appreciate it.
entries.translation: Mr. Ramirez: Waad ku mahadsan tahay, dhakhtar. Waan kaaga mahadnaqayaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Martinez: Good morning, Mr. Park. I see you're here for your scheduled vaccinations today.
entries.translation: Dikt. Martinez: Subax wanaagsan, Mr. Park. Waan arkaa inaad maanta u joogto tallaaladaada ku jadwaleysan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Park: I appreciate that, Doc. I just want to make sure I'm not being taken for a ride.
entries.translation: Mr. Park: Waan kaaga mahadnaqayaa taas, Dhakhtar. Kaliya waxaan rabaa inaan hubiyo inaan la i khiyaameyn.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Park: Alright, that sounds fair. Let's see what you've got.
entries.translation: Mr. Park: Hagaag, taasi ma xuma. Aan aragno waxa aad hayso.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Spouse: It's not just twitching, Sunita! Your hand was completely curled up this morning. You couldn't even hold your coffee mug!
entries.translation: Lammaanaha: Kaliya gariir ma ahan, Sunita! Gacantaadu saaka way isku laaban tahay gebi ahaanba. Xataa ma qabsan kartid koobkaaga bunka!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: It was a little stiff, that's all. It loosened up after a while.
entries.translation: Bukaanka: Xoogaa way adkaatay, waa un intaa. Waxyar kaddib way furfurantay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Spouse: And what about the leg cramps? You've been waking up screaming in the middle of the night!
entries.translation: Lammaanaha: Maxayse yihiin casiraadaha lugta? Habeenkii siqda dhexe ayaad soo kacdaa adigoo qeylinaya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Okay, okay, so I get a charley horse sometimes. Everyone gets those.
entries.translation: Bukaanka: Haye, haye, mararka qaar waxaan helaa casiraadaha lugta (charley horse). Qof kastaa way ku dhacaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: Good morning, I'm Nurse Miller. What seems to be the trouble today?
entries.translation: Kalkaaliyaha: Subax wanaagsan, waxaan ahay Kalkaaliye Miller. Maxaay maanta dhibaatada laga yaabo in ay idiin heysato?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Spouse: He's been having muscle spasms and cramps, nurse. Bad ones.
entries.translation: Lammaanaha: Wuxuu lahaa casiraad dhanka muruqyada, kalkaaliye. Kuwo xun.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: It's really not a big deal. My wife just worries too much.
entries.translation: Bukaanka: Wax weyn ma aha runtii. Xaaskaygu aad bay u welwelsan tahay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: Well, let's take a look, shall we? Can you describe the spasms for me, Sunita? When do they happen? How long do they last?
entries.translation: Kalkaaliyaha: Hagaag, aan eegno, diyaar miyaa? Ma ii sharrixi kartaa casiraadaha, Sunita? Goorme ayaad isku aragtaa? Intee in le'eg ayay kugu raagaan?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: And the pain? On a scale of 1 to 10?
entries.translation: Kalkaaliyaha: Iyo xanuunka? Ku qiyaas 1 ilaa 10?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Provider: Good morning. I understand you're here for the clinical trial screening for the fine-needle aspiration procedure. My name is Dr. Martin.

entries.english: Patient: Yes, that's correct. I'm Hamid. This is my husband, Pierre.

entries.english: Hamid: Well, I found a lump in my neck a few weeks ago. My doctor recommended getting it checked out, and mentioned this trial.

entries.english: The United States Department of State warns U.S. citizens of a high security threat level in Yemen due to what it describes as "terrorist activities and civil unrest". ,
entries.translation: Waaxda Arrimaha Dibedda ee Maraykanka ayaa uga digaysaa Muwaadiniinta Maraykanka Heerka sare ee ammaan ee Yemen sababo la xidhidha wax ay ku tilmaamtay inay yihiin “Hawlgalladda Argagixisadda iyo Kacdoonadda Dadweynaha”.

entries.english: The United States Food and Drug Administration approves the use of the drug Belimumab (Benlysta) to treat lupus, the first drug to be approved for this purpose in 56 years.
entries.translation: Maamulka Cuntada iyo Dawooyinka ee Maraykanka ayaa oggolaaday isticmaalka dawada Belimumab (Benlysta) si loogu daweeyo lupus ka, oo ah dawadii ugu horraysay ee loo ansixiyo ujeeddadan in mudo 56 sano.

entries.english: The Bank of Korea increases the main interest rate in South Korea by a quarter percentage point to 3% due to concerns over inflation.
entries.translation: Bangiga Kuuriya ayaa kordhiyay qiimaha ribada ee ugu weyn ee Kuuriyada Koonfureed rubuc boqolkiiba dhibic ilaa 3% taas oo ay kaliftay walwal laga qabo sixir bararka.

entries.english: The New York Times newspaper announces it is to start charging people who access content on its website.
entries.translation: Wargayska New York Times ayaa ku sheegay inay bilaabi doonaan khidmada ageega taas oo ay bixin doonaan dadka istimaala boggooda internetka.

entries.english: Vitali Klitschko defeats Odlanier Solís via a controversial first-round technical knockout to retain the WBC Heavyweight Championship in Cologne, Germany.
entries.translation: Vitali Klitschko ayaa ka badiyay Odlanier Solís isaga oo u adeegsanaya ciyaar wanaag farsamo wareegga kobaad si uu u sii haysto WBC Heavyweight Championship ee Cologne, Germany.

entries.translation: Xaakim Maraykan ah ayaa hor istaagay heshiis dhex maray Google iyo daabacayaasha buugaagta Google, kuwas oo ku heshiiyay in buugagta lagu qoro bogga internetka ah ee Google.

entries.translation: Tokyo Electric Power Co. ayaa dib u bilawday sharciyadeedi ay ku damin jirtay korontada oo qaraxday kadib dhibaatooyin joogto ah oo ay sababeen dhulgariirkii Tōhoku iyo tsunami 2011kii.

entries.english: The US National Highway Traffic Safety Administration reports that the number of traffic deaths has fallen to 32,788 in 2010, the lowest level since 1949.
entries.translation: Maamulka badbaadada gaadiidka waddooyinka qaranka ee Mareykanka ayaa sheegay in tirada dhimashada gaadiidka ay hoos u dhacday 32,788 sanadkii 2010, waana heerka ugu hooseeya tan iyo 1949 kii.

entries.english: Almost half of China's dairies are to close after failing to obtain new licenses following a safety audit.

entries.english: The World Meteorological Organisation reports that the ozone layer is damaged to its worst extent ever in the Arctic.
entries.translation: Ururka Saadaasha Hawada Adduunka ayaa ku warramaya in lakabka ozoneka ee Ka koreeya dhulka baraflayda uu waxyeelladii abid ugu darnaa soo gaadhay.

entries.english: British prime minister David Cameron sets out to block his predecessor Gordon Brown's attempt to take the £270,000 per year role of head of the International Monetary Fund (IMF).
entries.translation: Raysal wasaaraha Ingiriiska David Cameron ayaa hor istaagay isku daygii madaxa hayada lacagta ee aduunka (IMF) Gordon Brown, inuu sanadkiiba qaato lacag dhan £270,000 oo pound.

entries.translation: Xoghayaha Arrimaha Dibedda ee New Jersey ayaa diidey Carl Lewis oo hore ugu guulaystay billaddii Olombikada si uu ugu tartamo Senetarka gobolka sababo la xiriira shuruudaha u qalmitaanka.

entries.translation: Susan Rice, oo ah danjiraha Mareykanka ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa ku eedeysay, Qadaafi inuu siiyay ciidamadiisa Viagra si ay ugu dhiiranadaan gaysashada kufsi wadareed.

entries.translation: Shaqaaluhu waxay galaan mid ka mid ah dhismooyinka ku yaal warshadda tamarta Nukliyeerka ee Fukushima I ee Japan markii ugu horreysay tan iyo markii uu qarax dhacay maalmo ka dib dhulgariirkii Tōhoku iyo tsunami ee 2011.

entries.translation: Daadadka Mississippi ayaa ka sii daraya, iyago ay Injineerada Ciidanka ay sheegeen in meel u dhaxaysa Simmesport, Louisiana iyo Baton Rouge laga yaabo inay ku fataho qoto dhan 20-30 cagood oo biyo ah.

entries.translation: Waxaa maanta si rasmi ah magaalada Adama loogu soo xidhay madbaca Green Legacy 2021, iyadoo ay goobjoog ka ahaayeen Ra’iisul Wasaaraha iyo mas’uuliyiin kale oo ka tirsan dowladda.

entries.english: Federal Government Procurement and Property Administration Agency announced that it has finalized preparations to start electronics procurement system technology (e-GP).
entries.translation: "Hay'adda maamulka iibka iyo hantida dowladda federaalka ayaa ku dhawaaqday in ay soo gabagabeysay diyaar garowgii ugu dambeeyay ee lagu bilaabi doono tignoolajiyada nidaamka wax iibsiga ee elektaroonigga ah (e-GP)."

entries.english: Designed by Hong Kong firm Hanson Robotics, Sophia has been programmed to speak Amharic, Ethiopia’s official language.
entries.translation: Waxaa naqshadaysay shirkadda Hong Kong ee Hanson Robotics, Sophia ayaa loo qorsheeyay inay ku hadasho Amxaariga, luqadda rasmiga ah ee Itoobiya.

entries.english: India is committed to further deepen its partnership with Ethiopia to support its development with innovation and technology.
entries.translation: Hindiya ayay ka go’an tahay inay sii xoojiso iskaashiga ay la leedahay Itoobiya si ay horumarkeeda uga taageerto hal abuur iyo teknoloji.

entries.english: The exhibition at the headquarters of Ministry of Innovation and Technology will remain open until December 14, 2019.
entries.translation: Bandhigga oo ka dhacaya xarunta Wasaaradda Hal abuurka iyo Tignoolajiyada ayaa sii furnaan doona ilaa December 14, 2019.

entries.english: The MoU was signed at the Ethiopia and China Industrial Matchmaking Conference held in Addis Ababa.
entries.translation: Is afgaradka ayaa lagu kala saxiixday Shirkii Is barbar dhigga Warshadaha ee Itoobiya iyo Shiinaha oo lagu qabtay Addis Ababa.

entries.english: At the conference, Trade and Industry State Minister Teka Gebreyesus said Ethiopia and China have good historical foundation to bring the current industrial cooperation into higher level.
entries.translation: Shirka, wasiirka ganacsiga iyo warshadaha Teka Gebreyesus ayaa sheegay in Itoobiya iyo Shiinaha ay leeyihiin aasaas taariikhi ah oo wanaagsan si ay iskaashiga warshadaha ee hadda jira u gaarsiiyaan heer sare.

entries.english: Ethiopians on Sunday morning witnessed the solar eclipse after the moon is moving between the sun and the earth obscuring the planet Earth.
entries.translation: Itoobiya ayaa subaxnimadii Axadda argtay cadceed madoobaad ka dib markii dayaxu u kala wareegayo qorraxda iyo dhulka oo qarinaya meeraha dhulka.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: The solar eclipse was visible in several cities across Ethiopia, including the historical town of Lalibela and the capital Addis Ababa starting from 6:50 a.m to 9:30 a.m.
entries.translation: Cadceed madoobaadkan ayaa laga arkay dhowr magaalooyin oo ku yaalla Itoobiya, sida magaalada taariikhiga ah ee Lalibela iyo caasimadda Addis Ababa laga bilaabanaysa 6:50 subaxnimo ilaa 9:30 subaxnimo.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Ambassador Teshome and Vice Minister Liu Hua noted that the two countries need to give impetus to their relationship with multifaceted bilateral and multilateral engagements in the future.
entries.translation: Danjire Teshome iyo wasiir ku xigeenka Liu Hua ayaa xusay in labada wadan looga baahan yahay inay xoojiyaan xidhiidhka ay la leeyihiin iskaashi dhinacyo badan leh oo labada dhinac ah mustaqbalka.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Finance Minister Ahmed Shide and a Safaricom delegation led by CEO Peter Ndegwa held discussion today.
entries.translation: Wasiirka maaliyadda Axmed Shide iyo wafdi ka socday Safaricom oo uu hoggaaminayay agaasimaha guud ee shirkadda Peter Ndegwa ayaa maanta wada tashi yeeshay.

entries.english: Safaricom Ethiopia delegation provided updates on its operations in the country, it was learned.
entries.translation: Weftiga Safaricom ee Itoobiya ayaa ka warbixiyey hawlaha ay dalka ka wadaan, sida la ogaaday.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Ministry of Health has signed a trilateral agreement with the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) and the China Atomic Energy Authority (CAEA).
entries.translation: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa heshiis saddex geesood ah la saxiixatay Hay’adda Tamarta Atoomikada ee Caalamiga ah (IAEA) iyo Hay’adda Tamarta Atoomikada ee Shiinaha (CAEA).

entries.english: Ethiopian Health Minister Dr. Lia Tadesse has met with the United States Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (US-CDC) Ethiopia’s new country director, Dr. Caroline Rayan.
entries.translation: Wasiirada caafimaadka Itoobiya Dr. Lia Tadesse ayaa la kulantay xarunta Maraykanka ee Xakamaynta iyo Kahortagga Cudurrada (US-CDC). Agaasimaha cusub ee dalka Itoobiya, Dr. Caroline Rayan.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Regular training for the health professionals is according to him, a basic assistance the ministry had gave to improve the efficiency treatment.
entries.translation: Tababarka joogtada ah ee xirfadlayaasha caafimaadka ayaa ah sida uu sheegay, kaalmada aasaasiga ah ee wasaaraddu ay siisay si kor loogu qaado waxtqabadka daaweynta.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Ethiopia began accelerated Maternal and Neonatal Tetanus Elimination (MNTE) efforts in 1999.
entries.translation: Itoobiya ayaa bilawday dardargelinta dadaallada Hooyada iyo Dhallaanka Tirtiritaanka Tetanus ka (MNTE) 1999kii.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Meat production today is nearly five times higher than in the early 1960s – from 70 million tonnes to more than 330 million tonnes in 2017.
entries.translation: Soo saarka hilibka maanta ayaa ku dhawaad shan jeer ka sareeya horraantii 1960 meeyadii - laga soo bilaabo 70 milyan oo tan ilaa in ka badan 330 milyan oo tan sanadka 2017.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: A big reason for this is that there are many more people to feed.
entries.translation: Sababta ugu weyn waa in ay jiraan dad badan oo dheeraad ah oo la quudiyo.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Mebrahtu’s motivation came from personal experience.
entries.translation: Dhiiranaanta Mebrahtu ayaa ka timid khibrad shakhsiyeed.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: This grant will benefit approximately 6.5 million Ethiopians in need, of which 50 percent are expected to be women.
entries.translation: Deeqdan waxaa ka faa'iidaysan doona ku dhawaad 6.5 milyan oo Itoobiyaan ah oo u baahan, kuwaas oo boqolkiiba 50 la rajaynayo inay dumar noqdaan.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Since it began operation in 2017, the hospital has provided health services for 116, 029 patients, of which 25 percent are mental disabled persons, it was learned.
entries.translation: Tan iyo markii uu bilaabay shaqada 2017, dhakharku wuxuu adeegyo caafimaad uu siiyay 116,029 bukaan, kuwaas oo 25 boqolkiiba ay yihiin dadka dhimirka ka jiran ah, sida la ogaaday.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: A cornerstone has been laid today, to build the Ethiopia’s first specialized cardiac care center in the capital at a cost of 40 million Euro.
entries.translation: Waxaa maanta la dhagax dhigay dhismaha xaruntii ugu horaysay ee lagu daryeelo wadnaha ee Itoobiya oo ay ku baxayso 40 milyan oo Yuuro.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Minister of Health, Dr. Amir Aman and The Netherland’s Ambassador to Ethiopia, Bengt Van Loosdrecht have laid the cornerstone to build the cardiac care center at Black Lion hospital.
entries.translation: Wasiirka Caafimaadka Dr. Amir Aman iyo Safiirka Netherlands u fadhiya Itoobiya, Bengt Van Loosdrecht ayaa dhagax dhigay dhismaha xarunta daryeelka wadnaha ee dhakhtarka Black Lion.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Gudaf Tsegay broke the women’s world record for the indoor 1500 metres on Tuesday after posting a time of three minutes, 53.09 seconds during a meeting in Lievin, France.
entries.translation: Gudaf Tsegay ayaa jabisay horyaalka dumarka aduunka ee orodka 1500 ee mitir Talaadadii ka dib markii ay soo dhigtay 3 daqiiqo iyo 53.09 ilbidhikhsi kulan ka dhacay magaalada Lievin ee dalka France.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Ethiopian Tsegay beat by more than two seconds the previous record set by her compatriot Genzebe Dibaba in Karlsruhe in 2014.
entries.translation: Tsegay Itobiyanka ah ayaa kaga guulaysatay in ka badan laba ilbiriqsi horyaalka hore ee ay dhigatay gabadha ay isku dhalashada yihiin ee Genzebe Dibaba ee Karlsruhe 2014kii.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Athlete Lena Hailu also won the French Indoor Championships in the 3000 meter while Athlete Habtam Alemu finished second in the French 800 meter.
entries.translation: Orodyahanada Lena Hailu ayaa sidoo kale ku guuleysatay Horyaalada gudaha ee Faransiiska ee 3000 mitir halka Oradyahan Habtam Alemu uu ku dhameystay kaalinta labaad ee 800 mitir ee Faransiiska.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: The first Great Ethiopian Run in North America is scheduled to take place in Minnesota, USA, on the 4th of July 2020.
entries.translation: Orodkii ugu horeeyay ee Great Ethiopian ayaa dhici doona Waqooyiga Maraykanka, ayaa loo qorsheeyay inuu ka dhaco Minnesota, USA, 4ta Luulyo 2020.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: The Great Ethiopian Run scheduled to take place for the first time outside Africa is also the 1st edition in the US.
entries.translation: Orodka weyn ee Itoobiya oo la qorsheeyay inuu markii ugu horeysay ka dhaco meel ka baxsan Afrika ayaa sidoo kale ah daabacaaddii 1 aad ee Mareykanka.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: The International Federation of Association Football (FIFA) will hold its 70th congress in Addis Ababa next year.
entries.translation: Fadareeshinka Caalamiga ah ee Kubadda Cagta (FIFA) ayaa shirweynihiisii 70 aad ku qaban doona Addis Ababa sanadka soo socda.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: The FIFA Congress, the most-critical gathering of international football’s governing body, used to assemble every two years.
entries.translation: Koongareeska FIFA, oo ah kulanka ugu muhiimsan ee maamulka kubbadda cagta caalamiga ah, ayaa la kulmi jiray labadii sanaba mar.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: According to chief of staff of the African Union chairperson, Ambassador Abdoulaye Diop the next congress will take place at the AU’s headquarters in Addis Ababa in May 2020.
entries.translation: Sida laga soo xigtay madaxa shaqaalaha ee guddoomiyaha Midowga Afrika, Ambassador Abdoulaye Diop shirweynaha soo socda ayaa ka dhici doona xarunta AU ee Addis Ababa May 2020.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: This year’s 18th Great Ethiopian Run has grown to become a major street festival in Africa attracting thousands locals and foreign tourists every year.
entries.translation: Orodkii 18 aad ee Itoobiya ayaa sanadkan noqday mid aad u weyn oo ka dhaca qaaradda Afrika oo ay sanad walba soo jiitaan kumanaan qof oo gudaha iyo dibadda ah.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: On today, thousands people have taken to the streets of Addis Ababa to take part in Africa’s biggest road race, a challenging 10km run at 10,000ft above sea level.
entries.translation: Maanta, kumannaan qof ayaa isugu soo baxay waddooyinka Addis Ababa si ay uga qaybgalaan tartanka ugu weyn qaaradda Afrika ee waddooyinka, orod wayn oo 10km ah oo 10,000ft ka sarreeya cabirka badda.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: On the day, a huge variety of runners from all age groups and fitness levels participated, it was indicated.
entries.translation: Maalintaas, orodyahanno aad u tiro badan oo ka kala socda kooxaha da' kasta iyo heerarka jirdhiska ayaa ka qaybqaatay, waa la tilmaamay.

entries.english: The Ethiopian National Football Team has qualified for the Africa Cup of Nations (CAF) today.
entries.translation: Xulka Kubadda Cagta ee Itoobiya ayaa maanta u soo baxay Koobka Qaramada Afrika ee CAF.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Ethiopia qualified for CAF after the match between Niger and Madagascar ended in a draw, while Cote d’Ivoire beat Ethiopia 3 to 1.
entries.translation: Itobiya ayaa u soo baxday CAF kadib ciyaartii dhex martay Niger iyo Madagaskar oo ku dhamaatay barbaro, halka Cote d’Ivoire ay 3 iyo 1 kaga guulaysatay Itobiya.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Letesenbet smashed the world record at the Valencia Half Marathon Trinidad Alfonso EDP, clocking 1:02:52 on her debut at the distance at the World Athletics Elite Label road race on Sunday.
entries.translation: Letesenbet ayaa jebisay horyaalka adduunka ee Valencia Half Marathon Trinidad Alfonso EDP, saacada 1:02:52 kulankeedii ugu horeeyay ee masaafada ay ka dhacday tartanka orodka wadada Elite Label ee ciyaaraha fudud Axadii.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Asher, a dedicated staff member of the club, immigrated to Israel from Ethiopia in 1991 and first came to the golf club 27 years ago.
entries.translation: Asher, oo ah xubin ka mid ah shaqaalaha naadiga, ayaa Israel uga soo haajiray Itoobiya 1991 kii, wuxuuna markii ugu horreysay yimid naadiga Golf ka 27 sano ka hor.

entries.english: In Betking Ethiopia Premier League match, happened in Hawasa, the champions Fasil Kenema beat Hadiya Hosaena 3 to 1.
entries.translation: Ciyaartii Betking Itobiya Premier League oo ka dhacday magaalada Hawasa ayaa kooxda Fasil Kenema ee horyaalka difaacanaysa ay 3 iyo 1 kaga badisay Hadiya Hosaena.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Fekadu Alemu has got a hat-trick in the game by scoring all the three goals for Fasil Kenema while Baye Gezahegn netted the only goal of Hadya Hosaena.
entries.translation: Fekadu Alemu ayaa kulankan saddexley ka dhaliyay kadib markii uu saddexda gool u dhaliyay kooxda Fasil Kenema halka Baye Gezahegn uu dhaliyay goolka kaliya ee uu dhaliyay Hadya Hosaena.

entries.english: In the league’s closing encounter of the first week, Sebeta Ketema and St. George drew nil.
entries.translation: Xidhitaanka horyaalka ee todobaadkii ugu horeeyay, Sebeta Ketema iyo St. George ayaa bar baro galay.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: The Ethiopian national anti-doping office said it has begun doping tests on athletes.
entries.translation: Xafiiska heer qaran ee la dagaalanka doping ka ee Itoobiya ayaa sheegay in uu bilaabay tijaabooyin lagu sameeyo ciyaartooyda.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: More than 150 elite athletes are undergoing the two-day tests being done in partnership with world athletics integrity unit, it said.
entries.translation: In ka badan 150 ciyaartoy oo caan ah ayaa maraya tijaabooyinka labada maalmood ah ee la samaynayo iyada oo lala kaashanayo qaybta daacadnimada ciyaaraha fudud ee adduunka, ayay tidhi.

entries.english: According to EBC, more than 22 Ethiopian experts are taking part in the anti-doping tests.
entries.translation: Sida laga soo xigtay EBC, in ka badan 22 khabiir oo Itoobiyaan ah ayaa ka qayb qaadanaya tijaabooyinka ka hortagga doping ka.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: After the break, Ethiopia’s Ridet Assrasahang pulled one back on 50 minutes.
entries.translation: Markii layskugu soo laabtay badhkii danbe ee ciyaarta ayuu Ridet Assrasahang ee Itoobiya udhaliyay hal gool 50 daqiiqo markay marayasay
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Substitute Ariet Odong made it 2-2 after the 78th minutes before the referee sent off Ethiopia’s coach Firew Hailegebral.
entries.translation: Ariet Odong oo bedel ku soo galay ayaa ciyaarta ka dhigay 2-2 ka dib daqiiqadii 78aad ka hor inta uusan garsooraha ciyaarta ka saarin ciyaarta tababaraha Itoobiya ee Firew Hailegebral.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: But the Ethiopian team did not give up and scored the winning goal through Turist Lema on 82 minutes.
entries.translation: Laakin kooxda Itobiya ma ayna quusan, waxaana goolka guusha u dhaliyay Turist Lema daqiiqadii 82aad.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: The South African National Football team has arrived in Bahir Dar for FIFA 2022 World Cup Qualifiers match they have tomorrow with their Ethiopian counterpart.
entries.translation: Xulka Qaranka kubada Koonfur Afrika ayaa soo gaaray magaalada Bahir Dar si ay uga qeyb galaan cayaarta isreeb-reebka Koobka Adduunka ee FIFA 2022 oo ay berri la yeelan doonaan dhiggooda dalka Itoobiya.

entries.english: As goal.com reported a few days ago, their Belgian Coach, Hugo Broos, said that their game with Ethiopia is “crucial.”
entries.translation: Sida goal.com ay qortay maalmo ka hor, Belgian tababarohooda, Hugo Broos, ayaa sheegay in kulanka ay la leeyihiin Itoobiya uu yahay “muhiim”.

entries.english: According to this outlet, ‘Broos has challenged his side to “do everything to get six points” from back-to-back matches against Ethiopia as the qualifiers enter top gear.’
entries.translation: Sida laga soo xigtay mawjadan, ‘Broos ayaa uu ku xujeeyay kooxdiisa in ay wax walba u sameeyaan sidii ay lix dhibcood u heli lahaayeen’ ciyaaraha is reeb reebka ah ee ay la ciyaarayaan Itoobiya.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: South African, the Bafana Bafana, is leading the group by a point ahead of Ghana, the Black Stars; and Ethiopia, the Walia Antelopes, placed third.
entries.translation: Xulka Koonfur Afrika, Bafana Bafana, ayaa ku hogaaminaya kooxdan, iyagoo hal dhibic ka sarreeya Ghana, Black Stars; iyo Itoobiya, Walia Antelopes, oo kaalinta saddexaad galay.

entries.english: It was the latest in a long line of staggering performances in the game-changing technology, which is reckoned to improve performance by between half a second and a second a lap.
entries.translation: Waxa ay ahayd tii ugu dambaysay ee bandhigyo cajiib ah oo lagu sameeyay tignoolajiyada ciyaarta beddeleysa, taas oo lagu tiriyo in ay horumariso waxqabadka inta u dhaxaysa nus ilbiriqsi iyo ilbiriqsi.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Gidey, who was running on the same Hengelo track where Hassan set her world record, always looked confident.
entries.translation: Gidey oo ordayay isla orodka Hengelo ee uu Xasan dhigay horyaalka aduunka ayaa waligiiba u ekaa mid isku kalsoon.
