entries.english: A package of three-day visits, a ten-day return ticket (ten days depending on the result) was prepared and additional packages would be discussed accordingly.
entries.translation: Xidhmada booqashooyin saddex maalmood ah, tigidh toban maalmood ah oo soo laabasho ah (toban maalmood iyadoo ku xidhan natiijada) ayaa la diyaariyey iyo xidhmooyin dheeraad ah ayaa laga tashan doonaa si waafaqsan.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Ghana and South Africa are separated by one point going into the last two group matches.
entries.translation: Ghana iyo South Africa ayaa hal dhibic ku kala baxay labadii kulan ee ugu dambeeyay ee kooxaha.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: It is, therefore, shocking that the Ethiopian Football Association would seek to take their home match against Ghana to South Africa.
entries.translation: Haddaba, waxaa wax laga naxo ah in xidhiidhka kubbadda cagta Itoobiya uu doonayo in uu ciyaarta gurigooda ee Ghana inlagu ciyaarsiiyo Koonfur Afrika.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: In his comments, Ashebir acknowledged that the Ethiopian Athletics Federation (EAF) has the mandate to select the athletes.
entries.translation: Faalloo, Ashebir ayaa qiray in Federeeshinka Ciyaaraha Fudud ee Itoobiya (EAF) uu u xilsaaran yahay xulashada ciyaartoyda.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: A runner who fled Ethiopia nearly a decade ago is preparing for Sunday's Tokyo Marathon with hopes of returning to Japan this summer as a member of the Refugee Olympic Team.
entries.translation: Orodyahan ka soo cararay Itoobiya ku dhawaad toban sano ka hor ayaa isku diyaarinaya orodka Tokyo Marathon axada isagoo rajaynaya inuu xagaagan ku laabto Japan isagoo xubin ka ah kooxda Olombikada Qaxoontiga.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: "I'm in good condition," he said during training on Thursday.
entries.translation: "Marxalad fiican ayaan ku jiraa," ayuu yiri intii lagu jiray tababarkii Khamiista.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: "I hope the weather will be nice, and (I want) to find a good pace for me and record my fastest time at the Tokyo Marathon."
entries.translation: "Waxaan rajeynayaa in cimiladu ay fiicnaan doonto, iyo (waxaan rabaa) inaan meel fiican helo oo aan qoro waqtigayga ugu dhakhsaha badan Marathon ka Tokyo."
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: The first Irrechaa Great Run is scheduled to take place in Addis Ababa on September 22, 2019
entries.translation: Orodka Wayn ee Irreejaa ayaa loogutalagalay inuu kadhaco Addis Abaab 22ka sabtembar 2019ka
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: During a press conference held on Thursday, Oromia Regional State Tourism Bureau stated that 50,000 runners and several elite athletes are expected to participate in the event.
entries.translation: Intii lagu guda jiray shir jaraa'id oo uu laqabtay Khamiistii, Xafiiska Dalxiiska ee Deegaanka Oromiya ayaa sheegay in 50,000 oo orodyahan ah iyo dhowr ciyaaryahan oo caan ah la filayo inay ka qaybgalaan tartanka.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: According to the organizers, the winners will be awarded with a prize.
entries.translation: Sida laga soo xigtay qabanqaabiyeyaasha, ku guuleystayaasha waxaa la siin doonaa abaalmarin.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: The FIFA referees committee has selected 27 referees, 42 assistants and 21 video assistants for VAR technology.
entries.translation: Guddiga siidhi wadayaasha ee FIFA ayaa soo doortay 27 siidhi wade, 42 caawiye, iyo 21 caawiyayaasha muuqaalka ah ee farsamada VAR.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: According to FIFA requirements, the referees should be at the right place at the right time to make the correct decision.
entries.translation: Sida ku cad shuruudaha FIFA, siidhi wade yaashu waa inay joogaan goobta saxda ah waqtiga saxda ah si ay u qaataan go'aanka saxda ah.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Well, there were different Taekwondo competitions in Addis Ababa and its regions held by the Ethiopian International Taekwondo Association
entries.translation: Hagaag, waxaa Addis Ababa iyo goboladeeda lagu qabtay tartano Taekwondo ga oo kala duwan oo ay qabatay Ururka Taekwondoga Itoobiya
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: During my young age, I had a chance to watch these competitions and in 2004, I competed in the Addis Ababa club championships.
entries.translation: Intii aan yaraa waxa aan fursad u helay in aan daawado tartammadan, waxaana sannadkii 2004tii aan ka qayb qaatay tartankii naadiyada Addis Ababa.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: After my debut competition,I have achieved several medals in all local tournaments.
entries.translation: Ka dib tartankii ugu horeeyay, waxaan ku guuleystey billado dhowr ah dhammaan tartamada deegaanka ah.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Following the resignation of my former instructor in 2008, I took a responsibility to manage Choi Hong Hi taekwondo club and since then, I have been working as an instructor.
entries.translation: Kadib iscasilaadii macalinkeygii hore ee 2008, waxaan qaaday masuuliyada maamulida naadiga Choi Hong Hi taekwondo ilaa markaas, waxaan u shaqaynayay macalin ahaan.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: So, my good performances helped me to participate in international competitions across the world.
entries.translation: Markaa, bandhigaygii wacnaa ayaa iga caawiyay inaan ka qayb galo tartamada caalamiga ah ee daafaha aduunka.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: The Ethiopian National Football Team has qualified for the Africa Cup of Nations (CAF).
entries.translation: Xulka qaranka Itoobiya ayaa u soo baxay koobka qaramada Afrika ee CAF.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: According to sources, Dawit won her first indoor competition in Prague in February 2014, running a time of 4:09.08 minutes.
entries.translation: Sida laga soo xigtay ilo wareedyada, Dawit ayaa ku guuleysatay tartankeedii ugu horreeyay ee gudaha Prague bishii Febraayo 2014, waxay ku orday 4:09.08 daqiiqo.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: At the Rabat Meeting she established herself among the world’s top 1500 m runners with a win in 3:59.53 minutes.
entries.translation: Kulankii Rabat, waxay nafteeda ka dhigtay mid ka mid ah orodyahannada 1500 mitir ee ugu sarreeya adduunka iyadoo ku guulaysatay 3:59.53 daqiiqo.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Letesenbet Gidey of Ethiopia smashed the world half marathon record with 1:02:52 at Valencia half-marathon, an average of 2:59 min/km!
entries.translation: Letesenbet Gidey oo u dhalatay dalka Itoobiya ayaa jabisay horyaalka orodka marathonka aduunka 1:02:52
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: She took more than a minute off Ruth Chepngetich’s 1:04:02 in Istanbul last April.
entries.translation: Waxay wax ka badisay hal daqiiqo ka qaadatay Ruth Chepngetich’s 1:04:02 ee Istanbul bishii Abriil ee la soo dhaafay.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Second placed Yalemzerf Yehualaw again dipped under 1:04 (1:03:51) after her previous result of 1:03:44 at Antrim Coast half was not ratified due to a short course.
entries.translation: Yalemzerf Yehualaw oo kaalinta labaad ku jirta ayaa markale hoos u dhacday 1:04 (1:03:51) kadib natiijadeedii hore ee 1:03:44 ee Antrim Coast kala badh lama ansixin koorsada gaaban awgeed.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Ethiopian Premier League Share Company has decided Mekelle 70 Enderta and Fasil Kenema football clubs to participate in the 2020/21 CAF continental club football competitions.
entries.translation: Shirkadda saami qaybsiga Premier League ee Itoobiya ayaa go’aamisay kooxaha kubbadda cagta ee Mekelle 70 Enderta iyo Fasil Kenema inay ka qaybgalaan tartamada kubbadda cagta qaaradda ee CAF 2020/21.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Accordingly, Mekelle 70 Enderta, champion of the 2011 E.C. (2018/19) Ethiopian Premier League season, will represent Ethiopia in the CAF Champions League.
entries.translation: Sidaas darteed, Mekelle 70 Enderta, horyaalka 2011 E.C. (2018/19) xilli ciyaareedka Premier League ee Itoobiya, ayaa matali doontaa Itoobiya CAF Champions League.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Leza, a radio show on Sheger FM 102.1 hosted by Berhanu Digaffe, has been organizing Leza Awards for seven years now.
entries.translation: Barnaamijka Leza oo ah barnaamij ka baxa Sheger FM 102.1 oo uu daadihiyo Berhanu Digaffe, ayaa qabanqaabinaysa Abaalmarinta Leza muddo 7 sano ah.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Recognizing talent by a selection of musicians and filmmakers, it has been one of the platforms where local artistic excellence is celebrated.
entries.translation: Aqoonsashada kartida ee xulashada fanaaniinta iyo filim sameeyayaasha, ayaa ahayd mid ka mid ah goobaha lagu xuso heerka sare ee fanka deegaanka.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Leza, the organizer of the event, also paid tribute to prominent singer Zeritu Getahun who had passed away the previous day.
entries.translation: Leza oo ah qaban qaabiyaha xaflada ayaa sidoo kale amaan u soo jeedisay fanaanada caanka ah ee Zeritu Getahun oo maalintii ka horeeysay geeriyootay.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Mulatu Astatke’s trailblazing album, Mulatu of Ethiopia, was officially rereleased on Friday May 19.
entries.translation: Albumka raadraaca Mulatu Astatke, Mulatuga Itoobiya, ayaa si rasmi ah loo sii daayay Jimcihii May 19 keedii.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Recorded in New York, the album from 1972 arrived at a time when Mulatu had begun to master the delicate fusion of styles needed to create Ethio jazz.
entries.translation: Waxaa lagu duubay New York, albamkan oo laga soo bilaabay 1972 ayaa soo gaadhay waqti uu Mulatu uu bilaabay inuu barto isku dhafka jilicsan ee qaababka loo baahan yahay si loo abuuro Ethio jazz.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: The comencement of Walta’s Televistion paves a way for an alternative platform that can market new ideas in a manner that can educate, inform and entertain the general public, watchers said.
entries.translation: Bilawga Telefiishanka Walta ayuu u gogol xaadhayaa madal kale oo suuq geyn karta fikrado cusub hab wax ku bari kara, wargelin kara oona maaweelin kara dadweynaha guud, ayay dhaheen daawadayaashu.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: The Center plans to prepare content in different local, regional and international languages. However, the programs which are being aired are in Amharic.
entries.translation: Xaruntu ayaa qorshaynaysaa in ay ku diyaariso nuxurka luuqadaha kala duwan ee deegaanka ah, gobolka iyo kuwa caalamiga ah. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, barnaamijyada la sii daayo ayaa ku baxa luuqada amxaariga.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: The independent satellite channel is currently producing 12 different programmes, incorporating psychology, law, music and drama, the publication reported.
entries.translation: Kanaalka sateliteka ee madaxbannaan ayaa hadda soo saaraya 12 barnaamij oo kala gadisan, oo ay ku jiraan cilmunafsiga, sharciga, muusikada iyo riwaayadaha, daabacaadda ayaa sheegtay.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: This time around however, Festal Tigray was for the first time celebrated colorfully in Mekelle the capital city of Tigray National Regional State.
entries.translation: Si kastaba ha ahaatee, markan, Festal Tigray ayaa markii ugu horeysay si heer sare ah looga xusay magaalada Mekelle ee magaalo madaxda deegaanka Tigray.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: These parks are designed to have swimming pools, basketball courtyards, amphitheaters and cafes, according to the Agency.
entries.translation: Jardiinooyinkaan loo sahmiyay in ay lahadaan barkadaha dabaasha, barxadaha kubbadda koleyga, aamfitiyaatarrada, iyo kafateeriyada, sida ay sheegtay Wakaaladdu.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: MultiChoice Ethiopia, a South African company that operates the DStv satellite television service, announced plan to significantly increase its investment in Ethiopia.
entries.translation: MultiChoice Ethiopia oo ah shirkad laga leeyahay dalka Koonfur Afrika oo maamusha adeega talefishinka Satelite ka ee DStv ayaa ku dhawaaqday qorshe ay si weyn uugu kordhinayso maal gashigeeda Itoobiya.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: The company said in a statement that it is looking to extensively expand its reach, investment in people and infrastructure in Ethiopia.
entries.translation: Shirkadda ayaa bayaan ay soo saartay ku sheegtay inay raadinayso inay si xoogan u ballaariso isgaadhsiinteda, maalgashiga dadka, iyo kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha ee Itoobiya.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: It is also planning to provide support to Ethiopian content and content creators including investing heavily in local content as part of its hyper local content strategy.
entries.translation: Waxa kale oo ay qorshaynaysaa in ay taageero u fidiso waxa ku jira Itoobiya iyo abuurayaasha ay ka mid tahay in si weyn loo maalgeliyo macluumaadka gudaha taas oo qayb ka ah istaraatiijiyadeeda xog-maxali ah.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: During the event, artists performed traditional dances that demonstrated the beauty of the diverse nations, nationalities and peoples of Ethiopia.
entries.translation: Intii ay xafladani socotay, fanaaniintu waxa ay soo bandhigeen ciyaaraha hidaha iyo dhaqanka oo ay ku muujinayeen quruxda shucuubta, qoomiyadaha iyo shucuubta kala duwan ee Itoobiya.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Ras Theater Director, Meron Teshale told ENA that art has a power to strengthen unity in diversity and show diversity as a source of peace and harmony.
entries.translation: Maareeyaha Tiyaatarka Ras, Meron Teshale ayaa ENA u sheegtay in fanku uu awood u leeyahay xoojinta midnimada kala duwanaanshaha iyo muujinta kala duwanaanta oo ah isha nabadda iyo wada jirka.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Poems, drama, music, and dance, among others, are important instruments to teach the people about the beauty of diversity with few words and through entertainment, she added.
entries.translation: Gabayada, Riwaayadaha, Muusiga, iyo Ciyaaruhu ay ka mid yihiin, ayaa ah qalabka muhiimka ah ee dadka lagu baro quruxda kala duwanaanshaha erayo kooban iyo maaweelo, ayay raacisay.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: The award was given as symbol of their unwavering commitments towards promoting peace and unity in their localities and the country at large.
entries.translation: Abaal marintan ayaa lagu siiyay sida hagar la’aanta ah ee ay uga go’an tahay horumarinta nabadda iyo midnimada deegaannadooda iyo guud ahaan dalka.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: In an exclusive interview with ENA, the deputy mayor said besides being a place where Timket is celebrated, Jan-Meda is a place for hosting many social events and sports.
entries.translation: Guddoomiye ku xigeenka oo wareysi gaar ah siisay ENA, ayaa sheegtay in marka laga soo tago in ay tahay goobta laga xuso Timket, Jan-Meda ay tahay meel lagu qabto munaasabado badan oo bulsho iyo ciyaaro.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: President Sahle-Work Zewde has met with the General Manager for Africa of CANAL+ Group who presented the company’s work in Ethiopia.
entries.translation: Madaxweyne Sahle-Work Zewde ayaa lakulantay maareeyaha guud ee Afrika ee CANAL+ Group oo u soo bandhigtay shaqada ay shirkaddu ka qabato dalka Itoobiya.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: CANAL+ Group has made a significant investment in the entertainment industry.
entries.translation: Kooxda CANAL+ ayaa maalgalin weyn ku samaysay warshadaha madadaalada.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: The second channel of Oromia Broadcasting Network (OBN), a regional broadcaster headquartered in Adama, has started trial transmissions today.
entries.translation: Kanaalka Labaad Ee Shabakada Wararka Oromiya (OBN) ee xarunteedu tahay magaalada Adama, ayaa maanta si tijaabo ah u bilawday baahinta wararka.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Meskel Square annually hosts the Meskel-Demera Religious Festival which has already been inscribed by UNESCO as world’s intangible heritage.
entries.translation: Fagaaraha Meskel sanad walba ayaa lagu qabtaa Bandhiga Diinta ee Meskel Demera kaas oo ay UNESCO ay u diwaan galisaly dhaxalka aan la taaban karin ee aduunka.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: The name Meskel derives from the Amharic term Holy Cross.
entries.translation: Magaca Meskel wuxuu ka yimid erayga Amxaariga ah ee calaamada kiristanka.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: President Sahle-Work Zewde received Imtiaz Patel, Chairperson of the Board of Multichoice Group.
entries.translation: Madaxweyne Sahle-Work Zewde ayaa qaabishay Imtiaz Patel, oo ah Guddoomiyaha Golaha Sare ee Kooxda Multichoice.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Fana television will migrate to SES satellite as of December 31st, 2020.
entries.translation: Telefiishanka Fana ayaa u guuri doonaa satalitka SES laga bilaabo Diseembar 31st, 2020.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Ethiosat is Ethiopia’s first-ever dedicated free-to-air (FTA) TV platform, hosted on SES’s NSS-12 satellite.
entries.translation: "Ethiosat waa madal TV-ga xorta ah (FTA) ee Itoobiya ee ugu horreysay abid, oo lagu qabto satellit SES's NSS-12."
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Ethiosat currently delivers 65 channels to Ethiopian homes, with 16 of those channels already in high definition (HD) quality.
entries.translation: Ethiosat waxay hadda gaadhsiisa 65 kanaal guryaha Itoobiya, iyadoo 16 ka mid ah kanaaladaas ay hore u ahaayeen kuwo tayo sare leh (HD).
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: The KUTU tour set out to embody the magic they have created through this alliance, with upcoming performances outside of Ethiopia and within Ethiopia as well.
entries.translation: Socdaalkii KUTU waxay u sammeeyeen sixirkii ay ku abuureen isbahaysigan, iyadoo ay soo socdaa bandhig faneedyo ka baxsan Itoobiya iyo weliba gudaha Itoobiya.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: The set included multilingual music from within Ethiopia, incorporating love songs, breakup anthems and folk songs in different languages.
entries.translation: Qaybtan waxa ka mid ahaa muusiga luuqadaha badan ku baxa ee laga keenay gudaha Itoobiya, oo lagu daray heeso jacayl, heeso jabin, iyo heeso wadani oo luuqado kala duwan ku qoran.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Amongst the list of people and institutions responsible for the growing culture is ‘Kushineta skates.’
entries.translation: Liiska dadka iyo hay'adaha ka mas'uulka ah dhaqanka sii kordhaya waxaa ka mid ah 'Kushineta skates'.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: “Kushineta is opening up its first store in megenagna and that’s a huge step forward,” said Yared, hoping the future is wide open for the industry.
entries.translation: “Kushineta ayaa furaysaa dukaankeedii ugu horreeyay ee megenagna taasina waa tallaabo weyn oo hore loo qaaday," ayuu yiri Yared, isagoo rajeynaya in mustaqbalka uu u furan yahay warshadaha.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: The Afro-Ukrainian hip hop trio consisting of the three Ethiopian-Ukrainian sisters, Bethlehem (Betty), Miriam and Siona Endale have already left an imprint on the Ukrainian hip-hop scene.
entries.translation: Saddexda fannaan ee Hip-hop ka ee Afro-Ukrain oo ka kooban saddexda walaalaha ah ee Ethiopian-Ukrainian, Bethlehem (Betty), Miriam, iyo Siona Endale ayaa mar hore ka tagay sawir goobta hip-hop ee Yukreeniyaan.

entries.english: Turkish investment in Ethiopia is increasing as more companies interested in doing business in the Horn of African country, Turkish Ambassador to Ethiopia Fatih Ulusoy said.
entries.translation: Maalgashiga Turkiga ee Itoobiya ayaa sii kordhaya iyadoo shirkado badan ay xiisaynayaan inay ganacsi ka sameeyaan Waddan geeska Afrika ah, Safiirka Turkiga u fadhiya Itoobiya Fatih Ulusoy ayaa sheegay.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Ethiopia, the largest investment destination for Turkey in Africa, has attracted close to half of the latter’s investment in the continent.
entries.translation: Itoobiya, oo ah goobta ugu weyn ee uu Turkigu ku maalgashaday Afrika, ayaa soo jiidatay ku dhawaad kala badh maalgashiga dambe ee qaaradda.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: In an exclusive interview with ENA, Ambassador Ulusoy said, Turkish foreign direct investment in Ethiopia has continued to increase.
entries.translation: Safiirka Ulusoy oo war bixin gaar ah siiyay ENA ayaa sheegay in maalgashiga tooska ah ee Turkiga uu ku sameynayo Itoobiya uu sii kordhayo.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Ministry of Mines announced that it will be implementing a policy change that will give metal and steel manufactures access to local iron ore in order to produce steel bars.
entries.translation: Wasaaradda Macdanta ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in ay dhaqan galin doonto isbedel sharciyeed oo keenaya in biraha iyo warshadaha biraha soo saara ay helaan birta dalka si ay u soo saaraan biraha.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Mines Minister Engineer Takele Uma said that the implementation of the new policy will eliminate the struggle manufacturers are facing including lack of raw material and forex.
entries.translation: Wasiirka Macdanta Injineer Takele Uma ayaa sheegay in hirgelinta sharcigan cusub ay meesha ka saarayso kurbooyinka soo wajaha oo ay ka mid yihiin alaab la’aan iyo sarifka lacagaha qalaad.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Tourism Ethiopia Director, Sileshi Girma told The Ethiopian Herald that they have identified 50 potential sites for investment in the coming 10 years in the tourism industry.
entries.translation: Agaasimaha Dalxiiska Itoobiya, Sileshi Girma ayaa u sheegay wargeyska The Ethiopian Herald in ay ogaadeen 50 goobood oo macquul ah in la maalgashado 10 ka sano ee soo socda waaxyada dalxiiska.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: He stated that the participation of the private sector in tourism and hospitality sectors has been good over the past years.
entries.translation: Wuxuu sheegay in ka qeyb qaadashada ganacsiga gaarka loo leeyahay ee dhanka dalxiiska iyo soo dhaweynta uu ahaa mid wanaagsan sanadihii lasoo dhaafay.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: However, there are challenges such as lack of access to loan from banks and most of the tourism destinations are far from the capital of Ethiopia, he added
entries.translation: Si kastaba ha ahaatee, waxaa jira caqabado ay ka mid yihiin helitaan la'aanta amaahaha bangiyada iyo inta badan goobaha dalxiiska oo aad uga fog caasimadda Itoobiya, ayuu raaciyay.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: The Soflet Malt which joined the Bole Lemi Indistrial Park with an outlay of 70 Million Euros has finalized preparations to start production on coming March 2021.
entries.translation: soufflet Malt oo ku biiray xerada Warshadaha ee Bole Lemi oo ay ku baxday 70 Milyan oo Yuuro ayaa dhsmaystiray diyaar garowga uu ku bilaabayo wax soo saarka soo socda Maarso 2021.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: According to Industrial Parks Development Corporation, Soulfflet Malt Ethiopia will have a capacity of producing 100,000 metric tons of malt per annum.
entries.translation: Sida laga soo xigtay Hay'adda Horumarinta xerada Warshadaha, Soulfflet Malt Itoobiya waxay heli doontaa awood ay ku soo saarto 100,000 metrik ton oo malt ah sannadkii ba.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) approved last month a program for Ethiopia of 2.9 billion US dollars.
entries.translation: Hay’adda Lacagta Adduunka (IMF) ayaa bishii hore u oggolaatay barnaamij ay Itoobiya siinayso lacag dhan 2.9 bilyan oo Doollarka Maraykanka ah.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: The program is aimed at supporting the homegrown economic reform agenda of the country.
entries.translation: Barnaamijkan ayaa loogu talagalay in lagu taageero qorshaha dib u habeynta dhaqaalaha dalka.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: The economic reform is designed to eliminate macroeconomic imbalances and lay the foundation for sustainable and inclusive growth.
entries.translation: Dib u habaynta dhaqaalaha ayaa loo qaabeeyey in lagu baabi'iyo dheelli tirnaanta la’aanta dhaqaale xumada oo seeska u ah koboc waara oo loo dhan yahay.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: According to IMF, the $2.9 billion program would facilitate Ethiopia’s transition to flexible exchange-rate system.
entries.translation: Sida laga soo xigtay IMF, barnaamijyada $2.9 bilyan ayaa fududayn doona u gudubka Itoobiya ee nidaamka sarifka dabacsanaanta.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: The country is importing daily the same amount of fuel as it was in the past days via Djibouti and Sudan with more than 300 fuel trucks, he said.
entries.translation: Waxaa uu sheegay in dalku uu maalin walba la soo galiyo cadad shidaal oo iskumid ah oo la soo dejin jiray Jabuuti iyo Suudaan isaga oo wata in kabadan 300 oo baabuur oo shidaal ah.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: The Ministry of Trade and Industry (MoTI) as well as the Ministry of Mines, Petroleum and Natural Gas said they are not authorized to control fuel distribution in the country.
entries.translation: Wasaaradda Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha iyo sidoo kale Wasaaradda Macdanta, Shidaalka iyo Gaaska Dabiiciga ah ayaa sheegay in aan loo fasaxin xakameynta qeybinta shidaalka dalka.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: The Minister said Ethiopia has introduced cadastral-based modern mining licensing and database system to promote investments in the sector.
entries.translation: Wasiirk ayaa sheegay in Itoobiya ay keentay shatiyo casri ah oo ku salaysan khariirad lahansho iyo nidaamka macluumaadka macdanta si kor loogu qaado maalgashiga qaybta.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: The system enables investors to see different investment opportunities, to request for license from where they are living and to pay payments in simple and clear way, he added.
entries.translation: Nidaamku wuxuu u suurtageliynayaa maalgashadayaasha inay arkaan fursado maalgashi oo kala duwan, inay ka codsadaan shatiga halka ay ku nool yihiin, oo ay u bixiyaan lacagaha si fudud oo cad, ayuu raaciyay.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: He stated that the Cadastre System assures conducive environment for investment by building trust and creating closeness among the community, the companies and the government.
entries.translation: Waxa uu sheegay in Nidaamka khariirada uu xaqiijinayo jawi ku habboon maalgashiga isagoo abuuraya kalsooni iyo abuurista isku soo dhawaansho bulshada, shirkadaha, iyo dowladda.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Ethiopia collected some $318 million from the export of flowers and other horticulture products Ethiopian fiscal year, which ended July 7, 2019.
entries.translation: Itoobiya ayaa $318 milyan oo doolar ka ururisay dhoofinta ubaxa iyo waxsoosaarka kale ee dhirta sanad miisaaniyadeedka Itoobiya, kaas oo dhamaaday July 7, 2019.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Ethiopian horticulture products' main export destinations are the Netherlands, Saudi Arabia, UK, USA, Japan, Norway, Germany, UAE, Belgium, and Italy.
entries.translation: Waxsoosaarka beeraha Itoobiya meelaha ay u dhoofiso waxa ugu badan waa Netherlands, Saudi Arabia, UK, USA, Japan, Norway, Germany, UAE, Belgium, iyo Italy.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Ethio-telecom has announced new tariff cuts on international voice calls and short text-messaging.
entries.translation: Ethio-telecom ayaa ku dhawaaqday in ay qiimaha dhimi doonto cusub ee wicitaanada codka ee caalamiga ah iyo fariimaha gaaban.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: In a press conference today, CEO of Ethio-telecom, Firehiwot Tamiru, said the company had made 10-40 percent reduction on international voice calls.
entries.translation: Shir jaraa’id oo uu maanta qabtay maareeyaha guud eed shirkadda Ethio-telecom, Firehiwot Tamiru, ayaa sheegay in shirkaddu ay hoos u dhigtay boqolkiiba 10-40 wicitaannada codadka caalamiga ah.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: She also announced up to 51 percent tariff cut on international short text-messaging.
entries.translation: Waxay sidoo kale ku dhawaaqday inay dhimayso boqolkiiba 51 qiimaha fariimaha gaaban ee caalamiga ah.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: The Ethiopian economy will maintain its growth lead for the East African region according to the latest World Bank report.
entries.translation: Dhaqaalaha Itoobiya ayaa sii wadi doona kobaca hogaaminta gobolka Bariga Afrika sida lagu sheegay warbixintii ugu dambeysay ee lagasoo xigteeyey Bangiga Adduunka.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: The latest forecast puts Ethiopia at a percentage point behind Ghana.
entries.translation: Saadaashii ugu dambeysay ayaa Itoobiya ka dhigaysaa boqolkiiba in ay dhibic ka dambeeyaan Ghana.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: The West African nation is forecast to grow at 8.3% as against Ethiopia’s 8.2%.
entries.translation: Dalka Galbeedka Afrika ayaa la saadaalinayaa inuu kori doono 8.3% marka loo eego Itoobiya oo ah 8.2%.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: “Among East African countries, Ethiopia is likely to remain the fastest growing economy, but growth is expected to soften as it takes measures to stabilize government debt.”
entries.translation: "Wadamada Bariga Afrika, Itoobiya waxay u badan tahay inay sii ahaato dhaqaalaha ugu kobaca badan, laakiin kobaca ayaa la filayaa inuu jilciyo marka ay qaadayso tallaabooyin lagu xasilinayo deynta dawladda."
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: The addition of Habesha Petroleum, JR-Petroleum Plc, Kernel Oil Trading Plc and Kalub Oil Ethiopia, pushed the total number of oil retail companies in the country to 22.
entries.translation: Ku darida Habesha Petroleum, JR-Petroleum Plc, Kernel Oil Trading Plc, Kalub Oil Ethiopia, ayaa tirada guud ee shirkadaha tafaariiqda shidaalka ee dalka ka dhigtay 22. shirkadood.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: JR-Petroleum is the latest entrant among the four companies opening its doors on December 25, 2017.
entries.translation: JR-Petroleum waa ka soo galayaashii ugu dambeeyay ee afarta shirkadood ee albaabada u furay 25 kii Diseembar, 2017.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: The company was established with a 21 million Br capital and is headquartered in Addis Ababa.
entries.translation: Shirkadda ayaa lagu aasaasay 21 milyan oo Birr xarunteeda dhexna waxay kutaala Addis Ababa.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Founded by three partners engaged in distributing fuel from Nile Petroleum under a franchise arrangement, JR currently runs eight filling stations.
entries.translation: Waxaa aasaasay saddex shuraako ah oo ku hawlan qaybinta shidaalka Niil Petroleum iyada oo la raacayo habayn ganacsi, JR hadda waxa ay maamushaa siddeed xarumood oo buuxin ah.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Ethiopia's year-on-year headline inflation crept up to 8.8 percent in June, up from 8.7 percent the previous month, the statistics office said on Tuesday.
entries.translation: Sicirbararka dalka Itoobiya sanadba sanadka kasii dambeeya ayuu kor u kacay ilaa 8.8 boqolkiiba bishii June, halka uu ka ahaa 8.7 boqolkiiba bishii hore, xafiiska tirakoobka ayaa sheegay Talaadadii.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: The Ministry of Trade has disclosed that it has planned to gain about 1.2 billion birr from the export of oilseeds and pulses this year.
entries.translation: Wasaaradda ganacsiga ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in sanadkan ay qorsheysay in 1.2 bilyan oo Birr ay ka faa’ideysato dhoofinta Shidaalka iyo Hilibka.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: The planned amount of export has increased by 26 percent as compared to the same period last year.
entries.translation: Qadarka la qorsheeyay ee dhoofinta ayaa kordhay 26 boqolkiiba marka loo eego isla muddadaas sannadkii hore.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: The drastic increase of Ethiopia’s debt stock has been a source of debate among policymakers, researchers and political analysts in Ethiopia for the last half a decade.
entries.translation: Korodhka daran ee kaydka deynta Itoobiya ayaa ahayd isha dood ka dhex dhalisay siyaasad dejiyeyaasha, cilmi baarayaasha, iyo falanqeeyayaasha siyaasadeed ee Itoobiya nuskii 10 ka sano ee la soo dhaafay.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: As the country’s total debt surpassed 50 billion dollars since 2017, the country has become among the most indebted economies in Africa.
entries.translation: Iyadoo wadarta guud ee deynta dalka lagu leeyahay ay kor u dhaaftay 50 bilyan oo doollar tan iyo 2017, waddanku wuxuu ka mid noqday dalalka Afrika ugu deynta badan.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Last week, the National Bank of Ethiopia introduced a new rule that forces depositors make a maximum of five transactions per week.
entries.translation: Toddobaadkii hore, Baangiga Qaranka Itoobiya ayaa soo saaray sharci cusub oo dhigaya in dadka wax dhigaanaya ay sameeyaan ugu badnaan shan dhaqdhaqaaq toddobaadkii.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Though this was meant to boost export earnings, while reducing import bills of the country, none of these have been realized so far.
entries.translation: In kasta oo tan loola jeeday in kor loo qaado dakhliga dhoofinta, iyada oo la dhimayo qiimaha soo dejinta ee lacagta dalka, midna ilaa hadda lagama fiirsan.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: While the country shipped an average of three billion dollars of goods annually in the last decade, its imports barely averaged 15 billion dollars.
entries.translation: Halka waddanku u soo dajin jiray celcelis ahaan saddex bilyan oo doollar oo badeecooyin ah sannadkii tobankii sano ee u dambeeyay, waxa uu la soo degay celcelis ahaan celcelis magaadhayso 15 bilyan oo doolar.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Accordingly, the MTN Group Ltd. and a consortium led by Vodafone Group Plc, have bid for the licenses.
entries.translation: Sidaas aawadeed, MTN Group Ltd. iyo dalad ay hogaamiso Vodafone Group Plc, ayaa u tartamaya shatiyada.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Ahmed told The Reporter that the company's bidding document is under evaluation and as soon as it gets the government’s approval, the results will be publicized.
entries.translation: Axmed ayaa u sheegay The Reporter in dukumentiga qandaraaska shirkadu uu yahay mid qiimayn lagu samaynayo, isla markaana marka ay dawladda oggolaato, natiijada la shaacin doono.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: According to Abayneh, this time, the zonal administration livestock and fishery office is finalizing all the necessary preconditions to relocate people who live in the surrounding areas to other places.
entries.translation: Sida laga soo xigteeyey Abayneh xiligan xafiiska xanaanada xoolaha iyo kaluumeysiga ee maamulka deegaanka uu soo gaba gabeeyay dhamaan shuruudihii looga baahnaa in dadka ku nool deegaanada ku xeeran loo raro meelo kale.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: For instance, Chencha, Dita, Gacho Baba and Bonki are some of the mountainous areas where the farming is taking place.
entries.translation: Tusaale ahaan, Chencha, Dita, Gacho Baba, iyo Bonki waa qaar ka mid ah meelaha buuraleyda ah ee beeraleydu ka socoto.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: According to a statement issued by the Ministry of Water, Irrigation and Energy of Ethiopia, the three countries negotiated on technical issues on the first filling and annual operation of the dam.
entries.translation: Sida lagu sheegay war saxaafadeed ay soo saartay wasaaradda biyaha, waraabka iyo tamarta ee Itoobiya, saddexda dal ayaa ka wada-hadlay arrimo farsamo oo ku saabsan buuxinta koowaad iyo shaqo sannadeedka biyo xidheenka.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: According to the minister, the harvest expected from 300,000 hectares of land this year would help produce 10 million quintals.
entries.translation: Sida uu sheegay wasiirku, dalaggii la filayey in laga soo saaro 300,000 oo hektar oo dhul ah sanadkan ay wax ka tari doonaan soo sarida 10 milyan oo quntal.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Even if it was possible to get more produce this harvest season, the flooding in Afar Region obstructed the effort to meet the target, he added.
entries.translation: Xataa hadii ay suurta gashay in lahelo wax soo saar badan xiligan dalagyada, fatahaada daadka ee ka dhacday Gobolka Canfarta ayaa hor istaagtay dadaalkii lagu rabay in lagu gaadho yoolka, ayuu raaciyay.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Some 90,000 hectares of irrigated land has been covered with wheat, the minister said, adding that best seed, chemical, fertilizer supplies have been properly provided.
entries.translation: Ilaa 90,000 oo hektar oo dhul waraab ah ayaa lagu daboolay sarreen, wuxuuna wasiirku sheegay in abuurkii ugu fiicnaa, kiimikaad, bacriminta si wanaagsan loo bixiyay.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: The Korea Forest Service has been expanding collaboration with Ethiopia to restore degraded forests through sustainable agroforestry.
entries.translation: Adeegga Kaymaha Kuuriya ayaa uu ballaadhinayey iskaashiga Itoobiya si loo soo celiyo kaymihii xaalufiyey iyada oo loo marayo dhir beeris waarta.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Ethiopian Environment and Forest Research Institute announced a plan to cover the Abay Gorge areas ranging from Kere Goha to Dejen town.
entries.translation: Machadka cilmi baadhista deegaanka iyo kaymaha Itoobiya ayaa ku dhawaaqday qorshe ay ku doonayso in ay ku daboosho deegaanada Abay Gorge ee u dhexeeya Kere Goha ilaa magaalada Dejen.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Located on the boundary of Oromia and Amhara region, the Abay Gorge is a serios of gorges to a depth of some 1,500 meters.
entries.translation: Dooxa Abay ayaa ku yaalaa xadka deegaanka Oromia iyo gobolka Axmaarada, waana doox taxane ah oo qoto dheer ilaa 1,500 mitir.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: The Ethiopian Soil Information System (EthioSIS) project was launched in 2012 to transform the agriculture sector by improving the fertility of farming soil to support agricultural transformation.
entries.translation: Mashruuca Nidaamka Macluumaadka Ciidda Itoobiya (EthioSIS) ayaa la bilaabay 2012 si loo beddelo qaybta beeraha iyada oo la wanaajinayo bacrinta ciidda beeraha si loo taageero isbeddelka beeraha.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Geo-hazards are affecting agricultural products and human life in selected areas of Southern Nations, Nationalities and Peoples Region (SNNPR) of Ethiopia, according to Geological Survey of Ethiopia.
entries.translation: Khataraha dhulka ayaa saameeynaysa wax soo saarka beeraha iyo nolosha bini'aadamka ee deegaanada laga soo doortay ee Shucuubta Koonfureed ee Itoobiya, sida ay sheegtay Sahanka Juquraafiga ee Itoobiya.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: The National Disaster Risk Management Commission warned about a potential flash flood in some parts of the country due to torrential rains in the coming days.
entries.translation: Guddiga qaranka ee ka hortagga khatarta musiibooyinka ayaa ka digay fatahyo ka dhalan kara roobab mahiigaan ah oo maalmaha soo socda ka da’aya deegaanada dalka qaarkood.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Prevalence of unsafe social gatherings are also negatively contributing to the intensification of the pandemic, he noted.
entries.translation: Baahitaanka shirarka bulsheed ee aan badbaadada lahayn ayaa sidoo kale si xun uga qayb qaadanaya xoojinta masiibada, ayuu sheegay.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Ministry of Health stressed the need for Health Professionals Competency Assessment and Certification to enable the community get access to quality health care services.
entries.translation: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa ku cadaadisay baahida loo qabo Qiimaynta Kartida Xirfadlayaasha Caafimaadka iyo shahaado siinta si bulshadu u hesho adeeg caafimaad oo tayo leh.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Evaluation aims to bridge skill gaps in health workers thereby realize quality services in the sector, Alemtsehay noted.
entries.translation: Qiimaynta waxa ay rabta in lagu soo dhameeyo daldaloolada xirfadeed ee shaqaalaha caafimaadka si loo xaqiijiyo adeegyada tayada leh ee qaybta, Alemtsehay ayaa xustay.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Ministry explained that the system helps screen out professionals who have skilled gaps, and help them get qualified through practical professional assessment.
entries.translation: Wasaaraddu waxay sharraxday in nidaamku uu ka caawinayo in la baadho xirfadlayaasha leh daldaloolooyinka xirfadda leh, iyo ka caawinta inay u qalmaan qiimeyn xirfadeed oo la taaban karo.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: The day was particularly marked in Addis Ababa at the Grand Anwar Mosque with various religious activities in the presence of religious scholars, residents of the city and government officials.
entries.translation: Maalintan ayaa si gaar ah magaalada Addis Ababa looga xusay masjidka weyn ee Anwar iyadoo ay ka soo qeyb galeen culimaa’udiin, shacabka magaalada iyo mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan dowladda.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Tourists who attended the festivity expressed their happiness with the peaceful the celebration despite that fact that the country is in state of emergency.
entries.translation: Dalxiisayaashii ka soo qeyb galay xaflada ayaa muujiyay sida ay ugu faraxsan yihiin in si nabad ah ay u dabaaldegaan iyadoo ay jirto in dalka uu ku jiro xaalad degdeg ah.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: They expressed their suspicion of instability before their arrival and also witnessed that the country is in calm and peaceful situation and suitable for touring.
entries.translation: Waxa ay muujiyeen shaki ay ka qabaan xasillooni darro ka hor inta aysan imaanin, waxayna sidoo kale ka marag kaceen in dalka uu ku jiro xaalad deggan oo nabad ah, kuna habboon in loo dalxiis tago.

entries.english: Irrecha, a thanksgiving festival of the Oromo people, has been celebrated at Hora Finfine in Addis Ababa today.
entries.translation: Magaalada Hora Finfine ee magaalada Addis ababa ayaa maanta si weyn looga xusay Irreeja oo ah xaflad mahad celin ah oo ay leeyihiin qoomiyada Oromada.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Ashenda is a unique religious and traditional festival celebrated every year in Tigray and Amhara Regional States between 16 to 21 August.
entries.translation: Ashenda waa munasabad diimeed iyo dhaqameed gaar ah oo sanad walba laga xuso deegaanka Tigray iyo Amxaarada inta u dhaxaysa 16 ilaa 21ka Ogosto.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Ashenda is a Tigrinya word meaning ‘’tall green grass that estimates around 80–90 centimeters minimum height.
entries.translation: Ashenda waa kelmad af Tigree oo macneheedu yahay '' caws cagaaran oo dheer kaas oo lagu qiyaaso dherer gaadhaya ugu yaraan 80-90 sentimitir.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: In the tradition of this religious festival, blades of grass are strewn on the floors of homes and shops as a kind of welcome mat.
entries.translation: Dhaqanka xafladan diiniga ah, caws baa lagu daadiyay gidaarada guryaha iyo dukaamada sida dacsada soo dhawaynta.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Unmarried girls and young women skillfully wove the grass into a bunch and wear them at their back while dancing on the occasion.
entries.translation: Hablaha aan la qabin iyo gabdho yaryar ayaa si xirfad leh cawska u tola oo ay dhabarka ku xidha iyagoo qoob ka ciyaara wakhtiga munaasabadda.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Abune Paulos, who died on August 16 at the age of 76 after an illness, was the patriarch of Ethiopia’s Orthodox Church since 1992, when he was elected to the highest order of the denomination.
entries.translation: Abune Paulos, oo dhintay 16 kii Ogosto isagoo 76 jir ah ka dib xanuun, wuxuu ahaa wadaad kaniisadda Ortodokska ee Itoobiya tan iyo 1992 markii loo doortay nidaamka ugu sarreeya ee diinta.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: His Holiness, Abune Paulos was also president of the World Council of Churches.
entries.translation: Mudanaha, Abune Paulos ayaa sidoo kale ahaa madaxa Golaha Kaniisadaha Adduunka.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed called on Muslims to remember and practice the teachings of Prophet Muhammad while celebrating his birth.
entries.translation: Ra’iisul Wasaare Abiy Axmed ayaa Muslimiinta ugu baaqay in ay xusuustaan kuna dhaqmaan manhajkii Nabi Muxamed marka ay u dabaal dagayaan dhalashadiisa.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: In a message he extended in connection to the celebration of the birth of the Prophet, Abiy called on Muslims to practice what the Prophet has taught while celebrating the festival known as Mawlid.
entries.translation: Farriin uu ku sii daray oo la xidhiidhta xuska dhalashada nabiga ayuu Abiy ugu baaqay muslimiinta in ay ku dhaqmaan wuxuu nabigu baray marka ay u dabaaldegayaan ciida loo yaqaan Mawliid ka.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Mawlid, the birth of the Prophet, is mainly celebrated with prayer, reading the Quran, singing spiritual songs that honor the Prophet, and offering food clothes to the poor.
entries.translation: Mawliidka oo ah dhalashadii nabiga ayaa inta badan lagu xusaa salaad, qur’aan akhris,nabi amaan, iyo in masaakiinta la quudiyo oo dhar lasiiyo.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Abiy noted that the Prophet taught that the world need four pillars to survive – teaching of the wise, justice of the elderly, prayer of the good and courage.
entries.translation: Abiy ayaa xusay in Nebigu baray in dunidu ay u baahan tahay afar tiir si ay u noolaato - waxbaridda kuwa caqliinta, caddaaladda waayeelka, ducada kuwa wanaagsan, iyo geesinimada.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Religious fathers serving at Lailbela Rock-hewn churches appreciated the visit of French President Emanuel Macron and requested speedy renovation of the historical site.
entries.translation: Aabayaasha diinta ee ka shaqeeya kaniisadaha Lalibela Rock-Hewn ayaa ka mahadceliyey booqashada madaxweynaha Faransiiska Emanuel Macron waxayna codsadeen in si degdeg ah loo dayactiro goobta taariikhiga ah.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: After visiting the Lalibel Rock-hewn churches on Tuesday, President Macron had pledged to give technical and financial support for the renovation of the churches.
entries.translation: Ka dib markii uu booqday Kaniisada Lalibel Rock-Hewn Talaadadii, Madaxweyne Macron ayaa uu ballan qaaday in uu taageero farsamo iyo mid maaliyadeedba ku bixinayo dayactirka kaniisadaha.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Some religious fathers who attended the welcoming ceremony for the president told ENA that urgent restoration is needed for the churches which are severely damaged.
entries.translation: Qaar ka mid ah baadariyiintii soo dhawaynta ka qeyb galay xaflada soo dhaweynta madaxweynaha ayaa ENA u sheegay in loo baahan yahay in si deg deg ah loo dayac tiro kaniisadaha oo burbur xooggan uu soo gaadhay.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: The newly established Japan-Korea-Ethiopia Friendship Association held a concert in Tokyo, Japan, with the view to strengthening the people-to-people relationship among the countries.
entries.translation: Ururka saaxiibtinimada ee dhawaan la aas aasay ee Japan-Korea-Itoobiya ayaa lagu qabtay magaalada Tokyo ee dalka Japan bandhig faneed ujeedadiisu ahayd sidii loo xoojin lahaa xidhiidhka ka dhexeeya labada dal.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: French National Order of Arts and Letters was bestowed upon the celebrated Ethiopian musician, Mulatu Astatke, today for his distinguished contributions.
entries.translation: French National Order of Arts and Letters ayaa maanta la guddoonsiiyay fannaanka caanka ah ee reer Itoobiya, Mulatu Astatke, wax qabadkiisa gaarka ah.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: French Culture Minister, Franck Riester said during the award giving ceremony that Mulatu has uplifted music to another level by combining Ethiopian and another melodies.
entries.translation: Wasiirka dhaqanka ee Faransiiska, Franck Riester ayaa intii ay socotay xaflada abaal marinta ah ka sheegay in Mulatu uu kor u qaaday fanka oo uu heer kale gaadhsiiyay isagoo isku daray laxanka Itoobiya iyo kuwa kale.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: “His innovative contribution to music, particularly jazz, has earned him a global prestige,” he added.
entries.translation: "Ka qaybqaadashadiisa hal abuurka ee muusiga, gaar ahaan jazz ka, ayuu ku kasbaday sumcad caalami ah," ayuu raaciyay.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Mulatu Astatke is an Ethiopian musician and arranger considered as the father of Ethio-Jazz.
entries.translation: Mulatu Astatke waa muusikiiste Itoobiyaan ah iyo qabanqaabiye loo arko inuu yahay aabaha Ethio-Jazz.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Six delegates representing Ethiopia have finalized preparations to partake in the Cannes film festival including model and actress, Gelila Bekele as well as Film producer Mehret Mandefro.
entries.translation: Lix ergo oo matalaya Itoobiya ayaa soo gabagabeeyay diyaargarow ay uga qayb qaadanayaan bandhiga filimada Cannes oo ay ku jiraan Model iyo Atariisho, Gelila Bekele iyo sidoo kale soo saaraha Filimada Mehret Mandefro.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: The working group will also produce a case study report that lay out the business for targeting the film industry as a job creation sector, she indicated.
entries.translation: Kooxda shaqadu waxay sidoo kale soo saari doontaa warbixin xaaladeed oo qaabayn doonta ganacsiga lagu beegsanayo warshadaha filimada sida waax shaqo abuur, ayay tilmaantay.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Tewodros Kassahun (Teddy Afro), Ethiopia’s best selling artist, controversial, often times poetic, at all times talented, released his long awaited album – Ethiopia – this week.
entries.translation: Tewodros Kassahun (Teddy Afro) oo ah fannaanka ugu iibka badan Itoobiya, kicinta badan leh, marar badan gabayaa, mar walbana karti badan, ayaa toddobaadkan soo saaray albamkiisii la wada sugayey ee Itoobiya.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: It has since shot to number 1 in Billboard’s World Album chart – a milestone for Ethiopian music.
entries.translation: Waxau ilaa hada fursad uu uhelay lambarka 1aad ee shaxanka Albumka Adduunka ee Billboard oo ah horumar u ah dhanka muusigga Itoobiya.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed has appreciated all those involved in organising a memorial concert in honour of Tilahun Gessesse.

entries.english: The organizer contributed more than 80 million birr proceeds collected towards the ‘Dine for Ethiopia’ initiative.

entries.english: “Thank you for leaving an indelible print on Ethiopia’s development,” the Prime Minister tweeted.

entries.english: This is the second installment of African Film Week, the first launched in 2016 with the African Union Culture Department.

entries.english: The Film Week hopes to bring African countries closer by showcasing each other’s works, forming a shared experience and creating opportunities for storytellers.
entries.translation: Toddobaadka Filimku waxa uu rajaynayaa in uu isu soo keeno waddamada Afrika iyada oo midba midka kale uu soo bandhigayo waxqabadkiisa, samaynta khibrad la wadaago, iyo abuurista fursado loogu talagalay sheeko yaqaannada.

entries.english: One of the uprising rappers, Lij Michael, is scheduled to perform on May 21 at Bole Fana Park.

entries.english: This concert focused on having a mini festival in introducing the best album, best singles and also best DJs in the country.

entries.english: They chose Lij Michael as their debut concert since his album entitled “Zare Yihun Nege” was well accepted among fans.
entries.translation: Waxay u doorteen Lij Michael bandhig faneed koodi ugu horeysay tan iyo albamkiisii uu cinwaankiisu ahaa "Zare Yihun Nege" taas oo si wanaagsan looga aqbalay taageerayaasha dhexdooda.

entries.english: Especially his single “Zemenay Marye” was able to capture audience ears easily.

entries.english: Mihret Dawit’s clay works exhibition was presented on April 21 at Asni Gallery.

entries.english: The versatile artist who is highly drawn about three dimensional forms has been initially experimenting with materials such as gypsum and cement to create sculptures.

entries.english: Situated at the Gullele Botanic Gardens, the festival features a wide range of activities for first-time campers, festival goers or seasoned outdoor enthusiasts.
entries.translation: Waxay ku taal Beerta Gullele, dabbaaldeggu ayaa soo bandhigayaa hawlo badan oo kala duwan oo loogu talagalay dadka ay hada uugu horayso , dabbaaldegayaasha ama kuwa xiiseeya bannaanka ee xilliyada leh.

entries.english: March 2018 was a big year for circus in Ethiopia as the second edition of the African Circus Arts Festival came to town.
entries.translation: Maarso 2018 waxa uu ahaa sanad aad u weyn oo loo qabto sarkas ka Itoobiya iyadoo daabacaaddii labaad ee Bandhig faneedka sarkas Afrika uu yimid magaalada.

entries.english: Thousands gathered to attend the spectacle.

entries.english: 11 circus troupes from across the continent joined the festival to showcase their works.

entries.english: Inside the largest circus tent to ever be erected in the country, the lights dimmed to welcome the South African troupe Zip Zap.

entries.english: Ethiopian Muslims all over the country are celebrating the Al Maulid Al nabawi or Prophet Mohammed’s Birthday with various religious events.
entries.translation: Muslimiinta Itoobiya ee ku nool guud ahaan dalka ayaa ku ciidaya munaasabado diini ah oo kala duwan oo ku saabsan mawliidka Al nabawi ama dhalashada Nabi Maxamed.

entries.english: In the capital, Addis Ababa, the Muslim Community celebrated Al Maulid Al Nabawi at the Grand Mosque with prayers and spiritual events commemorating the birth of Prophet Mohammed.
entries.translation: Magaalada madaxda Addis Ababa ayaa shacabka Muslimiinta ah ay Masjidka wayn sy ku qabteen duco iyo munaasabado ay ku xusayeen dhalashada Nabi Muxamed NNKH.

entries.english: Jimma, Hawassa and Dessie towns have also witnessed colorful celebration of the Eid al-Adha festival with both outdoor and indoor religious events.
entries.translation: Magaalooyinka Jimma, Hawassa, iyo Dessie ayaa sido kale si wanagsan loogu ciiday munaasabada Ciidul Adxaa oo isugu jirta dhacdooyin lagu qabtay gudaha iyo dibadba.

entries.english: Eid al-Adha is the feast of obedience and sacrifice that remembers the willingness of Prophet Ibrahim to sacrifice his son Ibrahim based on a call from God (Allah).
entries.translation: Ciidul-Adxa oo ah Ciidda Tawfiiqda iyo nusuga oo lagu xasuusto rabitaankii Nebi Ibraahiim uu u huray wiilkiisii Ibraahiim oo ku salaysan baaq ka yimid xagga Eebbe (Alle).

entries.english: The Ethiopian Orthodox Church Religious leaders and the clergy held prayers and masses at the Holy Trinity Church in the capital Addis Ababa commemorating the Holy Maundy.
entries.translation: Hogaamiyaasha iyo culumaa’uddiinka kaniisada ortodokiska Itoobiya ayaa duco iyo dad badan ku qabtay Kaniisadda Holy Trinity ee magaalada caasimadda ah ee Addis Ababa, iyagoo xusayay Maundy ga.

entries.english: Religious fathers and some clergy, while observing the holly day, made supplication to God to save the world from the coronavirus (COVID-19) pandemic.
